`grembyte/ui/widgets/icons.py`:

```py
"""Material Icons (Outlined) from ui/resources/icons, tinted to match the theme.

Also the colours of the current theme for widgets that colour their content
(``theme_color``, ``theme_qcolor``): status texts, pointers, value types.
"""

from functools import lru_cache
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from PySide6.QtCore import QByteArray, QEvent, QObject, QRectF, Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QGuiApplication, QIcon, QPainter, QPixmap  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtSvg import QSvgRenderer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

ICONS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "resources" / "icons"
# The logo, and the colour it is drawn in (scripts/make_logo.py); the toolbar
# shows it in the theme's "brand" colour instead.
BRAND_ICON = ICONS_DIR.parent / "favicon.svg"
_BRAND_FILE_COLOR = "#8cfa5a"
# The default theme, whose colours apply until a theme is applied (tests,
# widgets built without the main window).
_DEFAULT_THEME = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "themes"
                  / "grembyte_themes_Github-Dark.json")

# Text colours in styles.py: (normal, hover/selected, disabled) of menu items
# and of the kinds of buttons.
_MENU = ("#e6edf3", "#ffffff", "#484f58")
_BUTTON_COLORS = {
    "": ("#e6edf3", "#2f81f7", "#484f58"),
    "btn_danger": ("#f85149", "#ffffff", "#6e3a37"),
    "btn_primary": ("#ffffff", "#ffffff", "#6e7f99"),
}
_MENU_ICON_NAMES = {}
# The colours of the theme last applied; until then those of Github-Dark.
_DEFAULT_COLORS = json.loads(_DEFAULT_THEME.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["colors"]
_theme_colors = dict(_DEFAULT_COLORS)


def theme_color(key):
    """Return the colour ``key`` (e.g. "muted") of the current theme, as text."""
    return _theme_colors.get(key, _DEFAULT_COLORS.get(key, "#808080"))


def parse_color(value):
    """Return a theme colour (``#rrggbb`` or CSS ``rgba(r, g, b, a)``) as a QColor.

    QColor reads the hex form but not CSS rgba.
    """
    match = re.fullmatch(r"rgba\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*\)", value)
    if match:
        return QColor(int(match[1]), int(match[2]), int(match[3]), round(float(match[4]) * 255))
    return QColor(value)


def theme_qcolor(key):
    """Return the colour ``key`` of the current theme as a QColor."""
    return parse_color(theme_color(key))


def _render(name, color, size, ratio):
    """Paint the icon ``name`` in ``color`` on a square pixmap."""
    svg = (ICONS_DIR / f"{name}.svg").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    svg = re.sub(r'(<svg\b[^>]*?)\s+fill=(["\']).*?\2', r"\1", svg, count=1)
    return _paint(svg.replace("<svg ", f'<svg fill="{color}" ', 1), size, ratio)


def _paint(svg, size, ratio):
    """Paint the SVG text ``svg`` on a square pixmap of ``size`` logical pixels."""
    renderer = QSvgRenderer(QByteArray(svg.encode()))
    pixmap = QPixmap(round(size * ratio), round(size * ratio))
    pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(ratio)
    pixmap.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(pixmap)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
    # The target in logical pixels: without it the renderer misjudges the
    # size on scaled screens (device pixel ratio above 1) and crops the icon.
    renderer.render(painter, QRectF(0, 0, size, size))
    painter.end()
    return pixmap


@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def _icon(name, normal, active, disabled, size):
    screen = QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
    ratio = screen.devicePixelRatio() if screen else 1.0
    icon = QIcon()
    for mode, color in ((QIcon.Mode.Normal, normal), (QIcon.Mode.Active, active),
                        (QIcon.Mode.Selected, active), (QIcon.Mode.Disabled, disabled)):
        icon.addPixmap(_render(name, color, size, ratio), mode)
    return icon


def material_icon(name, size=16):
    """Return the icon ``name`` (e.g. "edit") coloured like menu items."""
    icon = _icon(name, *_MENU, size)
    _MENU_ICON_NAMES[icon.cacheKey()] = name
    return icon


class _ButtonIcon(QObject):
    """Shows a button's icon in its text colour, also while hovered."""

    def __init__(self, button):
        super().__init__(button)
        self.normal = self.hover = None
        self.name = None
        self.size = 16
        button.installEventFilter(self)

    def show(self, button, normal, hover):
        self.normal, self.hover = normal, hover
        button.setIcon(hover if button.underMouse() and button.isEnabled() else normal)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.Enter and watched.isEnabled():
            watched.setIcon(self.hover)
        elif event.type() in (QEvent.Type.Leave, QEvent.Type.EnabledChange):
            watched.setIcon(self.normal)
        return False


def set_button_icon(button, name, size=16):
    """Give ``button`` the icon ``name`` in the colours of its kind of button.

    Call it after the button's object name (btn_danger, btn_primary) is set,
    and again when it changes; also to change the icon, e.g. from "pause" to
    "play_arrow". ``name`` None takes the icon away.
    """
    holder = button.findChild(_ButtonIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
    if holder is None:
        holder = _ButtonIcon(button)
    holder.name = name
    holder.size = size
    if name is None:
        holder.show(button, QIcon(), QIcon())
        return
    normal, hover, disabled = _BUTTON_COLORS.get(button.objectName(), _BUTTON_COLORS[""])
    # Focus shows QIcon.Mode.Active: in the normal colour like the text.
    holder.show(button, _icon(name, normal, normal, disabled, size),
                _icon(name, hover, hover, disabled, size))


class _LabelIcon(QObject):
    """Remembers which icon a label shows, to tint it anew with the theme."""

    def __init__(self, label):
        super().__init__(label)
        self.name = None
        self.color_key = None
        self.size = 16


def set_label_icon(label, name, color_key, size=16):
    """Show the icon ``name`` on ``label`` in the theme colour ``color_key``.

    For a label of its own beside a text label, e.g. in the text's colour.
    """
    holder = label.findChild(_LabelIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
    if holder is None:
        holder = _LabelIcon(label)
    holder.name, holder.color_key, holder.size = name, color_key, size
    label.setPixmap(_render(name, theme_color(color_key), size, label.devicePixelRatioF()))


class _BrandIcon(QObject):
    """Marks a label that shows the logo, to colour it anew with the theme."""

    def __init__(self, label):
        super().__init__(label)
        self.size = 16


def set_brand_icon(label, size):
    """Show the logo on ``label`` in the theme's "brand" colour.

    The bright green of the logo file is hard to see on light themes; they
    give a darker one.
    """
    holder = label.findChild(_BrandIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
    if holder is None:
        holder = _BrandIcon(label)
    holder.size = size
    svg = BRAND_ICON.read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace(_BRAND_FILE_COLOR, theme_color("brand"))
    label.setPixmap(_paint(svg, size, label.devicePixelRatioF()))


def apply_icon_theme(colors):
    """Tint menu, button and label icons to match a theme, updating existing
    widgets; theme_color gives its colours from now on."""
    global _MENU, _BUTTON_COLORS  # pylint: disable=global-statement
    _theme_colors.clear()
    _theme_colors.update(colors)
    previous_menu_icons = dict(_MENU_ICON_NAMES)
    _MENU = (colors["text"], colors["white"], colors["disabled_text"])
    _BUTTON_COLORS = {
        "": (colors["text"], colors["accent"], colors["disabled_text"]),
        "btn_danger": (colors["danger"], colors["white"], colors["danger_disabled_text"]),
        "btn_primary": (colors["white"], colors["white"], colors["accent_disabled_text"]),
    }
    _icon.cache_clear()
    _MENU_ICON_NAMES.clear()

    application = QApplication.instance()
    if application is None:
        return
    for widget in application.allWidgets():
        for action in widget.actions():
            name = previous_menu_icons.get(action.icon().cacheKey())
            if name is not None:
                action.setIcon(material_icon(name))
        holder = widget.findChild(
            _ButtonIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
        if holder is not None:
            set_button_icon(widget, holder.name, holder.size)
        label_icon = widget.findChild(
            _LabelIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
        if label_icon is not None:
            set_label_icon(widget, label_icon.name, label_icon.color_key, label_icon.size)
        brand_icon = widget.findChild(
            _BrandIcon, options=Qt.FindChildOption.FindDirectChildrenOnly)
        if brand_icon is not None:
            set_brand_icon(widget, brand_icon.size)
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/inspection.py`:

```py
"""The object inspectors and text viewers a window opens through its MethodMonitorWorker."""

import json

import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QPoint, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import RIGHT, find_dock_manager
from grembyte.ui.widgets.object_inspector import ObjectInspectorDialog
from grembyte.ui.widgets.text_viewer import TextViewerDialog

# The kind of dialog docked (see DockManager)
INSPECTOR = "inspector"


class Inspections(QObject):
    """Open object inspectors and string viewers for ``window``.

    Their requests go to ``worker`` (a MethodMonitorWorker or ScriptWorker:
    ``inspect``, ``evaluate``, ``list_methods``, ``full_text``), the answers
    back to the dialog that asked. An inspector calls an object's methods
    through a MethodCallDialog on the same worker. ``time()`` names when
    shown values were read, for the viewers' titles.
    """

    # a field of an inspected object to put on the address list (see ObjectInspectorDialog)
    address_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, worker, window, time=lambda: ""):
        super().__init__(window)
        self.translations = translations
        self._worker = worker
        self._window = window
        self._time = time
        # open object inspectors; inspection request id -> waiting inspector
        self.inspectors = []
        self._inspections = {}
        # request id -> TextViewerDialog waiting for a long string's whole text
        self._text_requests = {}
        worker.inspected.connect(self._on_inspected)
        worker.inspect_failed.connect(self._on_inspect_failed)
        worker.evaluated.connect(self._on_evaluated)
        worker.evaluate_failed.connect(self._on_evaluate_failed)
        worker.methods_listed.connect(self._on_methods_listed)
        worker.methods_failed.connect(self._on_methods_failed)
        worker.text_fetched.connect(self._on_text_fetched)
        worker.text_failed.connect(self._on_text_failed)

    # --- Object inspector ------------------------------------------------------
    def inspect(self, target, origin=None, name="", instance_name=None):
        """Show the current fields of ``target`` in a dialog of its own.

        ``origin`` is the dialog it was opened from (one level less deep);
        ``instance_name`` the object's name if known (see ObjectInspectorDialog).
        """
        self.show_inspector(ObjectInspectorDialog(
            self.translations, self.inspect, target=target, request=self._request_inspection,
            evaluate=self._request_evaluation, name=name,
            depth=1 if origin is None else origin.depth + 1, parent=self._window,
            show_text=self.show_text, list_methods=self._request_methods,
            call_method=self.call_method, instance_name=instance_name,
            pid=self._worker.pid), origin)

    def inspect_snapshot(self, target, snapshot, captured, name=""):
        """Show the fields of ``target`` as recorded at a call (``snapshot``)."""
        self.show_inspector(ObjectInspectorDialog(
            self.translations, self.inspect, target=target, contents=snapshot,
            captured=captured, evaluate=self._request_evaluation, name=name,
            parent=self._window, show_text=self.show_text,
            list_methods=self._request_methods, call_method=self.call_method,
            pid=self._worker.pid))

    def show_inspector(self, inspector, origin=None):
        """Show ``inspector``: docked in the main window as a tab if the last
        one was or ``origin`` is (see grembyte.ui.widgets.docking), else as a
        window of its own."""
        self.inspectors.append(inspector)
        inspector.address_requested.connect(self.address_requested.emit)
        inspector.destroyed.connect(self._forget_inspectors)
        floating_origin = origin is not None and origin.isWindow()
        if floating_origin:
            # Opened from another window: a little offset, so both stay visible.
            inspector.move(origin.pos() + QPoint(32, 32))
        manager = find_dock_manager(self._window)
        if manager is None:
            inspector.show()
            inspector.activateWindow()
            return
        # One opened from a docked inspector goes next to it
        docked_origin = origin is not None and not floating_origin
        manager.add(inspector, INSPECTOR, RIGHT, dock=True if docked_origin else None)

    # Slots for ``destroyed`` are bound methods, not lambdas: PySide does not
    # call a bound method of a dialog the garbage collector is taking apart,
    # while a lambda's ``self`` may already be cleared then (a fatal error in
    # the slot). The destroyed object is not the wrapper we keep, but that
    # one is marked as deleted already.
    def _forget_inspectors(self, _object=None):
        self.inspectors = [inspector for inspector in self.inspectors
                           if getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(inspector)]
        for request_id, waiting in list(self._inspections.items()):
            if not getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(waiting):
                del self._inspections[request_id]

    def _request_inspection(self, target, inspector):
        self._inspections[self._worker.inspect(target)] = inspector

    def _request_evaluation(self, target, names, inspector):
        self._inspections[self._worker.evaluate(target, names)] = inspector

    def _on_evaluated(self, request_id, results):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_properties(results)

    def _on_evaluate_failed(self, request_id, message):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_property_error(message)

    def _request_methods(self, target, inspector):
        self._inspections[self._worker.list_methods(target)] = inspector

    def _on_methods_listed(self, request_id, methods):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_methods(methods)

    def _on_methods_failed(self, request_id, message):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_methods_error(message)

    def call_method(self, target, entry, inspector, object_text):
        """Offer to call the instance method ``entry`` (see ``list_methods``)
        on ``target`` in the method call dialog of ``inspector``."""
        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        # method_call opens object inspectors through this module itself.
        from grembyte.ui.widgets.method_call import MethodCallDialog
        dialog = inspector.findChild(MethodCallDialog)
        if dialog is None:
            dialog = MethodCallDialog(self.translations, parent=inspector, worker=self._worker)
            dialog.address_requested.connect(self.address_requested.emit)
            dialog.call_done.connect(inspector.on_call_done)
        dialog.set_instance_method(target, entry, object_text)
        dialog.show()
        dialog.raise_()
        dialog.activateWindow()
        return dialog

    def _on_inspected(self, request_id, contents):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_contents(contents)

    def _on_inspect_failed(self, request_id, message):
        inspector = self._inspections.pop(request_id, None)
        if inspector is not None:
            inspector.show_error(message)

    # --- Long texts ------------------------------------------------------------
    def show_text(self, value, name, time=None):
        """Open a string value whole in a window of its own; a long one comes
        from the agent. ``time``: when the value was read (else ``time()``)."""
        title = self.translations["monitor.full_text_title"].format(
            name=name, time=time or self._time())
        if value.get("fullText"):
            viewer = TextViewerDialog(self.translations, title, parent=self._window)
            self._text_requests[self._worker.full_text(value["fullText"])] = (viewer, value)
            viewer.destroyed.connect(self._forget_texts)
        else:
            # Short: the text is all there, as a JSON string literal.
            viewer = TextViewerDialog(self.translations, title, json.loads(value["text"]),
                                      parent=self._window)
        viewer.show()
        viewer.activateWindow()

    def _forget_texts(self, _object=None):
        for request_id, (waiting, _value) in list(self._text_requests.items()):
            if not getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(waiting):
                del self._text_requests[request_id]

    def _on_text_fetched(self, request_id, text):
        viewer, value = self._text_requests.pop(request_id, (None, None))
        if viewer is None:
            return
        if text is None:
            viewer.show_missing()
        else:
            viewer.set_text(text, value.get("length"))

    def _on_text_failed(self, request_id, message):
        viewer, _value = self._text_requests.pop(request_id, (None, None))
        if viewer is not None:
            viewer.show_error(message)

```

```py
"""Choosing a game read before, for the offline catalog (see grembyte.features.games)."""

from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QDialog,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from grembyte.engines.registry import engine_by_id
from grembyte.features.games import known_games
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height

_GAME, _ENGINE, _UPDATED, _ASSEMBLIES, _PATH = range(5)


class KnownGamesDialog(QDialog):
    """List the games whose catalog was read; ``game`` is the one chosen.

    Only games of an engine Grembyte knows are offered (``engine_by_id``).
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, directory=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.game = None
        self.games = [game for game in known_games(directory)
                      if engine_by_id(game.engine) is not None]
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["games.title"])
        self.resize(900, 420)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = QLabel(translations["games.hint" if self.games else "games.none"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self.table = QTableWidget(len(self.games), 5)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([translations[f"games.column_{key}"] for key in
                                              ("game", "engine", "updated", "assemblies", "path")])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        for row, game in enumerate(self.games):
            cached = sum(1 for assembly in game.assemblies if assembly.get("mvid"))
            for column, text in (
                    (_GAME, game.name),
                    (_ENGINE, engine_by_id(game.engine).display_name),
                    (_UPDATED, datetime.fromtimestamp(game.updated).strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")),
                    (_ASSEMBLIES, str(cached)),
                    (_PATH, game.path)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == _ASSEMBLIES:
                    item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in (_GAME, _ENGINE, _UPDATED, _ASSEMBLIES):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_PATH, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, translations)
        self.table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _row, _column: self._accept())
        if self.games:
            self.table.selectRow(0)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(translations, "games.open", self._accept, self.reject))

    def _accept(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if 0 <= row < len(self.games):
            self.game = self.games[row]
            self.accept()
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/labels.py`:

```py
"""Label widgets shared by dialogs."""

import math
from html import escape

from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QTextOption  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QFrame,
    QLabel,
    QSizePolicy,
    QTextEdit,
)

from grembyte.ui.links import docs_url
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import theme_color


class SelectableText(QTextEdit):
    """Selectable text that looks like a label and wraps anywhere.

    For long names without spaces, such as method signatures. A QLabel
    wraps only at spaces, and without wrapping it asks for the width of its
    whole text: its dialog grew beyond the screen. This one breaks lines
    anywhere when a word does not fit, takes the height its lines need, and
    copies the text as it is.
    """

    def __init__(self, text="", parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setReadOnly(True)
        self.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse
                                     | Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByKeyboard)
        self.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        self.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.setWordWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed)
        self.document().setDocumentMargin(0)
        self.setText(text)

    def text(self):
        """The text shown."""
        return self.toPlainText()

    def setText(self, text):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Show ``text`` and take the height its lines need."""
        self.setPlainText(text)
        self._fit_height()

    def sizeHint(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Any width; the height of the text."""
        return QSize(0, self.height())

    def minimumSizeHint(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Any width; the height of the text."""
        return self.sizeHint()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Lay out the lines for the new width."""
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._fit_height()

    def _fit_height(self):
        # An empty text keeps the height of one line, so nothing jumps.
        document = self.document()
        document.setTextWidth(self.viewport().width())
        height = math.ceil(document.size().height()) + self.frameWidth() * 2
        if height != self.height():
            self.setFixedHeight(height)


class WrappedLabel(QLabel):
    """Word-wrapped label that reserves the height its text needs.

    QLabel reports the minimum height of wrapped text for an arbitrary width,
    so layouts (e.g. inside a QSplitter) can give it too little room and the
    text overlaps the widgets around it. This label sets its minimum height
    from its actual width instead.
    """

    def __init__(self, text="", parent=None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.setWordWrap(True)

    def setText(self, text):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Set the text and recompute the needed height."""
        super().setText(text)
        self._fit_height()

    def resizeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Recompute the needed height for the new width."""
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._fit_height()

    def _fit_height(self):
        current = self.minimumHeight()
        # heightForWidth() never goes below the minimum height; lift it first
        # so the label can shrink again when it gets wider.
        self.setMinimumHeight(0)
        height = self.heightForWidth(self.width()) if self.text() else 0
        self.setMinimumHeight(max(height, 0) if height != current else current)


class DocsHint(WrappedLabel):
    """A dialog's muted hint text, ending with a link to its page in the documentation.

    The hints in the windows stay short; the documentation explains the rest.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, text, page, parent=None):
        super().__init__("", parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.setTextFormat(Qt.TextFormat.RichText)
        self.setOpenExternalLinks(True)
        self.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextBrowserInteraction)
        self.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        self._link_color = theme_color("accent")
        self.set_hint(text, page)

    def set_hint(self, text, page):
        """Show ``text`` and the link to ``page``."""
        link = (f'<a href="{escape(docs_url(page), quote=True)}" '
                f'style="color: {self._link_color};">'
                f'{escape(self.translations["docs.more"])}</a>')
        self.setText(f"{escape(text)} {link}")

```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/log_view.py`:

```py
"""The application log in a window, and a dialog for unexpected errors."""

import time

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QUrl, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QDesktopServices, QFontDatabase, QGuiApplication, QTextCursor  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from grembyte.core import activity, logs
from grembyte.ui.export_folder import remember, suggested_path
from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import PinButton
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color


# Lines of the log the window shows at most (the newest).
MAX_LINES = 3000
_PROBLEMS = (" WARNING ", " ERROR ", " CRITICAL ")


def read_log(path, problems_only=False, max_lines=MAX_LINES):
    """The newest lines of the log; with ``problems_only`` only warnings and
    errors (with their tracebacks). None if there is no log file."""
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as file:
            lines = file.read().splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None
    if problems_only:
        kept = []
        keep = False
        for line in lines:
            # A record starts with its date; other lines continue the last one.
            if line[:4].isdigit() and line[4:5] == "-":
                keep = any(level in line[:60] for level in _PROBLEMS)
            if keep:
                kept.append(line)
        lines = kept
    return lines[-max_lines:]


def activity_lines(path, max_lines=MAX_LINES):
    """The newest entries of ``activity.jsonl`` as lines, or None without the file."""
    entries = activity.read_entries(path, max_lines)
    if entries is None:
        return None
    lines = []
    run = None
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.get("run") != run:
            run = entry.get("run")
            lines.append(f"--- {entry.get('t', '')[:10]} run {run} ---")
        lines.append(activity.describe_entry(entry))
    return lines


class LogDialog(QDialog):
    """The newest entries of ``grembyte.log`` or of the activity log."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.path = logs.log_path()
        self.activity_path = activity.activity_path()
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["log.title"])
        self.resize(1000, 600)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        self.source_combo = QComboBox()
        self.source_combo.addItem(translations["log.source_log"], "log")
        self.source_combo.addItem(translations["log.source_activity"], "activity")
        self.source_combo.setToolTip(translations["log.source_tooltip"])
        self.source_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(lambda _index: self.refresh())
        top.addWidget(self.source_combo)
        self.path_label = QLabel()
        self.path_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        top.addWidget(self.path_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(top)
        self.text = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.text.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text.setLineWrapMode(QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.NoWrap)
        self.text.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        layout.addWidget(self.text, 1)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.problems_check = QCheckBox(translations["log.problems_only"])
        self.problems_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self.refresh())
        buttons.addWidget(self.problems_check)
        buttons.addStretch()
        refresh = QPushButton(translations["log.refresh"])
        set_button_icon(refresh, "refresh")
        refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        buttons.addWidget(refresh)
        copy = QPushButton(translations["log.copy"])
        set_button_icon(copy, "content_copy")
        copy.clicked.connect(lambda: QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(self.text.toPlainText()))
        buttons.addWidget(copy)
        folder = QPushButton(translations["log.open_folder"])
        set_button_icon(folder, "folder_open")
        folder.setToolTip(translations["log.open_folder_tooltip"])
        folder.clicked.connect(
            lambda: QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(self.path.parent))))
        buttons.addWidget(folder)
        export = QPushButton(translations["log.export"])
        set_button_icon(export, "upload_file")
        export.setToolTip(translations["log.export_tooltip"])
        export.clicked.connect(self._export)
        buttons.addWidget(export)
        self.pin_button = PinButton(translations)
        buttons.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        self.refresh()

    def showing_activity(self):
        return self.source_combo.currentData() == "activity"

    def refresh(self):
        activity_shown = self.showing_activity()
        path = self.activity_path if activity_shown else self.path
        self.path_label.setText(self.translations["log.path"].format(path=path))
        self.problems_check.setEnabled(not activity_shown)
        lines = (activity_lines(path) if activity_shown
                 else read_log(path, self.problems_check.isChecked()))
        # Switched off in the settings: say so rather than only that the file is missing.
        note = (self.translations["log.activity_off"]
                if activity_shown and not activity.enabled() else None)
        if lines is None:
            missing = self.translations["log.missing"].format(path=path)
            self.text.setPlainText(missing if note is None else f"{note}\n\n{missing}")
            return
        if note is not None:
            lines = [note, ""] + lines
        self.text.setPlainText("\n".join(lines) if lines else self.translations["log.empty"])
        self.text.moveCursor(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)

    def _export(self):
        name = time.strftime("grembyte-report-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.zip")
        target, _filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, self.translations["log.export"], suggested_path(name),
            self.translations["log.export_filter"])
        if not target:
            return
        remember(target)
        try:
            files = activity.export_report(target, self.path.parent)
        except OSError as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, self.translations["log.export"],
                                self.translations["log.export_failed"].format(error=error))
            return
        QMessageBox.information(self, self.translations["log.export"],
                                self.translations["log.exported"].format(
                                    path=target, count=len(files)))


class ErrorReporter(QObject):
    """Shows exceptions nothing caught (see ``logs.install_exception_hooks``).

    They may happen in any thread; the dialog opens in the GUI thread. While
    one is shown, further ones are only counted (they are in the log).
    """

    unhandled = Signal(str, str)

    def __init__(self, translations, open_log, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.open_log = open_log
        self._box = None
        self._more = 0
        self.unhandled.connect(self._show)
        logs.on_unhandled(self.unhandled.emit)

    def _show(self, summary, details):
        if self._box is not None:
            self._more += 1
            self._box.setInformativeText(self.translations["error.more"].format(count=self._more))
            return
        box = QMessageBox(self.parent())
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Critical)
        box.setWindowTitle(self.translations["error.title"])
        box.setText(self.translations["error.text"].format(summary=summary))
        box.setDetailedText(details)
        show_log = box.addButton(self.translations["log.open"],
                                 QMessageBox.ButtonRole.ActionRole)
        box.addButton(QMessageBox.StandardButton.Ok)
        box.finished.connect(lambda _result: self._closed(box, show_log))
        self._box = box
        self._more = 0
        box.open()

    def _closed(self, box, show_log):
        self._box = None
        if box.clickedButton() is show_log:
            self.open_log()


class LogSignals(QObject):
    """``logs.subscribe`` as a Qt signal: an error was logged."""

    error_logged = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        emit = self.error_logged.emit
        logs.subscribe(emit)
        self.destroyed.connect(lambda _object=None: logs.unsubscribe(emit))

```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/markdown_preview.py`:

```py
"""Markdown shown formatted, in the colours of the theme (the notes' preview).

QTextBrowser.setMarkdown takes no style sheet, so the document it builds is
formatted afterwards: headings, inline code, code blocks (coloured like the
code editor), quotes, links, rules and tables.
"""

import re

from PySide6.QtGui import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QBrush,
    QFont,
    QFontDatabase,
    QTextBlockFormat,
    QTextCharFormat,
    QTextCursor,
    QTextFormat,
    QTextFrameFormat,
    QTextLength,
    QTextTable,
)
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTextBrowser  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import closes_fence, fence_opening, highlight_code
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import parse_color, theme_color

_COLOR_KEYS = ("muted", "accent", "border", "border_subtle", "surface", "alternate",
               "code_text", "code_keyword", "code_string", "code_number")
_TOKEN_COLORS = {"text": "code_text", "keyword": "code_keyword", "string": "code_string",
                 "number": "code_number", "comment": "muted"}
_HEADING_SPACE = {1: 14, 2: 12, 3: 10}
_Property = QTextFormat.Property
# What stands before a fence in a quote or a list item
_CONTAINER_PREFIX = re.compile(r"(?:[ \t]*>|[ \t]*(?:[-*+]|\d{1,9}[.)])(?=[ \t]))*[ \t]*")


def fenced_code_lines(markdown):
    """The number of lines of each fenced code block of ``markdown``, in order.

    QTextDocument.setMarkdown marks code lines only with their language, so
    two blocks of one language in a row look like one; these lengths part
    them. Blocks without a line are left out, as setMarkdown leaves them out.
    """
    lengths = []
    fence, lines = None, 0
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        prefix = _CONTAINER_PREFIX.match(line)
        content = line[prefix.end():] if prefix else line
        if fence is None:
            opening = fence_opening(content)
            if opening is not None:
                fence, lines = opening[0], 0
        elif closes_fence(content, fence):
            if lines:
                lengths.append(lines)
            fence = None
        else:
            lines += 1
    if fence is not None and lines:
        lengths.append(lines)
    return lengths


def _char_format(color=None, background=None, bold=False, italic=False, underline=False):
    text_format = QTextCharFormat()
    if color is not None:
        text_format.setForeground(color)
    if background is not None:
        text_format.setBackground(background)
    if bold:
        text_format.setFontWeight(QFont.Weight.Bold)
    if italic:
        text_format.setFontItalic(True)
    if underline:
        text_format.setFontUnderline(True)
    return text_format


def _merge(document, start, length, text_format):
    cursor = QTextCursor(document)
    cursor.setPosition(start)
    cursor.setPosition(start + length, QTextCursor.MoveMode.KeepAnchor)
    cursor.mergeCharFormat(text_format)


def _merge_block(block, block_format):
    QTextCursor(block).mergeBlockFormat(block_format)


def _is_code(char_format):
    return char_format.fontFixedPitch() or "monospace" in (char_format.fontFamilies() or [])


def _style_code_line(document, block, language, state, colors):
    def paint(start, length, token):
        _merge(document, block.position() + start, length,
               _char_format(colors[_TOKEN_COLORS[token]], bold=token == "keyword"))
    return highlight_code(paint, language, block.text(), state)


def _style_inline(document, block, colors):
    code = _char_format(colors["code_string"], colors["surface"])
    link = _char_format(colors["accent"], underline=True)
    ranges = []
    fragments = block.begin()
    while not fragments.atEnd():
        fragment = fragments.fragment()
        char_format = fragment.charFormat()
        if char_format.isAnchor():
            ranges.append((fragment.position(), fragment.length(), link))
        elif _is_code(char_format):
            ranges.append((fragment.position(), fragment.length(), code))
        fragments += 1
    for start, length, text_format in ranges:
        _merge(document, start, length, text_format)


def _style_table(table, colors):
    table_format = table.format()
    table_format.setBorder(1)
    table_format.setBorderBrush(QBrush(colors["border"]))
    table_format.setBorderStyle(QTextFrameFormat.BorderStyle.BorderStyle_Solid)
    table_format.setBorderCollapse(True)
    table_format.setCellSpacing(0)
    table_format.setCellPadding(5)
    table_format.setTopMargin(4)
    table_format.setBottomMargin(8)
    table_format.setWidth(QTextLength(QTextLength.Type.VariableLength, 0))
    table.setFormat(table_format)
    for row in range(table.rows()):
        background = colors["border_subtle"] if row == 0 else (
            colors["alternate"] if row % 2 == 0 else None)
        if background is None:
            continue
        for column in range(table.columns()):
            cell = table.cellAt(row, column)
            cell_format = cell.format()
            cell_format.setBackground(background)
            cell.setFormat(cell_format)


def _frame_code(document, start, end, indent, colors):
    """Put the code block from ``start`` to ``end`` in a padded, shaded box
    ``indent`` pixels from the left."""
    frame_format = QTextFrameFormat()
    frame_format.setBackground(colors["surface"])
    frame_format.setBorder(1)
    frame_format.setBorderBrush(QBrush(colors["border_subtle"]))
    frame_format.setBorderStyle(QTextFrameFormat.BorderStyle.BorderStyle_Solid)
    frame_format.setPadding(6)
    frame_format.setTopMargin(4)
    frame_format.setBottomMargin(8)
    frame_format.setLeftMargin(indent)
    cursor = QTextCursor(document)
    cursor.setPosition(start)
    cursor.setPosition(end, QTextCursor.MoveMode.KeepAnchor)
    frame = cursor.insertFrame(frame_format)
    # A frame needs a block before and after it: keep the empty ones flat
    flat = QTextBlockFormat()
    flat.setLineHeight(0, QTextBlockFormat.LineHeightTypes.FixedHeight.value)
    for position in (frame.firstPosition() - 1, frame.lastPosition() + 1):
        block = document.findBlock(position)
        if block.isValid() and not block.text():
            _merge_block(block, flat)


def style_markdown(document, colors, code_lines=None):
    """Format the ``document`` QTextDocument.setMarkdown built in the theme ``colors``
    (a theme's colour keys to ``#rrggbb``).

    ``code_lines`` are the lengths of its fenced code blocks (fenced_code_lines),
    to part blocks of the same language that follow each other.
    """
    code_lines = iter(code_lines or ())
    colors = {key: parse_color(colors[key]) for key in _COLOR_KEYS}
    fixed = QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont)
    cursor = QTextCursor(document)
    cursor.beginEditBlock()
    code_language = None
    code_state = 0
    code_fence = None
    code_left = None
    code_runs = []
    block = document.begin()
    while block.isValid():
        block_format = block.blockFormat()
        if block_format.hasProperty(_Property.BlockCodeLanguage):
            language = block_format.stringProperty(_Property.BlockCodeLanguage)
            fence = block_format.stringProperty(_Property.BlockCodeFence)
            if language != code_language or fence != code_fence or code_left == 0:
                code_state = 0
                # Indented code (no fence) is not counted
                code_left = next(code_lines, None) if fence else None
                # The box takes the indent of code in a list or quote
                indent = (block_format.leftMargin()
                          + block_format.indent() * document.indentWidth())
                code_runs.append([block.position(), block.position() + block.length() - 1,
                                  indent])
            else:
                code_runs[-1][1] = block.position() + block.length() - 1
            unindented = QTextBlockFormat()
            unindented.setLeftMargin(0)
            unindented.setIndent(0)
            _merge_block(block, unindented)
            line = QTextCharFormat()
            line.setFontFamilies([fixed.family()])
            _merge(document, block.position(), block.length() - 1, line)
            code_state = _style_code_line(document, block, language, code_state, colors)
            code_language, code_fence = language, fence
            if code_left is not None:
                code_left -= 1
            block = block.next()
            continue
        code_language = code_fence = None
        level = block_format.headingLevel()
        if level:
            heading = QTextBlockFormat()
            heading.setTopMargin(_HEADING_SPACE.get(level, 8))
            heading.setBottomMargin(4)
            if level <= 2:
                heading.setProperty(_Property.BlockTrailingHorizontalRulerWidth,
                                    QTextLength(QTextLength.Type.PercentageLength, 100))
                heading.setBackground(colors["border_subtle"])
            _merge_block(block, heading)
            _merge(document, block.position(), block.length() - 1,
                   _char_format(colors["code_keyword"], bold=True))
        elif block_format.hasProperty(_Property.BlockTrailingHorizontalRulerWidth):
            rule = QTextBlockFormat()
            rule.setBackground(colors["border"])
            _merge_block(block, rule)
        elif block_format.intProperty(_Property.BlockQuoteLevel):
            _merge(document, block.position(), block.length() - 1,
                   _char_format(colors["muted"], italic=True))
        _style_inline(document, block, colors)
        block = block.next()
    for frame in document.rootFrame().childFrames():
        if isinstance(frame, QTextTable):
            _style_table(frame, colors)
    # From the end: a frame moves the text after it
    for start, end, indent in reversed(code_runs):
        _frame_code(document, start, end, indent, colors)
    cursor.endEditBlock()


class MarkdownPreview(QTextBrowser):
    """A QTextBrowser for Markdown formatted in the current theme's colours."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setOpenExternalLinks(True)
        self.document().setDocumentMargin(10)
        self._markdown = ""
        self._colors = {key: theme_color(key) for key in _COLOR_KEYS}

    def set_markdown(self, text):
        """Show ``text`` formatted, keeping the scroll position."""
        self._markdown = text
        scroll = self.verticalScrollBar().value()
        self.setMarkdown(text)
        style_markdown(self.document(), self._colors, fenced_code_lines(text))
        self.verticalScrollBar().setValue(scroll)

    def code_theme_changed(self, colors):
        """Format the text again in the theme ``colors`` (see apply_code_theme)."""
        self._colors = {key: colors[key] for key in _COLOR_KEYS}
        self.set_markdown(self._markdown)


```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/memory_view.py`:

```py
"""Memory viewer: a live hex dump of process memory."""

import struct
import time

from PySide6.QtCore import QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex, Qt, QTimer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QFont, QKeySequence, QShortcut  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableView,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from grembyte.core.memory import describe_address, parse_address, read_memory
from grembyte.platform import read_mappings
from grembyte.core.value_types import VALUE_TYPES
from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import PinButton
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color, theme_qcolor

BYTES_PER_ROW = 16
REFRESH_MS = 500
# How long a changed byte stays highlighted.
CHANGE_HIGHLIGHT_S = 2.0
# Bytes read beyond the visible rows, so values at the end can be shown.
_TAIL = 8
# Rows shown until the view knows its size.
DEFAULT_ROWS = 16

# Theme colours (see icons.theme_color) of changed and unreadable bytes and of the text
_CHANGED = "orange"
_UNREADABLE = "disabled_text"
_ASCII = "muted"


class MemoryModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    """Rows of 16 bytes from ``base`` on: 16 hex columns and one ASCII column."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.base = 0
        self.rows = 0
        self.data_bytes = b""
        self.readable = bytearray()
        self._changed_at = {}

    # --- Qt model --------------------------------------------------------
    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else self.rows

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else BYTES_PER_ROW + 1

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return f"{section:X}" if section < BYTES_PER_ROW else "ASCII"
        return f"{self.base + section * BYTES_PER_ROW:016X}"

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        row, column = index.row(), index.column()
        if column == BYTES_PER_ROW:
            if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
                return self._ascii(row)
            if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole:
                return theme_qcolor(_ASCII)
            return None
        offset = row * BYTES_PER_ROW + column
        if offset >= len(self.data_bytes):
            return None
        readable = self.readable[offset]
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return f"{self.data_bytes[offset]:02X}" if readable else "??"
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole:
            if not readable:
                return theme_qcolor(_UNREADABLE)
            if self.changed(offset):
                return theme_qcolor(_CHANGED)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole:
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter
        return None

    # --- Content ---------------------------------------------------------
    def set_view(self, base, rows):
        """Show ``rows`` rows from ``base`` on (contents follow with ``update``)."""
        if base != self.base:
            self._changed_at.clear()
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.base = base
        self.rows = rows
        size = rows * BYTES_PER_ROW + _TAIL
        self.data_bytes = bytes(size)
        self.readable = bytearray(size)
        self.endResetModel()

    def update(self, data, readable, now=None):
        """Set freshly read bytes and remember which of them changed."""
        now = time.monotonic() if now is None else now
        old, old_readable = self.data_bytes, self.readable
        if len(old) == len(data):
            for offset, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(old, data)):
                if before != after and readable[offset] and old_readable[offset]:
                    self._changed_at[offset] = now
        self.data_bytes, self.readable = data, readable
        if self.rows:
            self.dataChanged.emit(self.index(0, 0),
                                  self.index(self.rows - 1, BYTES_PER_ROW))

    def changed(self, offset, now=None):
        """Whether the byte at ``offset`` changed a moment ago."""
        changed_at = self._changed_at.get(offset)
        now = time.monotonic() if now is None else now
        return changed_at is not None and now - changed_at < CHANGE_HIGHLIGHT_S

    def bytes_at(self, offset, size):
        """Return ``size`` readable bytes at ``offset``, or None."""
        end = offset + size
        if offset < 0 or end > len(self.data_bytes) or not all(self.readable[offset:end]):
            return None
        return self.data_bytes[offset:end]

    def _ascii(self, row):
        start = row * BYTES_PER_ROW
        return "".join(
            chr(byte) if self.readable[start + i] and 0x20 <= byte < 0x7F else "."
            for i, byte in enumerate(self.data_bytes[start:start + BYTES_PER_ROW])
        )


class MemoryView(QTableView):
    """Hex table that scrolls through memory with the wheel and page keys."""

    def __init__(self, dialog):
        super().__init__(dialog)
        self._dialog = dialog

    def wheelEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        steps = event.angleDelta().y() // 120
        if steps:
            self._dialog.scroll_rows(-3 * steps)
        event.accept()

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        rows = self.model().rowCount()
        moves = {
            Qt.Key.Key_PageDown: rows, Qt.Key.Key_PageUp: -rows,
        }
        index = self.currentIndex()
        if event.key() in moves:
            self._dialog.scroll_rows(moves[event.key()])
            return
        # Moving the cursor past the first or last row scrolls the memory.
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Down and index.row() == rows - 1:
            self._dialog.scroll_rows(1)
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Up and index.row() == 0:
            self._dialog.scroll_rows(-1)
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def resizeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._dialog.fit_rows()


class MemoryViewerDialog(QDialog):
    """Live hex dump of a process; not modal, so the scanner stays usable.

    ``set_process`` switches to another process (or None while there is none);
    ``go_to`` shows an address.
    """

    # Widgets are created by _build_ui called from __init__.
    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, address=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self._mappings = []
        self.model = MemoryModel(self)
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["memview.title"])
        self.resize(860, 640)
        self._build_ui()
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(REFRESH_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)
        self._timer.start()
        self._load_mappings()
        if address is not None:
            self.go_to(address)

    # --- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        bar.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["memview.address"]))
        self.address_input = QLineEdit()
        self.address_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["memview.address_placeholder"])
        self.address_input.returnPressed.connect(self._go_to_input)
        bar.addWidget(self.address_input, 1)
        go = QPushButton(self.translations["memview.go"])
        set_button_icon(go, "arrow_forward")
        go.clicked.connect(self._go_to_input)
        bar.addWidget(go)
        self.live = QCheckBox(self.translations["memview.live"])
        self.live.setToolTip(self.translations["memview.live_tooltip"])
        self.live.setChecked(True)
        self.live.toggled.connect(self._toggle_live)
        bar.addWidget(self.live)
        self.pin_button = PinButton(self.translations)
        bar.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        layout.addLayout(bar)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence("Ctrl+G"), self, self.address_input.setFocus)

        self.view = MemoryView(self)
        self.view.setModel(self.model)
        font = QFont("monospace")
        font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.Monospace)
        self.view.setFont(font)
        self.view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.view.setShowGrid(False)
        self.view.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.view.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.view.verticalHeader().setFont(font)
        self.view.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(self.view.fontMetrics().height() + 6)
        self.view.verticalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        self.view.setTextElideMode(Qt.TextElideMode.ElideNone)
        metrics = self.view.fontMetrics()
        header = self.view.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        # The byte columns are fixed: no lines that suggest resizing them.
        header.setStyleSheet("QHeaderView::section { border-right: none; }")
        for column in range(BYTES_PER_ROW + 1):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
            header.resizeSection(column, metrics.horizontalAdvance("00") + 12)
        header.resizeSection(BYTES_PER_ROW, metrics.horizontalAdvance("W" * BYTES_PER_ROW) + 24)
        self.view.selectionModel().currentChanged.connect(self._show_selection)
        layout.addWidget(self.view, 1)

        self.region_label = QLabel("")
        self.region_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.region_label)

        # Values at the selected byte.
        values = QFormLayout()
        self.value_labels = {}
        for name in VALUE_TYPES:
            label = QLabel("—")
            label.setFont(font)
            label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
            self.value_labels[name] = label
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        left, right = QFormLayout(), QFormLayout()
        for name, label in self.value_labels.items():
            # Signed integers and float on the left, unsigned and double on the right.
            (right if name.startswith("uint") or name == "double" else left).addRow(name, label)
        row.addLayout(left)
        row.addLayout(right)
        values.addRow(row)
        self.selection_label = QLabel(self.translations["memview.no_selection"])
        values.addRow(self.selection_label)
        layout.addLayout(values)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

    # --- Navigation --------------------------------------------------------
    def go_to(self, address):
        """Show ``address`` in the first row and select its byte."""
        address = max(0, address)
        base = address - address % BYTES_PER_ROW
        self._set_base(base)
        self.address_input.setText(f"0x{address:X}")
        self.view.setCurrentIndex(self.model.index(0, address - base))

    def scroll_rows(self, rows):
        """Move the view by ``rows`` rows (negative: towards lower addresses)."""
        index = self.view.currentIndex()
        self._set_base(max(0, self.model.base + rows * BYTES_PER_ROW))
        if index.isValid():
            self.view.setCurrentIndex(self.model.index(index.row(), index.column()))

    def fit_rows(self):
        """Show as many rows as fit into the view."""
        height = self.view.viewport().height()
        row_height = self.view.verticalHeader().defaultSectionSize()
        rows = max(1, height // max(1, row_height))
        if rows != self.model.rows:
            self._set_base(self.model.base, rows)

    def _set_base(self, base, rows=None):
        current = self.view.currentIndex()
        self.model.set_view(base, rows if rows is not None else self.model.rows or DEFAULT_ROWS)
        self.refresh()
        if current.isValid() and current.row() < self.model.rows:
            self.view.setCurrentIndex(self.model.index(current.row(), current.column()))
        self._show_region()

    def _go_to_input(self):
        if self._mappings == [] and self.pid is not None:
            self._load_mappings()
        try:
            address = parse_address(self.address_input.text(), self._mappings)
        except ValueError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(str(error))
            return
        self.status_label.setText("")
        self.go_to(address)

    # --- Process -----------------------------------------------------------
    def set_process(self, pid):
        """Show another process' memory, or nothing while ``pid`` is None."""
        self.pid = pid
        self._mappings = []
        if pid is None:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["memview.process_exited"])
        else:
            self.status_label.setText("")
            self._load_mappings()
        self.refresh()

    def _load_mappings(self):
        if self.pid is None:
            return
        try:
            self._mappings = read_mappings(self.pid)
        except OSError:
            self._mappings = []

    def _toggle_live(self, live):
        if live:
            self._timer.start()
            self.refresh()
        else:
            self._timer.stop()

    def refresh(self):
        """Read the visible memory again."""
        size = self.model.rows * BYTES_PER_ROW + _TAIL
        if self.pid is None or not self.model.rows:
            self.model.update(bytes(size), bytearray(size))
            return
        try:
            data, readable = read_memory(self.pid, self.model.base, size)
        except OSError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["memview.read_failed"].format(message=error)
            )
            data, readable = bytes(size), bytearray(size)
        self.model.update(data, readable)
        self._show_selection(self.view.currentIndex())

    # --- Details -----------------------------------------------------------
    def selected_address(self):
        """Return the address of the selected byte, or None."""
        index = self.view.currentIndex()
        if not index.isValid() or index.column() >= BYTES_PER_ROW:
            return None
        return self.model.base + index.row() * BYTES_PER_ROW + index.column()

    def _show_region(self):
        where = describe_address(self._mappings, self.model.base)
        self.region_label.setText(
            self.translations["memview.region"].format(region=where) if where
            else self.translations["memview.unmapped"]
        )

    def _show_selection(self, index, _previous=None):
        if not index.isValid() or index.column() >= BYTES_PER_ROW:
            self.selection_label.setText(self.translations["memview.no_selection"])
            for label in self.value_labels.values():
                label.setText("—")
            return
        offset = index.row() * BYTES_PER_ROW + index.column()
        address = self.model.base + offset
        where = describe_address(self._mappings, address)
        self.selection_label.setText(
            self.translations["memview.selected"].format(
                address=f"0x{address:X}", region=where or "—"
            )
        )
        for name, label in self.value_labels.items():
            kind = VALUE_TYPES[name]
            data = self.model.bytes_at(offset, kind.size)
            if data is None:
                label.setText("??")
                continue
            value = struct.unpack(kind.struct_format, data)[0]
            if kind.is_integer:
                label.setText(str(value))
            else:
                label.setText(f"{value:.{7 if kind.size == 4 else 15}g}")

    def showEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        super().showEvent(event)
        # All columns must fit; there is no horizontal scroll bar.
        width = (self.view.verticalHeader().width() + self.view.horizontalHeader().length()
                 + 2 * self.view.frameWidth() + 2)
        self.view.setMinimumWidth(width)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._timer.stop()
        super().closeEvent(event)

```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/method_call.py`:

```py
"""Call a method of the running game with arguments typed in: a static C# method
or UFunction, an instance method of an inspected object, or (Unreal) an
instance UFunction of the catalog on a live object of its class."""

import html
from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QFontDatabase  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTextBrowser,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.core import messages
from grembyte.features.method_call import (
    CHAR,
    ENGINE_NAME,
    INTEGER_RANGES,
    REFERENCES,
    R4,
    R8,
    ArgumentError,
    argument_text,
    is_bool,
    is_guid,
    is_number_struct,
    is_output,
    is_text,

    struct_field_names,
    supported,

from grembyte.features.catalog import csharp_name
from grembyte.features.monitor import MethodMonitorWorker
```
