from grembyte.ui.widgets.inspection import Inspections
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import SelectableText
from grembyte.ui.widgets.method_monitor import stop_worker

# The arguments last typed per method (its signature), for this run of Grembyte
_last_arguments = {}


def placeholder_key(param_type):
    """The translation of the hint an empty argument field shows."""
    # pylint: disable=too-many-return-statements
    kind = param_type["kind"]
    if not supported(param_type):
        return ("call.placeholder_unsupported" if "engine" in param_type
                else "call.placeholder_struct")
    if is_guid(param_type):
        return "call.placeholder_guid"
    if is_number_struct(param_type):
        return "call.placeholder_struct_fields"
    if param_type.get("enumName"):
        return "call.placeholder_enum"
    if param_type.get("engine") == ENGINE_NAME:
        return "call.placeholder_name"
    if is_text(param_type):
        return "call.placeholder_string"
    if kind == CHAR:
        return "call.placeholder_char"
    if kind in (R4, R8):
        return "call.placeholder_float"
    if kind in INTEGER_RANGES:
        return "call.placeholder_integer"
    if kind in REFERENCES:
        return "call.placeholder_object"
    return "call.placeholder_address"


def _type_name(name):
    """A type's name as shown: Mono's nested classes (Outer/Inner) as C#
    writes them; Unreal's paths stay."""
    return name if name.startswith("/") else csharp_name(name)


def _editor_text(editor):
    """What an argument editor holds, as parse_argument reads it."""
    if isinstance(editor, QCheckBox):
        return "true" if editor.isChecked() else "false"
    if isinstance(editor, QComboBox):
        index = editor.findText(editor.currentText())
        return editor.itemData(index) if index >= 0 else editor.currentText().strip()
    return editor.text()


class MethodCallDialog(QDialog):
    """Call a static method of the game, e.g. ``Scripts:GivePlayerMoney (int)``,
    or an instance method on an object of the object inspector.

    Not modal. The call runs on the game's main thread, like the property
    getters of the object inspector (see grembyte.features.monitor); its result
    or exception goes to the log below, with the values of outputs (Unreal).
    An object it returns opens in the object inspector, and its log line links
    to it. One method at a time: ``set_method`` (static, or an instance
    method of an engine that finds objects: then an object field comes first)
    or ``set_instance_method`` shows another one.

    The dialog runs a MethodMonitorWorker of its own for ``pid``, or uses
    ``worker`` (one of an object inspector's window, which keeps it running).
    ``call_done`` tells when a call returned without an exception.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # a field of an inspected object to put on the address list (see ObjectInspectorDialog)
    address_requested = Signal(object)
    call_done = Signal()

    def __init__(self, translations, pid=None, parent=None, worker=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.method = None
        # what is called: {key, name, describe(), call(arguments), found?}
        self._spec = None
        self._params = None
        # the parameters typed in (not outputs) and their editors
        self._inputs = []
        self._editors = []
        # where the object of a found call is typed in (see set_method)
        self.object_edit = None
        self._describe_request = None
        # call request id -> (the log line's start, the method's name)
        self._calls = {}
        # objects the calls returned, by their number in the log's links
        self._results = []
        self._failed = False
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["call.title"])
        self.resize(640, 480)
        self._build_ui()
        self._owns_worker = worker is None
        self._worker = MethodMonitorWorker(pid) if worker is None else worker
        self._worker.call_described.connect(self._on_described)
        self._worker.called.connect(self._on_called)
        self._worker.call_failed.connect(self._on_call_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self.inspections = Inspections(translations, self._worker, self,
                                       time=lambda: datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"))
        self.inspections.address_requested.connect(self.address_requested.emit)
        if self._owns_worker:
            self._worker.start()

    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.hint_label = QLabel(t["call.hint"])
        self.hint_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.hint_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.hint_label)
        self.signature_label = SelectableText()
        layout.addWidget(self.signature_label)

        self.form_widget = QWidget()
        self.form = QFormLayout(self.form_widget)
        self.form.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        layout.addWidget(self.form_widget)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        actions.addWidget(self.status_label, 1)
        self.call_button = QPushButton(t["call.call"])
        self.call_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.call_button, "call_made")
        self.call_button.setToolTip(t["call.call_tooltip"])
        self.call_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.call_button.clicked.connect(self.call)
        actions.addWidget(self.call_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.log = QTextBrowser()
        self.log.setOpenLinks(False)
        self.log.anchorClicked.connect(self._on_link)
        self.log.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        self.log.setPlaceholderText(t["call.log_placeholder"])
        layout.addWidget(self.log, 1)

    # --- The method --------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_method(self, method):
        """Show ``method`` (a CatalogMethod) and read its parameters.

        An instance method runs on a live object of its class (an engine with
        ``CALL_FOUND``): the first one found, or the one whose name or
        address is typed in above the arguments.
        """
        self.method = method
        if method.static:
            self.hint_label.setText(self.translations["call.hint"])
            self._show({
                "key": method.signature, "text": method.signature,
                "name": method.signature.split(" (")[0],
                "describe": lambda: self._worker.describe_call(method.identity()),
                "call": lambda arguments: self._worker.call(method.identity(), arguments),
            })
            return
        self.hint_label.setText(self.translations["call.hint_found"].format(
            type=method.class_name))
        self._show({
            "key": method.signature, "text": method.signature,
            "name": method.signature.split(" (")[0], "found": method.class_name,
            "describe": lambda: self._worker.describe_call(method.identity(), instance=True),
            "call": lambda arguments: self._worker.call_found(
                method.identity(), method.class_name, self.object_edit.text(), arguments),
        })

    def set_instance_method(self, target, entry, object_text):
        """Show an instance method (an entry of ``list_methods``: name, method,
        owner, params, returns) to call on the object ``target``, shown as
        ``object_text``."""
        self.method = None
        self.hint_label.setText(self.translations["call.hint_instance"].format(
            object=object_text))
        signature = f"{entry['owner']}:{entry['name']} ({entry['params']})"
        self._show({
            "key": signature, "text": f"{signature} → {entry['returns']}",
            "name": entry["name"],
            "describe": lambda: self._worker.describe_method(entry["method"]),
            "call": lambda arguments: self._worker.call_on(target, entry["method"], arguments),
        })

    def _show(self, spec):
        """Show the method ``spec`` describes and read its parameters."""
        self._spec = spec
        self._params = None
        self._clear_form()
        self.signature_label.setText(spec["text"])
        self.call_button.setEnabled(False)
        if self._failed:
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.reading"])
        self._describe_request = spec["describe"]()

    def _clear_form(self):
        while self.form.rowCount():
            self.form.removeRow(0)
        self._inputs = []
        self._editors = []
        self.object_edit = None

    def _on_described(self, request_id, info):
        if request_id != self._describe_request:
            return  # another method was chosen since
        self._describe_request = None
        t = self.translations
        self._params = info.get("params", [])
        last = _last_arguments.get(self._spec["key"], [])
        if "found" in self._spec:
            # The object comes first; its text is kept with the arguments.
            self.object_edit = QLineEdit(last[0] if last else "")
            self.object_edit.setPlaceholderText(t["call.placeholder_found"].format(
                type=self._spec["found"]))
            self.object_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.call)
            self.form.addRow(t["call.object"].format(type=self._spec["found"]),
                             self.object_edit)
            last = last[1:]
        self._inputs = [param for param in self._params if not is_output(param)]
        for param in self._params:
            if is_output(param):
                hint = QLabel(t["call.output"])
                hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
                self.form.addRow(self._param_label(param), hint)
                continue
            i = len(self._editors)
            self.form.addRow(self._param_label(param), self._editor(
                param["type"], last[i] if i < len(last) else None))
        if not self._params:
            self.form.addRow(QLabel(t["call.no_parameters"]))
        usable = all(supported(param["type"]) for param in self._inputs)
        self.call_button.setEnabled(usable)
        self.status_label.setText("" if usable else t["call.unsupported"])
        first = self.object_edit or (self._editors[0] if self._editors else None)
        if isinstance(first, QLineEdit):
            first.setFocus()

    def _param_label(self, param):
        param_type = param["type"]
        name = _type_name(param_type.get("enumName") or param_type["name"])
        if param.get("out"):
            name += " (out)"
        elif param_type.get("byref"):
            name += " (ref)"
        return f"{param['name']}  ({name})"

    def _editor(self, param_type, last):
        t = self.translations
        if is_bool(param_type) and ("engine" in param_type or not param_type.get("byref")):
            editor = QCheckBox()
            editor.setChecked(last == "true")
        elif param_type.get("enumValues") and supported(param_type):
            editor = self._enum_editor(param_type, last)
        else:
            editor = QLineEdit(last or "")
            fields = struct_field_names(param_type) if is_number_struct(param_type) else []
            editor.setPlaceholderText(t[placeholder_key(param_type)].format(
                type=_type_name(param_type.get("enumName") or param_type["name"]),
                fields=" ".join(fields),
                fields_example="; ".join(f"{name}={i + 1}" for i, name in enumerate(fields[:2]))))
            editor.setEnabled(supported(param_type))
            editor.returnPressed.connect(self.call)
        self._editors.append(editor)
        return editor

    def _enum_editor(self, param_type, last):
        """A choice of the enum's names, shown with their values ("Minor (1)");
        a number can be typed in, too."""
        editor = QComboBox()
        editor.setEditable(True)
        editor.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.InsertPolicy.NoInsert)
        for value, name in param_type["enumValues"].items():
            editor.addItem(f"{name} ({value})", name)
        editor.setCurrentIndex(editor.findData(last) if last else -1)
        if editor.currentIndex() < 0:
            editor.setEditText(last or "")
        editor.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText(self.translations["call.placeholder_enum_choice"])
        editor.lineEdit().returnPressed.connect(self.call)
        return editor

    def _texts(self):
        return [_editor_text(editor) for editor in self._editors]

    # --- Calling -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def call(self):
        """Call the method with the arguments typed in."""
        if self._params is None or not self.call_button.isEnabled():
            return
        texts = iter(self._texts())
        arguments = []
        typed = []
        for param in self._params:
            if is_output(param):
                arguments.append(None)
                continue
            text = next(texts)
            typed.append(text)
            try:
                arguments.append(parse_argument(param["type"], text))
            except ArgumentError as error:
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.bad_argument"].format(
                    name=param["name"],
                    message=self.translations[error.key].format(**error.values)))
                return
        found = [self.object_edit.text()] if self.object_edit is not None else []
        _last_arguments[self._spec["key"]] = found + typed
        name = self._spec["name"]
        shown = [argument_text(value) for param, value in zip(self._params, arguments)
                 if not is_output(param)]
        line = f"{datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}  {name}({', '.join(shown)})"
        self._calls[self._spec["call"](arguments)] = (line, name)
        self.call_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.calling"])

    def _on_called(self, request_id, answer):
        line, name = self._calls.pop(request_id, (None, None))
        if line is None:
            return
        t = self.translations
        if "exception" in answer:
            self._log(f"{line}  ⚠ {messages.describe(answer['exception'])}")
            self.status_label.setText(t["call.threw"])
        else:
            result = answer.get("result")
            target = result.get("target") if result else None
            if answer.get("object"):
                line += t["call.on_object"].format(object=answer["object"]["text"])
            text = f"{line}  → {result.get('text', '') if result else t['call.void']}"
            for output in answer.get("outputs", []):
                text += f"; {output['name']} = {output['value'].get('text', '')}"
            self._log(text, target, f"{name}()")
            self.status_label.setText(t["call.done"])
            if target:
                self.inspections.inspect(target, name=f"{name}()")
            self.call_done.emit()
        self.call_button.setEnabled(self._params is not None)

    def _on_call_failed(self, request_id, message):
        if request_id == self._describe_request:
            self._describe_request = None
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.describe_failed"].format(
                message=message))
            return
        line, _name = self._calls.pop(request_id, (None, None))
        if line is not None:
            self._log(f"{line}  ✗ {message}")
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.failed"].format(message=message))
            self.call_button.setEnabled(self._params is not None)

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self._failed = True
        self.call_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["call.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _log(self, text, target=None, name=""):
        """Add a line to the log; with ``target`` (an object) a link that inspects it."""
        line = f'<span style="white-space: pre-wrap">{html.escape(text)}</span>'
        if target:
            self._results.append((target, name))
            line += (f'  <a href="inspect:{len(self._results) - 1}">'
                     f'{html.escape(self.translations["call.inspect"])}</a>')
        self.log.append(line)

    def _on_link(self, url):
        kind, _, number = url.toString().partition(":")
        if kind == "inspect" and number.isdigit() and int(number) < len(self._results):
            target, name = self._results[int(number)]
            self.inspections.inspect(target, name=name)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if self._owns_worker:
            stop_worker(self._worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)

`grembyte/ui/widgets/method_monitor.py`:

```py
"""Window of the method monitor: monitored C# methods and their calls."""

import json
from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex, Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QSplitter,
    QTableView,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.core import messages
from grembyte.engines import base as engine_base
from grembyte.engines.registry import engine_by_id
from grembyte.features.catalog import short_name
from grembyte.features.monitor import MethodMonitorWorker
from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import PinButton
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color
from grembyte.ui.widgets.inspection import Inspections
from grembyte.ui.widgets.object_inspector import link_label, link_width
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import DocsHint
from grembyte.ui.workers import keep_until_finished


# Calls kept in the log; older ones are dropped.
MAX_CALLS = 5000

# Columns of the monitored methods and of the call log.
_M_METHOD, _M_SIGNATURE, _M_CALLS, _M_RETURNS, _M_OBJECTS, _M_STATUS = range(6)
_C_TIME, _C_THREAD, _C_METHOD, _C_SELF, _C_ARGS, _C_RESULT, _C_CALLER = range(7)
_CALL_COLUMNS = (
    "monitor.column_time", "monitor.column_thread", "monitor.column_method",
    "monitor.column_self", "monitor.column_args", "monitor.column_result",
    "monitor.column_caller",
)


def call_time(call):
    """Local time of a call, e.g. ``09:47:10.738``."""
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(call.get("time", 0) / 1000).strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]


def value_text(value):
    """Text of a logged value (``{text, target?, snapshot?}``), '' for none."""
    # A value that could not be read carries the agent's error.
    return messages.describe(value.get("text", "")) if value else ""


def argument_text(arg):
    """``name=value``, plus ``⇒ value`` for what a ref/out argument held after the call."""
    text = f"{arg.get('name', '?')}={value_text(arg)}"
    if "after" in arg:
        text += f" ⇒ {value_text(arg['after'])}"
    return text


def arguments_text(args):
    return ", ".join(argument_text(arg) for arg in args)


def signature_text(method):
    """``(parameters) → result``, after ``static`` for a static method (no ``this``)."""
    text = f"{method.parameters} → {method.return_type}"
    return f"static {text}" if method.static else text


def call_values(call, translations):
    """(label, value) of everything a call logged, for the details."""
    values = []
    if call.get("self"):
        values.append(("this", call["self"]))
    for arg in call.get("args", []):
        values.append((arg.get("name", "?"), arg))
        if "after" in arg:
            values.append((f"{arg.get('name', '?')} ⇒", arg["after"]))
    if "result" in call:
        values.append((translations["monitor.column_result"], call["result"]))
    return values



def _hookable(method):
    """Whether the engine of ``method`` offers method hooks."""
    engine = engine_by_id(method.engine)
    return engine is not None and engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS)

class CallLogModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    """The latest calls, newest last."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.calls = []
        self.names = {}
        # Monitors of static methods: their calls have no ``this``.
        self.static = set()

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.calls)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(_CALL_COLUMNS)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[_CALL_COLUMNS[section]]
        return None

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        call = self.calls[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        no_self = (column == _C_SELF and not call.get("self")
                   and call.get("monitorId") in self.static)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole:
            return QColor(theme_color("muted")) if no_self else None
        if role not in (Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole):
            return None
        if no_self:
            return self.translations["inspector.static"]
        if column == _C_TIME:
            return call_time(call)
        if column == _C_THREAD:
            return str(call.get("threadId", ""))
        if column == _C_METHOD:
            return self.names.get(call.get("monitorId"), "?")
        if column == _C_SELF:
            return value_text(call.get("self"))
        if column == _C_ARGS:
            if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole:
                return "\n".join(argument_text(arg) for arg in call.get("args", []))
            return arguments_text(call.get("args", []))
        if column == _C_RESULT:
            return value_text(call.get("result"))
        return call.get("caller", "")

    def append(self, calls):
        if not calls:
            return
        overflow = len(self.calls) + len(calls) - MAX_CALLS
        if overflow > 0:
            removed = min(overflow, len(self.calls))
            self.beginRemoveRows(QModelIndex(), 0, removed - 1)
            del self.calls[:removed]
            self.endRemoveRows()
            calls = calls[-MAX_CALLS:]
        start = len(self.calls)
        self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), start, start + len(calls) - 1)
        self.calls.extend(calls)
        self.endInsertRows()

    def clear(self):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.calls = []
        self.endResetModel()


class MethodMonitorDialog(QDialog):
    """Monitored methods above, their calls below; not modal.

    ``add_method`` starts monitoring a ``CatalogMethod``. The worker and its
    Frida session live as long as the dialog.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # CatalogMethod to create a method hook for
    hook_requested = Signal(object)
    # a field of an inspected object to put on the address list (see ObjectInspectorDialog)
    address_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.log = CallLogModel(translations, self)
        # monitor id -> {"method", "returns", "row", "calls", "dropped"}
        self._monitors = {}
        self._paused = False
        self._detail_time = ""
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["monitor.title"])
        self.resize(1100, 700)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = MethodMonitorWorker(pid)
        self._worker.monitor_added.connect(self._on_added)
        self._worker.monitor_failed.connect(self._on_failed)
        self._worker.monitor_ended.connect(self._on_ended)
        self._worker.calls.connect(self._on_calls)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self.inspections = Inspections(translations, self._worker, self,
                                       time=lambda: self._detail_time)
        self.inspections.address_requested.connect(self.address_requested.emit)
        self._worker.start()

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = DocsHint(self.translations, self.translations["monitor.hint"], "engines/#method-monitor")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        top = QWidget()
        top_layout = QVBoxLayout(top)
        top_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.methods_table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.methods_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["monitor.column_method"],
            self.translations["monitor.column_signature"],
            self.translations["monitor.column_calls"],
            self.translations["monitor.column_returns"],
            self.translations["monitor.column_objects"],
            self.translations["monitor.column_status"],
        ])
        self.methods_table.horizontalHeaderItem(_M_RETURNS).setToolTip(
            self.translations["monitor.returns_tooltip"])
        self.methods_table.horizontalHeaderItem(_M_OBJECTS).setToolTip(
            self.translations["monitor.objects_tooltip"])
        self.methods_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        # Removed one at a time (see _remove_selected)
        self.methods_table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.methods_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.methods_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.methods_table)
        header = self.methods_table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(6):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _M_SIGNATURE
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        resizable_columns(self.methods_table)
        copy_menu(self.methods_table, self.translations, self._remove_selected)
        self.methods_table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.methods_table)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.remove_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.remove"])
        set_button_icon(self.remove_button, "delete")
        self.remove_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.remove_button.clicked.connect(self._remove_selected)
        buttons.addWidget(self.remove_button)
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.create_hook"])
        self.hook_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["monitor.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        buttons.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.pin_button = PinButton(self.translations)
        buttons.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        top_layout.addLayout(buttons)
        splitter.addWidget(top)

        bottom = QWidget()
        bottom_layout = QVBoxLayout(bottom)
        bottom_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        log_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        log_bar.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["monitor.calls"]))
        log_bar.addStretch()
        self.pause_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.pause"])
        set_button_icon(self.pause_button, "pause")
        self.pause_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.pause_button.toggled.connect(self._toggle_pause)
        log_bar.addWidget(self.pause_button)
        clear_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.clear"])
        set_button_icon(clear_button, "clear_all")
        clear_button.clicked.connect(self.log.clear)
        log_bar.addWidget(clear_button)
        bottom_layout.addLayout(log_bar)
        self.log_view = QTableView()
        self.log_view.setModel(self.log)
        self.log_view.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.log_view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.log_view.setWordWrap(False)
        self.log_view.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        log_header = self.log_view.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_CALL_COLUMNS)):
            log_header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _C_ARGS
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_TIME, 100)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_THREAD, 70)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_METHOD, 200)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_SELF, 160)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_RESULT, 110)
        log_header.resizeSection(_C_CALLER, 240)
        resizable_columns(self.log_view)
        copy_menu(self.log_view, self.translations)
        self.log_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_call)
        # A reset (clearing the log) does not report a new current row.
        self.log.modelReset.connect(lambda: self._show_call(QModelIndex()))
        bottom_layout.addWidget(self.log_view, 1)
        # The values of the selected call; double click inspects an object.
        self.details = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        self.details.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["monitor.details_name"],
            self.translations["monitor.details_value"],
            self.translations["monitor.details_fields"],
        ])
        self.details.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.details.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.details.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.details.setWordWrap(False)
        details_header = self.details.horizontalHeader()
        details_header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        details_header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        details_header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        details_header.resizeSection(2, link_width(self.details, [
            self.translations["monitor.object_details"], self.translations["monitor.full_text"]]))
        resizable_columns(self.details)
        copy_menu(self.details, self.translations)
        self.details.setMaximumHeight(190)
        self.details.cellDoubleClicked.connect(self._inspect_detail)
        bottom_layout.addWidget(self.details)
        splitter.addWidget(bottom)
        splitter.setSizes([180, 520])
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

    # --- Monitors --------------------------------------------------------------
    def _option_check(self, row, column, checked, tooltip, toggled):
        check = QCheckBox()
        check.setChecked(checked)
        check.setToolTip(tooltip)
        holder = QWidget()
        holder.setObjectName("cell_widget")  # the row's selection shows through (styles.py)
        holder_layout = QHBoxLayout(holder)
        holder_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        holder_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        holder_layout.addWidget(check)
        self.methods_table.setCellWidget(row, column, holder)
        check.toggled.connect(toggled)
        return check

    def add_method(self, method, returns=None, objects=None):
        """Monitor a ``CatalogMethod``; a method is monitored at most once.

        ``returns`` and ``objects`` default to "if the method has any": a
        return value or ref/out arguments, objects among ``this``, the
        arguments and the result.
        """
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            if state["method"].signature == method.signature:
                return
        row = self.methods_table.rowCount()
        self.methods_table.insertRow(row)
        name = QTableWidgetItem(short_name(method.signature))
        name.setToolTip(method.signature)
        self.methods_table.setItem(row, _M_METHOD, name)
        for column in (_M_SIGNATURE, _M_CALLS, _M_STATUS):
            self.methods_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(""))
        self.methods_table.item(row, _M_SIGNATURE).setText(signature_text(method))
        self.methods_table.item(row, _M_CALLS).setText("0")
        state = {"method": method, "returns": returns, "objects": objects,
                 "calls": 0, "dropped": 0}
        state["returns_check"] = self._option_check(
            row, _M_RETURNS, bool(returns), self.translations["monitor.returns_tooltip"],
            lambda checked: self._set_option(state, "returns", checked))
        state["objects_check"] = self._option_check(
            row, _M_OBJECTS, bool(objects), self.translations["monitor.objects_tooltip"],
            lambda checked: self._set_option(state, "objects", checked))
        self._start(state)
        self.raise_()

    def _start(self, state):
        monitor_id = self._worker.add_monitor(
            state["method"].identity(), state["returns"], state["objects"])
        self._monitors[monitor_id] = state
        self.log.names[monitor_id] = short_name(state["method"].signature)
        if state["method"].static:
            self.log.static.add(monitor_id)
        self._set_status(state, self.translations["monitor.status_starting"])

    def _set_option(self, state, option, enabled):
        # Frida needs onLeave from the start: monitor the method anew.
        monitor_id = self._id_of(state)
        if monitor_id is not None:
            self._worker.remove_monitor(monitor_id)
            del self._monitors[monitor_id]
        state[option] = enabled
        self._start(state)

    def _id_of(self, state):
        return next((key for key, value in self._monitors.items() if value is state), None)

    def _row_of(self, state):
        for row in range(self.methods_table.rowCount()):
            if self.methods_table.item(row, _M_METHOD).toolTip() == state["method"].signature:
                return row
        return -1

    def _set_status(self, state, text, tooltip=""):
        row = self._row_of(state)
        if row >= 0:
            item = self.methods_table.item(row, _M_STATUS)
            item.setText(text)
            item.setToolTip(tooltip)

    def _remove_selected(self):
        row = self.methods_table.currentRow()
        if row < 0:
            return
        signature = self.methods_table.item(row, _M_METHOD).toolTip()
        for monitor_id, state in list(self._monitors.items()):
            if state["method"].signature == signature:
                self._worker.remove_monitor(monitor_id)
                del self._monitors[monitor_id]
        self.methods_table.removeRow(row)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _update_buttons(self):
        selected = self.methods_table.currentRow() >= 0
        self.remove_button.setEnabled(selected)
        method = self._selected_method()
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(method is not None and _hookable(method))

    def _selected_method(self):
        row = self.methods_table.currentRow()
        if row < 0:
            return None
        signature = self.methods_table.item(row, _M_METHOD).toolTip()
        state = next((state for state in self._monitors.values()
                      if state["method"].signature == signature), None)
        return None if state is None else state["method"]

    def _request_hook(self):
        method = self._selected_method()
        if method is not None and _hookable(method):
            self.hook_requested.emit(method)

    # --- Worker ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_added(self, monitor_id, info):
        state = self._monitors.get(monitor_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        # The agent decided the options left open; show them, and grey out
        # what the method has nothing for.
        for option, check, records, has, key in (
                ("returns", state["returns_check"], "recordsResults", "hasResults",
                 "monitor.no_results"),
                ("objects", state["objects_check"], "recordsObjects", "hasObjects",
                 "monitor.no_objects")):
            state[option] = info.get(records, state[option])
            check.blockSignals(True)
            check.setChecked(bool(state[option]))
            check.blockSignals(False)
            if not info.get(has, True) and not state[option]:
                check.setEnabled(False)
                check.setToolTip(self.translations[key])
        row = self._row_of(state)
        if row >= 0 and info.get("returns"):
            self.methods_table.item(row, _M_SIGNATURE).setText(
                f"{state['method'].parameters} → {info['returns']}")
        text = self.translations["monitor.status_active"]
        if info.get("undecoded"):
            text = self.translations["monitor.status_undecoded"].format(
                count=info["undecoded"])
        self._set_status(state, text, self.translations["monitor.status_tooltip"].format(
            address=info.get("address", ""),
            params=", ".join(info.get("params", [])) or "—",
            returns=info.get("returns", ""),
        ))

    def _on_failed(self, monitor_id, message):
        state = self._monitors.get(monitor_id)
        if state is not None:
            self._set_status(state, self.translations["monitor.status_failed"], message)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["monitor.failed"].format(
                method=short_name(state["method"].signature), message=message))

    def _on_ended(self, monitor_id):
        state = self._monitors.pop(monitor_id, None)
        if state is not None:
            self._set_status(state, self.translations["monitor.status_ended"],
                             self.translations["monitor.status_ended_tooltip"])

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["monitor.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            self._set_status(state, self.translations["monitor.status_failed"], message)

    def _on_calls(self, calls, dropped, counts):
        for monitor_id, count in counts.items():
            state = self._monitors.get(monitor_id)
            if state is None:
                continue
            state["calls"] += count
            state["dropped"] += dropped.get(monitor_id, 0)
            row = self._row_of(state)
            if row >= 0:
                self.methods_table.item(row, _M_CALLS).setText(str(state["calls"]))
        calls = [call for call in calls if call.get("monitorId") in self._monitors]
        if not self._paused:
            follow = self._at_bottom()
            self.log.append(calls)
            if follow:
                self.log_view.scrollToBottom()
        missed = sum(state["dropped"] for state in self._monitors.values())
        if missed:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["monitor.dropped"].format(count=missed))

    def _at_bottom(self):
        bar = self.log_view.verticalScrollBar()
        return bar.value() >= bar.maximum() - 2

    def _toggle_pause(self, paused):
        self._paused = paused
        self.pause_button.setText(
            self.translations["monitor.resume" if paused else "monitor.pause"])
        set_button_icon(self.pause_button, "play_arrow" if paused else "pause")

    def _show_call(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.log.calls[current.row()] if current.isValid() else None
        values = call_values(call, self.translations) if call else []
        self._detail_time = call_time(call) if call else ""
        self.details.setRowCount(len(values))
        for row, (label, value) in enumerate(values):
            name = QTableWidgetItem(label)
            name.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, value)
            text = QTableWidgetItem(value_text(value))
            text.setToolTip(value_text(value))
            self.details.setItem(row, 0, name)
            self.details.setItem(row, 1, text)
            self.details.removeCellWidget(row, 2)
            if value.get("target"):
                link = link_label(self.translations["monitor.object_details"],
                                  lambda row=row: self._inspect_detail(row, 2))
                link.setToolTip(self.translations[
                    "monitor.fields_captured" if "snapshot" in value else "monitor.fields_current"])
                self.details.setCellWidget(row, 2, link)
            elif value.get("string"):
                link = link_label(self.translations["monitor.full_text"],
                                  lambda row=row: self._inspect_detail(row, 2))
                # A short string's text is all there, as a JSON string literal.
                length = value.get("length") or len(json.loads(value["text"]))
                link.setToolTip(self.translations["monitor.full_text_tooltip"].format(
                    length=length))
                self.details.setCellWidget(row, 2, link)

    # --- Object inspector ------------------------------------------------------
    def _inspect_detail(self, row, _column):
        """Show the fields of the object in details ``row``: as recorded at the
        call if the monitor recorded objects, else as they are now. A string
        opens whole in a text viewer."""
        item = self.details.item(row, 0)
        value = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) if item is not None else None
        # "info ⇒": what info held after the call
        name = item.text().removesuffix(" ⇒") if item is not None else ""
        if value and value.get("string"):
            self._show_text(value, name)
            return
        if not value or not value.get("target"):
            return
        if "snapshot" in value:
            self.inspections.inspect_snapshot(value["target"], value["snapshot"],
                                              self._detail_time, name)
        else:
            self.inspect(value["target"], name=name)

    @property
    def inspectors(self):
        """The object inspectors open now."""
        return self.inspections.inspectors

    def inspect(self, target, origin=None, name=""):
        """Show the current fields of ``target`` in a dialog of its own."""
        self.inspections.inspect(target, origin, name)

    def _show_text(self, value, name, time=None):
        self.inspections.show_text(value, name, time)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Removing the interceptors can wait for calls in progress; do not
        # block the window for that.
        stop_worker(self._worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)


def stop_worker(worker):
    """Stop the MethodMonitorWorker of a window that closes, without waiting for it."""
    worker.requestInterruption()
    if worker.isRunning():
        keep_until_finished(worker)

# Calls kept in the log; older ones are dropped.
MAX_CALLS = 5000
# Register values below this are shown as numbers rather than addresses,
# from the top on they are no user-space addresses either.
_SMALL = 0x10000
_TOP = 0x800000000000

# Columns of the monitored functions, the call log, the values and the changes.
_F_FUNCTION, _F_LOCATION, _F_CALLS, _F_SKIPPED, _F_STATUS, _F_SIGNATURE = range(6)
_FUNCTION_COLUMNS = (

    "native_monitor.column_calls", "native_monitor.column_skipped",

def value_text(value):
    """A register value for the log: a small number, or the address and what it is."""
    number = int(value["value"], 16)
    if number < _SMALL or -_SMALL < signed(value["value"]) < 0:
        text = str(signed(value["value"]))
    else:
        text = value["value"]
    if value.get("text"):
        text += f' "{value["text"]}"'
    elif value.get("where"):
        text += f" ({value['where']})"
    return text


def typed_text(value, kind):
    """A register value as the argument type of a guessed signature reads it:
    a general register's {"value"}, or an xmm register's {"vector"} bytes."""
    if "vector" in value:
        single, double = vector_numbers(value["vector"])
        return float_text(single if kind == "float" else double)
    number = int(value["value"], 16)
    if kind == "uint8":
        return str(number & 0xff)
    if kind in ("int", "int16"):
        bits = 32 if kind == "int" else 16
        number &= (1 << bits) - 1
        return str(number - (1 << bits) if number >> (bits - 1) else number)
    return value_text(value)


def signature_values(signature, call, platform, arch):
    """(name, type, value or None, used) per argument of ``signature``, and
    the result's (type, value or None): the registers of ``call`` the
    arguments arrive in. None: not captured (more arguments than the monitor
    reads, or an xmm register of a call logged without them)."""
    captured = {argument_name(index, platform, arch): value
                for index, value in enumerate(call.get("args", []))}
    for index, vector in enumerate(call.get("vectors") or []):
        captured[f"xmm{index}"] = {"vector": vector}
    arguments = [(parameter.register, parameter.type, captured.get(parameter.register),
                  parameter.used) for parameter in signature.parameters]
    if signature.returns == "void":
        result = None
    elif signature.returns in ("float", "double"):
        vector = call.get("vectorResult")
        result = {"vector": vector} if vector else None
    else:
        result = call.get("result")
    return arguments, (signature.returns, result)


def registers_text(call):
    """The registers of an instruction pass that point somewhere or hold small numbers."""
    return ", ".join(f"{name}={value_text(value)}" for name, value in call["registers"])


def caller_text(call):
    return call.get("callerSymbol") or call.get("callerWhere") or call.get("caller", "")


def byte_numbers(hex_text):
    """``10 10`` for the bytes ``0a0a``."""
    return " ".join(str(byte) for byte in bytes.fromhex(hex_text))


class NativeCallModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    """The latest calls, newest last."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.calls = []
        self.names = {}
        self.platform = None
        self.arch = None
        # monitor id -> Signature guessed from the code; shown while use_signatures
        self.signatures = {}
        self.use_signatures = True

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.calls)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(_CALL_COLUMNS)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[_CALL_COLUMNS[section]]
        return None

    def signature_of(self, call):
        if not self.use_signatures or "registers" in call:
            return None
        return self.signatures.get(call.get("monitorId"))

    def arguments_text(self, call):
        if "registers" in call:
            return registers_text(call)
        signature = self.signature_of(call)
        if signature is not None:
            arguments, _result = signature_values(signature, call, self.platform, self.arch)
            return ", ".join(
                f"{kind} {name}=" + ("?" if value is None else typed_text(value, kind))
                for name, kind, value, used in arguments if used)
        return ", ".join(f"{argument_name(index, self.platform, self.arch)}={value_text(value)}"
                         for index, value in enumerate(call.get("args", [])))

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid() or role not in (Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole,
                                               Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole):
            return None
        call = self.calls[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _C_TIME:
            return call_time(call)
        if column == _C_THREAD:
            return str(call.get("thread", ""))
        if column == _C_FUNCTION:
            return self.names.get(call.get("monitorId"), "?")
        if column == _C_ARGS:
            return self.arguments_text(call)
        if "registers" in call:
            return "—" if column in (_C_RESULT, _C_CHANGES) else ""
        if column == _C_RESULT:
            signature = self.signature_of(call)
            if signature is not None:
                kind, value = signature_values(signature, call, self.platform, self.arch)[1]
                if kind == "void":
                    return "—"
                return "?" if value is None else typed_text(value, kind)
            return value_text(call["result"])
        if column == _C_CALLER:
            return caller_text(call)
        count = len(call.get("changes", []))
        return f"{count}+" if call.get("moreChanges") else str(count)

    def set_calls(self, calls):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.calls = list(calls[-MAX_CALLS:])
        self.endResetModel()

    def append(self, calls):
        if not calls:
            return
        overflow = len(self.calls) + len(calls) - MAX_CALLS
        if overflow > 0:
            removed = min(overflow, len(self.calls))
            self.beginRemoveRows(QModelIndex(), 0, removed - 1)
            del self.calls[:removed]
            self.endRemoveRows()
            calls = calls[-MAX_CALLS:]
        start = len(self.calls)
        self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), start, start + len(calls) - 1)
        self.calls.extend(calls)
        self.endInsertRows()

    def call_at(self, row):
        return self.calls[row] if 0 <= row < len(self.calls) else None


def _table(translations, columns, stretch_column, delete=None):
    table = QTableWidget(0, len(columns))
    table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([translations[column] for column in columns])
    table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
    table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    table.setWordWrap(False)
    header = table.horizontalHeader()
    for column in range(len(columns)):
        header.setSectionResizeMode(
            column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == stretch_column
            else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
    resizable_columns(table)
    copy_menu(table, translations, delete)
    return table


def _item(text, address=None, tooltip=None):
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    if address is not None:
        item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, address)
    if tooltip:
        item.setToolTip(tooltip)
    return item


class SignatureWorker(QThread):
    """Guess a monitored function's signature from its module's file (see
    CodeIndex.signature); indexing a large module takes seconds the first time."""

    found = Signal(int, object)  # monitor id, Signature or None

    def __init__(self, pid, monitor_id, address, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.pid, self.monitor_id, self.address = pid, monitor_id, address

    def run(self):
        signature = None
        try:
            choice, file_address = module_at(self.pid, self.address)
            if choice is not None:
                signature = index_for(choice.path).signature(file_address)
        except (OSError, ValueError, MemoryError):
            signature = None
        self.found.emit(self.monitor_id, signature)

        # monitor id -> {"label", "key", "row", "address": (address, kind), "function"}
        self._monitors = {}

        self._worker.removed.connect(self._on_removed)

        self._worker.command_failed.connect(self._on_command_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self._worker.start()

    # --- Monitors --------------------------------------------------------------
    def add_function(self, function):
        """Monitor a NativeFunction of the native trace."""
        location = ({"module": function.module, "offset": function.offset} if function.module
                    else {"address": f"0x{function.address:x}"})
        # A call target of the trace: the start of a function
        self._add(location, function.label, function.signature, FUNCTION)

    def add_address(self, address):
        """Monitor what runs at ``address``: an instruction, or a function if it starts there."""
        text = f"0x{address:x}"
        self._add({"address": text}, text, text, AUTO)

    def _add_typed(self):
        text = self.location_input.text()
        try:
            location = parse_location(text)
        except ValueError:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.location_missing"])
            return
        self._add(location, text.strip(), text.strip(), self.kind_combo.currentData())

    def _add_enclosing(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        function = None if monitor_id is None else self._monitors[monitor_id]["function"]
        if function is not None:
            start, name = function
            self._add({"address": start}, name, name, FUNCTION)

    def _add(self, location, label, tooltip, kind):
        key = tuple(sorted(location.items()))
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            if state["key"] == key:
                return  # monitored already
        monitor_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        row = self.functions_table.rowCount()
        self.functions_table.insertRow(row)
        self.functions_table.setItem(row, _F_FUNCTION, _item(label, tooltip=tooltip))
        for column in (_F_LOCATION, _F_CALLS, _F_SKIPPED, _F_SIGNATURE):
            self.functions_table.setItem(row, column, _item(""))
        self.functions_table.setItem(row, _F_STATUS, _item(
            self.translations["native_monitor.status_adding"]))
        self._monitors[monitor_id] = {"label": label, "key": key, "row": row, "address": None,
                                      "function": None}
        self.log.names[monitor_id] = label
        self._worker.add(monitor_id, location, self.arguments_spin.value(), self.dump_spin.value(),
                         kind)

    def _row_of(self, monitor_id):
        state = self._monitors.get(monitor_id)
        return None if state is None else state["row"]

    def _on_added(self, monitor_id, info):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        state = self._monitors[monitor_id]
        found = (info.get("address"), info.get("kind"))
        if any(other["address"] == found for other in self._monitors.values()):
            # The same function, written differently (name, module+offset, address)
            state["key"] = None
            self._worker.remove(monitor_id)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.already"].format(
                function=state["label"]))
            return
        state["address"] = found
        if info.get("symbol") and state["label"] != info["symbol"]:
            # Typed as an address: the symbol tells more.
            state["label"] = info["symbol"]
            self.log.names[monitor_id] = info["symbol"]
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_FUNCTION).setText(info["symbol"])
        location = info.get("where") or info.get("address", "")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_LOCATION).setText(
            f"{location}  ({info.get('address', '')})")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_CALLS).setText("0")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SKIPPED).setText("0")
        kind = info.get("kind", FUNCTION)
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setText(
            self.translations[f"native_monitor.status_{kind}"])
        self.status_label.setText("")
        if kind == FUNCTION and info.get("address"):
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SIGNATURE).setText(
                self.translations["native_monitor.signature_guessing"])
            worker = SignatureWorker(self.pid, monitor_id, int(info["address"], 16))
            worker.found.connect(self._on_signature)
            keep_until_finished(worker)
            worker.start()
        if info.get("function"):
            state["function"] = (info["function"], info["functionName"])
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.inside_function"].format(
                function=info["functionName"]))
        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_signature(self, monitor_id, signature):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        item = self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SIGNATURE)
        if signature is None:
            item.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.signature_unknown"])
            return
        self.log.signatures[monitor_id] = signature
        text = signature.text()
        item.setText(text)
        item.setToolTip(self.translations["native_monitor.signature_tooltip"].format(
            signature=signature.text(self._monitors[monitor_id]["label"])))
        self._show_calls()

    def _use_signatures(self, checked):
        self.log.use_signatures = checked
        self._show_calls()
        self._show_call(self.log_view.currentIndex())

    def _on_add_failed(self, monitor_id, message):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is not None:
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setText(
                self.translations["native_monitor.status_failed"])
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setToolTip(message)
            # Not monitored: may be added again (e.g. after a typo)
            self._monitors[monitor_id]["key"] = None
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.add_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    def _selected_monitor(self):
        row = self.functions_table.currentRow()
        for monitor_id, state in self._monitors.items():
            if state["row"] == row:
                return monitor_id
        return None

    def _update_buttons(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        self.remove_button.setEnabled(monitor_id is not None)
        self.function_button.setEnabled(
            monitor_id is not None and self._monitors[monitor_id]["function"] is not None)

    def _remove_selected(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        if monitor_id is not None:
            self._worker.remove(monitor_id)

    def _on_removed(self, monitor_id):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        del self._monitors[monitor_id]
        self.functions_table.removeRow(row)
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            if state["row"] > row:
                state["row"] -= 1
        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_command_failed(self, action, message):
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.failed"].format(
            message=f"{action}: {message}"))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self.add_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    # --- Calls -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_calls(self, calls, counts):
        self.log.platform = self._worker.platform
        self.log.arch = self._worker.arch
        for monitor_id, numbers in counts.items():
            row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
            if row is not None:
                self.functions_table.item(row, _F_CALLS).setText(str(numbers.get("calls", 0)))
                self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SKIPPED).setText(
                    str(numbers.get("skipped", 0)))
        if not calls or self.pause_button.isChecked():
            return
        self._calls.extend(calls)
        del self._calls[:-MAX_CALLS]
        self.log.append([call for call in calls if self._shown(call)])

    def _shown(self, call):
        return call.get("changes") or not self.changes_check.isChecked()

    def _show_calls(self):
        self.log.set_calls([call for call in self._calls if self._shown(call)])

    def _clear(self):
        self._calls = []
        self.log.set_calls([])

    def _show_call(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.log.call_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        self._fill_values(call)
        self._fill_changes(call)
        self._memory_address = None
        self.memory_button.setEnabled(False)
        if call is None or "registers" in call:
            self.selection_label.setText("" if call is None else
                                         self.log.names.get(call.get("monitorId"), "?"))
            return
        self.selection_label.setText(
            f"{self.log.names.get(call.get('monitorId'), '?')} ← {caller_text(call)}"
            f"  ({call.get('callerWhere') or call.get('caller', '')})")

    def _fill_values(self, call):
        table = self.values_table
        table.setRowCount(0)
        if call is None:
            return
        platform, arch = self._worker.platform, self._worker.arch
        signature = self.log.signature_of(call)
        if signature is not None:
            self._fill_typed_values(signature, call, platform, arch)
            return
        if "registers" in call:
            rows = [tuple(register) for register in call["registers"]]
        else:
            rows = [(argument_name(index, platform, arch), value)
                    for index, value in enumerate(call.get("args", []))]
            rows.append((self.translations["monitor.column_result"], call["result"]))
        for name, value in rows:
            number = int(value["value"], 16)
            meaning = (f'"{value["text"]}"' if value.get("text") else value.get("where", ""))
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            pointer = number if _SMALL <= number < _TOP else None
            table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(name))
            table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(value["value"], pointer))
            table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(str(signed(value["value"]))))
            table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(meaning, tooltip=meaning))
        self._fill_vectors(call)
        if "registers" in call:
            return
        row = table.rowCount()
        table.insertRow(row)
        table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(self.translations["monitor.column_caller"]))
        table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(call.get("caller", ""),
                                           int(call.get("caller", "0x0"), 16)))
        table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(""))
        caller = " · ".join(text for text in (call.get("callerSymbol"),
                                              call.get("callerWhere")) if text)
        table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(caller, tooltip=caller))

    def _fill_vectors(self, call):
        """Rows for the xmm registers of a call: the low bytes as float and as double."""
        table = self.values_table
        vectors = list(enumerate(call.get("vectors") or []))
        if call.get("vectorResult"):
            vectors.append((None, call["vectorResult"]))
        for index, vector in vectors:
            single, double = vector_numbers(vector)
            name = f"xmm{index}" if index is not None else \
                f"{self.translations['monitor.column_result']} (xmm0)"
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(name))
            table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(vector))
            table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(
                f"float {float_text(single)} · double {float_text(double)}"))
            table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(""))

    def _fill_typed_values(self, signature, call, platform, arch):
        """The values table by a guessed signature: its arguments, typed, and the result."""
        table = self.values_table
        arguments, (returns, result) = signature_values(signature, call, platform, arch)
        rows = []
        for name, kind, value, used in arguments:
            label = f"{name} ({kind})" if used else \
                f"{name} ({kind}, {self.translations['native_monitor.unused']})"
            if value is None:
                rows.append((label, None, self.translations["native_monitor.not_captured"]))
            else:
                rows.append((label, value, typed_text(value, kind)))
        result_label = f"{self.translations['monitor.column_result']} ({returns})"
        if returns == "void":
            rows.append((result_label, None, "—"))
        elif result is None:
            rows.append((result_label, None, self.translations["native_monitor.not_captured"]))
        else:
            rows.append((result_label, result, typed_text(result, returns)))
        for label, value, number in rows:
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(label))
            if value is None or "vector" in value:
                table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item("" if value is None else value["vector"]))
                table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(number))
                table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(""))
                continue
            raw = int(value["value"], 16)
            meaning = (f'"{value["text"]}"' if value.get("text") else value.get("where", ""))
            table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(value["value"], raw if _SMALL <= raw < _TOP
                                               else None))
            table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(number))
            table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(meaning, tooltip=meaning))
        row = table.rowCount()
        table.insertRow(row)
        table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(self.translations["monitor.column_caller"]))
        table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(call.get("caller", ""),
                                           int(call.get("caller", "0x0"), 16)))
        table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(""))
        caller = " · ".join(text for text in (call.get("callerSymbol"),
                                              call.get("callerWhere")) if text)
        table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(caller, tooltip=caller))

    def _fill_changes(self, call):
        table = self.changes_table
        table.setRowCount(0)
        if call is None:
            return
        platform, arch = self._worker.platform, self._worker.arch
        for change in call.get("changes", []):
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            address = int(change["address"], 16)
            numbers = change_numbers(change["before"], change["after"])
            table.setItem(row, _X_ARGUMENT, _item(argument_name(change["arg"], platform, arch)))
            table.setItem(row, _X_OFFSET, _item(f"+0x{change['offset']:x}"))
            table.setItem(row, _X_ADDRESS, _item(change["address"], address))
            table.setItem(row, _X_BEFORE, _item(change["before"]))
            table.setItem(row, _X_AFTER, _item(change["after"]))
            table.setItem(row, _X_BYTES, _item(
                f"{byte_numbers(change['before'])} → {byte_numbers(change['after'])}"))
            table.setItem(row, _X_NUMBER, _item(
                "" if numbers is None else f"{numbers[0]} → {numbers[1]}"))
        if call.get("moreChanges"):
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            table.setItem(row, _X_ARGUMENT, _item(self.translations["native_monitor.more_changes"]))

    # --- Memory ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _pick_memory(self, table):
        """The address of the row selected in ``table`` (values or changes), if any."""
        address = None
        row = table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            for column in range(table.columnCount()):
                item = table.item(row, column)
                if item is not None and item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) is not None:
                    address = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                    break
        self._memory_address = address
        self.memory_button.setEnabled(address is not None)

    def _request_memory(self):
        if self._memory_address is not None:
            self.memory_requested.emit(self._memory_address)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Removing the interceptors can wait for calls in progress; do not
        # block the window for that.
        worker = self._worker
        worker.requestInterruption()
        if worker.isRunning():
            keep_until_finished(worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)

```

# States of the window
_LOADING, _IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY, _RECORDING = range(5)


class NativeRowModel(TraceRowModel):
    """The functions the scenario called (TraceRows of NativeFunctions)."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, parent)
        self.columns = tuple("native_trace.column_function" if column == "trace.column_method"
                             else column for column in self.columns)

    def method_name(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].label


class NativeSequenceModel(TraceSequenceModel):
    """The first calls of the scenario, the call instruction as the caller."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, parent)
        self.columns = tuple("native_trace.column_function" if column == "trace.column_method"
                             else column for column in self.columns)

    def method_name(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].label


class NativeTraceDialog(QDialog):
    """Follow threads of the game with Stalker, record a baseline and a scenario, compare.

    Not modal. The worker and its Frida session live as long as the window;
    closing it stops following the threads.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # address (int) to show in the memory viewer
    memory_requested = Signal(object)
    # NativeFunction whose calls to monitor
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None, favorites=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.wine = is_wine_process(pid)
        self._favorites = favorites
        self.functions = []
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self.rows = []
        self.followed_modules = set()
        self._state = _LOADING
        self._recording = None
        self._selected = None
        self._positions = {}
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["native_trace.title"])
        self.resize(1100, 760)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = NativeTraceWorker(pid)
        self._worker.inventory_found.connect(self._on_inventory)
        self._worker.started.connect(self._on_started)
        self._worker.began.connect(self._on_began)
        self._worker.live.connect(self._on_live)
        self._worker.recorded.connect(self._on_recorded)
        self._worker.stopped.connect(self._on_stopped)
        self._worker.command_failed.connect(self._on_command_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self._worker.start()
        self._worker.inventory()
        self.status_label.setText(translations["native_trace.loading"])
        self._set_state(_LOADING)

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations

        layout.addWidget(hint)

            layout.addWidget(warning)

        scope = QHBoxLayout()

        scope.addLayout(threads, 1)

        modules.addWidget(self.module_list)
        scope.addLayout(modules, 1)
        scope_widget = QWidget()

        scope_widget.setMaximumHeight(180)
        layout.addWidget(scope_widget)

        steps = QHBoxLayout()

        self.trace_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button, "play_arrow")
        self.trace_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        steps.addWidget(self.trace_button)
        self.baseline_button = QPushButton(t["trace.baseline"])
        set_button_icon(self.baseline_button, RECORDING_ICONS["baseline"])
        self.baseline_button.setToolTip(t["trace.baseline_tooltip"])
        self.baseline_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.baseline_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("baseline"))
        steps.addWidget(self.baseline_button)

        set_button_icon(self.scenario_button, RECORDING_ICONS["scenario"])
        self.scenario_button.setToolTip(t["trace.scenario_tooltip"])
        self.scenario_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.scenario_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("scenario"))
        steps.addWidget(self.scenario_button)
        self.recording_label = QLabel("")
        steps.addWidget(self.recording_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(steps)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        top = QWidget()

        self.game_code_check.setToolTip(t["native_trace.game_code_tooltip"])

        rows_bar.addWidget(self.game_code_check)
        self.notable_check = QCheckBox(t["native_trace.notable_only"])
        self.notable_check.setToolTip(t["native_trace.notable_tooltip"])
        self.notable_check.setChecked(True)
        self.notable_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._show_rows())
        rows_bar.addWidget(self.notable_check)
        top_layout.addLayout(rows_bar)
        self.row_filter = RowFilterBar(t, self)
        self.row_filter.changed.connect(self._show_rows)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.row_filter)
        self.row_model = NativeRowModel(t, self)
        self.rows_view = self._table(self.row_model, _R_METHOD, sortable=True)
        header = self.rows_view.horizontalHeader()
        header.resizeSection(_R_ORDER, 60)
        header.resizeSection(_R_CALLS, 80)
        header.resizeSection(_R_RATE, 90)

        self.rows_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_row_selected)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.rows_view, 1)
