from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import EMPTY
from grembyte.ui import window_state
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import WrappedLabel
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import resizable_columns, set_row_height

ENTRY_COLUMN, GAME_COLUMN, COUNT_COLUMN, SIZE_COLUMN, REASON_COLUMN = range(5)

# The scans (ObsoleteScan.key) the user chose to keep; not offered again
# until they are filtered or scanned anew.
_KEPT_KEY = "pointer_scan/kept_obsolete"


def kept_scans():
    """The keys of the obsolete scans the user chose to keep."""
    stored = window_state.settings().value(_KEPT_KEY)
    if isinstance(stored, str):
        return set(filter(None, stored.split("\n")))
    if isinstance(stored, (list, tuple)):
        return {str(key) for key in stored}
    return set()


def keep_scans(scans, current):
    """Remember ``scans`` as kept; ``current`` are all obsolete scans now (the rest
    is forgotten, so the list does not grow)."""
    keys = (kept_scans() & {scan.key() for scan in current}) | {scan.key() for scan in scans}
    window_state.settings().setValue(_KEPT_KEY, "\n".join(sorted(keys)))


def scans_to_offer(scans):
    """The obsolete ``scans`` the user did not choose to keep."""
    kept = kept_scans()
    return [scan for scan in scans if scan.key() not in kept]


class PointerCleanupDialog(QDialog):
    """List obsolete pointer scans with a check box each; ``chosen()`` after accept."""

    def __init__(self, translations, scans, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.scans = list(scans)
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["pointer_cleanup.title"])
        self.resize(760, 360)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        total = sum(scan.size for scan in self.scans)
        layout.addWidget(WrappedLabel(translations["pointer_cleanup.hint"].format(
            count=len(self.scans), size=total / 1e6)))

        self.table = QTableWidget(len(self.scans), 5)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            translations["pointer_cleanup.column_entry"],
            translations["pointer_cleanup.column_game"],
            translations["pointer_cleanup.column_count"],
            translations["pointer_cleanup.column_size"],
            translations["pointer_cleanup.column_reason"],
        ])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        for row, scan in enumerate(self.scans):
            entry = QTableWidgetItem(scan.label)
            entry.setFlags(entry.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            entry.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
            self.table.setItem(row, ENTRY_COLUMN, entry)
            self.table.setItem(row, GAME_COLUMN, QTableWidgetItem(scan.process))
            count = QTableWidgetItem("–" if scan.count is None else str(scan.count))
            size = QTableWidgetItem(translations["pointer_cleanup.size"].format(
                size=scan.size / 1e6))
            for item in (count, size):
                item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
            self.table.setItem(row, COUNT_COLUMN, count)
            self.table.setItem(row, SIZE_COLUMN, size)
            reason = translations[f"pointer_cleanup.reason_{scan.reason}"]
            if scan.reason != EMPTY:
                reason = reason.format(days=scan.days)
            self.table.setItem(row, REASON_COLUMN, QTableWidgetItem(reason))
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in (ENTRY_COLUMN, GAME_COLUMN, COUNT_COLUMN, SIZE_COLUMN):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(REASON_COLUMN, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(
            translations, "pointer_cleanup.delete", self.accept, self.reject))

    def chosen(self):
        """The scans whose box is ticked."""
        return [scan for row, scan in enumerate(self.scans)
                if self.table.item(row, ENTRY_COLUMN).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

"""Dialog for finding pointer chains to an address-list entry."""

import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QThread, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

# Rows shown in the result table; all candidates are kept and filtered.
DISPLAY_LIMIT = 2000
# Candidates added to the address list at most at once; each one is
# resolved again on every refresh of the list.
ADOPT_LIMIT = 500

# How long closing the dialog waits for a cancelled scan.

# The memory categories chosen last (see grembyte.core.memory_regions), apart
# for Mono games with marked assemblies, whose defaults differ.
_CATEGORIES_KEY = "pointer_scan/categories"
_ASSEMBLY_CATEGORIES_KEY = "pointer_scan/categories_assemblies"


def _remembered_categories(with_assemblies):
    """The categories chosen last, else the defaults."""
    key, default = ((_ASSEMBLY_CATEGORIES_KEY, memory_regions.ASSEMBLY_DEFAULT_CATEGORIES)
                    if with_assemblies else
                    (_CATEGORIES_KEY, memory_regions.DEFAULT_CATEGORIES))
    stored = window_state.settings().value(key)
    if not isinstance(stored, str) or not stored:
        return set(default)
    chosen = set(stored.split(",")) & set(memory_regions.CATEGORIES)
    return chosen or set(default)


class PointerScanWorker(QThread):
    """Run a pointer scan, or filter candidates, outside the GUI thread."""

    # phase ("reading", "searching", "filtering") and percent or level
    progress = Signal(str, int)
    chains_ready = Signal(object)
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, pid, target, *, chains=None, max_depth=5, max_offset=0x1000,
                 max_results=10000, categories=None, main_module=None, location_step=None,
                 value_alignment=None, assemblies=(), parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        """``categories`` (see grembyte.core.memory_regions) limit the memory read
        and the modules chains may start in; None reads all writable memory.
        ``location_step`` and ``value_alignment`` see ``PointerMap.build``.
        With the category ``assemblies``, chains may also start in the static
        data of the classes of ``assemblies`` (Mono)."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        logs.log_failures(self)
        self.pid = pid
        self.target = target
        self.chains = chains
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.max_offset = max_offset
        self.max_results = max_results
        self.categories = categories
        self.main_module = main_module
        self.location_step = location_step
        self.value_alignment = value_alignment
        self.assemblies = tuple(assemblies)
        # Modules chains may start in, from ``categories`` (set by the scan).
        self.base_modules = None
        # The StaticAreas of ``assemblies`` (set by the scan).
        self.static_areas = []
        # Chain length up to which the results are complete if the scan
        # stopped at its memory limit, else None (set by the scan).
        self.complete_depth = None

    def run(self):
        try:
            if self.chains is None:
                result = self._scan()
            else:
                result = self._filter()
        except ScanCancelled:
            return
        except managed_statics.READ_ERRORS + (MemoryError,) as error:
            if not self.isInterruptionRequested():
                self.failed.emit(messages.describe(error))
            return
        if result is not None and not self.isInterruptionRequested():
            self.chains_ready.emit(result)

    def _scan(self):
        if (self.categories is not None and memory_regions.ASSEMBLIES in self.categories
                and self.assemblies):
            self.static_areas = managed_statics.read_static_areas(
                self.pid, {assembly: None for assembly in self.assemblies})
        pointer_map = PointerMap.build(
            self.pid,
            progress=lambda percent: self.progress.emit("reading", percent),
            cancelled=self.isInterruptionRequested,
            location_step=self.location_step,
            value_alignment=self.value_alignment,
            select=None if self.categories is None else self._select,
            static_areas=[(area.address, area.address + area.size, area.name)
                          for area in self.static_areas],
        )
        chains = pointer_map.find_chains(
            self.target,
            max_depth=self.max_depth,
            max_offset=self.max_offset,
            max_results=self.max_results,
            base_modules=self.base_modules,
            progress=lambda level: self.progress.emit("searching", level),
            cancelled=self.isInterruptionRequested,
        )
        self.complete_depth = pointer_map.complete_depth
        return chains

    def _select(self, mappings):
        regions = memory_regions.classify(mappings, self.main_module,
                                          thread_stack_pointers(self.pid))
        ranges, self.base_modules = memory_regions.selection(regions, self.categories)
        self.base_modules |= {area.name for area in self.static_areas}
        return ranges

    def _filter(self):
        missing = missing_managed_bases(self.pid, self.chains)
        if missing:
            managed_statics.read_static_areas(self.pid, missing)
        bases = chain_bases(self.pid, read_mappings(self.pid))
        kept = []
        with ProcessMemory(self.pid) as memory:
            for index, chain in enumerate(self.chains):
                if self.isInterruptionRequested():
                    return None
                if resolve_chain(memory, bases, chain) == self.target:
                    kept.append(chain)
                if index % 500 == 0:
                    self.progress.emit("filtering", index * 100 // len(self.chains))
        return kept


class PointerScanDialog(QDialog):
    """Search, filter and pick a pointer chain for an address-list entry.

    The candidates are saved for the entry, so after the program was
    restarted they can be filtered with the address the value has now.

        offset_label.setToolTip(self.translations["pointer.offset_tooltip"])
        limits.addWidget(offset_label)
        self.offset_input = QLineEdit(f"0x{self._scan.max_offset if self._scan else 0x1000:X}")
        self.offset_input.setToolTip(self.translations["pointer.offset_tooltip"])
        limits.addWidget(self.offset_input, 1)
        form.addRow(self.translations["pointer.depth"], limits)
        # Where chains may start; the heap lies between the steps of every chain.
        chosen = _remembered_categories(bool(self.assemblies))
        self.region_boxes = {}
        starts = [category for category in memory_regions.START_CATEGORIES
                  if category != memory_regions.ASSEMBLIES or self.assemblies is not None]
        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        for position, category in enumerate(starts):
            box = QCheckBox()
            box.setChecked(category in chosen)
            box.setEnabled(category != memory_regions.ASSEMBLIES or bool(self.assemblies))
            box.toggled.connect(self._remember_categories)
            self.region_boxes[category] = box
            grid.addWidget(box, position // 3, position % 3)
        form.addRow(self.translations["pointer.regions_start"], grid)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_scan = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.scan"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_scan, "search")
        self.btn_scan.clicked.connect(self.start_scan)
        self.btn_filter = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.filter"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_filter, "filter_alt")
        self.btn_filter.setToolTip(self.translations["pointer.filter_tooltip"])
        self.btn_filter.clicked.connect(self.start_filter)
        self.btn_cancel = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.cancel"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_cancel, "close")
        self.btn_cancel.clicked.connect(self._cancel)
        self.btn_cancel.setVisible(False)
        actions.addWidget(self.btn_scan)
        actions.addWidget(self.btn_filter)
        actions.addWidget(self.btn_cancel)
        self.progress = QProgressBar()
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        actions.addWidget(self.progress, 1)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.status_label = WrappedLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["pointer.column_score"],
            self.translations["pointer.column_base"],
            self.translations["pointer.column_offsets"],
            self.translations["pointer.column_depth"],
        ])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, self.translations)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        self.table.doubleClicked.connect(self._accept)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        bottom = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_adopt = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.adopt_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_adopt, "playlist_add")
        self.btn_adopt.setToolTip(self.translations["pointer.adopt_all_tooltip"])
        self.btn_adopt.clicked.connect(self.adopt_candidates)
        bottom.addWidget(self.btn_adopt)
        # Once a stable chain is in use, the candidates are no longer needed.
        self.btn_clear = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.clear_scan"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_clear, "delete_sweep")
        self.btn_clear.setToolTip(self.translations["pointer.clear_scan_tooltip"])
        self.btn_clear.clicked.connect(self.clear_scan)
        bottom.addWidget(self.btn_clear)
        bottom.addStretch()
        # Docks the dialog in the main window (see grembyte.ui.widgets.docking)
        self.pin_button = PinButton(self.translations, "pointer.pin_tooltip")
        bottom.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        close = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.close"])
        set_button_icon(close, "close")
        close.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self.btn_use = QPushButton(self.translations["pointer.use"])
        self.btn_use.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.btn_use, "check")
        self.btn_use.clicked.connect(self._accept)
        bottom.addWidget(close)
        bottom.addWidget(self.btn_use)
        layout.addLayout(bottom)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # State
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_scan(self):
        try:
            return self.repository.get_pointer_scan(self.entry["id"])
        except SQLAlchemyError:
            return None

    def candidates(self):
        """Return the current candidate chains, the most promising first."""
        return [chain for chain, _score in self._ranking]

    def _rank(self):
        """Score the candidates (see grembyte.core.chain_score), best first."""
        chains = [] if self._scan is None else self._scan.chains
        categories = dict(self._module_categories)
        categories.update((chain.module, memory_regions.ASSEMBLIES) for chain in chains
                          if split_managed(chain.module) is not None)
        self._ranking = chain_score.ranked(chains, categories, self._pointer_size())

    def _base_text(self, chain):
        """The base of ``chain`` as the table shows it; a static field by its name."""
        managed = split_managed(chain.module)
        if managed is None:
            return f"{chain.module}+0x{chain.base_offset:x}"
        area = self._areas.get(chain.module)
        field = area.field_at(chain.base_offset) if area is not None else None
        if field is not None:
            return f"[{managed[0]}] {managed[1]}.{field}"
        return f"[{managed[0]}] {managed[1]}+0x{chain.base_offset:x}"

    def _pointer_size(self):
        return pointer_size(self.pid)

    def _score_tooltip(self, result):
        t = self.translations
        lines = []
        for reason, points, detail in result.parts:
            if reason == "start":
                text = t["pointer.score_start"].format(group=t[f"pointer.region.{detail}"])
            elif reason == "length":
                text = t["pointer.score_length"].format(count=detail)
            elif reason == "offsets":
                text = t["pointer.score_offsets"].format(limit=f"{detail:#x}")
            else:
                text = t["pointer.score_aligned"]
            lines.append(f"{points:+d}  {text}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _show_candidates(self, message=None):
        self._rank()
        chains = self.candidates()
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        for chain, result in self._ranking[:DISPLAY_LIMIT]:
            row = self.table.rowCount()
            self.table.insertRow(row)
            score = QTableWidgetItem(str(result.total))
            score.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, chain)
            score.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
            score.setToolTip(self._score_tooltip(result))
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, score)
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(self._base_text(chain)))
            offsets = " → ".join(f"{offset:#x}" for offset in chain.offsets) or "—"
            self.table.setItem(row, 2, QTableWidgetItem(offsets))
            self.table.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem(str(len(chain.offsets))))
        if message is None:
            if self._scan is None:
                message = self.translations["pointer.no_scan"]
            else:
                message = self.translations["pointer.candidates"].format(
                    count=len(chains), rounds=self._scan.rounds
                )
        if len(chains) > DISPLAY_LIMIT:
            message += "  " + self.translations["pointer.display_limit"].format(
                count=DISPLAY_LIMIT
            )
        self.status_label.setText(message)
        self._update_buttons()

    def set_process(self, pid):
        """Switch to the restarted program, or to None while it is not running.

        A running scan or filter of the previous process is cancelled.
        """
        if pid == self.pid:
            return
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
        self.pid = pid
        if pid is None:
            self._static_chain = None
            self.static_label.setVisible(False)
            self.btn_static.setVisible(False)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.process_exited"])
        else:
            self._main_module = main_module(pid)
            self._show_regions()
            self._show_candidates(self.translations["pointer.process_attached"])
        self._update_buttons()

    def _update_buttons(self):
        running = self._worker is not None
        attached = self.pid is not None
        self.btn_scan.setEnabled(not running and attached)
        self.btn_filter.setEnabled(not running and attached and bool(self.candidates()))
        self.btn_cancel.setVisible(running)
        self.progress.setVisible(running)
        self.btn_use.setEnabled(
            not running and attached and self._selected_chain() is not None
        )
        self.btn_adopt.setEnabled(not running and attached and bool(self.candidates()))
        selected = len(self._selected_chains()) > 1
        self.btn_adopt.setText(self.translations[
            "pointer.adopt_selected" if selected else "pointer.adopt_all"])
        self.btn_adopt.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "pointer.adopt_selected_tooltip" if selected else "pointer.adopt_all_tooltip"])
        self.btn_clear.setEnabled(not running and self._scan is not None)
        self.btn_scan.setProperty("primary", self._scan is None)
        self.btn_filter.setProperty("primary", self._scan is not None)
        for button in (self.btn_scan, self.btn_filter):
            button.style().unpolish(button)
            button.style().polish(button)

    def _show_regions(self):
        """Label each memory category with its size and list its modules."""
        summary = None
        if self.pid is not None:
            try:
                mappings = read_mappings(self.pid)
                summary = memory_regions.summarize(memory_regions.classify(
                    mappings, self._main_module, thread_stack_pointers(self.pid)))
                self._module_categories = memory_regions.module_categories(
                    mappings, self._main_module)
            except OSError:
                summary = None
        t = self.translations
        for category, box in self.region_boxes.items():
            name = t[f"pointer.region.{category}"]
            tooltip = t[f"pointer.region.{category}_tooltip"]
            if category == memory_regions.ASSEMBLIES:
                name, tooltip = self._assemblies_text(name, tooltip)
            elif summary is not None:
                entry = summary[category]
                size = self._size_text(entry.size)
                if category == memory_regions.MAIN and entry.modules:
                    name += f" ({entry.modules[0]}, {size})"
                elif category in memory_regions.MODULE_CATEGORIES:
                    key = "pointer.region_module" if len(entry.modules) == 1 \
                        else "pointer.region_modules"
                    name += " (" + t[key].format(count=len(entry.modules), size=size) + ")"
                else:
                    name += f" ({size})"
                if entry.modules and category != memory_regions.MAIN:
                    shown = entry.modules[:_TOOLTIP_MODULES]
                    tooltip += "\n\n" + ", ".join(shown)
                    if len(entry.modules) > len(shown):
                        tooltip += " " + t["pointer.region_more"].format(
                            count=len(entry.modules) - len(shown))
            box.setText(name)
            box.setToolTip(tooltip)

    def _size_text(self, size):
        """``size`` bytes, in KB from a kilobyte, in MB from a megabyte."""
        if size < 2**10:
            return self.translations["pointer.region_size_bytes"].format(size=size)
        if size < 2**20:
            return self.translations["pointer.region_size_kb"].format(size=size / 2**10)
        return self.translations["pointer.region_size"].format(size=size / 2**20)

    def _assemblies_text(self, name, tooltip):
        """Label and tooltip of the marked assemblies: their names, after a
        scan the number and size of their classes' static data."""
        t = self.translations
        if not self.assemblies:
            return name + " (" + t["pointer.region.assemblies_none"] + ")", tooltip
        if self._areas:
            size = self._size_text(sum(area.size for area in self._areas.values()))
            key = "pointer.region_class" if len(self._areas) == 1 else "pointer.region_classes"
            name += " (" + t[key].format(count=len(self._areas), size=size) + ")"
        else:
            shown = ", ".join(self.assemblies[:2])
            name += f" ({shown}{', …' if len(self.assemblies) > 2 else ''})"
        return name, tooltip + "\n\n" + ", ".join(self.assemblies)

    def _chosen_categories(self):
        """The categories to scan: the chosen starts, the heap and, if set, the stacks."""
        chosen = {category for category, box in self.region_boxes.items() if box.isChecked()}
        chosen |= memory_regions.REQUIRED_CATEGORIES
        if settings.get("pointer_stacks"):
            chosen.add(memory_regions.STACK)
        return chosen

    def _remember_categories(self):
        starts = {category for category, box in self.region_boxes.items() if box.isChecked()}
        window_state.settings().setValue(
            _ASSEMBLY_CATEGORIES_KEY if self.assemblies else _CATEGORIES_KEY,
            ",".join(sorted(starts)))

    def _selected_chains(self):
        """The chains of the selected rows, in table order."""
        rows = sorted(index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows())
        items = (self.table.item(row, 0) for row in rows)
        return [item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) for item in items if item is not None]

    def _selected_chain(self):
        """The selected chain if exactly one is selected, else None."""
        chains = self._selected_chains()
        return chains[0] if len(chains) == 1 else None

    def _check_static(self, address):
        """Show whether ``address`` is static, i.e. needs no pointer at all."""
        try:
            self._static_chain = chain_for_static_address(read_mappings(self.pid), address)
        except (OSError, TypeError):
            self._static_chain = None
        static = self._static_chain is not None
        if static:
            self.static_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.static"].format(
                chain=self._static_chain.text()
            ))
        self.static_label.setVisible(static)
        self.btn_static.setVisible(static)
        return static

    def _use_static(self):
        if self._static_chain is not None and self._worker is None and self.pid is not None:
            self._choose(self._static_chain, static=True)

    def take_scan_address(self):
        """Use the address selected in the scanner results."""
        address = self.address_source() if self.address_source is not None else None
        if address is None:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.from_scan_none"])
            return
        self.address_input.setText(f"0x{address:X}")
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.from_scan_done"].format(
            address=f"0x{address:X}"
        ))

    def _target(self):
        try:
            return int(self.address_input.text().strip(), 0)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ValueError(self.translations["pointer.invalid_address"]) from error

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Actions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def start_scan(self):
        """Search chains to the entered address, replacing saved candidates."""
        try:
            target = self._target()
            max_offset = int(self.offset_input.text().strip(), 0)
            if max_offset <= 0:
                raise ValueError
        except ValueError:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.invalid_input"])
            return
        self._check_static(target)
        if self._scan is not None and self._scan.chains:
            answer = QMessageBox.question(
                self,
                self.windowTitle(),
                self.translations["pointer.replace_confirm"].format(
                    count=len(self._scan.chains)
                ),
            )
            if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return
        limits = {
            "max_depth": self.depth_input.value(),
            "max_offset": max_offset,
        }
        max_results = settings.get("pointer_max_results")
        size = self._pointer_size()
        worker = PointerScanWorker(
            self.pid, target, max_results=max_results,
            categories=self._chosen_categories(), main_module=self._main_module,
            location_step=settings.pointer_alignment("pointer_location_step", size),
            value_alignment=settings.pointer_alignment("pointer_value_alignment", size),
            assemblies=self.assemblies or (), **limits
        )
        self._start(worker, lambda chains: self._scan_done(
            chains, limits, max_results, worker.complete_depth, worker.static_areas
        ))

    def start_filter(self):
        """Keep the candidates that lead to the entered address now."""
        try:
            target = self._target()
        except ValueError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(str(error))
            return
        self._start(
            PointerScanWorker(self.pid, target, chains=self.candidates()),
            self._filter_done,
        )

    def _start(self, worker, on_done):
        self._worker = worker
        # The dialog may be deleted before a cancelled worker has finished.
        worker.progress.connect(self._if_alive(self._on_progress))
        worker.chains_ready.connect(self._if_alive(on_done))
        worker.failed.connect(self._if_alive(self._on_failed))
        worker.finished.connect(self._if_alive(lambda: self._on_finished(worker)))
        # The dialog may be deleted before a cancelled worker has finished.
        keep_until_finished(worker)
        worker.finished.connect(worker.deleteLater)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        worker.start()
        self._update_buttons()

    def _if_alive(self, callback):
        """Wrap a worker callback so it is skipped once the dialog is deleted."""
        return lambda *args: None if not getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(self) else callback(*args)

    def _on_progress(self, phase, value):
        if phase == "searching":
            self.progress.setRange(0, self.depth_input.value())
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["pointer.searching"].format(level=value)
            )
        else:
            self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations[f"pointer.{phase}"])
        self.progress.setValue(value)

    def _scan_done(self, chains, limits, max_results, complete_depth, static_areas=()):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        if static_areas:
            self._areas = {area.name: area for area in static_areas}
            self._show_regions()
        self._scan = SavedPointerScan(chains, limits["max_depth"], limits["max_offset"], 0)
        self._save()
        message = self.translations["pointer.found"].format(count=len(chains))
        if len(chains) >= max_results:
            message += "  " + self.translations["pointer.limit_reached"].format(
                depth=len(chains[-1].offsets)
            )
        if complete_depth is not None:
            message += "  " + self.translations["pointer.truncated"].format(
                depth=complete_depth
            )
        if not chains:
            message = self.translations[
                "pointer.none_found_static" if self._static_chain else "pointer.none_found"
            ]
        self._show_candidates(message)

    def _filter_done(self, chains):
        before = len(self._scan.chains)
        self._scan = SavedPointerScan(
            chains, self._scan.max_depth, self._scan.max_offset, self._scan.rounds + 1
        )
        self._save()
        self._show_candidates(self.translations["pointer.filtered"].format(
            before=before, count=len(chains), rounds=self._scan.rounds
        ))

    def _save(self):
        try:
            self.repository.save_pointer_scan(self.entry["id"], self._scan)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["hooks.db_failed"].format(message=error)
            )

    def _on_failed(self, message):
        if self.pid is None:
            return  # the process exited; that is reported already
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_finished(self, worker):
        if worker is self._worker:
            self._worker = None
        self._update_buttons()

    def _cancel(self):
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.cancelled"])

    def wait_for_worker(self, timeout_ms=None):
        """Wait until a running scan or filter has finished (for tests)."""
        worker = self._worker
        if worker is not None:
            if timeout_ms is None:
                worker.wait()
            else:
                worker.wait(timeout_ms)

    def _accept(self):
        chain = self._selected_chain()
        if chain is None or self._worker is not None or self.pid is None:
            return
        self._choose(chain)

    def adopt_candidates(self):
        """Add the candidates to the address list, to check them after a restart.

        With several rows selected only those are added.
        """
        selected = self._selected_chains()
        chains = selected if len(selected) > 1 else self.candidates()
        if not chains or self._worker is not None or self.pid is None:
            return
        if len(chains) > ADOPT_LIMIT:
            question = self.translations["pointer.adopt_limit_confirm"].format(
                count=len(chains), limit=ADOPT_LIMIT
            )
        else:
            question = self.translations["pointer.adopt_confirm"].format(count=len(chains))
        if QMessageBox.question(self, self.windowTitle(), question) \
                != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        self.chains_adopted.emit(chains[:ADOPT_LIMIT])

    def clear_scan(self):
        """Remove the saved candidates of this entry; its pointer stays."""
        if self._scan is None or self._worker is not None:
            return
        question = self.translations["pointer.clear_scan_confirm"].format(
            count=len(self._scan.chains))
        if QMessageBox.question(self, self.windowTitle(), question) \
                != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self.repository.delete_pointer_scan(self.entry["id"])
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["hooks.db_failed"].format(message=error))
            return
        self._scan = None
        self._show_candidates(self.translations["pointer.scan_cleared"])

    def show_adopted(self, count):
        """Report how many candidates were added to the address list (None: entry gone)."""
        if count is None:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.entry_missing"])
        else:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["pointer.adopted"].format(count=count))

    def _choose(self, chain, static=False):
        self.chain = chain
        self.chain_chosen.emit(chain)
        self._offer_clear(static)
        self.accept()

    def _offer_clear(self, static):
        """Offer to delete the candidates once a chain is in use.

        Asked when the chain was filtered after a restart at least once, or
        when the address is static and needs no chain search at all.
        """
        if self._scan is None or not self._scan.chains or not (static or self._scan.rounds):
            return
        question = self.translations["pointer.clear_after_choose"].format(
            count=len(self._scan.chains))
        if QMessageBox.question(self, self.windowTitle(), question) \
                != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self.repository.delete_pointer_scans([self.entry["id"]])
        except SQLAlchemyError:
            return  # kept; File > Delete saved entries removes it later
        self._scan = None
        try:
            self.repository.compact()
        except SQLAlchemyError:
            pass  # e.g. another connection writes; File > Compact database does it later

    def done(self, result):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Stop a running scan before closing (it may finish after a timeout)."""
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
            self._worker.wait(STOP_TIMEOUT_MS)
        super().done(result)

`grembyte/ui/widgets/process_list.py`:

```py
"""Process selection dialog widget."""

import psutil

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QCheckBox,
    QTableWidget, QTableWidgetItem, QLineEdit,
    QHeaderView, QAbstractItemView, QMessageBox,
)

from grembyte.core import cli_link
from grembyte.core.programs import resolve_display
from grembyte.engines.unreal.adapter import bootstrapped_game
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height
from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import material_icon, theme_qcolor


class ProcessSelectDialog(QDialog):
    """Lists running processes and lets the user select one."""

    # Dialog behavior is exposed through Qt signals rather than public methods.
    # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods

    def __init__(self, parent=None, translations=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations or load_translations()
        self.setWindowTitle(self.translations["process.dialog_title"])
        self.setMinimumSize(480, 400)
        self.selected_pid = None
        self.selected_name = None
        self.selected_path = None
        self._build_ui()
        self._load_processes()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        # Search bar
        search_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["process.search_placeholder"])
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(self._filter)
        search_bar.addWidget(self.search_input, 1)
        self.cli_only = QCheckBox(self.translations["process.cli_only"])
        self.cli_only.setToolTip(self.translations["process.cli_only_tooltip"])
        self.cli_only.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._filter())
        search_bar.addWidget(self.cli_only)
        layout.addLayout(search_bar)

        # Process list
        self.list = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        # One line per process: a long path is shortened, not broken at a space.
        self.list.setWordWrap(False)
        self.list.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["process.column_pid"],
            self.translations["process.column_name"],
            self.translations["process.column_path"],
        ])
        self.list.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        resizable_columns(self.list)
        copy_menu(self.list, self.translations)
        self.list.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.list.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.list.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.list.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.list)
        self.list.doubleClicked.connect(self._accept)
        layout.addWidget(self.list)

        # Buttons
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(
            self.translations, "process.attach", self._accept, self.reject
        ))

    def _load_processes(self):
        """Loads the process list via psutil."""
        # Games that grembyte-cli runs are marked: attaching takes them over.
        self._cli_games = cli_link.cli_games()
        try:
            self._all_procs = []
            for proc in psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name", "exe", "cmdline", "cwd"]):
                try:
                    info = proc.info
                    name, path = resolve_display(
                        info["name"] or "",
                        info["exe"] or "",
                        info["cmdline"],
                        info["cwd"],
                    )
                    self._all_procs.append((str(info["pid"]), name, path))
                except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.AccessDenied):
                    pass
            self._all_procs.sort(key=lambda x: x[1].lower())
            self._populate(self._all_procs)
        except ImportError:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                self.translations["process.psutil_missing_title"],
                self.translations["process.psutil_missing_message"],
            )

    def _populate(self, procs):
        self.list.setRowCount(0)
        for pid, name, exe in procs:
            row = self.list.rowCount()
            self.list.insertRow(row)
            pid_item = QTableWidgetItem(pid)
            pid_item.setForeground(theme_qcolor("accent"))
            self.list.setItem(row, 0, pid_item)
            name_item = QTableWidgetItem(name)
            cli = self._cli_games.get(int(pid))
            if cli is not None:
                name_item.setIcon(material_icon("link"))
                name_item.setToolTip(self.translations["process.cli_tooltip"].format(
                    cli_pid=cli["pid"]))
            self.list.setItem(row, 1, name_item)
            path_item = QTableWidgetItem(exe)
            path_item.setForeground(theme_qcolor("muted"))
            self.list.setItem(row, 2, path_item)

    def _filter(self, _text=None):
        """Show the processes matching the search text (and run by grembyte-cli)."""
        text = self.search_input.text().lower()
        cli_only = self.cli_only.isChecked()
        filtered = [
            p for p in self._all_procs
            if (text in p[1].lower() or text in p[2].lower())
            and (not cli_only or int(p[0]) in self._cli_games)
        ]
        self._populate(filtered)

    def _accept(self):
        row = self.list.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            pid, name, path = (self.list.item(row, column).text() for column in range(3))
            # An Unreal game's bootstrap only starts the game; attach to that.
            game = bootstrapped_game(path, [proc[2] for proc in self._all_procs])
            if game is not None:
                pid, name, path = next(proc for proc in self._all_procs if proc[2] == game)
            self.selected_pid = int(pid)
            self.selected_name = name
            self.selected_path = path
            self.accept()

```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/saved_games.py`:

"""Choosing a saved game (a process in the database), e.g. for its notes.

Like the offline catalog's choice of a game (see known_games), but it lists
every process Grembyte has saved, whatever its engine: a game is saved once
Grembyte attaches to it.

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,

from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

from grembyte.db.repository.game_export import GameExportRepository
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height

_GAME, _PLATFORM, _NOTES, _PATH = range(4)


class SavedGamesDialog(QDialog):
    """List the saved processes; ``process`` is the SavedProcess chosen.

    ``current`` is the database id of a process to select first.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, repository=None, current=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.process = None
        repository = repository or GameExportRepository()
        error = None
        try:
            self.processes = repository.list_processes()
        except SQLAlchemyError as failure:
            self.processes = []
            error = failure
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["saved_games.title"])
        self.resize(820, 420)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        if error is not None:
            hint = QLabel(translations["saved_games.failed"].format(error=error))
        else:
            hint = QLabel(translations["saved_games.hint" if self.processes else "saved_games.none"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self.table = QTableWidget(len(self.processes), 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            translations["export.column_name"], translations["export.column_platform"],
            translations["export.column_notes"], translations["import.column_path"]])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        for row, process in enumerate(self.processes):
            for column, text in ((_GAME, process.name), (_PLATFORM, process.platform),
                                 (_NOTES, str(process.counts.get("notes", 0))),
                                 (_PATH, process.path)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == _NOTES:
                    item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
                if column == _PATH:
                    item.setToolTip(text)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in (_GAME, _PLATFORM, _NOTES):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_PATH, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, translations)
        self.table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _row, _column: self._accept())
        ids = [process.process_id for process in self.processes]
        if ids:
            self.table.selectRow(ids.index(current) if current in ids else 0)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        buttons = dialog_button_row(translations, "saved_games.open", self._accept, self.reject)
        self.open_button = buttons.itemAt(buttons.count() - 1).widget()
        self.open_button.setEnabled(bool(self.processes))
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def _accept(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if 0 <= row < len(self.processes):
            self.process = self.processes[row]
            self.accept()

`grembyte/ui/widgets/script_params.py`:

```py
"""Parameters of scripts: defining them (ParamEditor, in the script dialog)
and typing them in when a script is run by hand (ScriptRunDialog).

See ScriptParam in grembyte.features.scripts. A choice's options come from its
code in the game; the run dialog asks the script worker for them once per
session (``options_cache``) and shows them in a combo box that filters by
any part of a choice's text.
"""

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QCompleter,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.core import messages
from grembyte.features.scripts import PARAM_KINDS, ScriptParam, choice_matches
from grembyte.hooks.syntax import BODY
from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import CodeEditor
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import DocsHint, WrappedLabel
from grembyte.ui.widgets.syntax_hint import SyntaxHint, syntax_problem

OPTIONS_EXAMPLE = """\
// The choices: values, or {label, value}
return [
  { label: "Strength (melee damage)", value: "Strength" },
  { label: "Dexterity (hit chance)", value: "Dexterity" },
];
"""


class ParamEditor(QWidget):
    """The parameters of a script: a row each (name, label, type, default)
    and, for the selected choice, the code that gives its options."""

    _COLUMNS = ("scripts.param_name", "scripts.param_label", "scripts.param_kind",
                "scripts.param_default")

    def __init__(self, translations, params=(), parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        # the options code of each row (the editor shows the selected row's)
        self._options = []
        self._shown = None
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 6, 0, 0)
        hint = DocsHint(translations, translations["scripts.params_help"], "guide/scripts/#parameters")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(self._COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([translations[key] for key in self._COLUMNS])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        if header is not None:
            header.setSectionResizeMode(QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(60)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._show_options)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_add = QPushButton(translations["scripts.param_add"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_add, "add")
        self.btn_add.clicked.connect(lambda: self.add_param(ScriptParam(self._free_name())))
        self.btn_remove = QPushButton(translations["scripts.param_remove"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_remove, "remove")
        self.btn_remove.clicked.connect(self._remove_selected)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_add)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_remove)
        buttons.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.options_label = WrappedLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.options_label)
        self.options_edit = CodeEditor("")
        self.options_edit.setMinimumHeight(60)
        layout.addWidget(self.options_edit, 1)
        self.options_hint = SyntaxHint(translations, self.options_edit, BODY)
        layout.addWidget(self.options_hint)

        for param in params:
            self.add_param(param)
        if params:
            self.table.selectRow(0)
        self._show_options()

    def _free_name(self):
        names = {self._cell(row, 0) for row in range(self.table.rowCount())}
        return next(f"param{n}" for n in range(1, len(names) + 2) if f"param{n}" not in names)

    def _cell(self, row, column):
        item = self.table.item(row, column)
        return "" if item is None else item.text()

    def _kind(self, row):
        combo = self.table.cellWidget(row, 2)
        return combo.currentData() if combo is not None else "text"

    def add_param(self, param):
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        self.table.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(param.name))
        self.table.setItem(row, 1, QTableWidgetItem(param.label))
        kind = QComboBox()
        for name in PARAM_KINDS:
            kind.addItem(self.translations[f"scripts.param_kind_{name}"], name)
        kind.setCurrentIndex(PARAM_KINDS.index(param.kind))
        kind.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._show_options)
        self.table.setCellWidget(row, 2, kind)
        self.table.setItem(row, 3, QTableWidgetItem(param.default))
        self._options.append(param.options)
        self.table.selectRow(row)

    def _remove_selected(self):
        row = self._selected_row()
        if row is None:
            return
        self._shown = None  # its code goes with it
        self.table.removeRow(row)
        del self._options[row]
        self._show_options()

    def _selected_row(self):
        model = self.table.selectionModel()
        rows = model.selectedRows() if model is not None else []
        return rows[0].row() if rows else None

    def _keep_options(self):
        if self._shown is not None and self._shown < len(self._options):
            self._options[self._shown] = self.options_edit.toPlainText()

    def _show_options(self):
        """Show the selected choice's options code (keeping the one shown before)."""
        self._keep_options()
        row = self._selected_row()
        self.btn_remove.setEnabled(row is not None)
        choice = row is not None and self._kind(row) == "choice"
        self._shown = row if choice else None
        self.options_edit.setEnabled(choice)
        if choice:
            self.options_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.param_options"].format(
                name=self._cell(row, 0)))
            self.options_edit.setPlainText(self._options[row] or OPTIONS_EXAMPLE)
        else:
            self.options_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.param_options_none"])
            self.options_edit.setPlainText("")

    def params(self):
        """The parameters as ScriptParams; raises LocalizedValueError (or a
        ValueError with the options code's syntax problem)."""
        self._keep_options()
        params = []
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            kind = self._kind(row)
            options = self._options[row] if kind == "choice" else ""
            param = ScriptParam(self._cell(row, 0).strip(), self._cell(row, 1).strip(), kind,
                                self._cell(row, 3).strip(), options)
            if kind == "choice":
                problem = syntax_problem(self.translations, BODY, options)
                if problem is not None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{param.name}: {problem}")
            params.append(param)
        return tuple(params)


def option_text(option):
    """How a choice's option shows: its label, and its value where that differs."""
    label = option["label"]
    value = option["value"]
    return label if choice_matches(value, label) else f"{label}  ({value})"


class ScriptRunDialog(QDialog):
    """Type in the parameters of a script before running it: ``args`` (by
    name) once accepted.

    ``worker`` gives a choice's options (script_options), ``options_cache``
    keeps them by parameter name for the next run, ``last`` holds the values
    of the last run (else the defaults are shown).
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes

    def __init__(self, translations, spec, *, worker, script_id, options_cache, last=None,
                 parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.spec = spec
        self.args = None
        self._worker = worker
        self._script_id = script_id
        self._cache = options_cache
        self._last = last or {}
        self._inputs = {}
        self._requests = {}
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["scripts.run_title"].format(
            label=spec.label or translations["scripts.unnamed"]))
        self.resize(520, 120 + 44 * len(spec.params))
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form = QFormLayout()
        for param in spec.params:
            widget = self._input(param)
            self._inputs[param.name] = widget
            form.addRow(param.label or param.name, widget)
        layout.addLayout(form)
        self.status_label = WrappedLabel("")
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color:{theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)
        self.error_label = WrappedLabel("")
        self.error_label.setStyleSheet(f"color:{theme_color('danger')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.error_label)
        layout.addStretch()
        buttons = dialog_button_row(translations, "scripts.run_button", self._accept, self.reject)
        if any(param.kind == "choice" for param in spec.params):
            reload_button = QPushButton(translations["scripts.options_reload"])
            set_button_icon(reload_button, "refresh")
            reload_button.clicked.connect(self._reload)
            buttons.insertWidget(0, reload_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        worker.options_listed.connect(self._on_options)
        worker.options_failed.connect(self._on_options_failed)
        for param in spec.params:
            if param.kind == "choice":
                self._load(param)

    def _start_text(self, param):
        last = self._last.get(param.name)
        if last is None:
            return param.default
        if isinstance(last, bool):
            return "true" if last else "false"
        return str(last)

    def _input(self, param):
        if param.kind == "bool":
            box = QCheckBox()
            box.setChecked(param.value(self._start_text(param)))
            return box
        if param.kind == "choice":
            combo = QComboBox()
            combo.setEditable(True)
            combo.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.InsertPolicy.NoInsert)
            completer = QCompleter(combo.model(), combo)
            completer.setFilterMode(Qt.MatchFlag.MatchContains)
            completer.setCaseSensitivity(Qt.CaseSensitivity.CaseInsensitive)
            completer.setCompletionMode(QCompleter.CompletionMode.PopupCompletion)
            combo.setCompleter(completer)
            combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText(self.translations["scripts.options_loading"])
            combo.setEnabled(False)
            return combo
        edit = QLineEdit(self._start_text(param))
        return edit

    # --- options of choices ----------------------------------------------
    def _load(self, param, fresh=False):
        options = None if fresh else self._cache.get(param.name)
        if options is not None:
            self._fill(param, options)
            return
        combo = self._inputs[param.name]
        combo.setEnabled(False)
        combo.clear()
        combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText(self.translations["scripts.options_loading"])
        request = self._worker.script_options(self._script_id, param.name)
        self._requests[request] = param
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.options_loading"])

    def _reload(self):
        for param in self.spec.params:
            if param.kind == "choice":
                self._load(param, fresh=True)

    def _on_options(self, request, options):
        param = self._requests.pop(request, None)
        if param is None:
            return
        self._cache[param.name] = options
        self._fill(param, options)
        if not self._requests:
            self.status_label.setText("")

    def _on_options_failed(self, request, message):
        param = self._requests.pop(request, None)
        if param is None:
            return
        self.error_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.options_failed"].format(
            name=param.label or param.name, message=messages.describe(message)))
        if not self._requests:
            self.status_label.setText("")

    def _fill(self, param, options):
        combo = self._inputs[param.name]
        combo.clear()
        for option in options:
            combo.addItem(option_text(option), option["value"])
        wanted = self._start_text(param)
        index = next((i for i, option in enumerate(options)
                      if choice_matches(option["value"], wanted)), -1)
        combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if index < 0:
            combo.setEditText("")
        combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText(self.translations["scripts.options_search"].format(
            count=len(options)))
        combo.setEnabled(True)

    # --- the values ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _value(self, param):
        widget = self._inputs[param.name]
        if param.kind == "bool":
            return widget.isChecked()
        if param.kind == "choice":
            index = widget.findText(widget.currentText(), Qt.MatchFlag.MatchExactly)
            if not widget.isEnabled() or index < 0:
                raise ValueError(self.translations["scripts.options_pick"].format(
                    name=param.label or param.name))
            return widget.itemData(index)
        return param.value(widget.text())

    def done(self, result):
        """Closed: answers still on their way no longer concern it."""
        for signal, slot in ((self._worker.options_listed, self._on_options),
                             (self._worker.options_failed, self._on_options_failed)):
            try:
                signal.disconnect(slot)
            except TypeError:
                pass
        super().done(result)

    def _accept(self):
        args = {}
        try:
            for param in self.spec.params:
                args[param.name] = self._value(param)
        except ValueError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(messages.describe(error))
            return
        self.args = args
        self.accept()

```

# The code a new script starts with: an example for the test game HermesQuest
