```py
def timing_text(translations, spec):
    """When a script runs, as the table shows it."""
    if spec.mode == "manual":
        if spec.hotkey:
            return translations["scripts.timing_hotkey"].format(hotkey=spec.hotkey)
        return translations["scripts.timing_manual"]
    seconds = f"{spec.seconds:g}"
    return translations[f"scripts.timing_{spec.mode}"].format(seconds=seconds)


class ScriptDialog(QDialog):
    """Create or edit a script: description, when it runs, its code and parameters."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, spec=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.spec = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["scripts.dialog_edit" if spec else "scripts.dialog_new"])
        self.resize(700, 600)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form = QFormLayout()

        self.label_edit = QLineEdit(spec.label if spec else "")
        self.label_edit.setPlaceholderText(translations["scripts.label_placeholder"])
        form.addRow(translations["scripts.label"], self.label_edit)

        timing = QHBoxLayout()
        self.mode_combo = QComboBox()
        for mode in MODES:
            self.mode_combo.addItem(translations[f"scripts.mode_{mode}"], mode)
        self.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(MODES.index(spec.mode) if spec else MODES.index("repeat"))
        self.seconds_spin = DoubleSpinBox()
        self.seconds_spin.setRange(0, 24 * 3600)
        self.seconds_spin.setDecimals(1)
        self.seconds_spin.setSuffix(" s")
        self.seconds_spin.setValue(spec.seconds if spec else 60)
        timing.addWidget(self.mode_combo, 1)
        timing.addWidget(self.seconds_spin)
        form.addRow(translations["scripts.when"], timing)
        self.hotkey_edit = QKeySequenceEdit(QKeySequence(spec.hotkey if spec else ""))
        self.hotkey_edit.setMaximumSequenceLength(1)
        self.hotkey_edit.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.hotkey_edit.setToolTip(translations["scripts.hotkey_tooltip"])
        form.addRow(translations["scripts.hotkey"], self.hotkey_edit)
        self.mode_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._update_seconds)
        self._update_seconds()

        layout.addLayout(form)

        # The code and the parameters take the height the window grows by
        self.tabs = QTabWidget()
        code_page = QWidget()
        code_layout = QVBoxLayout(code_page)
        code_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 6, 0, 0)
        self.code_edit = CodeEditor(spec.source if spec else EXAMPLE)
        self.code_edit.setMinimumHeight(200)
        code_layout.addWidget(self.code_edit, 1)
        self.syntax_hint = SyntaxHint(translations, self.code_edit, BODY)
        code_layout.addWidget(self.syntax_hint)
        help_label = DocsHint(translations, translations["scripts.code_help"],
                              "reference/script-context/")
        code_layout.addWidget(help_label)
        self.tabs.addTab(code_page, translations["scripts.code"])
        self.param_editor = ParamEditor(translations, spec.params if spec else ())
        self.tabs.addTab(self.param_editor, translations["scripts.params"])
        layout.addWidget(self.tabs, 1)

        self.error_label = WrappedLabel("")
        self.error_label.setStyleSheet(f"color:{theme_color('danger')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.error_label)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(translations, "button.save" if spec
                                           else "scripts.create", self._accept, self.reject))
        self._enabled = spec.enabled if spec else True

    def _update_seconds(self):
        manual = self.mode_combo.currentData() == "manual"
        self.seconds_spin.setEnabled(not manual)
        self.hotkey_edit.setEnabled(manual)

    def hotkey(self):
        """The hotkey typed in, as Qt writes it ("" for none)."""
        return self.hotkey_edit.keySequence().toString(
            QKeySequence.SequenceFormat.PortableText)

    def _accept(self):
        source = self.code_edit.toPlainText()
        if not source.strip():
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.error_empty"])
            return
        problem = self.syntax_hint.problem()
        if problem is not None:
            self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(0)
            self.error_label.setText(problem)
            return
        try:
            params = self.param_editor.params()
        except ValueError as error:
            self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(1)
            self.error_label.setText(messages.describe(error))
            return
        mode = self.mode_combo.currentData()
        seconds = self.seconds_spin.value() if mode != "manual" else 0.0
        if mode == "repeat" and seconds < MIN_REPEAT_SECONDS:
            self.error_label.setText(
                self.translations["scripts.error_interval"].format(seconds=MIN_REPEAT_SECONDS))
            return
        try:
            hotkey = hotkeys.normalized(self.hotkey()) if mode == "manual" else ""
        except ValueError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(messages.describe(error))
            return
        try:
            self.spec = ScriptSpec(source, mode, seconds, self._enabled,
                                   self.label_edit.text().strip(), params, hotkey)
        except ValueError as error:
            self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(1)
            self.error_label.setText(messages.describe(error))
            return
        self.accept()


class ScriptPanel(QGroupBox):
    """Table of the scripts of the attached process; owns their ScriptWorker.

    With a ``repository`` scripts are saved per program and started again
    whenever it is attached.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes

    count_changed = Signal(int)
    # a field of an inspected object to put on the address list (see ObjectInspectorDialog)
    address_requested = Signal(object)

    _COLUMNS = (
        "scripts.column_label",
        "scripts.column_timing",
        "scripts.column_status",
        "scripts.column_runs",
        "scripts.column_last",
    )

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, *, repository=None, language="en"):
        super().__init__(translations["scripts.title"], parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.language = language
        self._repository = repository
        self._pid = None
        self._process_id = None
        self._worker = None
        # runs manual scripts by their hotkeys while the game has the focus
        self._hotkeys = None
        # the inspectors of objects scripts returned (with the worker's agent)
        self.inspections = None
        # objects scripts returned, by their number in the log's links
        self._results = []
        # script id -> {spec, saved_id, status, runs, last, last_args, options}
        # (last_args: the values typed in for its last run; options: its
        # choices' options by parameter name, while the worker runs)
        self._scripts = {}
        self._build_ui()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        controls = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_new = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.new"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_new, "add")
        self.btn_new.clicked.connect(self._new_script)
        self.btn_edit = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.edit"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_edit, "edit")
        self.btn_edit.clicked.connect(self._edit_selected)
        self.btn_run = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.run"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_run, "play_circle")
        self.btn_run.setToolTip(self.translations["scripts.run_tooltip"])
        self.btn_run.clicked.connect(self._run_selected)
        self.btn_toggle = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.pause"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_toggle, "pause")
        self.btn_toggle.clicked.connect(self._toggle_selected)
        self.btn_remove = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.remove"])
        self.btn_remove.setObjectName("btn_danger")
        set_button_icon(self.btn_remove, "delete")
        self.btn_remove.clicked.connect(self._remove_selected)
        for button in (self.btn_new, self.btn_edit, self.btn_run, self.btn_toggle):
            controls.addWidget(button)
        self.status_label = QLabel(self.translations["scripts.hint"])
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        controls.addWidget(self.status_label, 1)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_remove)
        layout.addLayout(controls)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(self._COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([self.translations[key] for key in self._COLUMNS])
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        if header is not None:
            for column in range(len(self._COLUMNS)):
                header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
            header.setSectionResizeMode(len(self._COLUMNS) - 1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
            resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        self.table.doubleClicked.connect(self._edit_selected)
        self.table.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.table.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)
        splitter.addWidget(self.table)

        self.log_view = QTextBrowser()
        self.log_view.setOpenLinks(False)
        self.log_view.anchorClicked.connect(self._on_link)
        self.log_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(MAX_LOG_LINES)
        self.log_view.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        self.log_view.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["scripts.log_placeholder"])
        log_panel = QWidget()
        log_layout = QVBoxLayout(log_panel)
        log_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        log_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        log_bar.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["scripts.log"]))
        log_bar.addStretch()
        clear_button = QPushButton(self.translations["scripts.log_clear"])
        set_button_icon(clear_button, "clear_all")
        clear_button.clicked.connect(self._clear_log)
        log_bar.addWidget(clear_button)
        log_layout.addLayout(log_bar)
        log_layout.addWidget(self.log_view)
        splitter.addWidget(log_panel)
        splitter.setSizes([160, 130])
        layout.addWidget(splitter)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _show_context_menu(self, position):
        """The buttons' actions for the script under the pointer, and copying."""
        row = self.table.rowAt(position.y())
        if row < 0:
            return
        select_clicked_row(self.table, row)
        menu = QMenu(self)
        state = self._scripts.get(self._selected_id())
        paused = state is not None and (not state["spec"].enabled
                                        or state["status"] == "disconnected")
        for button, icon in ((self.btn_edit, "edit"), (self.btn_run, "play_circle"),
                             (self.btn_toggle, "play_arrow" if paused else "pause")):
            menu.addAction(material_icon(icon), button.text(), button.click).setEnabled(
                button.isEnabled())
        menu.addAction(material_icon("content_copy"), self.translations["scripts.copy"],
                   self._copy_selected).setEnabled(state is not None)
        add_delete_action(menu, self.table, self.translations, self._remove_selected)
        add_copy_actions(menu, self.table, position, self.translations)
        menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

    def _selected_id(self):
        rows = self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows() if self.table.selectionModel() else []
        if not rows:
            return None
        item = self.table.item(rows[0].row(), 0)
        return None if item is None else item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

    def _row_of(self, script_id):
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, 0)
            if item is not None and item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) == script_id:
                return row
        return None

    def _set_cell(self, script_id, column, text, color=None, tooltip=None):
        row = self._row_of(script_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        item = self.table.item(row, column)
        if item is None:
            item = QTableWidgetItem()
            self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        item.setText(text)
        if color is not None:
            item.setForeground(QColor(color))
        item.setToolTip(tooltip or text)

    def _show(self, script_id):
        state = self._scripts[script_id]
        spec = state["spec"]
        self._set_cell(script_id, 0, spec.label or self.translations["scripts.unnamed"],
                       tooltip=spec.source)
        self._set_cell(script_id, 1, timing_text(self.translations, spec))
        self._set_status(script_id, state["status"], state.get("message"))
        self._set_cell(script_id, 3, str(state["runs"]))
        last = state.get("last") or ""
        self._set_cell(script_id, 4, last[:MAX_RESULT_TEXT], tooltip=last)

    def _set_status(self, script_id, status, message=None):
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        state["status"] = status
        state["message"] = message
        self._set_cell(script_id, 2, self.translations[f"scripts.status_{status}"],
                       theme_color(STATUS_COLORS[status]), tooltip=message)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _update_buttons(self):
        script_id = self._selected_id()
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        attached = self._pid is not None
        self.btn_new.setEnabled(attached)
        for button in (self.btn_edit, self.btn_run, self.btn_toggle, self.btn_remove):
            button.setEnabled(state is not None)
        if state is not None:
            self.btn_run.setEnabled(state["status"] not in _STOPPED | {"starting"})
            # A disconnected script is resumed: started anew, running
            paused = not state["spec"].enabled or state["status"] == "disconnected"
            self.btn_toggle.setText(self.translations[
                "scripts.resume" if paused else "scripts.pause"])
            set_button_icon(self.btn_toggle, "play_arrow" if paused else "pause")

    def _clear_log(self):
        """Empty the log; the objects its links pointed to go with it."""
        self.log_view.clear()
        self._results.clear()

    def _log(self, text, target=None, name=""):
        """Add a line to the log; with ``target`` (an object) a link that inspects it."""
        line = f'<span style="white-space: pre-wrap">{html.escape(text)}</span>'
        if target and self.inspections is not None:
            targets = target if isinstance(target, (list, tuple)) else [target]
            for inspect_target in targets:
                self._results.append((self.inspections, inspect_target, name))
                line += (f'  <a href="inspect:{len(self._results) - 1}">'
                         f'{html.escape(self.translations["scripts.inspect"])}</a>')
        self.log_view.append(line)

    def _on_link(self, url):
        kind, _, number = url.toString().partition(":")
        if kind == "inspect" and number.isdigit() and int(number) < len(self._results):
            inspections, target, name = self._results[int(number)]
            if inspections is self.inspections:  # the game is still attached
                inspections.inspect(target, name=name)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Process
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_process(self, pid, process_id=None):
        """Switch to another process; its saved scripts start right away."""
        if pid == self._pid:
            return
        self.shutdown()
        self._pid = pid
        self._process_id = process_id
        self._scripts.clear()
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.hint"])
        self.count_changed.emit(0)
        self._update_buttons()
        self._restore_saved_scripts()
        self._update_hotkeys()

    def shutdown(self):
        """Stop the worker; the game keeps nothing of the scripts. The object
        inspectors opened from its results close: their objects are gone."""
        worker = self._worker
        self._worker = None
        if self._hotkeys is not None:
            self._hotkeys.close()
            self._hotkeys = None
        self._close_inspections()
        if worker is not None:
            worker.requestInterruption()
            worker.wait(3000)

    def _close_inspections(self):
        inspections = self.inspections
        self.inspections = None
        if inspections is not None:
            for inspector in list(inspections.inspectors):
                close_dialog(inspector)
            inspections.deleteLater()

    def _store(self, action, *args, **kwargs):
        """Run a repository call; report failures instead of raising."""
        if self._repository is None:
            return None
        try:
            return action(*args, **kwargs)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.db_failed"].format(message=error))
            return None

    def _restore_saved_scripts(self):
        if self._repository is None or self._process_id is None:
            return
        saved_scripts = self._store(self._repository.list_scripts, self._process_id) or []
        for saved in saved_scripts:
            try:
                spec = spec_from_saved(saved)
                last_args = json.loads(saved.last_args) if saved.last_args else {}
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.restore_failed"].format(
                    label=saved.label or saved.id, message=messages.describe(error)))
                continue
            self.add_script(spec, saved_id=saved.id, last_args=last_args)
        if saved_scripts:
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["scripts.restored"].format(count=len(saved_scripts)))

    def _ensure_worker(self):
        worker = self._worker
        if worker is not None and worker.isRunning():
            return worker
        worker = ScriptWorker(self._pid, self, self.language)
        worker.script_added.connect(lambda script_id: self._on_added(worker, script_id))
        worker.script_updated.connect(lambda script_id: self._on_added(worker, script_id))
        worker.script_removed.connect(lambda script_id: self._on_removed(worker, script_id))
        worker.script_failed.connect(
            lambda script_id, message: self._on_failed(worker, script_id, message))
        worker.script_ran.connect(lambda script_id, run: self._on_ran(worker, script_id, run))
        worker.worker_failed.connect(lambda message: self._on_worker_failed(worker, message))
        worker.finished.connect(lambda: self._on_worker_finished(worker))
        self.inspections = Inspections(self.translations, worker, self.window(),
                                       time=lambda: datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"))
        self.inspections.address_requested.connect(self.address_requested.emit)
        self._worker = worker
        worker.start()
        return worker

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Scripts
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def add_script(self, spec, saved_id=None, last_args=None):
        """Start a script (ScriptSpec); saved unless it is a restored one."""
        if self._pid is None:
            return None
        if saved_id is None and self._process_id is not None:
            saved_id = self._store(self._repository.add_script, self._process_id,
                                   label=spec.label, source=spec.source, mode=spec.mode,
                                   seconds=spec.seconds, enabled=spec.enabled,
                                   params=params_to_json(spec.params), hotkey=spec.hotkey)
        script_id = self._ensure_worker().add_script(spec)
        self._scripts[script_id] = {"spec": spec, "saved_id": saved_id, "status": "starting",
                                    "runs": 0, "last": "", "last_args": last_args or {},
                                    "options": {}}
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        item = QTableWidgetItem()
        item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, script_id)
        self.table.setItem(row, 0, item)
        self._show(script_id)
        self.table.selectRow(row)
        self.count_changed.emit(len(self._scripts))
        self._update_hotkeys()
        return script_id

    def _new_script(self):
        if self._pid is None:
            return
        dialog = ScriptDialog(self.translations, self)
        if dialog.exec() == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted and dialog.spec is not None:
            self.add_script(dialog.spec)

    def _edit_selected(self):
        script_id = self._selected_id()
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        dialog = ScriptDialog(self.translations, self, state["spec"])
        if dialog.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted or dialog.spec is None:
            return
        if script_id not in self._scripts:  # the game exited meanwhile
            return
        self._replace_spec(script_id, dialog.spec)

    def _copy_selected(self):
        script_id = self._selected_id()
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        label = state["spec"].label or self.translations["scripts.unnamed"]
        spec = dataclasses.replace(
            state["spec"], label=f"{label} {self.translations['scripts.copy_suffix']}"
        )
        self.add_script(spec)

    def _replace_spec(self, script_id, spec):
        state = self._scripts[script_id]
        if state["spec"].params != spec.params:
            state["options"] = {}  # their code may have changed
        state["spec"] = spec
        if state["saved_id"] is not None:
            self._store(self._repository.update_script, state["saved_id"], label=spec.label,
                        source=spec.source, mode=spec.mode, seconds=spec.seconds,
                        enabled=spec.enabled, params=params_to_json(spec.params) or "",
                        hotkey=spec.hotkey)
        if state["status"] in _STOPPED:
            # Its code did not compile, or its session ended: try it as a new
            # script of the (new) worker.
            self._drop_row(script_id)
            self.add_script(spec, saved_id=state["saved_id"], last_args=state["last_args"])
            return
        self._ensure_worker().update_script(script_id, spec)
        self._show(script_id)
        self._update_hotkeys()

    def _toggle_selected(self):
        script_id = self._selected_id()
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        spec = state["spec"]
        enabled = True if state["status"] == "disconnected" else not spec.enabled
        self._replace_spec(script_id, dataclasses.replace(spec, enabled=enabled))

    def _run_selected(self):
        script_id = self._selected_id()
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None or self._worker is None:
            return
        args = None
        if state["spec"].params:
            # Ask for its parameters; the choices' options come from the game
            dialog = ScriptRunDialog(self.translations, state["spec"], worker=self._worker,
                                     script_id=script_id, options_cache=state["options"],
                                     last=state["last_args"], parent=self)
            if dialog.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted or dialog.args is None:
                return
            if self._scripts.get(script_id) is not state or self._worker is None:
                return  # the game exited meanwhile
            args = dialog.args
            state["last_args"] = args
            if state["saved_id"] is not None:
                self._store(self._repository.update_script, state["saved_id"],
                            last_args=json.dumps(args))
        self._set_status(script_id, "running")
        self._worker.run_now(script_id, args)

    def _remove_selected(self):
        self.remove_script(self._selected_id())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Hotkeys
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _hotkey_scripts(self, hotkey=None):
        """The ids of the active manual scripts with a hotkey (``hotkey`` only)."""
        return [script_id for script_id, state in self._scripts.items()
                if state["spec"].hotkey and state["spec"].enabled
                and state["status"] not in _STOPPED
                and (hotkey is None or state["spec"].hotkey == hotkey)]

    def _update_hotkeys(self):
        """Listen for the hotkeys of the scripts, or stop when none has one."""
        wanted = {self._scripts[script_id]["spec"].hotkey
                  for script_id in self._hotkey_scripts()}
        if self._pid is None or (not wanted and self._hotkeys is None):
            return
        if self._hotkeys is None:
            try:
                reader = open_reader()
            except OSError as error:
                reader = None
                self.status_label.setText(
                    self.translations["scripts.hotkeys_unavailable"].format(message=error))
            self._hotkeys = hotkeys.HotkeyListener({self._pid}, reader, self)
            self._hotkeys.triggered.connect(self._on_hotkey)
        self._hotkeys.set_hotkeys(sorted(wanted))

    def _on_hotkey(self, hotkey):
        if self._worker is None:
            return
        for script_id in self._hotkey_scripts(hotkey):
            if self._scripts[script_id]["status"] == "starting":
                continue
            label = self._scripts[script_id]["spec"].label or f"#{script_id}"
            self._log(f"{datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')} " + self.translations[
                "scripts.hotkey_pressed"].format(hotkey=hotkey, label=label))
            self._set_status(script_id, "running")
            self._worker.run_now(script_id)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # For other windows (e.g. the GAS attributes window)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def worker(self):
        """The script worker of the attached game, started if needed; None if detached."""
        if self._pid is None:
            return None
        return self._ensure_worker()

    def scripts_labelled(self, prefix):
        """``{script id: ScriptSpec}`` of the scripts whose label starts with ``prefix``."""
        return {script_id: state["spec"] for script_id, state in self._scripts.items()
                if state["spec"].label.startswith(prefix)}

    def put_script(self, spec, prefix):
        """Replace the script whose label starts with ``prefix`` by ``spec``,
        or add ``spec`` if there is none; its id (None when detached)."""
        for script_id in self.scripts_labelled(prefix):
            self._replace_spec(script_id, spec)
            # A replaced stopped script was dropped and added anew
            return next(iter(self.scripts_labelled(prefix)), None)
        return self.add_script(spec)

    def remove_script(self, script_id):
        """Stop and delete a script, also from the saved ones."""
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if state is None:
            return
        if state["saved_id"] is not None:
            self._store(self._repository.delete_script, state["saved_id"])
        if self._worker is not None and state["status"] != "failed":
            self._worker.remove_script(script_id)
        self._drop_row(script_id)
        self._update_hotkeys()

    def _drop_row(self, script_id):
        row = self._row_of(script_id)
        if row is not None:
            self.table.removeRow(row)
        self._scripts.pop(script_id, None)
        self.count_changed.emit(len(self._scripts))
        self._update_buttons()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Worker signals
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_added(self, worker, script_id):
        if worker is not self._worker or script_id not in self._scripts:
            return
        enabled = self._scripts[script_id]["spec"].enabled
        self._set_status(script_id, "active" if enabled else "paused")

    def _on_removed(self, worker, script_id):
        if worker is self._worker:
            self._drop_row(script_id)

    def _on_failed(self, worker, script_id, message):
        if worker is not self._worker or script_id not in self._scripts:
            return
        message = message.splitlines()[0] if message else message
        self._set_status(script_id, "failed", message)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_ran(self, worker, script_id, run):
        state = self._scripts.get(script_id)
        if worker is not self._worker or state is None:
            return
        state["runs"] = run.get("runs", state["runs"] + 1)
        error = messages.describe(run["error"]) if run.get("error") else None
        label = state["spec"].label or f"#{script_id}"
        time = datetime.fromtimestamp(run.get("time", 0) / 1000).strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        thread = run.get("gameThread")
        if thread:
            key = "scripts.native_thread" if thread.get("main") else "scripts.native_thread_other"
            self._log(f"{time} " + self.translations[key].format(
                name=thread.get("name", "?"), thread=thread.get("thread", "?")))
        for entry in run.get("logs") or []:
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                self._log(f"{time} {label}: {entry.get('text', '')}",
                          entry.get("targets"), label)
            else:
                self._log(f"{time} {label}: {entry}")
        if error:
            state["last"] = error.splitlines()[0]
            self._log(f"{time} {label}: {self.translations['scripts.log_error']} {error}")
        else:
            state["last"] = run.get("result") or "—"
            if run.get("result"):
                self._log(f"{time} {label}: = {run['result']}", run.get("target"), label)
        self._show(script_id)
        if state["status"] == "running":
            self._set_status(script_id, "active" if state["spec"].enabled else "paused")

    def _on_worker_failed(self, worker, message):
        if worker is not self._worker:
            return
        self._worker = None
        for script_id in list(self._scripts):
            self._set_status(script_id, "failed", message)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["scripts.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message.splitlines()[0] if message else message))

    def _on_worker_finished(self, worker):
        """The worker ended (e.g. its session was ended in the sessions
        window): its scripts no longer run."""
        # Not our child any more: deleting the worker releases its slots, and
        # with them maybe the last reference to this panel; a panel without
        # a parent would then delete the worker a second time (PySide6).
        worker.setParent(None)
        worker.deleteLater()
        if worker is not self._worker:
            return
        self._worker = None
        tooltip = self.translations["scripts.disconnected_tooltip"]
        for script_id, state in self._scripts.items():
            if state["status"] != "failed":
                self._set_status(script_id, "disconnected", tooltip)
        if self._scripts:
            self.status_label.setText(tooltip)

```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/sessions.py`:

```py
"""Windows for the running sessions: an overview, and waiting for them on exit."""

import time

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from grembyte.core.sessions import SESSIONS, SessionSignals, frida_agents, frida_gadgets
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import DocsHint


# How long closing Grembyte waits for the sessions before it cuts them, and
# then for the cut sessions before it exits anyway.
SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_S = 10
DISCONNECT_GRACE_S = 3

_KIND, _PID, _RUNNING, _STATUS = range(4)


def duration_text(seconds):
    """``42 s``, ``3:07 min``, ``1:02 h``."""
    seconds = int(seconds)
    if seconds < 60:
        return f"{seconds} s"
    if seconds < 3600:
        return f"{seconds // 60}:{seconds % 60:02d} min"
    return f"{seconds // 3600}:{seconds % 3600 // 60:02d} h"


def status_text(translations, session, now):
    if session.detaching:
        return translations["sessions.status_detaching"]
    if session.stopping is None:
        return translations["sessions.status_active"]
    key = "sessions.status_stuck" if session.stuck(now) else "sessions.status_stopping"
    return translations[key].format(duration=duration_text(now - session.stopping))


class SessionsDialog(QDialog):
    """The workers attached to processes, with a way to end them.

    ``current_pid`` returns the process Grembyte is attached to (or None), to
    count the Frida agents loaded there.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, current_pid, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.current_pid = current_pid
        self._shown = []
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["sessions.title"])
        self.resize(760, 380)
        self._build_ui()
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(1000)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)
        self._timer.start()
        self._signals = SessionSignals(self)
        self._signals.changed.connect(self.refresh)
        self.refresh()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = DocsHint(self.translations, self.translations["sessions.hint"], "guide/tools/#sessions")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["sessions.column_kind"],
            self.translations["sessions.column_pid"],
            self.translations["sessions.column_running"],
            self.translations["sessions.column_status"],
        ])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(4):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column in (_KIND, _STATUS)
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, self.translations)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self.agents_label = QLabel("")
        self.agents_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.agents_label)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.stop_button = QPushButton(self.translations["sessions.stop"])
        set_button_icon(self.stop_button, "stop")
        self.stop_button.setToolTip(self.translations["sessions.stop_tooltip"])
        self.stop_button.clicked.connect(self._stop_selected)
        buttons.addWidget(self.stop_button)
        self.disconnect_button = QPushButton(self.translations["sessions.disconnect"])
        self.disconnect_button.setObjectName("btn_danger")
        set_button_icon(self.disconnect_button, "link_off")
        self.disconnect_button.setToolTip(self.translations["sessions.disconnect_tooltip"])
        self.disconnect_button.clicked.connect(self._disconnect_selected)
        buttons.addWidget(self.disconnect_button)
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.stop_all_button = QPushButton(self.translations["sessions.stop_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.stop_all_button, "stop_circle")
        self.stop_all_button.clicked.connect(SESSIONS.stop_all)
        buttons.addWidget(self.stop_all_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def refresh(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        selected = self.selected_session()
        self._shown = SESSIONS.sessions()
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self._shown))
        for row, session in enumerate(self._shown):
            values = (
                self.translations[f"sessions.kind_{session.kind}"],
                str(session.pid),
                duration_text(now - session.started),
                status_text(self.translations, session, now),
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(values):
                item = self.table.item(row, column)
                if item is None:
                    item = QTableWidgetItem()
                    self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
                item.setText(text)
                if column == _PID:
                    item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
            if session is selected:
                self.table.selectRow(row)
        self.stop_all_button.setEnabled(bool(self._shown))
        self._show_agents()
        self._update_buttons()

    def _show_agents(self):
        pid = self.current_pid()
        if pid is None:
            self.agents_label.setText("")
            return
        count = frida_agents(pid)
        # All sessions of this Grembyte share one agent; a gadget (Wine games)
        # is shared by every Grembyte run, so it is never stale.
        ours = 1 if any(s.pid == pid and s.frida_session is not None for s in self._shown) else 0
        ours = max(ours, frida_gadgets(pid))
        text = self.translations["sessions.agents"].format(pid=pid, count=count)
        if count > ours:
            text += " " + self.translations["sessions.agents_stale"].format(stale=count - ours)
        self.agents_label.setText(text)

    def selected_session(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        selected = self.table.selectionModel().hasSelection()
        return self._shown[row] if selected and 0 <= row < len(self._shown) else None

    def _update_buttons(self):
        session = self.selected_session()
        self.stop_button.setEnabled(session is not None and session.stopping is None)
        self.disconnect_button.setEnabled(
            session is not None and session.frida_session is not None and not session.detaching)

    def _stop_selected(self):
        session = self.selected_session()
        if session is not None:
            SESSIONS.stop(session)

    def _disconnect_selected(self):
        session = self.selected_session()
        if session is not None:
            SESSIONS.disconnect(session)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._timer.stop()
        super().closeEvent(event)


class ShutdownDialog(QDialog):
    """Shown while Grembyte exits and sessions still run.

    Asks them to stop, cuts their Frida sessions after SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_S (or
    when asked to), and gives up DISCONNECT_GRACE_S later. ``exec`` returns
    Accepted once all have ended, Rejected if Grembyte must exit regardless.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, timeout_s=SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_S,
                 grace_s=DISCONNECT_GRACE_S):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(True)
        self.translations = translations
        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
        self.grace_s = grace_s
        self._began = time.monotonic()
        self._cut = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["shutdown.title"])
        self.resize(480, 220)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(QLabel(translations["shutdown.waiting"]))
        self.sessions_label = QLabel("")
        self.sessions_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.sessions_label, 1)
        self.countdown_label = QLabel("")
        self.countdown_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.countdown_label)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.now_button = QPushButton(translations["shutdown.now"])
        self.now_button.setObjectName("btn_danger")
        set_button_icon(self.now_button, "power_settings_new")
        self.now_button.setToolTip(translations["shutdown.now_tooltip"])
        self.now_button.clicked.connect(self._cut_now)
        buttons.addWidget(self.now_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        SESSIONS.stop_all()
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(100)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._check)
        self._timer.start()
        self._check()

    def _check(self):
        running = SESSIONS.sessions()
        if not running:
            self._timer.stop()
            self.accept()
            return
        now = time.monotonic()
        if self._cut is None and now - self._began >= self.timeout_s:
            self._cut_all(now)
        if self._cut is not None and now - self._cut >= self.grace_s:
            self._timer.stop()
            self.reject()
            return
        self.sessions_label.setText("\n".join(
            f"• {self.translations[f'sessions.kind_{s.kind}']} (PID {s.pid}): "
            f"{status_text(self.translations, s, now)}" for s in running))
        if self._cut is None:
            self.countdown_label.setText(self.translations["shutdown.countdown"].format(
                seconds=max(0, int(self.timeout_s - (now - self._began) + 0.999))))

    def _cut_all(self, now):
        self._cut = now
        SESSIONS.disconnect_all()
        self.now_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.countdown_label.setText(self.translations["shutdown.disconnecting"])

    def _cut_now(self):
        # One more short wait: a cut session usually ends right away.
        self.grace_s = min(self.grace_s, 1)
        self._cut_all(time.monotonic())

    def reject(self):
        self._timer.stop()
        super().reject()
```

```py
"""The window of the general settings (grembyte.core.settings), under Settings in the menu."""

from PySide6.QtCore import QSize, Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QStackedWidget,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.core import settings
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import material_icon, set_button_icon, theme_color
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import WrappedLabel
from grembyte.ui.widgets.spin_boxes import SpinBox


# (category, icon, keys): a page each, listed on the left in this order
_SETTING_CATEGORIES = (
    ("general", "settings", ("activity_log", "refresh_interval_ms", "language")),
    ("scan", "search", ("scan_aligned",)),
    ("pointer", "link", ("pointer_max_results", "pointer_stacks", "pointer_location_step",
                         "pointer_value_alignment")),
    ("trace", "track_changes", ("wine_trace_limit", "large_trace", "trace_sequence")),
    ("hooks", "webhook", ("hook_short_jump", "hook_repatch", "hook_profiling")),
    ("objects", "account_tree", ("object_browser_limit",)),
    ("wine", "wine_bar", ("wine_gadget_download",)),
)


class SettingsDialog(QDialog):
    """Show the settings, store the changed ones and apply them.

    ``repository`` stores them (grembyte.db.repository.settings); ``changed``
    holds {key: value} of what the last save changed.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods

    def __init__(self, translations, repository, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.changed = {}
        self.editors = {}
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["settings.title"])
        self.setMinimumSize(680, 380)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        pages = QHBoxLayout()
        # Parented here: added to the still unattached ``pages`` layout, PySide kept them as
        # Python's own and deleted them a second time at exit, which crashed.
        self.categories = QListWidget(self)
        self.categories.setObjectName("settings_categories")
        self.categories.setIconSize(QSize(18, 18))
        self.pages = QStackedWidget(self)
        for category, icon, keys in _SETTING_CATEGORIES:
            item = QListWidgetItem(material_icon(icon, 18),
                                   translations[f"settings.category.{category}"])
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, category)
            self.categories.addItem(item)
            self.pages.addWidget(self._page(category, keys))
        self.categories.setFixedWidth(self.categories.sizeHintForColumn(0) + 24)
        self.categories.currentRowChanged.connect(self.pages.setCurrentIndex)
        self.categories.setCurrentRow(0)
        pages.addWidget(self.categories)
        pages.addWidget(self.pages, 1)
        layout.addLayout(pages, 1)
        self.restart_label = QLabel(translations["settings.restart"])
        self.restart_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('warning')};")
        self.restart_label.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.restart_label)
        defaults = QHBoxLayout()
        reset = QPushButton(translations["settings.defaults"])
        set_button_icon(reset, "restart_alt")
        reset.setToolTip(translations["settings.defaults_tooltip"])
        reset.clicked.connect(self.show_defaults)
        defaults.addWidget(reset)
        defaults.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(defaults)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(translations, "button.save", self._save, self.reject))
        self.show_values(settings.values())

    def _page(self, category, keys):
        """The page of ``category``: a form of its settings, scrolled when it gets long."""
        form_widget = QWidget()
        form = QFormLayout(form_widget)
        for key in keys:
            setting = settings.BY_KEY[key]
            if key == "hook_repatch":
                # Reserves the height of its lines: a QLabel was cut off here.
                warning = WrappedLabel(self.translations["settings.hook_repatch_warning"])
                warning.setObjectName("settings_hook_repatch_warning")
                warning.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('warning')}; font-weight: bold;")
                form.addRow(warning)
            editor = self._editor(setting)
            self.editors[setting.key] = editor
            label = QLabel(self.translations[f"settings.{setting.key}"])
            tooltip = self.translations[f"settings.{setting.key}_tooltip"]
            label.setToolTip(tooltip)
            editor.setToolTip(tooltip)
            form.addRow(label, editor)
        page = QScrollArea()
        page.setObjectName(f"settings_category_{category}")
        page.setWidgetResizable(True)
        page.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        page.setWidget(form_widget)
        return page

    def _editor(self, setting):
        if setting.kind == settings.BOOL:
            return QCheckBox()
        if setting.kind == settings.INT:
            editor = SpinBox()
            editor.setRange(setting.minimum, setting.maximum)
            editor.setSingleStep(setting.step)
            editor.setGroupSeparatorShown(True)
            if setting.minimum == 0:
                editor.setSpecialValueText(self.translations[f"settings.{setting.key}_off"])
            return editor
        editor = QComboBox()
        for choice in setting.choices:
            editor.addItem(self.translations[f"settings.{setting.key}_{choice}"], choice)
        editor.currentIndexChanged.connect(lambda _index: self._update_restart())
        return editor

    def show_values(self, values):
        """Put ``values`` ({key: value}) into the editors."""
        for key, value in values.items():
            editor = self.editors[key]
            if isinstance(editor, QCheckBox):
                editor.setChecked(value)
            elif isinstance(editor, SpinBox):
                editor.setValue(value)
            else:
                editor.setCurrentIndex(max(0, editor.findData(value)))
        self._update_restart()

    def show_defaults(self):
        """Put the defaults into the editors; saving stores them."""
        self.show_values({setting.key: setting.default for setting in settings.SETTINGS})

    def chosen(self):
        """{key: value} as the editors show them."""
        values = {}
        for key, editor in self.editors.items():
            if isinstance(editor, QCheckBox):
                values[key] = editor.isChecked()
            elif isinstance(editor, SpinBox):
                values[key] = editor.value()
            else:
                values[key] = editor.currentData()
        return values

    def _update_restart(self):
        chosen = self.chosen()
        self.restart_label.setVisible(any(
            setting.restart and chosen[setting.key] != settings.get(setting.key)
            for setting in settings.SETTINGS))

    def _save(self):
        values = self.chosen()
        self.repository.save(values)
        self.changed = settings.apply(values)
        self.accept()
```

```py
"""Spin boxes whose numbers keep the distance of the line edits beside them."""

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QDoubleSpinBox,
    QSpinBox,
)

# The stylesheet's padding does not reach the text of a spin box: it stuck
# to the left border. This margin puts it where a QLineEdit with its 10px
# padding shows its text.
TEXT_MARGIN = 13


def _pad(spin_box):
    spin_box.lineEdit().setTextMargins(TEXT_MARGIN, 0, 0, 0)


class SpinBox(QSpinBox):
    """QSpinBox with its text indented like a line edit's."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        _pad(self)


class DoubleSpinBox(QDoubleSpinBox):
    """QDoubleSpinBox with its text indented like a line edit's."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        _pad(self)
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/syntax_hint.py`:

```py
"""A line under a code editor that says whether its JavaScript compiles."""

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.hooks.syntax import FUNCTION, checker, looks_like_function
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import theme_color
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import WrappedLabel

# Typing pauses this long before the code is checked.
CHECK_DELAY_MS = 400

# Theme colours (see icons.theme_color) of the levels
_COLORS = {"error": "danger", "warning": "warning", "ok": "success"}


def syntax_problem(translations, kind, code):
    """What is wrong with the syntax of ``code`` (see grembyte.hooks.syntax), else None."""
    if not code.strip():
        return None
    issue = checker().check(kind, code)
    if issue is None:
        return None
    if issue.line is None:
        return translations["syntax.error_no_line"].format(message=issue.message)
    return translations["syntax.error"].format(line=issue.line, message=issue.message)


class SyntaxHint(WrappedLabel):
    """Check ``editor`` (a QPlainTextEdit) while one types; ``kind`` as in grembyte.hooks.syntax.

    Shows nothing when the check cannot run (no Frida system session).
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, editor, kind, parent=None):
        super().__init__("", parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.editor = editor
        self.kind = kind
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(CHECK_DELAY_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.check)
        editor.textChanged.connect(self._timer.start)
        self._timer.start()

    def problem(self):
        """The syntax error of the editor's code now (also shown), else None."""
        self._timer.stop()
        return self.check()

    def check(self):
        code = self.editor.toPlainText()
        problem = syntax_problem(self.translations, self.kind, code)
        if problem is not None:
            self._show(problem, "error")
        elif not code.strip() or not checker().available:
            self._show("", "ok")
        elif self.kind == FUNCTION and not looks_like_function(code):
            self._show(self.translations["syntax.not_function"], "warning")
        else:
            self._show(self.translations["syntax.ok"], "ok")
        return problem

    def _show(self, text, level):
        self.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color(_COLORS[level])};")
        self.setText(text)
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/table.py`:

```py
"""Shared settings for table widgets."""

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QObject, Qt, QTimer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractButton,
    QComboBox,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMenu,
    QTableWidget,
)

from grembyte.ui import window_state
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import material_icon

# Leaves room for the inline editors (line edits, combo boxes) of editable cells.
TABLE_ROW_HEIGHT = 36
# A column width is saved this long after the user stopped dragging it
SAVE_DELAY_MS = 300


def set_row_height(table):
    """Give all rows of ``table`` the shared row height."""
    table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(TABLE_ROW_HEIGHT)


def cell_text(view, row, column):
    """What a cell of ``view`` (a QTableView or QTableWidget) shows, as text.

    Cell widgets count too: a ticked check box is "✓", a combo box or line
    edit its text. A link (e.g. "Objekt-Details") is an action, not a value:
    it gives "".
    """
    text = view.model().index(row, column).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole)
    text = "" if text is None else str(text)
    widget = view.cellWidget(row, column) if isinstance(view, QTableWidget) else None
    if text or widget is None:
        return text
    for kind in (QComboBox, QLineEdit, QAbstractButton, QLabel):
        found = widget if isinstance(widget, kind) else widget.findChild(kind)
        if found is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(found, QComboBox):
            return found.currentText()
        if isinstance(found, QAbstractButton) and found.isCheckable():
            return "✓" if found.isChecked() else ""
        if isinstance(found, QLabel) and "<a " in found.text():
            return ""
        return found.text()
    return ""


def row_text(view, row):
    """The cells of ``row`` that are not hidden, separated by tabs (for a spreadsheet)."""
    header = view.horizontalHeader()
    return "\t".join(cell_text(view, row, column) for column in range(header.count())
                     if not header.isSectionHidden(column))


def add_copy_actions(menu, view, position, translations):
    """Add "copy row" and "copy cell" for the cell at ``position`` (viewport
    coordinates of ``view``) to ``menu``; nothing outside the rows."""
    index = view.indexAt(position)
    if not index.isValid():
        return
    if not menu.isEmpty():
        menu.addSeparator()
    row, column = index.row(), index.column()
    menu.addAction(translations["table.copy_row"],
                   lambda: QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(row_text(view, row)))
    menu.addAction(translations["table.copy_cell"],
                   lambda: QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(cell_text(view, row, column)))


def selected_row_count(view):
    """How many rows of ``view`` are selected."""
    model = view.selectionModel()
    return 0 if model is None else len(model.selectedRows())


def select_clicked_row(view, row):
    """Select ``row`` for its context menu, unless it already is (keeping a
    selection of several rows the menu then acts on)."""
    model = view.selectionModel()
    if model is not None and not model.isRowSelected(row):
        view.selectRow(row)


def add_delete_action(menu, view, translations, delete, enabled=True):
    """Add "Delete row" (or "Delete N rows" for a selection of several),
    calling ``delete`` (what the panel's remove button does)."""
    if not menu.isEmpty():
        menu.addSeparator()
    count = selected_row_count(view)
    text = (translations["table.delete_rows"].format(count=count) if count > 1
            else translations["table.delete_row"])
    menu.addAction(material_icon("delete"), text, delete).setEnabled(enabled)


def copy_menu(view, translations, delete=None, can_delete=None):
    """Give ``view`` (a table without a context menu of its own) one that copies.

    With ``delete`` (a function removing the selected rows) the menu also
    offers to delete the clicked row; ``can_delete()`` says whether it may
    now (e.g. whether the remove button is enabled)."""
    view.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)

    def show(position):
        menu = QMenu(view)
        if delete is not None:
            index = view.indexAt(position)
            if index.isValid():
                select_clicked_row(view, index.row())
                add_delete_action(menu, view, translations, delete,
                                  can_delete is None or can_delete())
        add_copy_actions(menu, view, position, translations)
        if not menu.isEmpty():
            menu.exec(view.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

    view.customContextMenuRequested.connect(show)


def resizable_columns(view):
    """Let the user resize the columns of ``view`` that Qt sizes by itself.

    Call it once the header's resize modes are set. Qt does not let the user
    resize a ``Stretch`` or ``ResizeToContents`` column; these become
    ``Interactive`` and keep behaving as before until the user resizes them:
    stretch columns share the free width, content columns fit their contents.
    ``Fixed`` columns (stars, buttons, combo boxes) stay fixed.

    The widths the user gives columns are kept between runs (see
    grembyte.ui.window_state) and set again when the table is first shown.
    """
    return _ColumnSizer(view)


class _ColumnSizer(QObject):
    """Sizes the columns of a view like Qt's automatic modes; see ``resizable_columns``."""

    def __init__(self, view):
        header = view.horizontalHeader()
        super().__init__(header)
        # The header keeps the Qt object, but PySide ties the Python object to the
        # header's wrapper, which horizontalHeader() makes anew and Python
        # collects: the view (kept by its window) keeps it instead. Not a
        # handler of ``destroyed``: run while the garbage collector deletes a
        # window, such handlers can crash the interpreter.
        view.grembyte_column_sizer = self
        self._view = view
        self._header = header
        self._fill = []
        self._fit = []
        # Columns the user sized: they keep their width.
        self._sized = set()
        self._adjusting = False
        # Where their widths are kept; known once the table is shown in its window
        self._key = None
        self._save_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._save_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._save_timer.setInterval(SAVE_DELAY_MS)
        self._save_timer.timeout.connect(self._save)
        for column in range(header.count()):
            mode = header.sectionResizeMode(column)
            if mode == QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch:
                self._fill.append(column)
            elif mode == QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents:
                self._fit.append(column)
            else:
                continue
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._timer.setInterval(0)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._adjust)
        header.sectionResized.connect(self._on_section_resized)
        header.installEventFilter(self)
        model = view.model()
        for signal in (model.rowsInserted, model.rowsRemoved, model.modelReset,
                       model.layoutChanged, model.dataChanged):
            signal.connect(self._schedule)
        self._schedule()

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Share the free width again when the table changes its width."""
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.Resize:
            self._schedule()
        elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.Show and self._key is None:
            self._restore()
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def _restore(self):
        self._key = window_state.view_key(self._view)
        widths = window_state.load_columns(self._key, self._header.count())
        self._adjusting = True
        try:
            for column, width in widths.items():
                if self._header.sectionResizeMode(column) != QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed:
                    self._sized.add(column)
                    self._header.resizeSection(column, width)
        finally:
            self._adjusting = False
        self._schedule()

    def _save(self):
        if self._key is not None:
            window_state.save_columns(self._key, self._header.count(), {
                column: self._header.sectionSize(column) for column in sorted(self._sized)
                if column < self._header.count()})

    def _on_section_resized(self, column, _old, _new):
        if not self._adjusting:
            self._sized.add(column)
            self._schedule()
            self._save_timer.start()

    def _schedule(self, *_args):
        if not self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.start()

    def _adjust(self):
        header = self._header

        def shown(column):
            return column not in self._sized and not header.isSectionHidden(column)

        self._adjusting = True
        try:
            for column in filter(shown, self._fit):
                header.resizeSection(column, max(header.sectionSizeHint(column),
                                                 self._view.sizeHintForColumn(column)))
            fill = list(filter(shown, self._fill))
            if not fill:
                return
            others = sum(header.sectionSize(column) for column in range(header.count())
                         if column not in fill and not header.isSectionHidden(column))
            share = (header.viewport().width() - others) // len(fill)
            for column in fill:
                header.resizeSection(column, max(header.sectionSizeHint(column), share))
        finally:
            self._adjusting = False

```

```py
"""Dialog for maintaining hook templates (JavaScript manipulations)."""

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QFontDatabase  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
```
