```py
NEW_TEMPLATE_SOURCE = """function (ctx) {
  return ctx.new;
}"""

# Parameter table columns
_NAME, _LABEL, _KIND, _DEFAULT, _OPTIONAL, _CHOICES = range(6)
_KINDS = ("number", "choice", "code")
# What a template is for: write hooks or method hooks.
_HOOK_KINDS = ("value", "method")
# Theme colour (see icons.theme_color) of method templates in the list
_METHOD_COLOR = "purple"


def format_choices(parameter):
    """Return the choices of a parameter as ``value=Label; value=Label``."""
    return "; ".join(
        f"{choice}={parameter.choice_label(index)}"
        for index, choice in enumerate(parameter.choices)
    )


def parse_choices(text):
    """Parse ``value=Label; value`` into (values, labels)."""
    values, labels = [], []
    for part in text.split(";"):
        value, _, label = part.partition("=")
        value = value.strip()
        if value:
            values.append(value)
            labels.append(label.strip() or value)
    return tuple(values), tuple(labels)


class TemplateDialog(QDialog):
    """List, create, edit and delete hook templates.

    Hooks keep a copy of their template, so changes here do not alter existing
    hooks; the hook dialog offers to adopt a changed template.
    """

    # Widgets are created by the _build_* helpers called from __init__.
    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    def __init__(self, translations, repository, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self._repository = repository
        self._templates = []
        self._current_id = None
        self._snapshot = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["templates.title"])
        self.resize(980, 640)
        self._build_ui()
        self._reload()
        if self._templates:
            self.template_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self._load(None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        left = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left)
        left_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.template_list = QListWidget()
        self.template_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_row_changed)
        left_layout.addWidget(self.template_list)
        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_new = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.new"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_new, "add")
        self.btn_new.clicked.connect(self._new_template)
        self.btn_delete = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.delete"])
        self.btn_delete.setObjectName("btn_danger")
        set_button_icon(self.btn_delete, "delete")
        self.btn_delete.clicked.connect(self._delete_template)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_new)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_delete)
        left_layout.addLayout(buttons)
        splitter.addWidget(left)

        splitter.addWidget(self._build_editor())
        splitter.setSizes([240, 740])

        bottom = QHBoxLayout()
        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        bottom.addWidget(self.status_label, 1)
        close_button = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.close"])
        set_button_icon(close_button, "close")
        close_button.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        bottom.addWidget(close_button)
        layout.addLayout(bottom)

    def _build_editor(self):
        editor = QGroupBox()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(editor)

        form = QFormLayout()
        self.name_input = QLineEdit()
        form.addRow(self.translations["templates.name"], self.name_input)
        self.hook_kind_combo = QComboBox()
        for kind in _HOOK_KINDS:
            self.hook_kind_combo.addItem(self.translations[f"templates.hook_kind_{kind}"], kind)
        self.hook_kind_combo.setToolTip(self.translations["templates.hook_kind_tooltip"])
        self.hook_kind_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._update_script_hint)
        form.addRow(self.translations["templates.hook_kind"], self.hook_kind_combo)
        self.description_input = QLineEdit()
        self.description_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["hooks.optional"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["templates.description"], self.description_input)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["templates.parameters"]))
        self.param_table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.param_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["templates.column_name"],
            self.translations["templates.column_label"],
            self.translations["templates.column_kind"],
            self.translations["templates.column_default"],
            self.translations["templates.column_optional"],
            self.translations["templates.column_choices"],
        ])
        self.param_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        # Removed one at a time (see _remove_parameter_row)
        self.param_table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.param_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.param_table)
        self.param_table.setToolTip(self.translations["templates.parameters_hint"])
        header = self.param_table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(6):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_CHOICES, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        # ResizeToContents ignores cell widgets; size the type column for its combo box.
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_KIND, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        metrics = self.param_table.fontMetrics()
        widest = max(
            metrics.horizontalAdvance(self.translations[f"templates.kind_{kind}"])
            for kind in _KINDS
        )
        # text + padding, drop-down arrow and cell margins
        self.param_table.setColumnWidth(_KIND, widest + 64)
        resizable_columns(self.param_table)
        copy_menu(self.param_table, self.translations, self._remove_parameter_row)
        self.param_table.setMinimumHeight(140)
        layout.addWidget(self.param_table)
        param_buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        add_param = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.param_add"])
        set_button_icon(add_param, "add")
        add_param.clicked.connect(lambda: self._add_parameter_row(None))
        remove_param = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.param_remove"])
        set_button_icon(remove_param, "remove")
        remove_param.clicked.connect(self._remove_parameter_row)
        param_buttons.addWidget(add_param)
        param_buttons.addWidget(remove_param)
        param_buttons.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(param_buttons)

        layout.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["templates.source"]))
        self.source_input = CodeEditor()
        self.source_input.setMinimumHeight(180)
        layout.addWidget(self.source_input, 1)
        self.syntax_hint = SyntaxHint(self.translations, self.source_input, FUNCTION)
        layout.addWidget(self.syntax_hint)
        self.script_hint = DocsHint(self.translations, self.translations["hooks.script_hint"],
                                    "reference/hook-context/")
        layout.addWidget(self.script_hint)

        self.error_label = WrappedLabel()
        self.error_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('danger')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.error_label)

        save_row = QHBoxLayout()
        save_row.addStretch()
        self.btn_test = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.test"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_test, "play_arrow")
        self.btn_test.setToolTip(self.translations["templates.test_tooltip"])
        self.btn_test.clicked.connect(self._test_template)
        save_row.addWidget(self.btn_test)
        self.btn_save = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.save"])
        self.btn_save.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.btn_save, "save")
        self.btn_save.clicked.connect(self.save)
        save_row.addWidget(self.btn_save)
        layout.addLayout(save_row)
        return editor

    def _add_parameter_row(self, parameter):
        parameter = parameter or TransformParameter("", default=0)
        row = self.param_table.rowCount()
        self.param_table.insertRow(row)
        self.param_table.setItem(row, _NAME, QTableWidgetItem(parameter.name))
        self.param_table.setItem(row, _LABEL, QTableWidgetItem(parameter.label))
        kind = self._kind_combo()
        kind.setCurrentIndex(max(kind.findData(parameter.kind), 0))
        self.param_table.setCellWidget(row, _KIND, kind)
        default = "" if parameter.default is None else (
            format_number(parameter.default) if parameter.kind == "number"
            else str(parameter.default)
        )
        self.param_table.setItem(row, _DEFAULT, QTableWidgetItem(default))
        optional = QTableWidgetItem()
        optional.setFlags(
            Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
            | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
        )
        optional.setCheckState(
            Qt.CheckState.Checked if parameter.optional else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
        )
        self.param_table.setItem(row, _OPTIONAL, optional)
        self.param_table.setItem(row, _CHOICES, QTableWidgetItem(format_choices(parameter)))

    def _update_script_hint(self):
        method = self.hook_kind_combo.currentData() == "method"
        self.script_hint.set_hint(
            self.translations["hooks.method_script_hint" if method else "hooks.script_hint"],
            "reference/hook-context/#method-hooks" if method else "reference/hook-context/")

    def _kind_combo(self):
        combo = QComboBox()
        for value in _KINDS:
            combo.addItem(self.translations[f"templates.kind_{value}"], value)
        return combo

    def _remove_parameter_row(self):
        row = self.param_table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            self.param_table.removeRow(row)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Loading and state
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _reload(self, select_id=None):
        try:
            self._templates = self._repository.list_templates()
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self._templates = []
            self.status_label.setText(
                self.translations["hooks.db_failed"].format(message=error)
            )
        self.template_list.blockSignals(True)
        self.template_list.clear()
        for definition in self._templates:
            item = QListWidgetItem(definition.name)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, definition.template_id)
            kind = self.translations[f"templates.hook_kind_{definition.kind}"]
            item.setToolTip(f"{kind}\n{definition.description}".strip())
            if definition.kind == "method":
                item.setForeground(theme_qcolor(_METHOD_COLOR))
            self.template_list.addItem(item)
            if definition.template_id == select_id:
                self.template_list.setCurrentItem(item)
        self.template_list.blockSignals(False)
        self.btn_delete.setEnabled(bool(self._templates))

    def _load(self, definition):
        """Show ``definition`` in the editor; ``None`` starts a new template."""
        if definition is None:
            definition = TransformDefinition(
                self.translations["templates.new_name"], NEW_TEMPLATE_SOURCE
            )
        self._current_id = definition.template_id
        self.name_input.setText(definition.name)
        self.hook_kind_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(self.hook_kind_combo.findData(definition.kind), 0))
        self._update_script_hint()
        self.description_input.setText(definition.description)
        self.source_input.setPlainText(definition.source)
        self.param_table.setRowCount(0)
        for parameter in definition.parameters:
            self._add_parameter_row(parameter)
        self.error_label.setText("")
        self._snapshot = self._editor_state()

    def _editor_state(self):
        rows = []
        for row in range(self.param_table.rowCount()):
            cells = []
            for column in range(6):
                if column == _KIND:
                    cells.append(self.param_table.cellWidget(row, column).currentData())
                elif column == _OPTIONAL:
                    cells.append(
                        self.param_table.item(row, column).checkState()
                        == Qt.CheckState.Checked
                    )
                else:
                    item = self.param_table.item(row, column)
                    cells.append("" if item is None else item.text().strip())
            rows.append(tuple(cells))
        return (
            self.name_input.text().strip(),
            self.description_input.text().strip(),
            self.source_input.toPlainText(),
            tuple(rows),
            self.hook_kind_combo.currentData(),
        )

    def is_dirty(self):
        """Return True when the editor has unsaved changes."""
        return self._snapshot is not None and self._editor_state() != self._snapshot

    def _confirm_discard(self):
        """Ask what to do with unsaved changes; False means cancel."""
        if not self.is_dirty():
            return True
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            self.translations["templates.unsaved_title"],
            self.translations["templates.unsaved_message"],
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save
            | QMessageBox.StandardButton.Discard
            | QMessageBox.StandardButton.Cancel,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save,
        )
        if answer == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save:
            return self.save()
        return answer == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Discard

    def _select_row_of(self, template_id):
        self.template_list.blockSignals(True)
        row = next(
            (
                i for i, definition in enumerate(self._templates)
                if definition.template_id == template_id
            ),
            -1,
        )
        self.template_list.setCurrentRow(row)
        self.template_list.blockSignals(False)

    def _on_row_changed(self, row):
        if row < 0 or row >= len(self._templates):
            return
        target_id = self._templates[row].template_id
        if not self._confirm_discard():
            self._select_row_of(self._current_id)
            return
        # Saving reloads the list; look the clicked template up again.
        definition = next(
            (d for d in self._templates if d.template_id == target_id), None
        )
        if definition is not None:
            self._select_row_of(target_id)
            self._load(definition)

    def reject(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Close the dialog after asking about unsaved changes."""
        if self._confirm_discard():
            super().reject()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Actions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _new_template(self):
        if not self._confirm_discard():
            return
        self._select_row_of(None)
        self._load(None)
        self.name_input.setFocus()
        self.name_input.selectAll()

    def _delete_template(self):
        if self._current_id is None:
            self._new_template()
            return
        name = self.name_input.text().strip()
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            self.translations["templates.title"],
            self.translations["templates.delete_confirm"].format(name=name),
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self._repository.delete_template(self._current_id)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["hooks.db_failed"].format(message=error))
            return
        self._snapshot = None
        self._reload()
        if self._templates:
            self.template_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self._load(None)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["templates.deleted"].format(name=name))

    def editor_definition(self):  # pylint: disable=too-many-locals
        """Build a TransformDefinition from the editor; raises ValueError."""
        name, description, source, rows, hook_kind = self._editor_state()
        if not name:
            raise ValueError(self.translations["templates.name_required"])
        if not source.strip():
            raise ValueError(self.translations["templates.source_required"])
        problem = self.syntax_hint.problem()
        if problem is not None:
            raise ValueError(problem)
        parameters, names = [], set()
        for param_name, label, kind, default, optional, choices in rows:
            if not PARAMETER_NAME.match(param_name):
                raise ValueError(
                    self.translations["templates.param_name_invalid"].format(name=param_name)
                )
            if param_name in names:
                raise ValueError(
                    self.translations["templates.param_name_duplicate"].format(name=param_name)
                )
            names.add(param_name)
            values, labels = (), ()
            if kind == "choice":
                values, labels = parse_choices(choices)
                if not values:
                    raise ValueError(
                        self.translations["templates.param_choices_required"].format(
                            name=param_name
                        )
                    )
                if default and default not in values:
                    raise ValueError(
                        self.translations["templates.param_default_invalid"].format(
                            name=param_name
                        )
                    )
                value = default or values[0]
            elif kind == "code":
                value = default or None
                problem = syntax_problem(self.translations, BODY, default)
                if problem is not None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{param_name}: {problem}")
            elif default:
                try:
                    value = parse_number(default)
                except ValueError as error:
                    raise ValueError(
                        self.translations["templates.param_default_invalid"].format(
                            name=param_name
                        )
                    ) from error
            else:
                value = None
            parameters.append(TransformParameter(
                name=param_name,
                kind=kind,
                default=value,
                choices=values,
                optional=optional,
                label=label,
                choice_labels=labels,
            ))
        return TransformDefinition(
            name=name,
            source=source.strip(),
            parameters=tuple(parameters),
            description=description,
            template_id=self._current_id,
            kind=hook_kind,
        )

    def _test_template(self):
        """Try the edited (possibly unsaved) template in the sandbox."""
        try:
            definition = self.editor_definition()
        except ValueError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(str(error))
            return
        self.error_label.setText("")
        TemplateTestDialog(self.translations, definition, self).exec()

    def save(self):
        """Save the edited template; returns True on success."""
        try:
            definition = self.editor_definition()
            template_id = self._repository.save_template(definition, self._current_id)
        except DuplicateTemplateError:
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["templates.name_exists"].format(
                name=self.name_input.text().strip()))
            return False
        except ValueError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(str(error))
            return False
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["hooks.db_failed"].format(message=error))
            return False
        self._reload(select_id=template_id)
        self._load(next(d for d in self._templates if d.template_id == template_id))
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["templates.saved"].format(name=definition.name)
        )
        return True


class TemplateTestDialog(QDialog):
    """Run a template with sample values outside the target process.

    ``ctx.state`` is kept between runs until it is reset or the dialog closes.
    """

    # Widgets are created by _build_ui called from __init__.
    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    def __init__(self, translations, definition, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.definition = definition
        self.sandbox = TransformSandbox()
        self.setWindowTitle(
            translations["templates.test_title"].format(name=definition.name)
        )
        self.resize(560, 560)
        self._build_ui()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        form = QFormLayout()
        self.method = self.definition.kind == "method"
        self.result_input = QLineEdit("10")
        self.value_type_combo = QComboBox()
        for value_type in VALUE_TYPES:
            self.value_type_combo.addItem(value_type, value_type)
        self.value_type_combo.setCurrentIndex(
            self.value_type_combo.findData(DEFAULT_VALUE_TYPE)
        )
        self.old_input = QLineEdit("100")
        self.new_input = QLineEdit("110")
        if self.method:
            # Arguments, objects and game calls only exist in the game.
            form.addRow(self.translations["templates.test_method_result"], self.result_input)
            form.addRow(WrappedLabel(self.translations["templates.test_method_hint"]))
        else:
            form.addRow(self.translations["templates.test_value_type"], self.value_type_combo)
            form.addRow(self.translations["templates.test_old"], self.old_input)
            form.addRow(self.translations["templates.test_new"], self.new_input)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        if self.definition.parameters:
            params_box = QGroupBox(self.translations["templates.parameters"])
            params_layout = QVBoxLayout(params_box)
            self.params_form = TransformForm(self.definition, self.translations)
            params_layout.addWidget(self.params_form)
            layout.addWidget(params_box)
        else:
            self.params_form = TransformForm(self.definition, self.translations)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        reset = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.test_reset"])
        set_button_icon(reset, "restart_alt")
        reset.setToolTip(self.translations["templates.test_reset_tooltip"])
        reset.clicked.connect(self.reset_state)
        buttons.addWidget(reset)
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.btn_run = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.test_run"])
        self.btn_run.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.btn_run, "play_arrow")
        self.btn_run.clicked.connect(self.run)
        buttons.addWidget(self.btn_run)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.result_label = WrappedLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.result_label)
        self.output = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.output.setReadOnly(True)
        self.output.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        layout.addWidget(self.output, 1)

        close_row = QHBoxLayout()
        close_row.addStretch()
        close_button = QPushButton(self.translations["templates.close"])
        set_button_icon(close_button, "close")
        close_button.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        close_row.addWidget(close_button)
        layout.addLayout(close_row)

    def _number(self, editor, key):
        try:
            return parse_number(editor.text().strip())
        except ValueError as error:
            raise ValueError(
                self.translations["hooks.invalid_number"].format(
                    name=self.translations[key]
                )
            ) from error

    def reset_state(self):
        """Forget ctx.state."""
        self.sandbox.reset_state()
        self.output.setPlainText("")
        self.result_label.setText(self.translations["templates.test_state_reset"])
        self.result_label.setStyleSheet("")

    def run(self):
        """Call the template once with the entered values and show the outcome."""
        if self.method:
            return self._run_method()
        try:
            old = self._number(self.old_input, "templates.test_old")
            new = self._number(self.new_input, "templates.test_new")
            params = self.params_form.create_transform().params
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_error"].format(message=error), True)
            return None
        value_type = self.value_type_combo.currentData()
        result = self.sandbox.run(self.definition.source, params, old, new, value_type)
        if result.error is not None:
            self._show(
                self.translations["templates.test_error"].format(message=result.error), True
            )
        elif result.kept:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_kept"].format(
                value=format_number(normalize_for_display(new, value_type))
            ), False)
        else:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_result"].format(
                old=format_number(old), new=format_number(new),
                value=format_number(result.value),
            ), False)
        lines = [f"{self.translations['templates.test_logs']}:"]
        lines += [f"  {line}" for line in result.logs] or ["  —"]
        lines += ["", f"ctx.state = {result.state}"]
        self.output.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))
        return result

    def _run_method(self):
        try:
            result = self._number(self.result_input, "templates.test_method_result")
            params = self.params_form.create_transform().params
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_error"].format(message=error), True)
            return None
        outcome = self.sandbox.run_method(self.definition.source, params, result)
        if outcome.error is not None:
            self._show(
                self.translations["templates.test_error"].format(message=outcome.error), True
            )
        elif outcome.kept:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_method_kept"].format(
                value=format_number(result)), False)
        else:
            self._show(self.translations["templates.test_method_replaced"].format(
                old=format_number(result), value=format_number(outcome.value)), False)
        self._show_output(outcome)
        return outcome

    def _show_output(self, outcome):
        lines = [f"{self.translations['templates.test_logs']}:"]
        lines += [f"  {line}" for line in outcome.logs] or ["  —"]
        lines += ["", f"ctx.state = {outcome.state}"]
        self.output.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))

    def _show(self, text, error):
        self.result_label.setText(text)
        self.result_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {theme_color('danger' if error else 'success')};")


def normalize_for_display(value, value_type):
    """Show an entered value the way the game would store it."""
    return int(value) if value_type.startswith("int") else float(value)
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/text_viewer.py`:

```py
"""A window for a long text, e.g. a string a monitored method returned.

JSON (an object or an array) is shown as a tree and formatted; any text can
be copied or saved.
"""

import json

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QFontDatabase, QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QDialog,
    QFileDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMenu,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTabWidget,
    QTreeWidget,
    QTreeWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from grembyte.ui.export_folder import remember, suggested_path
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon

# Characters of a value the tree shows in one line
_VALUE_PREVIEW = 200
# Item data: the JSON value of a tree item
_VALUE = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole


def parse_json(text):
    """The object or array ``text`` holds as JSON, else None."""
    if text.lstrip()[:1] not in ("{", "["):
        return None
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def summary(value):
    """One line for a JSON value: ``{3}``, ``[12]`` or the value itself."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return f"{{{len(value)}}}"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return f"[{len(value)}]"
    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
    return text if len(text) <= _VALUE_PREVIEW else text[:_VALUE_PREVIEW] + "…"


def _children(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return list(value.items())
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [(f"[{index}]", item) for index, item in enumerate(value)]
    return []


class TextViewerDialog(QDialog):
    """Show a text that is still coming (``set_text``) or known (``text``).

    ``length`` is the length of the original text, when the text is only
    its start.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes
    def __init__(self, translations, title, text=None, length=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose)
        self.translations = translations
        self.text = None
        self.data = None
        self.setWindowTitle(title)
        self.resize(900, 640)
        self._build_ui()
        if text is not None:
            self.set_text(text, length)

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.info_label = QLabel(self.translations["text_viewer.loading"])
        self.info_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.info_label)

        self.tabs = QTabWidget()
        self.tree = QTreeWidget()
        self.tree.setColumnCount(2)
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels([self.translations["text_viewer.column_key"],
                                   self.translations["text_viewer.column_value"]])
        self.tree.setColumnWidth(0, 280)
        self.tree.itemExpanded.connect(self._fill)
        self.tree.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.tree.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._tree_menu)
        self.plain = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.plain.setReadOnly(True)
        self.plain.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        self.tabs.addTab(self.plain, self.translations["text_viewer.tab_text"])
        layout.addWidget(self.tabs, 1)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.copy_button = QPushButton(self.translations["text_viewer.copy"])
        set_button_icon(self.copy_button, "content_copy")
        self.copy_button.setToolTip(self.translations["text_viewer.copy_tooltip"])
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy)
        self.save_button = QPushButton(self.translations["text_viewer.save"])
        set_button_icon(self.save_button, "save")
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self._save)
        close_button = QPushButton(self.translations["text_viewer.close"])
        set_button_icon(close_button, "close")
        close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)
        for button in (self.copy_button, self.save_button, close_button):
            buttons.addWidget(button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)
        self._enable(False)

    def _enable(self, enabled):
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.save_button.setEnabled(enabled)

    # --- Content -------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_text(self, text, length=None):
        """Show ``text``; ``length`` of the original if ``text`` is only its start."""
        self.text = text
        self.data = parse_json(text)
        info = self.translations["text_viewer.characters"].format(count=len(text))
        if length is not None and length > len(text):
            info = self.translations["text_viewer.cut"].format(count=len(text), length=length)
        if self.data is not None:
            info += "  ·  " + self.translations["text_viewer.json"]
            self.plain.setPlainText(json.dumps(self.data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
            self.tree.clear()
            self._add_children(self.tree.invisibleRootItem(), self.data)
            self.tabs.insertTab(0, self.tree, self.translations["text_viewer.tab_tree"])
            self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(0)
        else:
            self.plain.setPlainText(text)
        self.info_label.setText(info)
        self._enable(True)

    def show_missing(self):
        """The text is no longer kept (see MethodMonitorWorker.full_text)."""
        self.info_label.setText(self.translations["text_viewer.missing"])

    def show_error(self, message):
        self.info_label.setText(self.translations["text_viewer.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _add_children(self, parent, value):
        for key, child in _children(value):
            item = QTreeWidgetItem([str(key), summary(child)])
            item.setData(0, _VALUE, child)
            item.setToolTip(1, summary(child))
            if _children(child):
                # Filled when expanded: a save game has far too many nodes.
                item.setChildIndicatorPolicy(
                    QTreeWidgetItem.ChildIndicatorPolicy.ShowIndicator)
            parent.addChild(item)

    def _fill(self, item):
        if item.childCount() == 0:
            self._add_children(item, item.data(0, _VALUE))

    # --- Actions -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _copy(self):
        """Copy the text as it came, or the selected node of the tree."""
        if self.tabs.currentWidget() is self.tree and self.tree.currentItem() is not None:
            self._copy_node(self.tree.currentItem())
        elif self.text is not None:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(self.text)

    @staticmethod
    def _copy_node(item):
        value = item.data(0, _VALUE)
        text = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, indent=2,
                                                                ensure_ascii=False)
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(text)

    def _tree_menu(self, position):
        item = self.tree.itemAt(position)
        if item is None:
            return
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.addAction(self.translations["text_viewer.copy_node"],
                       lambda: self._copy_node(item))
        menu.exec(self.tree.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

    def _save(self):
        if self.text is None:
            return
        suffix = "json" if self.data is not None else "txt"
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, self.translations["text_viewer.save"], suggested_path(f"text.{suffix}"))
        if not path:
            return
        remember(path)
        try:
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
                file.write(self.text)
        except OSError as error:
            self.show_error(str(error))
```

```py
"""Dialog for selecting and editing UI color themes."""

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QApplication,
    QColorDialog,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.ui.styles.styles import build_stylesheet
from grembyte.ui.styles.themes import COLOR_KEYS
from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import apply_code_theme
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import apply_icon_theme, parse_color


def _label_color(value, background):
    """Black or white, whichever reads better on the colour ``value``.

    A translucent colour (the selection) is judged as it shows: over the
    theme's ``background``.
    """
    color, under = parse_color(value), parse_color(background)
    alpha = color.alphaF()
    red, green, blue = (alpha * channel + (1 - alpha) * base for channel, base in (
        (color.redF(), under.redF()), (color.greenF(), under.greenF()),
        (color.blueF(), under.blueF())))
    luminance = 0.2126 * red + 0.7152 * green + 0.0722 * blue
    return "#000000" if luminance > 0.5 else "#ffffff"


class ThemeDialog(QDialog):
    """Preview and save a named theme with editable palette colors."""

    def __init__(self, translations, manager, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.manager = manager
        self.application = QApplication.instance()
        self.original_stylesheet = self.application.styleSheet()
        self.original_theme = manager.load_theme()
        self.colors = dict(self.original_theme["colors"])
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["theme.title"])
        self.resize(560, 680)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.theme_combo = QComboBox()
        self.theme_combo.setEditable(True)
        self.theme_combo.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.InsertPolicy.NoInsert)
        self.theme_combo.addItems(manager.available_themes())
        self.theme_combo.setCurrentText(self.original_theme["name"])
        self.theme_combo.activated.connect(self._select_theme)

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.addRow(QLabel(translations["theme.name"]), self.theme_combo)
        self.color_buttons = {}
        for key in COLOR_KEYS:
            button = QPushButton()
            button.clicked.connect(lambda _checked=False, color_key=key:
                                   self._choose_color(color_key))
            self.color_buttons[key] = button
            form.addRow(QLabel(translations[f"theme.color.{key}"]), button)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        contents = QWidget()
        contents.setLayout(form)
        scroll.setWidget(contents)
        layout.addWidget(scroll)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(
            translations, "button.save", self._save_theme, self.reject))
        self._refresh_color_buttons()

    def _select_theme(self, _index):
        theme = self.manager.load_theme(self.theme_combo.currentText())
        self.theme_combo.setCurrentText(theme["name"])
        self.colors = dict(theme["colors"])
        self._refresh_color_buttons()
        self._preview()

    def _choose_color(self, key):
        color = QColorDialog.getColor(
            parse_color(self.colors[key]), self, self.translations[f"theme.color.{key}"],
            options=QColorDialog.ColorDialogOption.ShowAlphaChannel)
        if not color.isValid():
            return
        self.colors[key] = (color.name() if color.alpha() == 255 else
                            f"rgba({color.red()}, {color.green()}, {color.blue()}, "
                            f"{color.alphaF():.3f})")
        self._refresh_color_buttons()
        self._preview()

    def _refresh_color_buttons(self):
        for key, button in self.color_buttons.items():
            value = self.colors[key]
            button.setText(value)
            button.setToolTip(value)
            label = _label_color(value, self.colors["background"])
            button.setStyleSheet(f"background-color: {value}; color: {label};")

    def _preview(self):
        self.application.setStyleSheet(build_stylesheet(self.colors))
        apply_icon_theme(self.colors)
        apply_code_theme(self.colors)

    def _save_theme(self):
        name = self.theme_combo.currentText().strip()
        try:
            self.manager.save_theme(name, self.colors)
            self.manager.set_current(name)
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, self.translations["theme.title"],
                                self.translations["theme.save_error"].format(error=error))
            return
        self.application.setStyleSheet(self.manager.stylesheet(name))
        apply_icon_theme(self.colors)
        apply_code_theme(self.colors)
        self.accept()

    def reject(self):
        self.application.setStyleSheet(self.original_stylesheet)
        apply_icon_theme(self.original_theme["colors"])
        apply_code_theme(self.original_theme["colors"])
        super().reject()
```

```py
"""Window of the Mono trace: which C# methods a scenario in the game runs."""

from PySide6.QtCore import QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex, Qt, QTimer, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color
from grembyte.ui.widgets.labels import DocsHint, SelectableText
from grembyte.ui.widgets.trace_filters import TraceFilterPanel
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns
from grembyte.ui.workers import keep_until_finished

# The recording steps in their order: first the baseline, then the scenario.
RECORDING_ICONS = {"baseline": "looks_one", "scenario": "looks_two"}

# The limits come from the settings (grembyte.core.settings):
# large_trace: above this many methods the trace asks first, Mono compiles them all.
# wine_trace_limit: under Wine/Proton no more than this (0: no limit): compiling
# and hooking tens of thousands of methods there froze or crashed the game
# (Mono's garbage collector waiting in SuspendThread; Frida's Windows gadget).

_R_FAVORITE, _R_ORDER, _R_METHOD, _R_CALLS, _R_RATE, _R_BASELINE, _R_VERDICT = range(7)
_ROW_COLUMNS = (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY, "trace.column_order", "trace.column_method", "trace.column_calls",
    "trace.column_rate", "trace.column_baseline", "trace.column_verdict",
)
_S_FAVORITE, _S_TIME, _S_THREAD, _S_METHOD, _S_CALLER = range(5)
# Typing in the free-text filter pauses this long before the choice is counted.
CHOICE_DELAY_MS = 200

_SEQUENCE_COLUMNS = (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY, "trace.column_time", "trace.column_thread", "trace.column_method", "trace.column_caller",
)

# States of the window
_IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY, _RECORDING = range(4)


class _TableModel(FavoriteColumn, QAbstractTableModel):
    """Read-only rows with translated column headers, the first column the star.

    Every item has a ``method``: the index of its method in ``methods``.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, columns, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.columns = columns
        self.methods = []
        self.items = []

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.items)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.columns)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[self.columns[section]]
        return None

    def set_items(self, methods, items):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.methods = methods
        self.items = items
        self.endResetModel()

    def item_at(self, row):
        return self.items[row] if 0 <= row < len(self.items) else None

    def favorite_item(self, row):
        item = self.item_at(row)
        return None if item is None else self.methods[item.method]

    def method_name(self, index):
        return short_name(self.methods[index].signature)

    def signature(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].signature


class TraceRowModel(_TableModel):
    """The methods the scenario called (TraceRows).

    Sorts by a column when the view asks; column -1 is the order of ``analyze``.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, _ROW_COLUMNS, parent)
        self._unsorted = []
        self._sort_column = -1
        self._sort_order = Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder

    def set_items(self, methods, items):
        self._unsorted = list(items)
        self.methods = methods  # the method names sort by them
        super().set_items(methods, self._sorted(self._unsorted))

    def sort(self, column, order=Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder):
        self._sort_column = column
        self._sort_order = order
        self.set_items(self.methods, self._unsorted)

    def _sorted(self, rows):
        column = self._sort_column
        if column < 0 or column >= len(self.columns):
            return rows
        keys = {
            _R_FAVORITE: lambda row: (self.favorites is not None
                                      and self.favorites.is_favorite(self.methods[row.method])),
            _R_ORDER: lambda row: (row.first is None, row.first or 0),
            _R_METHOD: lambda row: self.method_name(row.method).lower(),
            _R_CALLS: lambda row: row.calls,
            _R_RATE: lambda row: row.rate,
            _R_BASELINE: lambda row: (row.baseline_rate is not None, row.baseline_rate or 0),
            _R_VERDICT: lambda row: ({NEW: 2, MORE: 1}.get(row.verdict, 0), row.factor or 0),
        }
        return sorted(rows, key=keys[column],
                      reverse=self._sort_order == Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)

    def verdict_text(self, row):
        if row.verdict == NEW:
            return self.translations["trace.verdict_new"]
        if row.verdict == MORE:
            return self.translations["trace.verdict_more"].format(factor=row.factor)
        return self.translations["trace.verdict_same"]

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        row = self.items[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _R_FAVORITE:
            return self.favorite_data(index.row(), role)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _R_METHOD:
            return self.signature(row.method)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole and column in (_R_ORDER, _R_CALLS, _R_RATE,
                                                                    _R_BASELINE):
            return int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if column == _R_ORDER:
            return "" if row.first is None else str(row.first + 1)
        if column == _R_METHOD:
            return self.method_name(row.method)
        if column == _R_CALLS:
            return str(row.calls)
        if column == _R_RATE:
            return f"{row.rate:.1f}"
        if column == _R_BASELINE:
            return "—" if row.baseline_rate is None else f"{row.baseline_rate:.1f}"
        return self.verdict_text(row)


class TraceSequenceModel(_TableModel):
    """The calls of the scenario in order (TraceCalls)."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, _SEQUENCE_COLUMNS, parent)

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        call = self.items[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _S_FAVORITE:
            return self.favorite_data(index.row(), role)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _S_METHOD:
            return self.signature(call.method)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _S_CALLER:
            return call.caller
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if column == _S_TIME:
            return f"{call.time / 1000:.3f} ms"
        if column == _S_THREAD:
            return str(call.thread)
        if column == _S_METHOD:
            return self.method_name(call.method)
        return call.caller


def trace_table(model, stretch_column, sortable=False, favorites=None, source="",
                translations=None):
    """A table of trace results: whole rows, one at a time.

    ``sortable``: a click on a column header sorts by it; until then the
    rows keep the model's order. ``favorites``: the FavoriteStore the star
    column marks the methods in, as found by ``source``. With
    ``translations`` the rows and cells can be copied (context menu).
    """
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    view = QTableView()
    view.setModel(model)
    view.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    view.setWordWrap(False)
    view.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    header = view.horizontalHeader()
    for column in range(model.columnCount()):
        header.setSectionResizeMode(
            column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == stretch_column
            else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
    set_up_favorite_column(view, model, favorites, source)
    resizable_columns(view)
    if translations is not None:
        copy_menu(view, translations)
    if sortable:
        header.setSortIndicator(-1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        view.setSortingEnabled(True)
    return view


class RowFilterBar(QWidget):
    """Narrow the rows of a trace down: by words in the name, by call count."""

    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, placeholder="trace.rows_name_placeholder"):
        """``placeholder`` is the catalog key of the name field's hint text."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.name_input = QLineEdit()
        self.name_input.setPlaceholderText(translations[placeholder])
        self.name_input.setToolTip(translations["trace.rows_name_tooltip"])
        self.name_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.name_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self.changed.emit())
        layout.addWidget(self.name_input, 3)
        self.calls_input = QLineEdit()
        self.calls_input.setPlaceholderText(translations["trace.rows_calls_placeholder"])
        self.calls_input.setToolTip(translations["trace.rows_calls_tooltip"])
        self.calls_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.calls_input.textChanged.connect(self._on_calls_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.calls_input, 1)
        self._calls = None

    def _on_calls_changed(self, text):
        try:
            self._calls = calls_filter(text)
            self.calls_input.setStyleSheet("")
        except ValueError:
            # Keep the last valid filter while the text is being typed.
            self.calls_input.setStyleSheet(f"border: 1px solid {theme_color('danger')};")
            return
        self.changed.emit()

    def accepts(self, row, text):
        """Whether to show ``row`` (a TraceRow), its function or method described by ``text``."""
        if self._calls is not None and not self._calls(row.calls):
            return False
        text = text.lower()
        return all(word in text for word in self.name_input.text().lower().split())


class TraceDialog(QDialog):
    """Hook many C# methods, record a baseline and a scenario, compare.

    Not modal. The worker and its Frida session live as long as the window;
    closing it removes the interceptors. With an assembly selection (see
    grembyte.ui.widgets.assemblies) only the selected assemblies are traced.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # CatalogMethod to log the calls of, or to create a method hook for
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)
    hook_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None, engine=None, filter_repository=None,
                 favorites=None, assembly_selection=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.engine = resolve_engine(pid, engine)
        self.limit = (settings.get("wine_trace_limit") or None) if is_wine_process(pid) else None
        self.large = settings.get("large_trace")
        self._filter_repository = filter_repository
        self._favorites = favorites
        self._assembly_selection = assembly_selection
        # The selection changed while a trace ran: list the candidates when it ends.
        self._stale_candidates = False
        self.methods = []
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self.rows = []
        self._state = _IDLE
        self._recording = None
        self._selected = None
        self.setWindowTitle(self._title())
        self.resize(1100, 720)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = TraceWorker(pid, engine=self.engine, selection=self.selection())
        self._worker.planned.connect(self._on_planned)
        self._worker.started.connect(self._on_started)
        self._worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self._worker.began.connect(self._on_began)
        self._worker.live.connect(self._on_live)
        self._worker.recorded.connect(self._on_recorded)
        self._worker.stopped.connect(self._on_stopped)
        self._worker.ended.connect(self._on_ended)
        self._worker.command_failed.connect(self._on_command_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self._worker.candidates_found.connect(self._on_candidates)
        self._worker.start()
        self._worker.candidates()
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        if assembly_selection is not None:
            assembly_selection.changed.connect(self._on_selection_changed)

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        # An engine whose trace sees other calls than Mono's says which.
        hint_key = f"trace.hint_{self.engine.id}"
        hint = DocsHint(self.translations, self.translations[
            hint_key if hint_key in self.translations else "trace.hint"], "engines/#trace")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        scope = QHBoxLayout()
        self.filter_input = QLineEdit()
        self.filter_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["trace.filter_placeholder"])
        self.filter_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_tooltip"])
        self.filter_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.filter_input.returnPressed.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        scope.addWidget(self.filter_input, 1)
        self.trace_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.start"])
        self.trace_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button, "play_arrow")
        self.trace_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        scope.addWidget(self.trace_button)
        layout.addLayout(scope)

        self.filter_panel = TraceFilterPanel(self.translations, self._filter_repository, self)
        self.filter_panel.selection_changed.connect(self._show_choice)
        layout.addWidget(self.filter_panel)
        self.choice_label = QLabel("")
        self.choice_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.choice_label)
        # In the choice label's place while the method list loads
        self.loading_bar = QProgressBar()
        self.loading_bar.setTextVisible(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.loading_bar)
        self._show_loading(0, 0, "")
        # Typing pauses this long before the choice is counted again.
        self._choice_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._choice_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._choice_timer.setInterval(CHOICE_DELAY_MS)
        self._choice_timer.timeout.connect(self._show_choice)
        self.filter_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._choice_timer.start())

        steps = QHBoxLayout()
        self.baseline_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.baseline"])
        set_button_icon(self.baseline_button, RECORDING_ICONS["baseline"])
        self.baseline_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.baseline_tooltip"])
        self.baseline_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.baseline_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("baseline"))
        steps.addWidget(self.baseline_button)
        self.scenario_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.scenario"])
        set_button_icon(self.scenario_button, RECORDING_ICONS["scenario"])
        self.scenario_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.scenario_tooltip"])
        self.scenario_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.scenario_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("scenario"))
        steps.addWidget(self.scenario_button)
        self.recording_label = QLabel("")
        steps.addWidget(self.recording_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(steps)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        top = QWidget()
        top_layout = QVBoxLayout(top)
        top_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        rows_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        rows_bar.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["trace.methods"]))
        rows_bar.addStretch()
        self.notable_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.notable_only"])
        self.notable_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.notable_tooltip"])
        self.notable_check.setChecked(True)
        self.notable_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._show_rows())
        rows_bar.addWidget(self.notable_check)
        top_layout.addLayout(rows_bar)
        self.row_filter = RowFilterBar(
            self.translations, self, placeholder="trace.rows_method_placeholder")
        self.row_filter.changed.connect(self._show_rows)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.row_filter)
        self.row_model = TraceRowModel(self.translations, self)
        self.rows_view = self._table(self.row_model, _R_METHOD, sortable=True)
        header = self.rows_view.horizontalHeader()
        header.resizeSection(_R_ORDER, 60)
        header.resizeSection(_R_CALLS, 80)
        header.resizeSection(_R_RATE, 90)
        header.resizeSection(_R_BASELINE, 130)
        header.resizeSection(_R_VERDICT, 170)
        self.rows_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_row_selected)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.rows_view, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(top)

        bottom = QWidget()
        bottom_layout = QVBoxLayout(bottom)
        bottom_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        bottom_layout.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["trace.sequence"]))
        self.sequence_model = TraceSequenceModel(self.translations, self)
        self.sequence_view = self._table(self.sequence_model, _S_CALLER)
        sequence_header = self.sequence_view.horizontalHeader()
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_TIME, 110)
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_THREAD, 80)
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_METHOD, 280)
        self.sequence_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_call_selected)
        bottom_layout.addWidget(self.sequence_view, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(bottom)
        splitter.setSizes([330, 290])
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.selection_label = SelectableText()
        actions.addWidget(self.selection_label, 1)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.monitor"])
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.monitor_tooltip"])
        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        actions.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.create_hook"])
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["monitor.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        actions.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        unsupported = self.translations["engine.unsupported"].format(
            engine=self.engine.display_name)
        for button, capability in ((self.monitor_button, engine_base.MONITOR),
                                   (self.hook_button, engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS)):
            if not self.engine.supports(capability):
                button.setToolTip(unsupported)
        self.pin_button = PinButton(self.translations)
        actions.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)
        self._show_selection()

    def _table(self, model, stretch_column, sortable=False):
        view = trace_table(model, stretch_column, sortable, self._favorites, TRACE,
                           self.translations)
        view.doubleClicked.connect(
            lambda index: index.column() != FAVORITE_COLUMN and self._request_monitor())
        return view

    def _set_state(self, state):
        self._state = state
        if state == _IDLE and self._stale_candidates:
            self._stale_candidates = False
            self._reload_candidates()
        tracing = state in (_READY, _RECORDING)
        self.filter_input.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.filter_panel.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(state in (_IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY))
        self.trace_button.setText(self.translations[
            "trace.cancel" if state == _PREPARING else "trace.stop" if tracing else "trace.start"])
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button,
                        "close" if state == _PREPARING else "stop" if tracing else "play_arrow")
        for phase, button in (("baseline", self.baseline_button),
                              ("scenario", self.scenario_button)):
            active = state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase
            button.setEnabled(state == _READY or active)
            button.setChecked(active)
            button.setText(self.translations[f"trace.{phase}_stop" if active else f"trace.{phase}"])
            set_button_icon(button, "stop" if active else RECORDING_ICONS[phase])
        if state != _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText("")

    # --- Trace -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _words(self):
        return self.filter_input.text().lower().split()

    def _toggle_trace(self):
        if self._state == _IDLE:
            chosen = self.filter_panel.selection(self._words())
            if chosen is None:
                # The method list is still loading: let the agent choose by words.
                self._set_state(_PREPARING)
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.planning"])
                self._worker.plan(self._words())
                return
            if not chosen:
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filters_nothing"])
                return
            if not self._may_trace(len(chosen)):
                return
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.preparing"].format(
                count=len(chosen)))
            self._worker.trace_selection(chosen, self._words())
        elif self._state == _PREPARING:
            self.trace_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.cancel()
        elif self._state == _READY:
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self._worker.stop()

    def _title(self):
        return self.translations["trace.title"].format(engine=self.engine.display_name)

    def _may_trace(self, count):
        """Whether ``count`` methods may be traced: within the limit, and confirmed."""
        if self.limit is not None and count > self.limit:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.wine_limit"].format(
                count=count, limit=self.limit))
            return False
        if count > self.large and not self._confirm_large(count):
            self.status_label.setText("")
            return False
        return True

    def selection(self):
        """The user's assembly selection; empty for none."""
        store = self._assembly_selection
        return store.selection if store is not None else frozenset()

    def _on_selection_changed(self):
        self._worker.set_selection(self.selection())
        if self._state == _IDLE:
            self._reload_candidates()
        else:
            self._stale_candidates = True

    def _reload_candidates(self):
        self._show_loading(0, 0, "")
        self.filter_panel.set_candidates(None)
        self._worker.candidates()

    def _on_candidates(self, methods, _skipped):
        self.loading_bar.hide()
        self.choice_label.show()
        self.filter_panel.set_candidates(methods)

    def _show_loading(self, done, total, assembly):
        """Show how far the method list is read: ``done`` of ``total`` assemblies."""
        self.choice_label.hide()
        self.loading_bar.show()
        # 0 of 0: busy until the worker knows the assemblies
        self.loading_bar.setRange(0, total)
        self.loading_bar.setValue(done)
        text = self.translations["trace.filters_loading"] if total == 0 else             self.translations["trace.filters_loading_progress"].format(
                done=done, total=total, assembly=assembly)
        self.loading_bar.setFormat(text.replace("%", "%%"))

    def _show_choice(self):
        chosen = self.filter_panel.selection(self._words())
        if chosen is None:
            return
        text = self.translations["trace.filters_count"].format(
            count=len(chosen), total=len(self.filter_panel.candidates))
        if self.selection():
            text += " " + self.translations["trace.assembly_selection"].format(
                count=len(self.selection()))
        if self.limit is not None and len(chosen) > self.limit:
            text += " " + self.translations["trace.filters_over_limit"].format(limit=self.limit)
        self.choice_label.setText(text)

    def _confirm_large(self, count):
        """Whether to trace ``count`` methods, more than ``self.large``."""
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self, self._title(),
            self.translations["trace.confirm_large"].format(count=count))
        return answer == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes

    def _on_planned(self, plan):
        count = plan.get("methods", 0)
        if count == 0:
            self._set_state(_IDLE)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.nothing"].format(
                assemblies=", ".join(plan.get("assemblies", [])) or "—"))
            return
        if not self._may_trace(count):
            self._set_state(_IDLE)
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.preparing"].format(count=count))
        self._worker.trace(self._words())

    def _on_progress(self, step, done, total, current):
        if step == "catalog" and self.filter_panel.candidates is None:
            self._show_loading(done, total, current)
            return
        text = self.translations[f"trace.progress_{step}"].format(done=done, total=total)
        if current:
            text += f"\n{current}"
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def _on_started(self, methods, info):
        self.methods = methods
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self._show_results()
        self._set_state(_READY)
        skipped = sum(info.get("skipped", {}).values())
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.started"].format(
            count=len(methods), skipped=skipped,
            failed=info.get("notCompiled", 0) + info.get("failed", 0)))

    def _on_stopped(self):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.stopped"])

    def _on_ended(self):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.ended"])

    def _on_command_failed(self, action, message):
        # A failed start leaves no trace; other commands keep it.
        self._set_state(_IDLE if action in ("plan", "trace", "start") else _READY)
        if message.endswith("cancelled"):
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.cancelled"])
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    # --- Recording -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _toggle_recording(self, phase):
        if self._state == _READY:
            self._recording = phase
            self._set_state(_RECORDING)
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["trace.recording_starting"])
            self._worker.begin(phase)
        elif self._state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase:
            self.baseline_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.scenario_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.finish()
        else:
            self._set_state(self._state)  # undo the click's check mark

    def _on_began(self, phase):
        self.recording_label.setText(self.translations[f"trace.recording_{phase}"])

    def _on_live(self, live):
        if self._state == _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["trace.live"].format(
                phase=self.translations[f"trace.phase_{live.get('phase', '')}"],
                calls=live.get("calls", 0), methods=live.get("methods", 0)))

    def _on_recorded(self, result):
        self._recording = None
        self._set_state(_READY)
        seconds = result.get("duration", 0) / 1000
        if result.get("phase") == "baseline":
            self.baseline = result
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.baseline_done"].format(
                methods=len(result.get("counts", {})), seconds=seconds))
            if self.scenario is not None:
                self._show_results()  # compare the scenario with the new baseline
            return
        self.scenario = result
        self._show_results()
        text = self.translations["trace.scenario_done"].format(
            methods=len(self.rows), notable=sum(row.notable for row in self.rows),
            calls=len(self.sequence_model.items), seconds=seconds)
        if result.get("dropped"):
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["trace.dropped"].format(count=result["dropped"])
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    # --- Results -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _show_results(self):
        self.rows = analyze(self.scenario, self.baseline) if self.scenario else []
        calls = recording_calls(self.scenario) if self.scenario else []
        self.sequence_model.set_items(self.methods, calls)
        self._show_rows()

    def _show_rows(self):
        notable_only = self.notable_check.isChecked()
        rows = [row for row in self.rows if (row.notable or not notable_only)
                and self.row_filter.accepts(row, self.methods[row.method].signature)]
        self.row_model.set_items(self.methods, rows)
        self._selected = None
        self._show_selection()

    def _on_row_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        row = self.row_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if row is None:
            return
        self._selected = row.method
        self._show_selection()
        if row.first is not None:
            # Its first call in the sequence
            index = self.sequence_model.index(row.first, 0)
            self.sequence_view.scrollTo(index, QAbstractItemView.ScrollHint.PositionAtCenter)

    def _on_call_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.sequence_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if call is not None:
            self._selected = call.method
            self._show_selection()

    def selected_method(self):
        """The CatalogMethod chosen in either table, or None."""
        return self.methods[self._selected] if self._selected is not None else None

    def _show_selection(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                       and self.engine.supports(engine_base.MONITOR))
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                    and self.engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS))
        self.selection_label.setText(method.signature if method is not None else "")

    def _request_monitor(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self.engine.supports(engine_base.MONITOR):
            self.monitor_requested.emit(method)

    def _request_hook(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self.engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS):
            self.hook_requested.emit(method)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Removing thousands of interceptors takes a moment; do not block the
        # window for that.
        worker = self._worker
        worker.requestInterruption()
        if worker.isRunning():
            keep_until_finished(worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)
```
