`grembyte/ui/widgets/trace_filters.py`:

```py
"""Choosing the methods of a trace with filters (see grembyte.features.trace_filters)."""

import itertools
from dataclasses import replace

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.features.trace_filters import BUILTIN_FILTERS, TraceFilter, select_methods
from grembyte.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color

# Methods the editor shows as examples of what a filter matches
_PREVIEW = 8
# Ids of filters kept without a repository (the database's are positive)
_unsaved_ids = itertools.count(-1, -1)


def filter_title(translations, trace_filter):
    """The name a filter is shown with (built-in ones are translated)."""
    if trace_filter.builtin:
        return translations[f"trace.filter_{trace_filter.builtin}"]
    return trace_filter.name


def filter_summary(translations, trace_filter):
    """A tooltip that says what a filter matches."""
    parts = []
    if trace_filter.words:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_summary_words"].format(
            words=", ".join(trace_filter.words)))
    if trace_filter.exclude:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_summary_exclude"].format(
            words=", ".join(trace_filter.exclude)))
    if trace_filter.numbers:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_numbers"])
    if trace_filter.changes:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_changes"])
    return "\n".join(parts)


class TraceFilterPanel(QWidget):
    """The filters to choose from, how many methods each one picks, and the total.

    ``repository`` keeps the user's filters (TraceFilterRepository); without
    one they last until the window closes.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes
    selection_changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, translations, repository=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.candidates = None
        self._user_filters = repository.list_filters() if repository is not None else []
        self._build_ui()
        self._fill()

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left = QVBoxLayout()
        title = QLabel(self.translations["trace.filters_label"])
        title.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filters_tooltip"])
        left.addWidget(title)
        self.list = QListWidget()
        self.list.setMaximumHeight(130)
        self.list.itemChanged.connect(lambda _item: self._changed())
        self.list.currentRowChanged.connect(lambda _row: self._update_buttons())
        self.list.itemDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _item: self._edit())
        left.addWidget(self.list)
        layout.addLayout(left, 1)

        right = QVBoxLayout()
        self.new_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_new"])
        set_button_icon(self.new_button, "add")
        self.new_button.clicked.connect(self._new)
        self.edit_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_edit"])
        set_button_icon(self.edit_button, "edit")
        self.edit_button.clicked.connect(self._edit)
        self.delete_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_delete"])
        set_button_icon(self.delete_button, "delete")
        self.delete_button.clicked.connect(self._delete)
        self.check_all_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_check_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.check_all_button, "check_box")
        self.check_all_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_all)
        for button in (self.new_button, self.edit_button, self.delete_button,
                       self.check_all_button):
            right.addWidget(button)
        self.generated_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_generated"])
        self.generated_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_generated_tooltip"])
        self.generated_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._changed(recount=True))
        right.addWidget(self.generated_check)
        right.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(right)

    def _filters(self):
        return list(BUILTIN_FILTERS) + self._user_filters

    def _fill(self):
        checked = {self._key(item) for item in self.checked_filters()}
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        self.list.clear()
        for trace_filter in self._filters():
            item = QListWidgetItem()
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, trace_filter)
            item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if self._key(trace_filter) in checked
                               else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            item.setToolTip(filter_summary(self.translations, trace_filter))
            self.list.addItem(item)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_counts()
        self._update_buttons()

    @staticmethod
    def _key(trace_filter):
        return trace_filter.builtin or ("user", trace_filter.filter_id, trace_filter.name)

    def _update_counts(self):
        generated = self.generated_check.isChecked()
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            item = self.list.item(row)
            trace_filter = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            title = filter_title(self.translations, trace_filter)
            if self.candidates is not None:
                count = len(select_methods(self.candidates, [trace_filter], generated=generated))
                title = self.translations["trace.filter_with_count"].format(
                    name=title, count=count)
            item.setText(title)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        current = self._current()
        self.edit_button.setEnabled(current is not None)
        self.delete_button.setEnabled(current is not None and not current.builtin)
        all_checked = self._all_checked()
        key = "trace.filter_uncheck_all" if all_checked else "trace.filter_check_all"
        self.check_all_button.setText(self.translations[key])
        set_button_icon(self.check_all_button,
                        "check_box_outline_blank" if all_checked else "check_box")

    def _all_checked(self):
        return self.list.count() > 0 and len(self.checked_filters()) == self.list.count()

    def _toggle_all(self):
        """Tick every filter, or untick them all when every one is ticked already."""
        state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked if self._all_checked() else Qt.CheckState.Checked
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            self.list.item(row).setCheckState(state)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        self._changed()

    def _changed(self, recount=False):
        # What each filter picks only changes with the candidates, the
        # generated-code switch and the filters themselves, not with a tick.
        if recount:
            self._update_counts()
        self._update_buttons()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    # --- State ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_candidates(self, methods):
        """The methods to choose from (CatalogMethods), or None while unknown."""
        self.candidates = methods
        self._update_counts()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    def checked_filters(self):
        """The filters the user ticked."""
        return [self.list.item(row).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                for row in range(self.list.count())
                if self.list.item(row).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

    def include_generated(self):
        """Whether compiler-generated methods may be chosen."""
        return self.generated_check.isChecked()

    def selection(self, words=()):
        """The candidates the ticked filters and ``words`` pick (None while unknown)."""
        if self.candidates is None:
            return None
        return select_methods(self.candidates, self.checked_filters(), words,
                              generated=self.include_generated())

    def _current(self):
        item = self.list.currentItem()
        return None if item is None else item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

    # --- Editing -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _new(self):
        self._open_editor(TraceFilter(""))

    def _edit(self):
        current = self._current()
        if current is None:
            return
        if current.builtin:
            # Built-in filters stay as shipped; edit a copy.
            name = self.translations["trace.filter_copy_name"].format(
                name=filter_title(self.translations, current))
            current = current.copy_as(name)
        self._open_editor(current)

    def _open_editor(self, trace_filter):
        dialog = TraceFilterDialog(self.translations, trace_filter, self.candidates,
                                   self._save, parent=self)
        dialog.exec()

    def _save(self, trace_filter):
        """Store an edited filter; raises ValueError for a duplicate name."""
        if any(other.name == trace_filter.name and other.filter_id != trace_filter.filter_id
               for other in self._user_filters):
            raise ValueError(trace_filter.name)
        if self.repository is not None:
            self.repository.save_filter(trace_filter)
            self._user_filters = self.repository.list_filters()
        else:
            if trace_filter.filter_id is None:
                trace_filter = replace(trace_filter, filter_id=next(_unsaved_ids))
            self._user_filters = sorted(
                [other for other in self._user_filters
                 if other.filter_id != trace_filter.filter_id] + [trace_filter],
                key=lambda other: other.name.lower())
        self._fill()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    def _delete(self):
        current = self._current()
        if current is None or current.builtin:
            return
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self, self.translations["trace.filter_dialog_title"],
            self.translations["trace.filter_delete_confirm"].format(name=current.name))
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        if self.repository is not None:
            self.repository.delete_filter(current.filter_id)
            self._user_filters = self.repository.list_filters()
        else:
            self._user_filters = [f for f in self._user_filters
                                  if f.filter_id != current.filter_id]
        self._fill()
        self.selection_changed.emit()


class TraceFilterDialog(QDialog):
    """Create or change a user's trace filter, with a preview of what it picks.

    ``save`` stores the result and raises ValueError for a duplicate name.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,too-many-arguments
    def __init__(self, translations, trace_filter, candidates, save, parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.original = trace_filter
        self.candidates = candidates
        self._save = save
        self.result_filter = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["trace.filter_dialog_title"])
        self.resize(560, 420)
        self._build_ui()
        self._preview()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form = QFormLayout()
        self.name_input = QLineEdit(self.original.name)
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_name"], self.name_input)
        self.words_input = QLineEdit(", ".join(self.original.words))
        self.words_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_words_tooltip"])
        self.words_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["trace.filter_words_placeholder"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_words"], self.words_input)
        self.exclude_input = QLineEdit(", ".join(self.original.exclude))
        self.exclude_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_words_tooltip"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_exclude"], self.exclude_input)
        self.numbers_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_numbers"])
        self.numbers_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_numbers_tooltip"])
        self.numbers_check.setChecked(self.original.numbers)
        form.addRow("", self.numbers_check)
        self.changes_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_changes"])
        self.changes_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_changes_tooltip"])
        self.changes_check.setChecked(self.original.changes)
        form.addRow("", self.changes_check)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self.preview_label = QLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.preview_label)
        self.preview_list = QListWidget()
        layout.addWidget(self.preview_list, 1)
        self.error_label = QLabel("")
        self.error_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('danger')};")
        self.error_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.error_label)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(self.translations, "button.save",
                                           self._accept, self.reject))

        for line in (self.words_input, self.exclude_input):
            line.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._preview())
        for check in (self.numbers_check, self.changes_check):
            check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._preview())

    def edited_filter(self):
        """The filter as the fields describe it."""
        return TraceFilter.from_text(
            self.name_input.text().strip(), self.words_input.text(), self.exclude_input.text(),
            self.numbers_check.isChecked(), self.changes_check.isChecked(),
            filter_id=self.original.filter_id, description=self.original.description)

    def _preview(self):
        self.preview_list.clear()
        if self.candidates is None:
            self.preview_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filters_loading"])
            return
        chosen = select_methods(self.candidates, [self.edited_filter()])
        self.preview_label.setText(
            self.translations["trace.filter_preview"].format(count=len(chosen)))
        for method in chosen[:_PREVIEW]:
            self.preview_list.addItem(method.signature)
        if len(chosen) > _PREVIEW:
            self.preview_list.addItem("…")

    def _accept(self):
        edited = self.edited_filter()
        if not edited.name:
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filter_error_name"])
            return
        if not (edited.words or edited.numbers or edited.changes):
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filter_error_empty"])
            return
        try:
            self._save(edited)
        except ValueError:
            self.error_label.setText(
                self.translations["trace.filter_error_duplicate"].format(name=edited.name))
            return
        self.result_filter = edited
        self.accept()
```

`grembyte/ui/widgets/write_watch.py`:

```py
"""Live results dialog for a process-memory write (or access) watch."""

from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
)

from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import PinButton
from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height


# Result table columns.
_COUNT, _PC, _SITE, _READ, _WRITE, _VALUE, _THREAD, _TIME = range(8)


class WriteWatchDialog(QDialog):
    """Display grouped write-watch hits and let the user stop monitoring.

    With ``reads`` the watch reports reads as well; the "read" and "write"
    columns tell what each instruction does with the target.
    """

    stop_requested = Signal()
    # trap PC (instruction after the write), module/offset description
    # (a Qt int has 32 bits and would cut off 64-bit addresses)
    hook_requested = Signal(object, str)
    # trap PC to monitor in the native function monitor
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, address, size, translations, parent=None, reads=False):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self._rows_by_pc = {}
        self._failed = False
        self.setWindowTitle(
            translations["watch.title_access" if reads else "watch.title"].format(
                address=address
            )
        )
        self.resize(900, 460)
        self._build_ui(address, size)

    def _build_ui(self, address, size):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        target = QLabel(
            self.translations["watch.target"].format(
                address=address,
                size=size,
            )
        )
        target.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        layout.addWidget(target)

        self.status_label = QLabel(self.translations["watch.starting"])
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.results_table = QTableWidget(0, 8)
        self.results_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                self.translations["watch.column_count"],
                self.translations["watch.column_trap_pc"],
                self.translations["watch.column_site"],
                self.translations["watch.column_read"],
                self.translations["watch.column_write"],
                self.translations["watch.column_value"],
                self.translations["watch.column_thread"],
                self.translations["watch.column_time"],
            ]
        )
        self.results_table.setSelectionBehavior(
            self.results_table.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self.results_table.setEditTriggers(
            self.results_table.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        header = self.results_table.horizontalHeader()
        if header is not None:
            for column in range(self.results_table.columnCount()):
                header.setSectionResizeMode(
                    column,
                    QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _SITE
                    else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents,
                )
            resizable_columns(self.results_table)
            copy_menu(self.results_table, self.translations)
        self.results_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.results_table)
        self.results_table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_hook_button)
        self.results_table.doubleClicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        layout.addWidget(self.results_table)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.create_hook"])
        self.hook_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["watch.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        buttons.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.monitor"])
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations["watch.monitor_tooltip"])
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        buttons.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.pin_button = PinButton(self.translations)
        buttons.addWidget(self.pin_button)
        self.stop_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.stop"])
        set_button_icon(self.stop_button, "stop")
        self.stop_button.clicked.connect(self._request_stop)
        buttons.addWidget(self.stop_button)
        close_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.close"])
        set_button_icon(close_button, "close")
        close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)
        buttons.addWidget(close_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def add_hits(self, hits):
        """Append a batch of hits, grouping repeated PCs into a single row."""
        for hit in hits:
            pc = hit["pc"]
            row = self._rows_by_pc.get(pc)
            if row is None:
                row = self.results_table.rowCount()
                self.results_table.insertRow(row)
                self._rows_by_pc[pc] = row
                for column in range(self.results_table.columnCount()):
                    self.results_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(""))
                self.results_table.item(row, _COUNT).setText("0")
                self.results_table.item(row, _PC).setText(pc)
                self.results_table.item(row, _SITE).setText(hit.get("site", pc))
                for column in (_READ, _WRITE):
                    item = self.results_table.item(row, column)
                    # A check box the user cannot change.
                    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)

            if hit.get("method"):
                # JIT code of a Mono game: the C# method says more than an address.
                site_item = self.results_table.item(row, _SITE)
                site_item.setText(hit["method"])
                site_item.setToolTip(hit.get("site", pc))
            count_item = self.results_table.item(row, _COUNT)
            count_item.setText(str(int(count_item.text()) + hit.get("count", 1)))
            # Older agents report writes only.
            for column, key, default in ((_READ, "read", False), (_WRITE, "write", True)):
                if hit.get(key, default):
                    self.results_table.item(row, column).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
            self.results_table.item(row, _VALUE).setText(hit.get("value", ""))
            self.results_table.item(row, _THREAD).setText(str(hit.get("threadId", "")))
            self.results_table.item(row, _TIME).setText(self._hit_time(hit))
        self._update_hook_button()

    @staticmethod
    def _hit_time(hit):
        """Return the local time of a hit's last write, e.g. ``14:03:27.418``."""
        milliseconds = hit.get("time")
        moment = datetime.now() if milliseconds is None \
            else datetime.fromtimestamp(milliseconds / 1000)
        return moment.strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]

    def set_monitoring(self, thread_count, details=""):
        text = self.translations["watch.running"].format(
            threads=thread_count
        )
        if details:
            text = f"{text} {details}"
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def show_warning(self, message):
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["watch.warning"].format(message=message)
        )

    def show_error(self, message):
        self._failed = True
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["watch.failed"].format(message=message)
        )

    def set_stopped(self):
        self.stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        if not self._failed:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["watch.stopped"])

    def _selected_writes(self):
        """Return whether the selected row's instruction writes the target."""
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        item = self.results_table.item(row, _WRITE) if row >= 0 else None
        return (self.results_table.selectionModel().hasSelection() and item is not None
                and item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked)

    def _update_hook_button(self):
        # Only writes can be hooked: the hook rewrites the written value.
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(self._selected_writes())
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(self.results_table.currentRow() >= 0
                                       and self.results_table.selectionModel().hasSelection())

    def _request_monitor(self):
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        pc_item = self.results_table.item(row, _PC) if row >= 0 else None
        if pc_item is not None:
            self.monitor_requested.emit(int(pc_item.text(), 16))

    def _request_hook(self):
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or not self._selected_writes():
            return
        pc_item = self.results_table.item(row, 1)
        site_item = self.results_table.item(row, 2)
        if pc_item is None:
            return
        self.hook_requested.emit(
            int(pc_item.text(), 16),
            site_item.text() if site_item is not None else pc_item.text(),
        )

    def _request_stop(self):
        self.stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["watch.stopping"])
        self.stop_requested.emit()
```

`grembyte/ui/window_buttons.py`:

```py
"""Minimize and maximize buttons for Grembyte's dialogs on Windows.

On Windows Qt gives a dialog only a close button; on Linux the window
manager decides and lets any window be maximized, by a double click on its
title too. ``add_window_buttons`` gives every dialog of Grembyte the two
buttons when it first gets the focus. Qt leaves the maximize button out for
a dialog of a fixed size. Qt's own dialogs (message boxes, file dialogs)
stay as they are.

Not an event filter on the application (see activity_recorder.py): the
focus signal is enough, and changing the flags of the native window neither
hides nor re-creates it, so a modal dialog stays open.
"""

import sys

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

_BUTTONS = Qt.WindowType.WindowMinMaxButtonsHint


def add_window_buttons(app):
    """Have ``app`` add the buttons to Grembyte's dialogs (Windows only)."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        app.focusWindowChanged.connect(_on_focus_window)


def _on_focus_window(window):
    if window is None:
        return
    dialog = next((widget for widget in QApplication.topLevelWidgets()
                   if widget.windowHandle() == window), None)
    if not isinstance(dialog, QDialog) or not type(dialog).__module__.startswith("grembyte."):
        return
    flags = dialog.windowFlags()
    if flags & _BUTTONS == _BUTTONS:
        return
    flags |= _BUTTONS
    # Tell the widget without re-creating it, then the native window.
    dialog.overrideWindowFlags(flags)
    window.setFlags(flags)

```

`grembyte/ui/window_state.py`:

```py
"""Window sizes, splitter positions and column widths, kept between runs.

An event filter of the application (``keep_window_state``) restores, when one
of Grembyte's windows is first shown, its size and the positions of its
splitters, and saves them when the window is hidden or closed. Windows that
are not modal get their position back, too; modal dialogs only their size
(Qt centres them over their parent). Column widths the user sets are kept by
the tables' column sizer (see ``resizable_columns`` in
grembyte.ui.widgets.table), under a key built from the window and the table's
place in it (``view_key``).

Everything lives in QSettings("grembyte", "grembyte") under
``windows/``, ``splitters/`` and ``columns/``.
"""

import json

from PySide6.QtCore import QByteArray, QEvent, QObject, QSettings, QSize  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QSplitter, QWidget  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

# Set on a window once its state was restored
_RESTORED = "grembyteStateRestored"


def settings():
    """The QSettings the state is kept in (tests point it elsewhere)."""
    return QSettings("grembyte", "grembyte")


def _is_grembyte(widget):
    return type(widget).__module__.startswith("grembyte.")


def _path(widget, top):
    """Where ``widget`` sits below ``top``: class names and indexes among
    siblings of the same class, e.g. ``QSplitter0/QTableWidget1``."""
    parts = []
    node = widget
    while node is not None and node is not top:
        parent = node.parent()
        siblings = [child for child in (parent.children() if parent is not None else [])
                    if type(child) is type(node)]
        index = next((i for i, child in enumerate(siblings) if child is node), 0)
        parts.append(f"{type(node).__name__}{index}")
        node = parent
    return "/".join(reversed(parts))


def _owner(widget):
    """The dialog ``widget`` lies in, docked in the main window or not; else its window."""
    node = widget.parentWidget()
    while node is not None:
        if isinstance(node, QDialog):
            return node
        node = node.parentWidget()
    return widget.window()


def view_key(view):
    """The key a table's column widths are kept under (the same docked or not)."""
    window = _owner(view)
    return f"{type(window).__name__}/{_path(view, window)}"


def load_columns(key, count):
    """{column: width} kept for a table with ``count`` columns, else {}."""
    try:
        data = json.loads(settings().value(f"columns/{key}", "") or "{}")
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {}
    if data.get("count") != count:
        return {}
    return {int(column): int(width) for column, width in data.get("widths", {}).items()}


def save_columns(key, count, widths):
    """Keep the widths ({column: width}) the user gave a table's columns."""
    settings().setValue(f"columns/{key}", json.dumps(
        {"count": count, "widths": {str(column): width for column, width in widths.items()}}))


def restore_window(window):
    store = settings()
    key = type(window).__name__
    if isinstance(window, QDialog) and window.isModal():
        size = store.value(f"windows/{key}/size")
        if isinstance(size, QSize) and size.isValid():
            window.resize(size)
    else:
        geometry = store.value(f"windows/{key}/geometry")
        if isinstance(geometry, QByteArray) and not geometry.isEmpty():
            window.restoreGeometry(geometry)
    for splitter in window.findChildren(QSplitter):
        state = store.value(f"splitters/{key}/{_path(splitter, window)}")
        if isinstance(state, QByteArray) and not state.isEmpty():
            splitter.restoreState(state)


def save_window(window):
    store = settings()
    key = type(window).__name__
    store.setValue(f"windows/{key}/geometry", window.saveGeometry())
    if not window.isMaximized() and not window.isFullScreen():
        store.setValue(f"windows/{key}/size", window.size())
    for splitter in window.findChildren(QSplitter):
        store.setValue(f"splitters/{key}/{_path(splitter, window)}", splitter.saveState())


class _WindowStateKeeper(QObject):
    """Restores Grembyte's windows when first shown, saves them when hidden."""

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        kind = event.type()
        if kind not in (QEvent.Type.Show, QEvent.Type.Hide):
            return False
        if not isinstance(watched, QWidget) or not watched.isWindow() or not _is_grembyte(watched):
            return False
        if kind == QEvent.Type.Show:
            if not watched.property(_RESTORED):
                watched.setProperty(_RESTORED, True)
                restore_window(watched)
        elif watched.property(_RESTORED):
            save_window(watched)
        return False


def keep_window_state(app):
    """Have ``app`` keep the sizes of Grembyte's windows; returns the filter."""
    keeper = _WindowStateKeeper(app)
    app.installEventFilter(keeper)
    return keeper

```

`grembyte/ui/workers.py`:

```py
"""Keep QThreads referenced until their thread has really ended.

A QThread destroyed while its thread still runs aborts the application. Its
``finished`` signal is emitted from the thread just before the thread ends, so
a slot of ``finished`` that drops the last reference may destroy it too early.
Workers of windows that close are kept here until then.
"""

import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtCore import QThread, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.attach.wine_gadget import ensure_gadget

_workers = set()


class GadgetDownloadWorker(QThread):
    """Download a Wine gadget without blocking the GUI thread."""

    progress = Signal(int, int)
    completed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, bits, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.bits = bits
        self.path = None
        self.error = None

    def run(self):
        try:
            self.path = ensure_gadget(self.bits, progress=self.progress.emit)
        except Exception as error:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
            self.error = str(error)
        self.completed.emit()


def keep_until_finished(worker):
    """Keep ``worker`` referenced until its thread has ended, also after its window closed."""
    _workers.add(worker)
    worker.finished.connect(lambda: _release(worker))


def _release(worker):
    if QThread.currentThread() is not worker:
        worker.wait()  # past run(): only the end of the thread is left
    _workers.discard(worker)


def running_workers():
    """The workers kept right now."""
    # One deleted by Qt (e.g. never started, with its parent gone) runs no
    # more; nor does one never started or whose thread ended before its
    # ``finished`` slot ran (no event loop ran since).
    _workers.difference_update([worker for worker in _workers
                                if not getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(worker)
                                or not worker.isRunning()])
    return set(_workers)


def stop_workers(timeout_ms):
    """Ask every kept worker to stop and wait for each; True if all have ended."""
    workers = list(running_workers())
    for worker in workers:
        worker.requestInterruption()
    # A list, not a generator: wait for each, also after one timed out.
    return all([worker.wait(timeout_ms) for worker in workers])  # pylint: disable=use-a-generator

```

`scripts/grembyte.cmd`:

```cmd
@echo off
rem Start Grembyte from the project's virtual environment, e.g. from a
rem shortcut. Works from any working directory. Uses pythonw.exe, so no
rem console window stays open.
setlocal

for %%I in ("%~dp0..") do set "PROJECT_DIR=%%~fI"
if defined GREMBYTE_VENV (set "VENV_DIR=%GREMBYTE_VENV%") else (set "VENV_DIR=%PROJECT_DIR%\.venv")

if not exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" (
    echo No virtual environment at %VENV_DIR% ^(see docs\getting-started\installation.md^). 1>&2
    exit /b 1
)

cd /d "%PROJECT_DIR%"
start "" "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" -m grembyte %*

```

`scripts/grembyte.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start Grembyte from the project's virtual environment, e.g. from the
# desktop menu. Works from any working directory.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")/.." && pwd)"
VENV_DIR="${GREMBYTE_VENV:-$PROJECT_DIR/.venv}"

if [[ ! -f "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate" ]]; then
    echo "No virtual environment at $VENV_DIR (see docs/getting-started/installation.md)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
exec python -m grembyte "$@"

```

`scripts/install-desktop-entry.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install a desktop menu entry (KDE, GNOME, ...) for the current user that
# starts Grembyte through scripts/grembyte.sh.
# Remove it again with: install-desktop-entry.sh --uninstall
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")/.." && pwd)"
APPS_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/applications"
# The file name has to match DESKTOP_FILE_NAME in grembyte/main.py, so that
# Wayland shows the icon of this entry.
DESKTOP_FILE="$APPS_DIR/grembyte.desktop"
# The entry of Hermes Hook, as the project was called up to 0.6
OLD_DESKTOP_FILE="$APPS_DIR/hermes-hook.desktop"

refresh_menu() {
    command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null && update-desktop-database "$APPS_DIR" || true
    command -v kbuildsycoca6 >/dev/null && kbuildsycoca6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--uninstall" ]]; then
    rm -f "$DESKTOP_FILE" "$OLD_DESKTOP_FILE"
    refresh_menu
    echo "Removed $DESKTOP_FILE"
    exit 0
fi

rm -f "$OLD_DESKTOP_FILE"
chmod +x "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/grembyte.sh"
mkdir -p "$APPS_DIR"
cat > "$DESKTOP_FILE" <<ENTRY
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Grembyte
GenericName=Memory Scanner and Hook Engine
Comment=Linux memory scanner, hook engine and reverse engineering tool
Comment[de]=Speicherscanner, Hook-Engine und Reverse-Engineering-Werkzeug für Linux
Exec="$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/grembyte.sh"
Path=$PROJECT_DIR
Icon=$PROJECT_DIR/grembyte/ui/resources/favicon.svg
Terminal=false
Categories=Development;Debugger;Game;
Keywords=memory;scanner;hook;trainer;cheat;
StartupWMClass=grembyte
ENTRY

command -v desktop-file-validate >/dev/null && desktop-file-validate "$DESKTOP_FILE" || true
refresh_menu
echo "Installed $DESKTOP_FILE"

```

`scripts/install-windows-shortcut.ps1`:

```ps1
# Install a Start menu shortcut for the current user that starts Grembyte
# from the project's virtual environment. Pin it to the taskbar from the Start
# menu (right click, "Pin to taskbar"); Windows does not allow scripts to pin.
# Remove it again with: install-windows-shortcut.ps1 -Uninstall
#
# Run with: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-windows-shortcut.ps1
param([switch]$Uninstall)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$ProjectDir = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$VenvDir = if ($env:GREMBYTE_VENV) { $env:GREMBYTE_VENV } else { Join-Path $ProjectDir ".venv" }
$ShortcutFile = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("Programs")) "Grembyte.lnk"
$IconFile = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "grembyte\grembyte.ico"
# Has to match WINDOWS_APP_ID in grembyte/main.py, so that the pinned shortcut
# and the running window share one taskbar button.
$AppId = "grembyte.win"
# The shortcut of Hermes Hook, as the project was called up to 0.6
$OldShortcutFile = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("Programs")) "Hermes Hook.lnk"

if ($Uninstall) {
    Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $ShortcutFile, $IconFile, $OldShortcutFile
    Write-Output "Removed $ShortcutFile"
    exit 0
}

Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $OldShortcutFile

$Pythonw = Join-Path $VenvDir "Scripts\pythonw.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path $Pythonw)) {
    Write-Error "No virtual environment at $VenvDir (see docs\getting-started\installation.md)."
}

# Shortcuts cannot use the SVG icon, so render it to an .ico with Qt.
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $IconFile) | Out-Null
$env:QT_QPA_PLATFORM = "offscreen"
& (Join-Path $VenvDir "Scripts\python.exe") -c @"
import sys
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication, QIcon
app = QGuiApplication(sys.argv)
image = QIcon(sys.argv[1]).pixmap(256, 256).toImage()
sys.exit(0 if image.save(sys.argv[2], 'ICO') else 1)
"@ (Join-Path $ProjectDir "grembyte\ui\resources\favicon.svg") $IconFile
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Warning "Cannot create $IconFile, the shortcut uses the Python icon."
    $IconFile = $Pythonw
}

# The shortcut starts pythonw.exe directly instead of grembyte.cmd, so no
# console window flashes up.
$Shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$Shortcut = $Shell.CreateShortcut($ShortcutFile)
$Shortcut.TargetPath = $Pythonw
$Shortcut.Arguments = "-m grembyte"
$Shortcut.WorkingDirectory = $ProjectDir
$Shortcut.IconLocation = "$IconFile,0"
$Shortcut.Description = "Memory scanner, hook engine and reverse engineering tool"
$Shortcut.Save()

# WScript.Shell cannot set the app ID of a shortcut, so write the property
# through IPropertyStore.
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

public static class ShortcutAppId
{
    [ComImport, Guid("00021401-0000-0000-C000-000000000046")]
    class ShellLink { }

    [ComImport, Guid("0000010b-0000-0000-C000-000000000046"),
     InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
    interface IPersistFile
    {
        void GetClassID(out Guid classId);
        [PreserveSig] int IsDirty();
        void Load([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName, uint mode);
        void Save([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName, bool remember);
        void SaveCompleted([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName);
        void GetCurFile([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] out string fileName);
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 4)]
    struct PropertyKey
    {
        public Guid FormatId;
        public uint PropertyId;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
    struct PropVariant
    {
        [FieldOffset(0)] public ushort VarType;
        [FieldOffset(8)] public IntPtr Value;
    }

    [ComImport, Guid("886D8EEB-8CF2-4446-8D02-CDBA1DBDCF99"),
     InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
    interface IPropertyStore
    {
        void GetCount(out uint count);
        void GetAt(uint index, out PropertyKey key);
        void GetValue(ref PropertyKey key, out PropVariant value);
        void SetValue(ref PropertyKey key, ref PropVariant value);
        void Commit();
    }

    public static void Set(string shortcutFile, string appId)
    {
        object link = new ShellLink();
        try
        {
            ((IPersistFile)link).Load(shortcutFile, 2);  // STGM_READWRITE
            // PKEY_AppUserModel_ID
            PropertyKey key = new PropertyKey
            {
                FormatId = new Guid("9F4C2855-9F79-4B39-A8D0-E1D42DE1D5F3"),
                PropertyId = 5,
            };
            PropVariant value = new PropVariant
            {
                VarType = 31,  // VT_LPWSTR
                Value = Marshal.StringToCoTaskMemUni(appId),
            };
            try
            {
                IPropertyStore store = (IPropertyStore)link;
                store.SetValue(ref key, ref value);
                store.Commit();
            }
            finally
            {
                Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(value.Value);
            }
            ((IPersistFile)link).Save(shortcutFile, true);
        }
        finally
        {
            Marshal.ReleaseComObject(link);
        }
    }
}
"@
[ShortcutAppId]::Set($ShortcutFile, $AppId)

Write-Output "Installed $ShortcutFile"
Write-Output "Pin it from the Start menu: right click 'Grembyte', 'Pin to taskbar'."
```

`scripts/make_logo.py`:

```py
"""Generate the Grembyte logo SVGs: icon, 16 px icon, wordmarks (dark and light).

Run from anywhere: ``python scripts/make_logo.py [SourceCodePro-Bold.otf]``.
The wordmark text is converted to paths, so the SVGs need no installed font.
Writes grembyte/ui/resources/favicon.svg (app icon), docs/assets/logo.svg
(docs header), docs/assets/favicon.svg (browser tab) and the wordmarks in
docs/assets/.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtGui import QFont, QFontDatabase, QGuiApplication, QPainterPath

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
FONT_FILE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/usr/share/fonts/adobe-source-code-pro-fonts/SourceCodePro-Bold.otf"

LIME = "#8cfa5a"        # brand green on dark backgrounds; icons.py replaces it in
                        # the toolbar logo with the theme's "brand" colour
GREEN_LIGHT = "#2b8a00"  # brand green on light backgrounds
INK_DARK = "#e6edf3"     # "grem" on dark
INK_LIGHT = "#1f2328"    # "grem" on light

# 0110 0111 = 0x67 = ASCII "g"
BITS = ("0110", "0111")
# Squares of 10 with gaps of 3: the grid is 49 x 23.
SIZE, GAP, STROKE = 10, 3, 2.5
GRID_W, GRID_H = 4 * SIZE + 3 * GAP, 2 * SIZE + GAP

COMMENT = ("<!-- Grembyte icon: the bits 0110 0111 (0x67, ASCII \"g\") as two rows of "
           "four squares; filled = 1, outlined = 0 -->")


def grid(green, transform=""):
    parts = []
    for row, bits in enumerate(BITS):
        for col, bit in enumerate(bits):
            x = col * (SIZE + GAP)
            y = row * (SIZE + GAP)
            if bit == "1":
                parts.append(f'<rect x="{x:g}" y="{y:g}" width="{SIZE:g}" height="{SIZE:g}"/>')
            else:
                inset = STROKE / 2
                parts.append(
                    f'<rect x="{x + inset:g}" y="{y + inset:g}" width="{SIZE - STROKE:g}" '
                    f'height="{SIZE - STROKE:g}" fill="none" stroke="{green}" '
                    f'stroke-width="{STROKE:g}"/>')
    inner = "\n      ".join(parts)
    attributes = f' transform="{transform}"' if transform else ""
    return f'<g fill="{green}"{attributes}>\n      {inner}\n    </g>'


def icon():
    """Square, for the app and window icon: the grid fills the width."""
    pad = 1
    top = (GRID_W - GRID_H) / 2
    box = f"{-pad} {-top - pad:g} {GRID_W + 2 * pad} {GRID_W + 2 * pad}"
    return (f'{COMMENT}\n<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="{box}">\n'
            f'    {grid(LIME)}\n</svg>\n')


def icon_wide():
    """Just the grid, for the docs header (its height is fixed, so it is as large as can be)."""
    box = f"-1 -1 {GRID_W + 2} {GRID_H + 2}"
    return (f'{COMMENT}\n<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="{box}">\n'
            f'    {grid(LIME)}\n</svg>\n')


def icon16():
    """Pixel grid for 16 px (and 32 px): squares of 3 with gaps of 1, outlines of 1."""
    parts = []
    for row, bits in enumerate(BITS):
        for col, bit in enumerate(bits):
            x, y = col * 4, 4 + row * 4
            if bit == "1":
                parts.append(f'<rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="3" height="3"/>')
            else:
                parts.append(f'<path d="M{x} {y}h3v3h-3zM{x + 1} {y + 1}v1h1v-1z" '
                             'fill-rule="evenodd"/>')
    body = "\n      ".join(parts)
    return (f'{COMMENT.replace("icon:", "icon for 16 px (and 32 px):")}\n'
            f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16" shape-rendering="crispEdges">\n'
            f'    <g fill="{LIME}">\n      {body}\n    </g>\n</svg>\n')


def text_path(text, font, x, baseline):
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addText(x, baseline, font, text)
    d = []
    i = 0
    n = path.elementCount()
    while i < n:
        e = path.elementAt(i)
        if e.isMoveTo():
            d.append(f"M{e.x:.2f} {e.y:.2f}")
            i += 1
        elif e.isLineTo():
            d.append(f"L{e.x:.2f} {e.y:.2f}")
            i += 1
        else:  # curveTo + two CurveToData elements
            c1, c2 = path.elementAt(i + 1), path.elementAt(i + 2)
            d.append(f"C{e.x:.2f} {e.y:.2f} {c1.x:.2f} {c1.y:.2f} {c2.x:.2f} {c2.y:.2f}")
            i += 3
    return "".join(d) + "Z", path.boundingRect()


def wordmark(font, ink, green, variant):
    scale = 1.25
    baseline = 47
    grid_w = GRID_W * scale
    grem, rect_grem = text_path("grem", font, grid_w + 14, baseline)
    byte, rect_byte = text_path("byte", font, rect_grem.right() + 2, baseline)
    width = rect_byte.right() + 2
    # The grid stands on the baseline.
    transform = f"translate(1 {baseline - GRID_H * scale:g}) scale({scale:g})"
    return (f'<!-- Grembyte wordmark ({variant} backgrounds): icon and "grembyte" in '
            f'Source Code Pro Bold (SIL OFL 1.1), as paths -->\n'
            f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {width:.0f} 64">\n'
            f'    {grid(green, transform)}\n'
            f'    <path fill="{ink}" d="{grem}"/>\n'
            f'    <path fill="{green}" d="{byte}"/>\n</svg>\n')


def main():
    app = QGuiApplication([])  # noqa: F841 - fonts need an application
    family = QFontDatabase.applicationFontFamilies(QFontDatabase.addApplicationFont(FONT_FILE))[0]
    font = QFont(family)
    font.setPixelSize(52)
    font.setWeight(QFont.Weight.Bold)
    assets = ROOT / "docs" / "assets"
    (ROOT / "grembyte" / "ui" / "resources" / "favicon.svg").write_text(icon())
    (assets / "logo.svg").write_text(icon_wide())
    (assets / "favicon.svg").write_text(icon16())
    (assets / "wordmark-dark.svg").write_text(wordmark(font, INK_DARK, LIME, "dark"))
    (assets / "wordmark-light.svg").write_text(wordmark(font, INK_LIGHT, GREEN_LIGHT, "light"))


main()

```

`scripts/screenshots/run.py`:

```py
"""Render the screenshots of the documentation (docs/assets/screenshots).

    python scripts/screenshots/run.py                 # every scene, dark and light
    python scripts/screenshots/run.py main-window     # only scenes whose name starts so
    python scripts/screenshots/run.py --theme dark --list

Each theme renders in a process of its own, offscreen, against a grembyte whose
settings, database, logs and caches live in a temporary folder. The images
are named ``<scene>-<dark|light>.webp`` (lossless); the pages show the one matching the
reader's color scheme. The scenes are in the scenes_*.py modules beside
this file.
"""

import argparse
import importlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUTPUT = ROOT / "docs" / "assets" / "screenshots"
THEMES = {"dark": "Github-Dark", "light": "Github-Light"}
# Logical pixels are doubled so the images stay sharp when the page scales them.
SCALE = "2"


def _isolate(home):
    """Point every directory grembyte writes to into ``home``; before importing grembyte."""
    for variable, folder in (("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "config"), ("XDG_DATA_HOME", "data"),
                             ("XDG_STATE_HOME", "state"), ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", "cache")):
        path = Path(home) / folder
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.environ[variable] = str(path)
    os.environ["GREMBYTE_DB"] = str(Path(home) / "grembyte.db")
    os.environ["GREMBYTE_CACHE_DIR"] = str(Path(home) / "catalog-cache")
    os.environ["GREMBYTE_LOG_DIR"] = str(Path(home) / "logs")
    os.environ["GREMBYTE_LANGUAGE"] = "en"
    # Numbers as English readers write them (1,000 rather than 1.000)
    os.environ["LANG"] = os.environ["LC_ALL"] = "en_US.UTF-8"
    os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
    os.environ["QT_SCALE_FACTOR"] = SCALE


def _load_scenes():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    for module in sorted(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.glob("scenes_*.py")):
        importlib.import_module(module.stem)


def _render(theme, prefixes, list_only):
    """Render the scenes in this process, with ``theme`` (dark or light)."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="grembyte-screenshots-") as home:
        _isolate(home)
        _load_scenes()
        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        from PySide6.QtGui import QImageWriter  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

        import studio

        chosen = [scene for name, scene in studio.SCENES.items()
                  if not prefixes or name.startswith(tuple(prefixes))]
        if list_only:
            for scene in chosen:
                print(f"{scene.name:32} {scene.description}")
            return 0
        from grembyte.core import settings
        from grembyte.db.engine import init_db
        from grembyte.db.repository.settings import SettingsRepository
        from grembyte.ui.window_buttons import add_window_buttons

        init_db()
        settings.load(SettingsRepository().load())
        application = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv[:1])
        add_window_buttons(application)
        application.setStyle("Fusion")
        OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        failed = 0
        for scene in chosen:
            # Each scene gets a main window of its own: what one scene fills
            # in or folds away must not show up in the next.
            stage = studio.Studio(THEMES[theme])
            try:
                widget = scene.build(stage)
                if scene.size:
                    widget.resize(*scene.size)
                widget.show()
                studio.settle(300)
                path = OUTPUT / f"{scene.name}-{theme}.webp"
                writer = QImageWriter(str(path))
                writer.setQuality(100)  # lossless WebP: about half the size of PNG
                if not writer.write(widget.grab().toImage()):
                    raise OSError(f"cannot write {path}: {writer.errorString()}")
                print(f"{theme:5} {scene.name}")
            except Exception:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
                failed += 1
                print(f"{theme:5} {scene.name} FAILED", file=sys.stderr)
                traceback.print_exc()
            finally:
                stage.close()
        return 1 if failed else 0


def main():
    """Render the chosen scenes for the chosen themes."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n", 1)[0])
    parser.add_argument("scenes", nargs="*", help="name prefixes of the scenes to render")
    parser.add_argument("--theme", choices=("dark", "light", "both"), default="both")
    parser.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="list the scenes and exit")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.theme != "both":
        return _render(args.theme, args.scenes, args.list)
    status = 0
    for theme in ("dark", "light") if not args.list else ("dark",):
        status |= subprocess.call([sys.executable, __file__, "--theme", theme, *args.scenes]
                                  + (["--list"] if args.list else []))
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

```py
The windows here start workers that attach to the game when they open. The

@contextmanager
def _idle_workers(*places):
    """Swap ``(module, name)`` worker classes for ones whose thread never starts.

    Only while the window is built: its worker is made then, and the
    classes are back for whatever renders next.
    """
    saved = [(module, name, getattr(module, name)) for module, name in places]
    for module, name, worker_class in saved:
        setattr(module, name, type(f"Idle{worker_class.__name__}", (worker_class,),
                                   {"start": lambda self, *_args: None}))
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        for module, name, worker_class in saved:
            setattr(module, name, worker_class)


def _method(class_name, name, parameters="()", returns="System.Void", static=False,
            assembly="Assembly-CSharp", names=()):
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    token = 0x06000000 + next(_TOKENS)
    return CatalogMethod(assembly, class_name, name, parameters, returns, static, token,
                         f"{class_name}:{name} {parameters}", "mono", tuple(names))

def _game_methods():
    """Every method of Assembly-CSharp the catalog lists."""
    pick = random.Random(7)
    methods = list(_STORE) + list(_PLAYER_INVENTORY)
    for class_name in _CLASSES:
        for name, parameters, returns in pick.sample(_MEMBERS, pick.randint(9, 16)):
            methods.append(_method(class_name, name, parameters, returns))
    return methods

def _poe_process():
    """The database id of the game, with its favorites (made once per run)."""
    process_id = HookRepository().get_or_create_process(_POE_NAME, _POE_PATH)
    repository = FavoriteRepository()
    if repository.list_favorites(process_id):
        return process_id
    for method, source, note in (
            (_BY_NAME["PlayerInventory:AddCurrency"], TRACE,
             "Every gold change: shop, loot, quest rewards"),
            (_BY_NAME["UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction"], CATALOG,
             "Runs once per purchase"),
            (_BY_NAME["Health:DoDamage"], CATALOG, "Returns the damage dealt; this = victim"),
            (_BY_NAME["DamagePacket:RollDamage"], TRACE, "Damage before DR, hookable"),
            (_BY_NAME["PlayerInventory:get_Instance"], CATALOG, ""),
    ):
        favorite_id = repository.add_favorite(process_id, favorite_from_method(method, source))
        if note:
            repository.set_note(favorite_id, note)
    native = NativeFunction(0xDC3A10, _POE_NAME, 0x9C3A10)
    favorite_id = repository.add_favorite(process_id,
                                          favorite_from_function(native, NATIVE_TRACE))
    repository.set_note(favorite_id, "Writes the gold float (movss)")
    return process_id


def _favorites(studio):
    """The main window's favorites, showing the game's."""
    store = studio.window._favorite_store
    store.set_process(_poe_process())
    return store

        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        self.info = {"pid": pid, "name": name, "exe": exe, "cmdline": cmdline, "cwd": cwd}

@scene("process-list", size=(980, 600),
       description="Choosing the game to attach to, Proton games by their Windows program")
def process_list(studio):
    """The process dialog with a few Proton games, the test game and the desktop."""
    original = process_list_widget.psutil.process_iter
    process_list_widget.psutil.process_iter = lambda _attributes: iter(_PROCESSES)
    try:
        dialog = studio.keep(process_list_widget.ProcessSelectDialog(
            studio.window, studio.translations))
    finally:
        process_list_widget.psutil.process_iter = original
    header = dialog.list.horizontalHeader()
    header.resizeSection(0, 80)
    header.resizeSection(1, 220)
    row = next(row for row in range(dialog.list.rowCount())
               if dialog.list.item(row, 1).text() == _POE_NAME)
    dialog.list.selectRow(row)
    return dialog

@scene("catalog", size=(1180, 720),
       description="The C# methods of a Unity Mono game, searched for a class")
def catalog(studio):
    """The catalog of Pillars of Eternity, narrowed to PlayerInventory."""
    studio.show_attached(_POE_NAME, _POE_PID, _POE_DETAILS)
    favorites = _favorites(studio)
    with _idle_workers((catalog_widget, "CatalogWorker")):
        dialog = studio.keep(catalog_widget.CatalogDialog(
            studio.translations, _POE_PID, parent=studio.window, engine=MONO,
            favorites=favorites))
    found = _assemblies()
    dialog._on_assemblies_found(found)
    methods = _game_methods()
    dialog._on_assembly_loaded("Assembly-CSharp", methods)
    firstpass = [_method(class_name, name, parameters, returns,
                         assembly="Assembly-CSharp-firstpass")
                 for class_name in ("UIPanel", "UILabel", "UISprite", "UIButton", "UIGrid",
                                    "UITweener", "UICamera", "UIRoot", "UIWidget", "UITable")
                 for name, parameters, returns in _MEMBERS[:12]]
    dialog._on_assembly_loaded("Assembly-CSharp-firstpass", firstpass)
    dialog._on_assembly_loaded("Assembly-UnityScript-firstpass", [])
    dialog._on_assembly_loaded("ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib", [])
    dialog._on_assembly_loaded("Polenter.SharpSerializer", [])
    for assembly in ("Assembly-CSharp", "Assembly-CSharp-firstpass"):
        dialog._cached.add(assembly)
    dialog._on_worker_finished(dialog._worker)
    dialog.search_input.setText("PlayerInventory")
    dialog._filter_timer.stop()
    dialog._apply_filter()
    header = dialog.view.horizontalHeader()
    header.resizeSection(catalog_widget._RETURN, 230)
    header.resizeSection(catalog_widget._ASSEMBLY, 150)
    row = next(row for row, method in enumerate(dialog.model.visible)
               if method.name == "AddCurrency")
    dialog.view.selectRow(row)
    dialog.view.setFocus()
    return dialog

# A purchase in a shop: (time in microseconds, method, caller) in the order called;
# methods the baseline called too are only counted.
_PURCHASE = (
    (1_204_118, "PlayerInventory:CanAfford", "UIStoreStorePage:OnConfirmClicked+0x4e"),
    (1_204_160, "StoreInventory:RemoveItem", "UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction+0x2b8"),
    (1_204_391, "Inventory:AddItem", "UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction+0x31a"),
    (1_204_655, "PlayerInventory:RemoveCurrency", "UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction+0x5f0"),
    (1_204_662, "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency", "PlayerInventory:RemoveCurrency+0x3a"),
    (1_204_671, "PlayerInventory:set_currencyTotalValue", "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency+0x41"),
    (1_204_690, "UIInventoryGoldCounter:OnCurrencyChanged",
     "PlayerInventory:set_currencyTotalValue+0x57"),
)
# Calls in the scenario (4 s) and in the baseline (10 s)
_SCENARIO_COUNTS = {
    "UIInventoryGoldCounter:Update": 240,
    "PlayerInventory:CanAfford": 1, "PlayerInventory:get_currencyTotalValue": 44,
    "StoreInventory:RemoveItem": 1, "Inventory:AddItem": 1, "Inventory:get_ItemList": 82,
    "PlayerInventory:RemoveCurrency": 1, "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency": 1,
    "PlayerInventory:set_currencyTotalValue": 1, "UIInventoryGoldCounter:OnCurrencyChanged": 1,
    "StoreInventory:GetBuyPrice": 12,
}
_BASELINE_COUNTS = {
    "UIInventoryGoldCounter:Update": 600,
    "PlayerInventory:get_currencyTotalValue": 20, "Inventory:get_ItemList": 50,
    "StoreInventory:GetBuyPrice": 31,
}


@scene("trace", size=(1200, 1000),
       description="Mono trace: the methods a purchase called, compared with a baseline")
def trace(studio):
    """A trace of Pillars of Eternity after a baseline and the scenario "pay gold"."""
    studio.show_attached(_POE_NAME, _POE_PID, _POE_DETAILS)
    favorites = _favorites(studio)
    with _idle_workers((trace_widget, "TraceWorker")):
        dialog = studio.keep(trace_widget.TraceDialog(
            studio.translations, _POE_PID, parent=studio.window, engine=MONO,
            favorites=favorites))
    candidates = _game_methods()
    dialog._on_candidates(candidates, {})
    panel = dialog.filter_panel
    for row in range(panel.list.count()):
        item = panel.list.item(row)
        if item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole).builtin in ("money", "inventory"):
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    chosen = panel.selection([])
    index = {f"{m.class_name}:{m.name}": i for i, m in enumerate(chosen)}
    for name in list(_SCENARIO_COUNTS) + [name for _time, name, _caller in _PURCHASE]:
        if name not in index:
            raise LookupError(f"the money and inventory filters do not choose {name}")
    dialog._on_started(chosen, {"skipped": {"abstract": 3, "generic": 2}})
    dialog._on_recorded({"phase": "baseline", "duration": 10_000, "events": [],
                         "counts": {str(index[name]): calls
                                    for name, calls in _BASELINE_COUNTS.items()}})
    dialog._on_recorded({
        "phase": "scenario", "duration": 4_000,
        "counts": {str(index[name]): calls for name, calls in _SCENARIO_COUNTS.items()},
        "events": [[index[name], _MAIN_THREAD, time, caller]
                   for time, name, caller in _PURCHASE],
    })
    header = dialog.rows_view.horizontalHeader()
    header.resizeSection(trace_widget._R_BASELINE, 150)
    sequence = dialog.sequence_view.horizontalHeader()
    sequence.resizeSection(trace_widget._S_METHOD, 360)
    row = next(row for row, item in enumerate(dialog.row_model.items)
               if chosen[item.method].name == "AddCurrency")
    dialog.rows_view.selectRow(row)
    dialog.rows_view.scrollToTop()
    dialog.rows_view.setFocus()
    dialog.findChild(QSplitter).setSizes([520, 300])
    return dialog


# --- Method monitor -----------------------------------------------------------------------

def _object(type_name, name, address):
    text = f'{type_name} "{name}"@{address}' if name else f"{type_name}@{address}"
    return {"text": text, "target": {"address": address}}


_EDER = "Companion_Eder(Clone)_0"
_PLAYER = "Player_New_Game(Clone)_0"


def _monitor_calls(ids):
    """The calls of a fight after a purchase: (monitor, seconds, this, args, result, caller)."""
    inventory = _object("PlayerInventory", _PLAYER, "0x2a41c7f3e40")
    store = _object("UIStoreStorePage", "StorePage", "0x2a41d0218a0")
    xaurip = _object("UnityEngine.GameObject", "CRE_Xaurip_Skirmisher(Clone)_3", "0x2a42a1c5b80")
    eder = _object("Health", _EDER, "0x2a41c80a1e0")
    enemy = _object("Health", "CRE_Xaurip_Skirmisher(Clone)_3", "0x2a42a1c7f00")
    calls = [
        (ids["store"], 0.000, store, [], None, "UIStoreStorePage:OnConfirmClicked+0x4e"),
        (ids["gold"], 0.012, inventory, [("amount", "-250")], None,
         "PlayerInventory:RemoveCurrency+0x3a"),
        (ids["damage"], 41.207, eder, [
            ("damage", _object("DamageInfo", None, "0x2a43b0e1d20")), ("attacker", xaurip)],
         "12.5", "AttackMelee:OnImpact+0x1c4"),
        (ids["damage"], 41.982, enemy, [
            ("damage", _object("DamageInfo", None, "0x2a43b0e2a80")),
            ("attacker", _object("UnityEngine.GameObject", _EDER, "0x2a41c809f00"))],
         "18.75", "AttackMelee:OnImpact+0x1c4"),
        (ids["damage"], 43.316, eder, [
            ("damage", _object("DamageInfo", None, "0x2a43b0e3c40")), ("attacker", xaurip)],
         "9.0", "AttackMelee:OnImpact+0x1c4"),
        (ids["damage"], 44.105, enemy, [
            ("damage", _object("DamageInfo", None, "0x2a43b0e4e00")),
            ("attacker", _object("UnityEngine.GameObject", _PLAYER, "0x2a41c7f1a00"))],
         "23.25", "AttackRanged:OnImpact+0x2a8"),
        (ids["damage"], 45.660, enemy, [
            ("damage", _object("DamageInfo", None, "0x2a43b0e5fc0")),
            ("attacker", _object("UnityEngine.GameObject", _EDER, "0x2a41c809f00"))],
         "0.0", "AttackMelee:OnImpact+0x1c4"),
        (ids["gold"], 47.918, inventory, [("amount", "75")], None, "Loot:TakeAll+0x9d"),
        (ids["gold"], 47.921, inventory, [("amount", "12")], None, "Loot:TakeAll+0x9d"),
    ]
    result = []
    for monitor_id, seconds, this, args, value, caller in calls:
        call = {"monitorId": monitor_id, "time": _EVENING + seconds * 1000,
                "threadId": _MAIN_THREAD, "self": this, "caller": caller,
                "args": [dict(arg, name=name) if isinstance(arg, dict)
                         else {"name": name, "text": arg} for name, arg in args]}
        if value is not None:
            call["result"] = {"text": value}
        result.append(call)
    return result


@scene("method-monitor", size=(1480, 860),
       description="Method monitor: the calls of C# methods with this, arguments and result")
def method_monitor(studio):
    """Three monitored methods of Pillars of Eternity after a purchase and a fight."""
    studio.show_attached(_POE_NAME, _POE_PID, _POE_DETAILS)
    with _idle_workers((method_monitor_widget, "MethodMonitorWorker")):
        dialog = studio.keep(method_monitor_widget.MethodMonitorDialog(
            studio.translations, _POE_PID, parent=studio.window))
    ids = {}
    for key, name, info in (
            ("gold", "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency", {
                "address": "0x2a43f6b1a40", "params": ["System.Int32 amount"],
                "returns": "System.Void", "recordsResults": False, "hasResults": False,
                "recordsObjects": False, "hasObjects": True}),
            ("store", "UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction", {
                "address": "0x2a43f7c0e10", "params": [], "returns": "System.Void",
                "recordsResults": False, "hasResults": False, "recordsObjects": False,
                "hasObjects": True}),
            ("damage", "Health:DoDamage", {
                "address": "0x2a43f80d5c0",
                "params": ["DamageInfo damage", "UnityEngine.GameObject attacker"],
                "returns": "System.Single", "recordsResults": True, "hasResults": True,
                "recordsObjects": False, "hasObjects": True})):
        before = set(dialog._monitors)
        dialog.add_method(_BY_NAME[name])
        (ids[key],) = set(dialog._monitors) - before
        dialog._on_added(ids[key], info)
    calls = _monitor_calls(ids)
    counts = {}
    for call in calls:
        counts[call["monitorId"]] = counts.get(call["monitorId"], 0) + 1
    dialog._on_calls(calls, {}, counts)
    header = dialog.log_view.horizontalHeader()
    for column, width in ((method_monitor_widget._C_METHOD, 270),
                          (method_monitor_widget._C_SELF, 330),
                          (method_monitor_widget._C_RESULT, 80),
                          (method_monitor_widget._C_CALLER, 300)):
        header.resizeSection(column, width)
    dialog.methods_table.selectRow(2)
    dialog.findChild(QSplitter).setSizes([200, 600])
    row = next(row for row, call in enumerate(dialog.log.calls)
               if call["monitorId"] == ids["damage"] and call["result"]["text"] == "23.25")
    dialog.log_view.selectRow(row)
    dialog.log_view.setFocus()
    return dialog


# --- Object inspector -----------------------------------------------------------------------

def _field(name, type_name, offset, text, value_type=None, address=None, target=None,
           static=False, storage=None):
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    value = {"text": text}
    if target is not None:
        value["target"] = {"address": target}
    return {"name": name, "type": type_name, "offset": offset, "static": static,
            "storage": storage, "value": value, "address": address, "valueType": value_type}

@scene("object-inspector", size=(1080, 1120),
       description="Object inspector: the fields, getters and methods of a C# object")
def object_inspector(studio):
    """Eder's Health component, opened from a call of Health:DoDamage."""
    studio.show_attached(_POE_NAME, _POE_PID, _POE_DETAILS)

    def nothing(*_args):
        return None

    dialog = studio.keep(ObjectInspectorDialog(
        studio.translations, nothing, target={"address": hex(_HEALTH)}, request=nothing,
        evaluate=nothing, name="this", parent=studio.window, show_text=nothing,
        list_methods=nothing, call_method=nothing))
    dialog.show_contents(_health_contents())
    dialog.show_properties([
        {"name": name, "value": value} for name, value in (
            ("CurrentHealth", {"text": "212.5"}), ("CurrentStamina", {"text": "41.25"}),
            ("MaxHealth", {"text": "236"}), ("MaxStamina", {"text": "88"}),

            ("name", {"text": f'"{_EDER}"', "string": True}))])
    dialog.methods_section.set_open(True, remember=False)
    dialog.show_methods([
        {"name": name, "method": hex(0x2A43F80D5C0 + 0x2A0 * index), "owner": "Health",
         "params": params, "returns": returns}
        for index, (name, params, returns) in enumerate(_HEALTH_METHODS)])
    dialog.splitter.setSizes([560, 250, 230])

# --- Call graph -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _framework(class_name, name, parameters, returns, assembly, static=False):
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    return _method(class_name, name, parameters, returns, static, assembly)


@scene("call-graph", size=(1100, 720),
       description="Call graph: what a C# method calls and which methods call it")
def call_graph(studio):
    """What UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction calls, and its callers."""
    studio.show_attached(_POE_NAME, _POE_PID, _POE_DETAILS)
    finalize = _BY_NAME["UIStoreStorePage:FinalizeTransaction"]
    with _idle_workers((call_graph_widget, "CallGraphWorker")):
        dialog = studio.keep(call_graph_widget.CallGraphDialog(
            studio.translations, _POE_PID, finalize, parent=studio.window, engine=MONO))
    callees = [
        Call("call", _BY_NAME["PlayerInventory:get_Instance"]),
        Call("callvirt", _BY_NAME["PlayerInventory:CanAfford"]),
        Call("callvirt", _BY_NAME["StoreInventory:GetBuyPrice"]),
        Call("callvirt", _BY_NAME["StoreInventory:RemoveItem"]),
        Call("callvirt", _BY_NAME["Inventory:AddItem"]),
        Call("callvirt", _BY_NAME["PlayerInventory:RemoveCurrency"]),
        Call("call", _BY_NAME["UIStoreStorePage:RefreshTotals"]),
        Call("call", _BY_NAME["GlobalAudioPlayer:Play"]),
        Call("call", _framework("UnityEngine.Object", "op_Implicit", "(UnityEngine.Object)",
                                "System.Boolean", "UnityEngine", static=True)),
        Call("callvirt", _framework("System.Collections.Generic.List`1<StoreItem>", "Clear",
                                    "()", "System.Void", "mscorlib")),
        Call("call", _framework("System.String", "Format", "(string,object)",
                                "System.String", "mscorlib", static=True)),
        Call("newobj", _framework("StoreTransactionEvent", ".ctor", "(Item,int)",
                                  "System.Void", "Assembly-CSharp")),
    ]
    dialog._on_callees(dialog._callee_request, finalize, callees, [])
    dialog.search_callers()
    dialog._on_callers(dialog._caller_request, finalize, [
        Call("call", _BY_NAME["UIStoreStorePage:OnConfirmClicked"]),
        Call("call", _method("UIStoreStorePage", "<Start>m__2A3", "(UnityEngine.GameObject)",
                                 static=True)),
        Call("call", _method("UIStoreStorePage", "OnKeyConfirm", "(KeyControl)",
                             "System.Boolean")),
    ], [])
    dialog.findChild(QSplitter).setSizes([480, 240])
    dialog.callees_table.selectRow(5)
    dialog.callees_table.setFocus()
    return dialog

        "returns": {"kind": 0x01, "byref": False, "name": "void"}})
    dialog._editors[0].setText("50")
    before = set(dialog._calls)
    dialog.call()
    (request,) = set(dialog._calls) - before
    dialog._on_called(request, {"result": None, "object": {
        "text": 'BP_AlabamaCheatManager_C "BP_AlabamaCheatManager_C_2147482190"@0x2c6f1e40a00'}})
    return dialog

class _GasWorker(QObject):
    """Answers for the window from the scene: the scripts worker's GAS signals."""

    gas_listed = Signal(int, object)
    gas_failed = Signal(int, str)
    gas_set = Signal(int, object)
    gas_set_failed = Signal(int, str)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._requests = itertools.count(1)
        self.last = None

    def gas_attributes(self):
        self.last = next(self._requests)
        return self.last

    def gas_set_base(self, _name, _value):
        return next(self._requests)


class _ScriptPanel:
    """Stands in for the scripts tab: its worker and one hold script."""

    def __init__(self, worker, held):
        self._worker = worker
        self._held = held

    def worker(self):
        return self._worker

    def scripts_labelled(self, prefix):
        return {number: spec for number, spec in enumerate(self._held, 1)
                if spec.label.startswith(prefix)}


def _attributes(*rows):
    return [{"name": name, "base": base, "current": current} for name, base, current in rows]

class _BrowseWorker(QObject):
    """Answers for the object browser from the scene: the scripts worker's browse signals."""

    classes_browsed = Signal(int, object)
    browse_failed = Signal(int, str)
    instances_browsed = Signal(int, object)
    instances_failed = Signal(int, str)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._requests = itertools.count(1)
        self.last = None
        self.instances = {}  # klass -> request id of its objects

    def browse_classes(self, _filter="", _internal=False):
        self.last = next(self._requests)
        return self.last

    def browse_instances(self, klass, _filter="", _internal=False):
        self.instances[klass] = next(self._requests)
        return self.instances[klass]


class _BrowsePanel:
    """Stands in for the scripts tab: its worker, no inspector."""

    inspections = None

    def __init__(self, worker):
        self._worker = worker

    def worker(self):
        return self._worker


def _browse_class(klass, name, assembly, count, role=None):
    return {"klass": klass, "name": name, "cppName": name, "package": assembly,
            "count": count, "role": role, "matched": 0}
```

```py
"""The worked examples: the code explorer, the native monitor and a native
script on the tutorial's test game (docs/examples/dummy-game-code-explorer.md).

The code explorer scenes index the real test game, built as the tutorial
builds it (see scenes_tools._dummy_game_binary); the monitor and the script
get calls and runs in the format their workers emit, with the addresses of
that build.

def _explorer(studio, size=(1280, 820)):
    """The code explorer on the test game, indexed and shown at its final
    size (so a selected line can be scrolled to the middle); and its index."""
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from grembyte.features.code_explorer import CodeIndex, load_image
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import code_explorer as module

    path = _dummy_game_binary()
    dialog = module.CodeExplorerDialog(studio.translations)
    studio.keep(dialog)
    index = CodeIndex(load_image(str(path)))
    choice = module.ModuleChoice(DEMO_NAME, str(path), index.image.base, program=True)
    dialog.modules = [choice]
    dialog.module_combo.clear()
    dialog.module_combo.addItem(choice.name, choice)
    dialog.module = choice
    dialog._on_built(index)
    dialog.resize(*size)
    dialog.show()
    settle()
    names = {name: address for address, name in index.image.names.items()}
    return dialog, index, names


@scene("example-code-button", size=(1280, 820),
       description="Example: the button's text, and where on_activate hands on_treasure to GTK")

    settle()
    dialog.line_view.scrollTo(dialog.line_view.currentIndex(),
                              dialog.line_view.ScrollHint.PositionAtCenter)
    settle()
    return dialog
```
