`test_app/unity/Assets/Scripts/GameState.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace HermesQuest
{
    // One running game. "New game" builds a new GameState, so the player and
    // its stats move to new heap addresses, as after loading a save in a real game.
    // The static field Current is the root of every pointer chain.
    public class GameState
    {
        public static GameState Current;

        public const int ChaseDistance = 10;

        public readonly int Seed;
        public readonly System.Random Rng;
        public readonly Map Map;
        public readonly Character Player;
        public readonly List<Character> Enemies = new List<Character>();
        public readonly MessageLog Log = new MessageLog(6);
        public DamageReport LastDamage;
        public int Turn;
        public int Kills;
        public bool GameOver;
        int nextId = 1;

        GameState(int seed)
        {
            Seed = seed;
            Rng = new System.Random(seed);
            Map = Map.Generate(Rng);
            Player = Character.CreatePlayer(nextId++);
            Player.X = Map.StartX;
            Player.Y = Map.StartY;
        }

        public static GameState NewGame(int seed)
        {
            Current = new GameState(seed);
            Current.Log.Add(string.Format("New game, seed {0}. Press H for help.", seed));
            return Current;
        }

        public Character EnemyAt(int x, int y)
        {
            foreach (var enemy in Enemies)
                if (enemy.X == x && enemy.Y == y && !enemy.IsDead)
                    return enemy;
            return null;
        }

        bool IsFree(int x, int y)
        {
            return Map.IsWalkable(x, y) && EnemyAt(x, y) == null && !(Player.X == x && Player.Y == y);
        }

        public static int Distance(Character a, Character b)
        {
            return Math.Max(Math.Abs(a.X - b.X), Math.Abs(a.Y - b.Y));
        }

        public Character NearestEnemy(Character from, int range)
        {
            Character nearest = null;
            foreach (var enemy in Enemies)
            {
                if (enemy.IsDead || Distance(from, enemy) > range)
                    continue;
                if (nearest == null || Distance(from, enemy) < Distance(from, nearest))
                    nearest = enemy;
            }
            return nearest;
        }

        // Places the enemy 3 to 8 cells away from the player; null if there is no room.
        public Character SpawnEnemy(EnemyType type)
        {
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt++)
            {
                int x = Player.X + Rng.Next(-8, 9);
                int y = Player.Y + Rng.Next(-8, 9);
                int distance = Math.Max(Math.Abs(x - Player.X), Math.Abs(y - Player.Y));
                if (distance < 3 || !IsFree(x, y))
                    continue;
                var enemy = Character.CreateEnemy(nextId++, type);
                enemy.X = x;
                enemy.Y = y;
                Enemies.Add(enemy);
                Log.Add(string.Format("A {0} appears.", type.Name));
                return enemy;
            }
            Log.Add(string.Format("No room for a {0}.", type.Name));
            return null;
        }

        public void ClearEnemies()
        {
            Enemies.Clear();
            Log.Add("All enemies removed.");
        }

        public void OnKilled(Character killer, Character victim)
        {
            Log.Add(string.Format("{0} dies.", victim.Name));
            if (victim.IsPlayer)
            {
                GameOver = true;
                Log.Add("You are dead. Press N for a new game.");
                return;
            }
            Enemies.Remove(victim);
            if (!killer.IsPlayer)
                return;
            Kills++;
            int gold = Rng.Next(victim.Type.GoldMin, victim.Type.GoldMax + 1);
            killer.AddGold(gold);
            int levels = killer.AddExperience(victim.Type.Experience);
            Log.Add(string.Format("You gain {0:0.##} experience and {1} gold.",
                                  victim.Type.Experience, gold));
            if (levels > 0)
                Log.Add(string.Format("You reach level {0}!", killer.Stats.Level));
        }

        // Moves the player or attacks the enemy in the way; returns whether
        // that took a turn.
        public bool PlayerMove(int dx, int dy)
        {
            int x = Player.X + dx;
            int y = Player.Y + dy;
            Character enemy = EnemyAt(x, y);
            if (enemy != null)
            {
                Combat.MeleeAttack(this, Player, enemy);
                return true;
            }
            if (!Map.IsWalkable(x, y))
                return false;
            Player.X = x;
            Player.Y = y;
            return true;
        }

        public void PlayerRest()
        {
            float healed = Player.Heal(2f);
            if (healed > 0f)
                Log.Add(string.Format("You rest and recover {0:0.##} health.", healed));
        }

        public void EndTurn()
        {
            Turn++;
            // Copy: an enemy may die during the loop and leave the list.
            foreach (var enemy in Enemies.ToArray())
            {
                if (GameOver)
                    return;
                if (enemy.IsDead)
                    continue;
                int distance = Distance(enemy, Player);
                if (distance <= 1)
                    Combat.MeleeAttack(this, enemy, Player);
                else if (distance <= ChaseDistance)
                    StepToward(enemy, Player.X, Player.Y);
                else if (Rng.NextDouble() < 0.25)
                    StepToward(enemy, enemy.X + Rng.Next(-1, 2), enemy.Y + Rng.Next(-1, 2));
            }
        }

        void StepToward(Character enemy, int targetX, int targetY)
        {
            int dx = Math.Sign(targetX - enemy.X);
            int dy = Math.Sign(targetY - enemy.Y);
            if (TryStep(enemy, dx, dy))
                return;
            if (dx != 0 && TryStep(enemy, dx, 0))
                return;
            if (dy != 0)
                TryStep(enemy, 0, dy);
        }

        bool TryStep(Character enemy, int dx, int dy)
        {
            if ((dx == 0 && dy == 0) || !IsFree(enemy.X + dx, enemy.Y + dy))
                return false;
            enemy.X += dx;
            enemy.Y += dy;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`test_app/unity/Assets/Scripts/GameView.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using UnityEngine;

namespace HermesQuest
{
    public enum ViewMode
    {
        Map,
        Character,
        Debug,
        Help,
    }

    // Draws a GameState onto the 80 x 30 terminal:
    //     rows 0-21  map (60 columns) or another view, and the side panel
    //     rows 23-28 message log
    //     row  29    key hints
    public static class GameView
    {
        public const int Columns = 80;
        public const int Rows = 30;
        const int PanelX = Map.Width + 1;
        const int LogY = Map.Height + 1;

        static readonly Color Text = new Color(0.85f, 0.85f, 0.85f);
        static readonly Color Dim = new Color(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
        static readonly Color Title = new Color(1f, 0.8f, 0.3f);
        static readonly Color Bad = new Color(1f, 0.35f, 0.35f);

        public static void Render(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game, ViewMode mode)
        {
            terminal.Clear();
            switch (mode)
            {
                case ViewMode.Character: RenderCharacterSheet(terminal, game); break;
                case ViewMode.Debug: RenderDebug(terminal, game); break;
                case ViewMode.Help: RenderHelp(terminal); break;
                default: RenderMap(terminal, game); break;
            }
            // The debug view needs the full width.
            if (mode != ViewMode.Debug)
                RenderPanel(terminal, game);
            RenderLog(terminal, game);
            terminal.Print(0, Rows - 1,
                           "Arrows/WASD move  F bolt  R rest  E/1-5 spawn  C sheet  F1 debug  H help",
                           Dim);
        }

        static string Exact(float value)
        {
            return value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        static string Exact(double value)
        {
            return value.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        static void RenderMap(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game)
        {
            var map = game.Map;
            for (int x = 0; x < Map.Width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < Map.Height; y++)
                {
                    char tile = map.Tiles[x, y];
                    terminal.Put(x, y, tile, Map.ColorOf(tile));
                }
            foreach (var enemy in game.Enemies)
                terminal.Put(enemy.X, enemy.Y, enemy.Glyph, enemy.Color);
            var player = game.Player;
            terminal.Put(player.X, player.Y, game.GameOver ? '%' : player.Glyph,
                         game.GameOver ? Bad : player.Color);
        }

        static void RenderPanel(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game)
        {
            var player = game.Player;
            var stats = player.Stats;
            int y = 0;
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, player.Name + "  Lv " + stats.Level, Title);
            y++;
            Color health = stats.Health < stats.MaxHealth * 0.3f ? Bad : Text;
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("HP  {0:0.0}/{1:0}", stats.Health, stats.MaxHealth), health);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("MP  {0:0.0}/{1:0}", stats.Mana, stats.MaxMana), Text);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("XP  {0:0}/{1:0}", stats.Experience, player.ExperienceForNextLevel), Text);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Gold {0}", stats.Gold), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("STR {0}", stats.Strength), Text);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("DEX {0}", stats.Dexterity), Text);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("INT {0}", stats.Intelligence), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Dmg out  x{0:0.##}", player.DamageOutgoingMultiplier), Text);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Dmg in   x{0:0.##}", player.DamageIncomingMultiplier), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Turn {0}", game.Turn), Dim);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Enemies {0}", game.Enemies.Count), Dim);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Kills {0}", game.Kills), Dim);
            terminal.Print(PanelX, y++, string.Format("Seed {0}", game.Seed), Dim);
        }

        static void RenderLog(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < Columns; x++)
                terminal.Put(x, LogY - 1, '-', Dim);
            var lines = game.Log.Lines;
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
                terminal.Print(0, LogY + i, lines[i], i == lines.Count - 1 ? Text : Dim);
        }

        static void RenderCharacterSheet(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game)
        {
            var player = game.Player;
            var stats = player.Stats;
            int y = 0;
            terminal.Print(2, y++, "CHARACTER                                   C / Esc: back", Title);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Name          {0}", player.Name), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Level         {0}", stats.Level), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Experience    {0:0.00} / {1:0}", stats.Experience, player.ExperienceForNextLevel), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Strength      {0,3}   melee damage +{1:0.##}", stats.Strength, stats.Strength * 0.25f), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Dexterity     {0,3}   hit chance and dodge", stats.Dexterity), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Intelligence  {0,3}   Fire Bolt {1:0.##} damage", stats.Intelligence, Combat.FireBoltDamage(player)), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Health        {0:0.00} / {1:0.00}", stats.Health, stats.MaxHealth), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Mana          {0:0.00} / {1:0.00}  (+{2}/s)", stats.Mana, stats.MaxMana, Character.ManaRegenPerSecond), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Gold          {0}", stats.Gold), Text);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Weapon        {0}-{1} + STR/4", player.DamageMin, player.DamageMax), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Damage out    x{0}", Exact(player.DamageOutgoingMultiplier)), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Damage in     x{0}", Exact(player.DamageIncomingMultiplier)), Text);
            terminal.Print(2, y++, string.Format("Kills         {0}", game.Kills), Text);
        }

        static void RenderDebug(AsciiTerminal terminal, GameState game)
        {
            var player = game.Player;
            var stats = player.Stats;
            int y = 0;
            terminal.Print(1, y++, "DEBUG  exact values                        F1 / Esc: back", Title);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("PID {0}   seed {1}   turn {2}",
                                                 Process.GetCurrentProcess().Id, game.Seed, game.Turn), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, "Chain: GameState.Current -> Player -> Stats", Dim);
            y++;
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Health      {0} / {1}", Exact(stats.Health), Exact(stats.MaxHealth)), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Mana        {0} / {1}", Exact(stats.Mana), Exact(stats.MaxMana)), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Experience  {0}", Exact(stats.Experience)), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Gold {0}  STR {1}  DEX {2}  INT {3}  Lv {4}",
                                                 stats.Gold, stats.Strength, stats.Dexterity, stats.Intelligence, stats.Level), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Mult out {0}  in {1}",
                                                 Exact(player.DamageOutgoingMultiplier), Exact(player.DamageIncomingMultiplier)), Text);
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Rumors heard {0}  garbled {1}", Rumors.Heard, Rumors.Garbled), Text);
            y++;
            var report = game.LastDamage;
            terminal.Print(1, y++, "Last ApplyDamage", Title);
            if (report == null)
                terminal.Print(1, y++, "none yet", Dim);
            else
            {
                terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("{0} {1} {2}", report.Attacker, report.Source, report.Target), Text);
                terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("base {0}  x out {1}  x in {2}",
                                                     Exact(report.BaseDamage), Exact(report.OutgoingMultiplier), Exact(report.IncomingMultiplier)), Text);
                float expected = report.BaseDamage * report.OutgoingMultiplier * report.IncomingMultiplier;
                bool changed = !Mathf.Approximately(expected, report.Calculated);
                terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("calculated {0}  dealt {1}{2}",
                                                     Exact(report.Calculated), Exact(report.Dealt),
                                                     changed ? "  (CalculateDamage changed)" : ""), changed ? Title : Text);
            }
            y++;
            terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("Enemies ({0})", game.Enemies.Count), Title);
            foreach (var enemy in game.Enemies)
            {
                if (y >= Map.Height)
                    break;
                terminal.Print(1, y++, string.Format("#{0,-3} {1} {2,-8} HP {3,-8} at {4},{5}  out {6} in {7}",
                                                     enemy.Id, enemy.Glyph, enemy.Name, Exact(enemy.Stats.Health),
                                                     enemy.X, enemy.Y, Exact(enemy.DamageOutgoingMultiplier),
                                                     Exact(enemy.DamageIncomingMultiplier)), Text);
            }
        }

        static void RenderHelp(AsciiTerminal terminal)
        {
            string[] lines =
            {
                "HELP                                        H / Esc: back",
                "",
                "Arrows, WASD, numpad   move; walk into an enemy to attack",
                "Space                  wait a turn",
                "R                      rest a turn and recover 2 health",
                "F                      Fire Bolt at the nearest enemy (7.5 mana)",
                "E                      spawn a random enemy",
                "1 2 3 4 5              spawn rat, goblin, skeleton, orc, ogre",
                "Delete                 remove all enemies",
                "C                      character sheet",
                "F1                     debug view with exact values",
                "N                      new game (moves player and stats",
                "                       to new addresses)",
                "",
                "Mana regenerates in real time, even while the window",
                "is in the background. Start with -seed <n> for a fixed map.",
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
                terminal.Print(2, i, lines[i], i == 0 ? Title : Text);
        }
    }
}
```

`test_app/unity/Assets/Scripts/Map.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace HermesQuest
{
    public class Map
    {
        public const int Width = 60;
        public const int Height = 22;

        public const char Wall = '#';
        public const char Floor = '.';
        public const char Grass = ',';
        public const char Tree = 'T';
        public const char Water = '~';

        public readonly char[,] Tiles = new char[Width, Height];
        public int StartX;
        public int StartY;

        public bool InBounds(int x, int y)
        {
            return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < Width && y < Height;
        }

        public bool IsWalkable(int x, int y)
        {
            if (!InBounds(x, y))
                return false;
            char tile = Tiles[x, y];
            return tile == Floor || tile == Grass;
        }

        public static Color ColorOf(char tile)
        {
            switch (tile)
            {
                case Wall: return new Color(0.6f, 0.6f, 0.6f);
                case Floor: return new Color(0.35f, 0.35f, 0.35f);
                case Grass: return new Color(0.2f, 0.55f, 0.2f);
                case Tree: return new Color(0.1f, 0.7f, 0.25f);
                case Water: return new Color(0.25f, 0.45f, 0.95f);
                default: return Color.white;
            }
        }

        // Open land with a few ruins, lakes and trees, framed by a wall.
        // The same seed gives the same map.
        public static Map Generate(System.Random rng)
        {
            var map = new Map();
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                    map.Tiles[x, y] = rng.NextDouble() < 0.25 ? Grass : Floor;

            int lakes = rng.Next(1, 3);
            for (int i = 0; i < lakes; i++)
                map.AddLake(rng);
            int ruins = rng.Next(3, 6);
            for (int i = 0; i < ruins; i++)
                map.AddRuin(rng);
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                    if (map.IsWalkable(x, y) && rng.NextDouble() < 0.06)
                        map.Tiles[x, y] = Tree;

            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                map.Tiles[x, 0] = Wall;
                map.Tiles[x, Height - 1] = Wall;
            }
            for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
            {
                map.Tiles[0, y] = Wall;
                map.Tiles[Width - 1, y] = Wall;
            }

            map.FindWalkableNear(Width / 2, Height / 2, out map.StartX, out map.StartY);
            map.ConnectAll();
            return map;
        }

        // Ruins, trees and lakes can close off an area, and the player or an
        // enemy spawned there could not get out. Breaks a straight way from
        // each such area to the part reachable from the start.
        void ConnectAll()
        {
            while (true)
            {
                bool[,] reached = Reachable(StartX, StartY);
                int x, y;
                if (!FindUnreached(reached, out x, out y))
                    return;
                // Horizontally first, then vertically, until the reached part.
                while (!reached[x, y])
                {
                    if (x != StartX)
                        x += Math.Sign(StartX - x);
                    else
                        y += Math.Sign(StartY - y);
                    if (!IsWalkable(x, y))
                        Tiles[x, y] = Floor;
                }
            }
        }

        // Flood fill with the four straight steps, as the arrow keys move.
        bool[,] Reachable(int startX, int startY)
        {
            var reached = new bool[Width, Height];
            var open = new Stack<int>();
            reached[startX, startY] = true;
            open.Push(startY * Width + startX);
            while (open.Count > 0)
            {
                int cell = open.Pop();
                int cx = cell % Width;
                int cy = cell / Width;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                {
                    int nx = cx + (i == 0 ? 1 : i == 1 ? -1 : 0);
                    int ny = cy + (i == 2 ? 1 : i == 3 ? -1 : 0);
                    if (IsWalkable(nx, ny) && !reached[nx, ny])
                    {
                        reached[nx, ny] = true;
                        open.Push(ny * Width + nx);
                    }
                }
            }
            return reached;
        }

        bool FindUnreached(bool[,] reached, out int foundX, out int foundY)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                    if (IsWalkable(x, y) && !reached[x, y])
                    {
                        foundX = x;
                        foundY = y;
                        return true;
                    }
            foundX = 0;
            foundY = 0;
            return false;
        }

        void AddLake(System.Random rng)
        {
            int cx = rng.Next(8, Width - 8);
            int cy = rng.Next(4, Height - 4);
            int rx = rng.Next(3, 7);
            int ry = rng.Next(2, 4);
            for (int x = cx - rx; x <= cx + rx; x++)
                for (int y = cy - ry; y <= cy + ry; y++)
                {
                    float dx = (x - cx) / (float)rx;
                    float dy = (y - cy) / (float)ry;
                    if (InBounds(x, y) && dx * dx + dy * dy <= 1f)
                        Tiles[x, y] = Water;
                }
        }

        // The outline of a building with one gap as door.
        void AddRuin(System.Random rng)
        {
            int w = rng.Next(5, 11);
            int h = rng.Next(4, 7);
            int left = rng.Next(2, Width - w - 2);
            int top = rng.Next(2, Height - h - 2);
            int right = left + w - 1;
            int bottom = top + h - 1;
            for (int x = left; x <= right; x++)
                for (int y = top; y <= bottom; y++)
                {
                    bool edge = x == left || x == right || y == top || y == bottom;
                    Tiles[x, y] = edge ? Wall : Floor;
                }
            int door = rng.Next(1, w - 1);
            Tiles[left + door, rng.Next(2) == 0 ? top : bottom] = Floor;
        }

        // The walkable cell nearest to (x, y), searched in growing squares.
        public bool FindWalkableNear(int x, int y, out int foundX, out int foundY)
        {
            for (int radius = 0; radius < Math.Max(Width, Height); radius++)
                for (int dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++)
                    for (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++)
                    {
                        if (Math.Max(Math.Abs(dx), Math.Abs(dy)) != radius)
                            continue;
                        if (IsWalkable(x + dx, y + dy))
                        {
                            foundX = x + dx;
                            foundY = y + dy;
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
            foundX = x;
            foundY = y;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace HermesQuest
{
    // The last few messages on screen; every message also goes to Player.log.
    public class MessageLog
    {
        readonly int capacity;
        readonly List<string> lines = new List<string>();

        public MessageLog(int capacity)
        {
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }

        public IList<string> Lines
        {
            get { return lines; }
        }

        public void Add(string message)
        {
            Debug.Log(message);
            lines.Add(message);
            if (lines.Count > capacity)
                lines.RemoveAt(0);
        }
    }
}
```

`test_app/unity/Assets/Scripts/Rumors.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

namespace HermesQuest
{
    // Once per second the town hears a rumor, a line "<days>:<text>". Some
    // lines are garbled: Parse throws for them and Tick catches it, as games
    // catch what their own code throws. A target for hooks on a method an
    // exception leaves: the exception has to find its way back to Tick past
    // the hook (Frida's onEnter and onLeave broke that and ended the game).
    public static class Rumors
    {
        public const float SecondsPerRumor = 1f;

        static readonly string[] Lines =
        {
            "3:An ogre was seen near the old mill.",
            "seven:The well is cursed.",
            "1:The smith pays well for goblin ears.",
            "12:A skeleton guards gold in the crypt.",
            "?:Someone saw lights in the swamp.",
        };

        public static int Heard;
        public static int Garbled;
        public static string Last = "";
        static float elapsed;
        static int next;

        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
        public static void Tick(float seconds)
        {
            elapsed += seconds;
            if (elapsed < SecondsPerRumor)
                return;
            elapsed -= SecondsPerRumor;
            string line = Lines[next];
            next = (next + 1) % Lines.Length;
            try
            {
                int days = Parse(line);
                Heard++;
                Last = string.Format("{0} ({1} days ago)", line.Substring(line.IndexOf(':') + 1), days);
            }
            catch (FormatException)
            {
                Garbled++;
            }
        }

        // The days since the rumor began; throws FormatException for a garbled line.
        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
        public static int Parse(string line)
        {
            return int.Parse(line.Substring(0, line.IndexOf(':')), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }
}
```

`test_app/unity/README.md`:

```md
# HermesQuest (Unity)

A small top-down ASCII role-playing game as a test target for the Mono adapter
and as the running example of the documentation. It has a character sheet, enemies
that spawn at the press of a key, and one damage pipeline where hooks and scripts can
multiply or reduce damage.

The game needs no assets: it starts from code (`Bootstrap`), draws an 80 x 30
character grid with IMGUI and reads the keyboard from IMGUI events.

## Setup

1. Install Unity 6 LTS (or 2022.3 LTS) with the modules *Linux Build Support (Mono)*
   and *Windows Build Support (Mono)*.
2. Open `test_app/unity` in Unity Hub (*Add project from disk*). On the first start,
   Unity creates `ProjectSettings/` and the `.meta` files; commit them.
3. Press Play in the editor, or build:
   - menu *HermesQuest → Build Linux / Build Windows / Build All*, or
   - `Unity -batchmode -quit -projectPath test_app/unity -executeMethod HermesQuest.Editor.BuildScript.BuildAll`

The builds land in `test_app/unity/Build/Linux` and `Build/Windows`, as release builds
with the Mono backend. The Windows build is for testing under Proton.

`-seed <n>` on the command line fixes the map and all rolls, including after "New game".

## Keys

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Arrows, WASD, numpad | move; walk into an enemy to attack |
| Space / R | wait / rest (recover 2 health) |
| F | Fire Bolt at the nearest enemy, costs 7.5 mana |
| E, 1-5 | spawn a random enemy / rat, goblin, skeleton, orc, ogre |
| Delete | remove all enemies |
| C, F1, H | character sheet, debug view with exact values, help |
| N | new game |

## What to test

**Values (memory scan, pointer scan).** All values live in heap objects:
`GameState.Current → Player → Stats → {Health, Mana, Experience, Gold, Strength, ...}`.
"New game" builds new objects, so the addresses change. Health and Mana are `float`,
Experience is a `double`; Mana regenerates by 0.13 per second in real time, even in the
background. The F1 view shows the exact values and the process ID.

**Damage pipeline (hooks, scripts).** Melee and Fire Bolt go through the same methods:

```
Combat.MeleeAttack / Combat.CastFireBolt
  → Combat.ApplyDamage(game, attacker, target, baseDamage, source)
      → Combat.CalculateDamage(attacker, target, baseDamage)   returns the damage
      → Character.TakeDamage(amount)                           writes Stats.Health
```

- `Character.DamageOutgoingMultiplier` / `DamageIncomingMultiplier` (float, 1.0) are
  fields a script can set per character.
- A hook on `CalculateDamage` can change the return value; the log and the F1 view show
  base, multipliers and the damage actually dealt, and mark a changed result.
- `TakeDamage` hits player and enemies alike; a hook tells them apart by `IsPlayer`.
- `Heal`, `SpendMana`, `RegenerateMana`, `AddGold` and `AddExperience` each write one
  value in their own method.

All these methods are marked `NoInlining`, so the Mono JIT keeps them as separate
functions.

**Exceptions (monitors and hooks on code that throws).** Once per second, also without
a window, `Rumors.Tick` reads the next rumor with `Rumors.Parse(line)`. Two of the five
lines are garbled: `Parse` throws a `FormatException`, and `Tick` catches it. A monitor or
hook on `Parse` must leave that to the game; if it breaks Mono's way back to `Tick`, the
exception goes unhandled and Unity ends the game. The F1 view counts the rumors heard and
garbled. `tests/test_hermesquest.py` runs this against the build.

```

```md
# HermesQuest (Unreal) — planned

The Unreal counterpart of [the Unity game](../unity/README.md): same map, keys and
enemies, so the documentation can show the same steps for both engines.

Plan:

- UE5 C++ project with the GameplayAbilities plugin.
- `UHermesAttributeSet` with `FGameplayAttributeData` for Health, MaxHealth, Mana,
  MaxMana, Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, DamageOutgoingMult and
  DamageIncomingMult, as in shipped GAS games.
- Damage as a `UGameplayEffect` with an `UGameplayEffectExecutionCalculation`, so
  the multipliers apply in the place real games use.
- Shipping builds only: the Unreal adapter has to work without exports and symbols.
  Linux builds from Linux; the Windows build (for Proton) needs a Windows machine,
  since Unreal does not cross-compile from Linux to Windows.
```

```py
import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _private_catalog_cache(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Keep the catalog cache (see grembyte.features.catalog_cache) out of the user's."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_CACHE_DIR", str(tmp_path / "catalog-cache"))

def _private_window_state(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Keep window sizes and column widths (see grembyte.ui.window_state) out of the user's."""
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui import window_state

    path = str(tmp_path / "window-state.ini")
    monkeypatch.setattr(window_state, "settings",
                        lambda: QSettings(path, QSettings.Format.IniFormat))


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _english_messages():
    """Undo the language a window chose for error messages (see grembyte.core.messages)."""
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.core import messages

    yield
    messages.use(None)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True, scope="session")
def _no_garbage_collection_in_other_threads():
    """Collect garbage in the main thread only, as the app does (see grembyte.ui.garbage).

    Collected in a hook or Frida thread, Qt objects in reference cycles are
    deleted by PySide6 later in the GUI thread, and widgets can crash the
    interpreter then.
    """
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import gc

    gc.disable()
    yield
    gc.enable()


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _collect_garbage_after_each_test():
    """Free what a test leaves in reference cycles (see the fixture above)."""
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import gc

    yield
    gc.collect()


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True, scope="session")
def _end_qt_before_python():
    """Stop workers and delete the windows tests leave, before Python ends.

    Otherwise PySide6 deletes what is left while the interpreter shuts down,
    in an order that crashes (a running QThread aborts, a widget is deleted
    twice), and every test run leaves a core dump.
    """
    yield
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import gc

    from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui import workers

    application = QApplication.instance()
    if application is None:
        return
    workers.stop_workers(5000)
    for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
        widget.close()
        widget.deleteLater()
    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
    application.processEvents()
    gc.collect()
```

```py
"""The activity log: what happened in Grembyte, in order (see activity.py)."""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import zipfile

import pytest

from grembyte.core import activity, logs

from tests.test_hooks import (  # pylint: disable=unused-import
    _wait_for,
    fixture_qt_app,
    fixture_translations,
    linux_only,
    requires_target,
)


@pytest.fixture(name="activity_file")
def fixture_activity_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_LOG_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    path = activity.setup()
    yield path
    activity.teardown()


def _entries(path):
    for handler in activity._logger.handlers:  # pylint: disable=protected-access
        handler.flush()
    return activity.read_entries(path)


def _events(path, *names):
    return [entry for entry in _entries(path) if not names or entry["event"] in names]


def test_nothing_is_written_before_setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_LOG_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    activity.record("click", text="x")
    handle = activity.rpc_started("agent#1", "scan")
    activity.rpc_ended(handle)
    assert not (tmp_path / activity.ACTIVITY_NAME).exists()
    assert activity.in_flight() == []


@linux_only
def test_an_activity_log_deleted_while_grembyte_runs_is_written_again(activity_file):
    activity.record("click", text="before")
    activity_file.unlink()
    activity.record("click", text="after")
    assert [entry.get("text") for entry in _entries(activity_file)] == ["after"]


def test_the_log_window_says_when_the_activity_log_is_off(tmp_path, monkeypatch, qt_app,
                                                          translations):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument

    dialog = LogDialog(translations)
    dialog.source_combo.setCurrentIndex(1)
    text = dialog.text.toPlainText()
    assert text.startswith(translations["log.activity_off"])
    assert "activity.jsonl" in text  # and that there is no file yet
    dialog.close()


def test_a_run_starts_with_what_grembyte_runs_on(activity_file):
    import frida  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel

    activity.record("click", window="Grembyte", text="Prozess öffnen")
    first, click = _entries(activity_file)
    assert first["event"] == "app_started"
    assert first["frida"] == frida.__version__
    assert first["pid"] == os.getpid() and first["python"] and first["qt"]
    assert first["run"] == click["run"] == activity.run_id()
    assert click["text"] == "Prozess öffnen"  # not escaped: the file is read by people too
    assert '"Prozess öffnen"' in activity_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert click["s"] >= first["s"]


def test_repeated_rpcs_are_summed_up_failures_are_not(activity_file, monkeypatch):
    clock = [100.0]
    monkeypatch.setattr(activity.time, "monotonic", lambda: clock[0])

    def call(method, ms, error=None, agent="trace#1"):
        handle = activity.rpc_started(agent, method)
        clock[0] += ms / 1000
        activity.rpc_ended(handle, error)

    for _ in range(activity.REPEAT_WRITTEN):
        call("next_scan", 10)    # written one by one
    for _ in range(5):
        clock[0] += 0.1
        call("next_scan", 20)    # summed up
    call("begin", 1)             # another method: written, the sum is not due yet
    call("next_scan", 30, "access violation")  # the sum first, then the failure
    clock[0] += 0.1
    call("next_scan", 5)
    clock[0] += activity.REPEAT_WINDOW_S
    activity.record("click", text="Stopp")      # the sum is due: written before
    rpcs = [entry for entry in _events(activity_file, "rpc", "click")]
    assert [(entry.get("method"), entry.get("repeated"), entry.get("error")) for entry in rpcs] == [
        ("next_scan", None, None),
        ("next_scan", None, None),
        ("next_scan", None, None),
        ("begin", None, None),
        ("next_scan", 5, None),
        ("next_scan", None, "access violation"),
        ("next_scan", 1, None),
        (None, None, None),
    ]
    assert rpcs[4]["ms"] == 100.0 and rpcs[4]["max_ms"] == 20.0
    assert rpcs[0]["ms"] == 10.0


def test_rpcs_in_flight_are_named(activity_file):
    handle = activity.rpc_started("native_trace#2", "finish")
    assert [call["method"] for call in activity.in_flight()] == ["finish"]
    activity.rpc_ended(handle)
    assert activity.in_flight() == []


def test_sessions_know_their_thread(activity_file):
    class Worker:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        pid = 42

    seen = []

    def run():
        number = activity.session_started("native_trace", Worker(), 42)
        seen.append(activity.current_session())
        activity.session_ended(number, "native_trace", 42, 1.5)
        seen.append(activity.current_session())

    thread = threading.Thread(target=run)
    thread.start()
    thread.join()
    assert seen[0][1] == "native_trace" and seen[1] == (None, None)
    assert activity.current_session() == (None, None)  # another thread
    started, ended = _events(activity_file, "session_started", "session_ended")
    assert started["worker"] == "Worker" and started["session"] == ended["session"]
    assert ended["seconds"] == 1.5

    (proton / "files" / "bin").mkdir(parents=True)
    (proton / "version").write_text("1718000000 proton-9.0-2\n")

        == "1718000000 proton-9.0-2"
    assert activity.proton_version("/usr/bin/wine64-preloader") is None


def test_the_report_holds_the_logs(activity_file, tmp_path):
    logs.setup(tmp_path)
    try:
        logs.log.warning("something went wrong")
        target = tmp_path / "report.zip"
        names = activity.export_report(target, tmp_path)
    finally:
        logs.teardown()
    assert set(names) >= {"activity.jsonl", "grembyte.log", "crash.log"}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as archive:
        assert "something went wrong" in archive.read("grembyte.log").decode()
    assert _events(activity_file, "report_exported")[0]["files"] == names


def _wait_for_sleeping(pid, timeout=5.0):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import time

    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        with open(f"/proc/{pid}/syscall", encoding="ascii") as syscall:
            if syscall.read().split()[0] in ("35", "230"):  # nanosleep, clock_nanosleep
                return
        time.sleep(0.01)
    raise AssertionError("sleep did not start sleeping")


@requires_target
def test_frida_sessions_note_agents_rpcs_and_their_end(activity_file):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.attach.frida_attach import attach_session

    process = subprocess.Popen(["sleep", "30"])
    try:
        # Not while it starts up: Frida's agent in a half-initialised libc kills it.
        _wait_for_sleeping(process.pid)
        session = attach_session(process.pid)
        script = session.create_script(
            "rpc.exports = { add(a, b) { return a + b; }, fail() { throw new Error('no'); } };")
        script.on("message", lambda _message, _data: None)
        script.load()
        assert script.exports_sync.add(2, 3) == 5
        with pytest.raises(Exception, match="no"):
            script.exports_sync.fail()
        script.unload()
        session.detach()
    finally:
        process.kill()
        process.wait()
    loaded = next(entry for entry in _events(activity_file, "agent_loaded")
                  if entry["pid"] == process.pid)
    # Only this process: workers of earlier tests may still be unloading.
    entries = [entry for entry in _events(activity_file) if entry.get("pid") == process.pid
               or entry.get("agent") == loaded["agent"]]
    names = [entry["event"] for entry in entries]
    assert names[names.index("attached"):] == [
        "attached", "agent_loaded", "rpc", "rpc", "agent_unloaded", "detach", "detached"]
    attached = entries[names.index("attached")]
    assert attached["via"] == "frida.attach" and attached["pid"] == process.pid
    rpcs = [entry for entry in entries if entry["event"] == "rpc"]
    assert [(entry["method"], "error" in entry) for entry in rpcs] == [("add", False),
                                                                      ("fail", True)]
    assert rpcs[0]["agent"] == entries[names.index("agent_loaded")]["agent"]
    assert entries[-1]["reason"] == "application-requested"


@requires_target
def test_large_agents_reach_the_gadget_in_parts(activity_file):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import frida

    from grembyte.attach.frida_attach import GADGET_SOURCE_LIMIT, RecordedSession

    process = subprocess.Popen(["sleep", "30"])
    try:
        _wait_for_sleeping(process.pid)
        # The loader path as under Wine, on a native process
        session = RecordedSession(frida.attach(process.pid), process.pid, 0, "test", gadget=True)
        source = ("const base = 40;\n"
                  "rpc.exports = { add(a) { return base + a; } };\n"
                  "send({ kind: 'ready', text: 'ä\\u2028\"' });\n"
                  + "// padding \\ \" ä\n" * (GADGET_SOURCE_LIMIT // 10))
        messages = []
        script = session.create_script(source)
        script.on("message", lambda message, _data: messages.append(message))
        script.load()
        assert script.exports_sync.add(2) == 42
        assert [message["payload"] for message in messages] == [
            {"kind": "ready", "text": "ä\N{LINE SEPARATOR}\""}]
        script.unload()
        session.detach()
    finally:
        process.kill()
        process.wait()
    loaded = next(entry for entry in _events(activity_file, "agent_loaded")
                  if entry["pid"] == process.pid)
    assert loaded["size"] == len(source)


def test_clicks_actions_and_windows_are_recorded(activity_file, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QComboBox, QDialog, QMenu, QPushButton, QVBoxLayout  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.activity_recorder import UiRecorder

    recorder = UiRecorder()
    try:
        dialog = QDialog()
        dialog.setWindowTitle("Nativer Trace")
        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)
        button = QPushButton("&Verfolgung starten")
        # as the windows do: their slot, connected first, changes the text
        button.clicked.connect(lambda: button.setText("Verfolgung beenden"))
        layout.addWidget(button)
        combo = QComboBox()
        combo.setObjectName("phase")
        combo.addItems(["Grundrauschen", "Szenario"])
        layout.addWidget(combo)
        menu = QMenu(dialog)
        action = menu.addAction("Adresse kopieren")
        dialog.show()
        qt_app.processEvents()
        recorder.scan()  # what the timer does
        button.click()
        combo.activated.emit(1)
        action.trigger()
        dialog.close()
        qt_app.processEvents()
        recorder.scan()
    finally:
        recorder.stop()
    events = [(entry["event"], entry.get("text") or entry.get("window"))
              for entry in _events(activity_file, "click", "choice", "action",
                                   "window_shown", "window_hidden")]
    assert events == [("window_shown", "Nativer Trace"), ("click", "Verfolgung starten"),
                      ("choice", "Szenario"), ("action", "Adresse kopieren"),
                      ("window_hidden", "Nativer Trace")]
    click = _events(activity_file, "click")[0]
    assert click["window"] == "Nativer Trace" and click["widget"] == "QPushButton"


def test_clearing_a_filter_with_its_clear_button_is_recorded(activity_file, qt_app):
    # The clear button's action is created by Qt; asking its tool button for
    # defaultAction() invalidated the action's wrapper and the click raised.

    from PySide6.QtGui import QAction  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLineEdit  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module

        line.findChild(QAction).trigger()
        qt_app.processEvents()

        recorder.stop()
    assert _events(activity_file, "action")
```

```py
"""Tests for the assembly selection: the rule, persistence, the window and the catalog filter."""

import os

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from grembyte.db.base import Base
from grembyte.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
from grembyte.db.repository.assembly_selections import AssemblySelectionRepository
from grembyte.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
from grembyte.engines.registry import ENGINES
from grembyte.features.assemblies import chosen_assemblies, missing_assemblies
from grembyte.features.catalog import CatalogMethod
from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations


MONO = ENGINES[0]
LOADED = ["mscorlib", "Assembly-CSharp", "UnityEngine", "Game.Data", "System.Core"]

class FakeCatalogWorker(QObject):
    """Answers the assembly list at once instead of attaching to a game."""

    assemblies_found = Signal(object)
    catalog_failed = Signal(str)
    finished = Signal()

    def __init__(self, _pid, assemblies=None, engine=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.assemblies = assemblies
        self.engine = engine

    def start(self):
        self.assemblies_found.emit([{"name": name, "file": f"/data/Managed/{name}.dll", "classes": 3}
                                    for name in LOADED])
        self.finished.emit()

    def requestInterruption(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def wait(self, _timeout_ms=None):
        return True


def test_without_selection_the_game_assemblies_are_chosen():
    assert chosen_assemblies(LOADED, frozenset(), MONO) == ["Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Data"]
    # A selection may name framework assemblies; the order is the game's.
    assert chosen_assemblies(LOADED, {"Game.Data", "UnityEngine", "Gone"}, MONO) == [
        "UnityEngine", "Game.Data"]
    assert missing_assemblies(LOADED, {"Game.Data", "Gone"}) == ["Gone"]


def test_repository_replaces_the_selection_per_program(repository, process_id, sessions):
    other_id = HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("other", "/opt/other")
    repository.save_assemblies(process_id, ["Game.Data", "Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Data"])
    repository.save_assemblies(other_id, ["Other"])
    assert repository.list_assemblies(process_id) == ["Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Data"]
    repository.save_assemblies(process_id, ["UnityEngine"])
    assert repository.list_assemblies(process_id) == ["UnityEngine"]
    repository.save_assemblies(process_id, [])
```

`tests/test_call_graph.py`:

```py
"""The call graph from IL code (see grembyte.features.call_graph), without a game."""

import struct

from grembyte.features.call_graph import (
    Call,
    async_owner,
    build_call_index,
    callees_of,
    callers_in,
    calls_in,
    split_bodies,
    state_machines,
)
from grembyte.features.catalog import CatalogMethod, catalog_methods


def _token(value):
    return struct.pack("<I", value)


# ldarg.0; call LoadBin; ldc.i4.s 5; switch (2 targets); callvirt (MemberRef);
# ldftn (lambda); newobj (MemberRef); ldstr; ldc.i4 0x28282828 (looks like calls);
# ldc.i8; call into a field token (not a method); ret
_CODE = (b"\x02" + b"\x28" + _token(0x06000002) + b"\x1f\x05"
         + b"\x45" + _token(2) + _token(0) + _token(4)
         + b"\x6f" + _token(0x0A000010) + b"\xfe\x06" + _token(0x06000003)
         + b"\x73" + _token(0x0A000011) + b"\x72" + _token(0x70000001)
         + b"\x20" + _token(0x28282828) + b"\x21" + b"\x28" * 8
         + b"\x28" + _token(0x04000001) + b"\x2a")

_LOADER = "Game.Loader"
_CLASSES = [
    [_LOADER, [
        ["Load", "()", "System.Void", False, 0x06000001, "Game.Loader:Load ()", 0, 0],
        ["LoadBin", "(string)", "System.Byte[]", False, 0x06000002,
         "Game.Loader:LoadBin (string)", 0, 0],
        ["<Load>b__0", "()", "System.Void", False, 0x06000003, "Game.Loader:<Load>b__0 ()", 0, 0],
    ]],
    [f"{_LOADER}.<Load>d__4", [
        ["MoveNext", "()", "System.Void", False, 0x06000004,
         "Game.Loader/<Load>d__4:MoveNext ()", 0, 0],
    ]],
]


def test_calls_are_found_in_the_order_of_the_code():
    assert calls_in(_CODE) == [("call", 0x06000002), ("callvirt", 0x0A000010),
                               ("ldftn", 0x06000003), ("newobj", 0x0A000011)]


def test_cut_or_odd_code_keeps_what_was_decoded():
    assert calls_in(_CODE[:6]) == [("call", 0x06000002)]
    assert calls_in(_CODE[:4]) == []
    assert calls_in(b"\xfe") == [] and calls_in(b"") == []


def test_method_bodies_answer_is_split_into_records():
    buffer = _token(0x06000001) + _token(2) + b"\x02\x2a" + _token(0x06000002) + _token(0)
    assert split_bodies(buffer) == {0x06000001: b"\x02\x2a", 0x06000002: b""}


def test_index_names_own_and_foreign_methods():
    asked = []

    def resolve(tokens):
        asked.append(tokens)
        return [["mscorlib", 0x06001234, "System.Text.Encoding:GetString (byte[])"], None]

    progress = []
    index = build_call_index("Assembly-CSharp", _CLASSES,
                             lambda tokens: {0x06000001: _CODE, 0x06000004: _CODE[:6]},
                             resolve, lambda done, total: progress.append((done, total)))

    # Only the tokens the assembly does not define are asked for, once.
    assert asked == [[0x0A000010, 0x0A000011]]
    assert progress == [(0, 4), (4, 4)]
    targets = index["targets"]
    calls = dict((caller, [(opcode, targets[target][2]) for opcode, target in listed])
                 for caller, listed in index["calls"])
    # The unresolvable newobj is left out.
    assert calls == {
        0x06000001: [("call", "Game.Loader:LoadBin (string)"),
                     ("callvirt", "System.Text.Encoding:GetString (byte[])"),
                     ("ldftn", "Game.Loader:<Load>b__0 ()")],
        0x06000004: [("call", "Game.Loader:LoadBin (string)")]}


def test_callees_callers_and_the_body_of_an_async_method():
    index = build_call_index("Assembly-CSharp", _CLASSES,
                             lambda tokens: {0x06000004: _CODE[:6]},
                             lambda tokens: [None] * len(tokens))
    methods = {m.token: m for m in catalog_methods("Assembly-CSharp", _CLASSES)}
    load, load_bin, move_next = methods[0x06000001], methods[0x06000002], methods[0x06000004]

    # Load's body is in <Load>d__4.MoveNext.
    assert async_owner(move_next) == (_LOADER, "Load")
    assert async_owner(load) is None
    assert state_machines(load, methods.values()) == [move_next]

    lookup = lambda assembly, token: methods.get(token)  # pylint: disable=unnecessary-lambda-assignment
    assert callees_of(index, load, lookup) == []
    assert callees_of(index, move_next, lookup) == [Call("call", load_bin)]
    assert callers_in(index, load_bin, methods) == [Call("call", move_next)]
    assert callers_in(index, load, methods) == []


def test_a_generic_instance_keeps_its_signature():
    index = {"targets": [["mscorlib", 0x0600000e, "System.Collections.Generic.List`1<int>:Add (int)"]],
             "calls": [[0x06000001, [["callvirt", 0]]]]}
    definition = CatalogMethod("mscorlib", "System.Collections.Generic.List<T>", "Add", "(T)",
                               "System.Void", False, 0x0600000e,
                               "System.Collections.Generic.List`1:Add (T)")
    caller = CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", _LOADER, "Load", "()", "System.Void", False,
                           0x06000001, "Game.Loader:Load ()")
    [call] = callees_of(index, caller, lambda assembly, token: definition)
    assert call.method.signature == "System.Collections.Generic.List`1<int>:Add (int)"
    assert call.method.token == 0x0600000e


def test_dialog_navigates_and_searches_callers(monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,too-many-locals
    import os
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.engines.registry import engine_by_id
    from grembyte.features.call_graph import CallGraphWorker
    from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.call_graph import CallGraphDialog

    _app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    asked = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(CallGraphWorker, "start", lambda self: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(CallGraphWorker, "callees",
                        lambda self, method: asked.append(("callees", method.name)) or len(asked))
    monkeypatch.setattr(CallGraphWorker, "callers",
                        lambda self, method: asked.append(("callers", method.name)) or len(asked))
    methods = {m.token: m for m in catalog_methods("Assembly-CSharp", _CLASSES)}
    load, load_bin, move_next = methods[0x06000001], methods[0x06000002], methods[0x06000004]

    dialog = CallGraphDialog(load_translations("de"), 4242, load, engine=engine_by_id("mono"))
    monitored = []
    dialog.monitor_requested.connect(monitored.append)
    try:
        assert asked == [("callees", "Load")]
        dialog._worker.callees_found.emit(1, load, [], [Call("call", load_bin)])
        assert dialog.callees_table.item(0, 0).text() == "call · async"
        assert dialog.callees_table.item(0, 1).text() == "Game.Loader:LoadBin (string)"
        assert "async-Teil" in dialog.status_label.text()

        # Callers: searched once, then for every method gone to.
        dialog.callers_button.click()
        dialog._worker.progress.emit(0, 2, "Assembly-CSharp")
        assert "Assembly-CSharp (0 von 2)" in dialog.callers_progress.format()
        dialog._worker.callers_found.emit(2, load, [Call("call", move_next)], [])
        assert dialog.callers_table.item(0, 1).text() == "Game.Loader:Load (async)"

        dialog.callees_table.setCurrentCell(0, 1)
        dialog.monitor_button.click()
        assert monitored == [load_bin]
        dialog.callees_table.cellDoubleClicked.emit(0, 1)
        assert dialog.method == load_bin and asked[-2:] == [("callees", "LoadBin"),
                                                            ("callers", "LoadBin")]
        # An answer for the method left behind is not shown.
        dialog._worker.callees_found.emit(1, load, [Call("call", load_bin)], [])
        assert dialog.callees_table.rowCount() == 0

        dialog.back_button.click()
        assert dialog.method == load and dialog.forward_button.isEnabled()
        dialog.forward_button.click()
        assert dialog.method == load_bin and not dialog.forward_button.isEnabled()
    finally:
        dialog.close()


def test_an_index_made_with_other_builds_is_made_anew():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.features.call_graph import read_call_index

    made = []

    def build():
        made.append(len(made))
        return {"targets": [["DOTween", 0x06000001, "DG.Tween:Kill ()"],
                            ["UnityEngine.CoreModule", 0x06000123, "UnityEngine.Object:Destroy ()"]],
                "calls": [[0x06000001, [["call", 1]]]]}

    game_a = {"DOTween": "dotween", "UnityEngine.CoreModule": "unity-2021"}
    index = read_call_index("mono", "DOTween", "dotween", game_a, build)
    # Its own assembly is not a reference.
    assert index["references"] == {"UnityEngine.CoreModule": "unity-2021"}
    read_call_index("mono", "DOTween", "dotween", game_a, build)
    assert made == [0]  # from the cache

    # The same DOTween in a game with another UnityEngine
    game_b = {"DOTween": "dotween", "UnityEngine.CoreModule": "unity-2022"}
    index = read_call_index("mono", "DOTween", "dotween", game_b, build)
    assert made == [0, 1]
    assert index["references"] == {"UnityEngine.CoreModule": "unity-2022"}
    read_call_index("mono", "DOTween", "dotween", game_b, build)
    assert made == [0, 1]
```

`tests/test_catalog_cache.py`:

```py
"""The catalog cache: one file per assembly build, keyed by its MVID."""

import gzip
import os
import time

from grembyte.features import catalog_cache

_CLASSES = [["Game.Loot", [["Take", "(int&,int)", "System.Void", True, 0x06000002,
                            "Game.Loot:Take (int&,int)"]]]]
_MVID = "6F9619FF-8B86-D011-B42D-00C04FC964FF"


def test_stored_classes_come_back_for_the_same_build(tmp_path):
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, _CLASSES, tmp_path)

    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, tmp_path) == _CLASSES
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "another build", tmp_path) is None
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp.Other", _MVID, tmp_path) is None
    assert catalog_cache.load("il2cpp", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, tmp_path) is None


def test_builds_of_one_name_stay_side_by_side(tmp_path):
    # Two games, each with its Assembly-CSharp
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-a", _CLASSES, tmp_path)
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-b", [], tmp_path)
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-b", {"targets": []}, tmp_path,
                        kind=catalog_cache.CALLS)

    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-a", tmp_path) == _CLASSES
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-b", tmp_path) == []
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "game-b", tmp_path,
                              kind=catalog_cache.CALLS) == {"targets": []}


def test_unused_files_are_pruned(tmp_path):
    for mvid in ("old", "used", "new"):
        catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", mvid, _CLASSES, tmp_path)
    folder = tmp_path / "mono" / "Assembly-CSharp"
    long_ago = time.time() - (catalog_cache.MAX_AGE_DAYS + 1) * 24 * 3600
    for mvid in ("old", "used"):
        os.utime(folder / f"{mvid}.json.gz", (long_ago, long_ago))
    (folder / "lost.json.gz.part").write_bytes(b"")
    os.utime(folder / "lost.json.gz.part", (long_ago, long_ago))
    # Reading a file counts as using it.
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", "used", tmp_path) == _CLASSES

    catalog_cache.prune(tmp_path)
    assert sorted(path.name for path in folder.iterdir()) == ["new.json.gz", "used.json.gz"]


def test_assemblies_without_mvid_are_not_cached(tmp_path):
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", None, _CLASSES, tmp_path)

    assert not any(tmp_path.iterdir())
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", None, tmp_path) is None


def test_odd_names_stay_inside_the_cache(tmp_path):
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "../evil/name", "a/b", _CLASSES, tmp_path / "cache")

    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "../evil/name", "a/b", tmp_path / "cache") == _CLASSES
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "..", "..", _CLASSES, tmp_path / "cache")
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "..", "..", tmp_path / "cache") == _CLASSES
    assert [path.name for path in tmp_path.iterdir()] == ["cache"]


def test_damaged_or_foreign_files_are_ignored(tmp_path):
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, _CLASSES, tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / "mono" / "Assembly-CSharp" / f"{_MVID}.json.gz"

    path.write_bytes(b"not gzip")
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, tmp_path) is None
    with gzip.open(path, "wt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
        file.write('{"format": 0, "assembly": "Assembly-CSharp", "classes": []}')
    assert catalog_cache.load("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, tmp_path) is None


def test_the_cache_lies_in_grembyte_cache_dir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_CACHE_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    catalog_cache.store("mono", "Assembly-CSharp", _MVID, _CLASSES)

    assert catalog_cache.cache_dir() == tmp_path
    assert (tmp_path / "mono" / "Assembly-CSharp" / f"{_MVID}.json.gz").is_file()
```

`tests/test_chain_score.py`:

```py
"""Scores of pointer chains (grembyte/core/chain_score.py)."""

from grembyte.core import memory_regions
from grembyte.core.chain_score import ranked, score
from grembyte.core.pointer import PointerChain


def test_short_chains_with_small_offsets_from_the_game_score_best():
    small = PointerChain("Game.exe", 0x123456, (0x20, 0x18))
    large = PointerChain("Game.exe", 0x123456, (0xF80, 0xE40))

    assert score(small, memory_regions.MAIN).total == 40 + 10 + 10 + 10
    assert score(large, memory_regions.MAIN).total == 40 + 10 + 0 + 10
    assert score(small, memory_regions.SYSTEM).total == 0 + 10 + 10 + 10
    assert score(PointerChain("Game.exe", 0x10, (0x300,)), memory_regions.GAME).parts == (
        ("start", 30, "game"), ("length", 20, 1), ("offsets", 5, 0x400), ("aligned", 10, None))


def test_length_points_fall_with_every_step():
    totals = [score(PointerChain("m", 0, (0x8,) * steps), None).total for steps in range(1, 8)]

    assert totals == [t + 20 for t in (20, 10, 0, -5, -10, -15, -15)]


def test_a_pointer_into_the_middle_of_an_object_is_not_aligned():
    # the offset after a pointer tells where in the object the next pointer is
    inner = PointerChain("m", 0, (0x14, 0x8))
    last = PointerChain("m", 0, (0x10, 0x4))  # the last offset leads to the value itself

    assert "aligned" not in [part[0] for part in score(inner, None).parts]
    assert "aligned" in [part[0] for part in score(last, None).parts]
    # 32-bit programs align to 4 bytes
    assert "aligned" in [part[0] for part in score(inner, None, pointer_size=4).parts]


def test_ranked_puts_the_best_first_and_keeps_ties_in_order():
    system = PointerChain("libc.so.6", 0x10, (0x8,))
    first = PointerChain("game", 0x10, (0x8, 0x10))
    second = PointerChain("game", 0x18, (0x8, 0x10))
    unknown = PointerChain("gone.dll", 0x10, (0x8,))
    categories = {"game": memory_regions.MAIN, "libc.so.6": memory_regions.SYSTEM}

    order = [chain for chain, _score in ranked([system, first, unknown, second], categories)]

    assert order == [first, second, system, unknown]
```

`tests/test_cli.py`:

```py
"""grembyte-cli: starting a game and installing what is saved for it."""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from grembyte import cli
from tests.test_hooks import requires_target


def test_split_arguments_takes_options_before_the_command():
    assert cli.split_arguments(["--delay", "2", "/game", "--delay", "9"]) == (
        2.0, False, ["/game", "--delay", "9"])
    assert cli.split_arguments(["--delay=0.5", "--", "-game"]) == (0.5, False, ["-game"])
    assert cli.split_arguments(["-h"]) == (cli.DEFAULT_DELAY_S, True, [])
    # Whatever is typed, the command is kept and the delay stays sane.
    assert cli.split_arguments(["--delay", "soon", "/game"]) == (
        cli.DEFAULT_DELAY_S, False, ["/game"])
    assert cli.split_arguments(["--delay", "-3", "/game"]) == (
        cli.DEFAULT_DELAY_S, False, ["/game"])


def test_clean_environment_drops_steams_loader_settings():
    environ = {"LD_PRELOAD": "gameoverlayrenderer.so", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH": "/runtime",
               "SteamAppId": "123", "HOME": "/home/me"}
    assert cli.needs_clean_environment(environ)
    assert not cli.needs_clean_environment({"LD_PRELOAD": "", "HOME": "/home/me"})
    assert cli.clean_environment(environ, 42) == {
        "SteamAppId": "123", "HOME": "/home/me", cli.CHILD_ENV: "42"}


def test_exit_code_follows_the_shell():
    assert cli.exit_code(7 << 8) == 7
    assert cli.exit_code(15) == 128 + 15  # killed by SIGTERM


@pytest.mark.skipif(not sys.platform.startswith("linux"), reason="reads /proc")
def test_launched_processes_are_found_by_their_environment():
    pid = cli.start_command(["sh", "-c", "sleep 30 & wait"])
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        found = []
        while time.monotonic() < deadline and len(found) < 2:
            found = cli.launched_pids(os.getpid())
            time.sleep(0.05)
        # The shell and the sleep it started, which could outlive it
        assert pid in found and len(found) == 2
        assert set(found) <= {pid, *cli.descendant_pids(os.getpid())}
    finally:
        subprocess.run(["pkill", "-P", str(pid)], check=False)
        os.kill(pid, 15)
        os.waitpid(pid, 0)


def test_anti_cheat_is_found_up_to_the_game_folder(tmp_path):
    game = tmp_path / "steamapps" / "common" / "Game"
    binaries = game / "Binaries" / "Win64"
    binaries.mkdir(parents=True)
    proc = tmp_path / "proc" / "1"
    proc.mkdir(parents=True)
    os.symlink(binaries, proc / "cwd")
    assert cli.anti_cheat(1, proc_root=tmp_path / "proc") is None
    (game / "EasyAntiCheat").mkdir()
    assert cli.anti_cheat(1, proc_root=tmp_path / "proc") == str(game / "EasyAntiCheat")
    # Not beyond the game's own folder
    shutil.rmtree(game / "EasyAntiCheat")
    (tmp_path / "steamapps" / "common" / "BattlEye").mkdir()
    assert cli.anti_cheat(1, proc_root=tmp_path / "proc") is None


def test_without_a_command_it_shows_how_to_use_it(capsys):
    assert cli.main([]) == 2
    assert "%command%" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_the_window_finds_the_grembyte_cli_of_a_game(tmp_path):
    from grembyte.core import cli_link  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel

    proc = tmp_path / "proc"
    folder = tmp_path / "run"
    folder.mkdir()

    def process(pid, cmdline, environ=""):
        (proc / str(pid)).mkdir(parents=True)
        (proc / str(pid) / "cmdline").write_bytes(cmdline.replace(" ", "\0").encode())
        (proc / str(pid) / "environ").write_bytes(environ.replace(" ", "\0").encode())

    process(10, "/usr/bin/python3 -m grembyte.cli --delay 5")
    process(20, "/venv/bin/python /venv/bin/grembyte-cli /game")
    process(11, "/game", f"{cli_link.LAUNCHER_ENV}=10 HOME=/home/me")
    process(12, "/launcher", f"{cli_link.LAUNCHER_ENV}=10")
    process(21, "/other", f"{cli_link.LAUNCHER_ENV}=20")
    cli_link.write_state({"pid": 10, "game_pid": 11, "state": "attached"}, folder)
    cli_link.write_state({"pid": 20, "game_pid": None, "state": "searching"}, folder)
    # Left by a grembyte-cli that was killed; its pid now runs something else
    process(30, "/usr/bin/bash")
    cli_link.write_state({"pid": 30, "game_pid": 31, "state": "attached"}, folder)

    def find(pid):
        state = cli_link.find_cli(pid, folder, proc)
        return state and state["pid"]

    assert find(11) == 10
    # Another process of a launch whose CLI found its game, and a CLI that is gone
    assert find(12) is None and find(31) is None
    # Before its CLI has found the game
    assert find(21) == 20
    assert set(cli_link.cli_games(folder, proc)) == {11}


# --- integration: grembyte-cli starts a game with a saved hook -------------

_GAME_SOURCE = r"""
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>

typedef struct { int32_t gold; } Character;
Character g_player = { 0 };

volatile int g_events;

/* g_events gives the hook room for its jump after the write. */
__attribute__((noinline)) void add_gold(Character *c, int32_t amount) {
    c->gold += amount;
    g_events++;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    /* Earns 1 gold every 20 ms; the saved hook makes it 100. */
    int goal = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 1000;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1500; i++) {
        add_gold(&g_player, 1);
        if (g_player.gold >= goal) {
            printf("rich %d\n", g_player.gold);
            return 3;
        }
        usleep(20000);
    }
    printf("poor %d\n", g_player.gold);
    return 4;
}
"""


def _save_profile(database, binary):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from grembyte.db.engine import init_db
    from grembyte.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from grembyte.hooks.transforms import MultiplyTransform

    listing = subprocess.run(["nm", str(binary)], check=True, capture_output=True,
                             text=True).stdout
    offset = next(int(line.split()[0], 16) for line in listing.splitlines()
                  if line.split()[-1] == "add_gold")
    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{database}")
    init_db(engine)
    repository = HookRepository(sessionmaker(bind=engine))
    # Named as the process list names a native program: its name and path
    process_id = repository.get_or_create_process(binary.name, os.path.realpath(binary))
    with open(binary, "rb") as program:
        program.seek(offset)
        code = program.read(2).hex()
    assert code == "0137", "add_gold should start with add [rdi], esi"
    repository.add_hook(process_id, label="Gold", module=binary.name, module_offset=offset,
                        instruction_bytes=code, instruction_text="add dword ptr [rdi], esi",
                        value_type="int32", transform=MultiplyTransform(100))
    engine.dispose()


@requires_target
def test_grembyte_cli_installs_the_saved_hooks_of_the_game_it_starts(tmp_path):
    binary = _build_game(tmp_path)
    database = tmp_path / "grembyte.db"
    _save_profile(database, binary)

    env = dict(_cli_env(tmp_path, database),
               # As Steam sets it: grembyte-cli executes itself anew without it.
               LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(tmp_path / "steam-runtime"))
    finished = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "grembyte.cli", "--delay", "0.2", str(binary)],
        env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False,
        cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    assert finished.returncode == 3, finished.stderr
    assert finished.stdout.startswith("rich "), finished.stdout
    assert 'Hook "Gold" is active.' in finished.stderr
    assert "Attaching to game" in finished.stderr


def _build_game(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "game.c").write_text(_GAME_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "game"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O2", "-fPIE", "-pie", str(tmp_path / "game.c"), "-o", str(binary)],
                   check=True)
    return binary


def _cli_env(tmp_path, database):
    return dict(os.environ, GREMBYTE_DB=str(database), GREMBYTE_LOG_DIR=str(tmp_path / "logs"),
                GREMBYTE_LANGUAGE="en", XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=str(tmp_path / "run"))


@requires_target
def test_the_window_takes_the_game_over_and_gives_it_back(tmp_path):
    from grembyte.core import cli_link  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.platform import frida_agents  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel

    binary = _build_game(tmp_path)
    database = tmp_path / "grembyte.db"
    _save_profile(database, binary)
    folder = tmp_path / "run" / "grembyte"
    lines = []
    with subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "grembyte.cli", "--delay", "0.2", str(binary), "999999999"],
            env=_cli_env(tmp_path, database), stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
            cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]) as launch:
        reader = threading.Thread(target=lambda: lines.extend(launch.stderr), daemon=True)
        reader.start()

        def wait_for(text, count=1):
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while sum(text in line for line in lines) < count:
                assert time.monotonic() < deadline and launch.poll() is None, "".join(lines)
                time.sleep(0.05)

        try:
            wait_for('Hook "Gold" is active.')
            (state,) = cli_link.running_clis(folder)
            game_pid = state["game_pid"]
            assert state["state"] == cli_link.STATE_ATTACHED
            assert cli_link.find_cli(game_pid, folder) == state
            assert set(cli_link.cli_games(folder)) == {game_pid}

            claim = cli_link.claim(state, game_pid, folder=folder)
            # Its agent is gone: the window may attach on its own.
            assert not frida_agents(game_pid)
            assert cli_link.find_cli(game_pid, folder)["state"] == cli_link.STATE_RELEASED

            claim.release()
            wait_for('Hook "Gold" is active.', count=2)
            assert cli_link.find_cli(game_pid, folder)["state"] == cli_link.STATE_ATTACHED
        finally:
            launch.terminate()  # passed on to the game, as Steam ends it
            code = launch.wait(timeout=30)
            reader.join(timeout=5)
    assert code == 128 + 15, "".join(lines)
    # grembyte-cli cleans up after itself.
    assert not list(folder.iterdir())


def test_scripts_that_run_by_time_or_by_a_hotkey_are_started():
    from types import SimpleNamespace  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel

    rows = [SimpleNamespace(mode=mode, hotkey=hotkey) for mode, hotkey in (
        ("manual", None), ("repeat", None), ("once", None), ("manual", "Ctrl+G"))]
    assert [(row.mode, row.hotkey) for row in cli.cli_scripts(rows)] == [
        ("repeat", None), ("once", None), ("manual", "Ctrl+G")]


def test_grembyte_cli_runs_manual_scripts_by_their_hotkeys(monkeypatch, capsys):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    import itertools
    from types import SimpleNamespace

    from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.core import messages
    from grembyte.features import scripts
    from grembyte.platform import keyboard as keyboard_module
    from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
    from tests.test_hotkeys import FakeKeyboard

    messages.use(load_translations("en"))

    class Signals(QObject):  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        worker_failed = Signal(str)
        script_added = Signal(int)
        script_failed = Signal(int, str)
        script_ran = Signal(int, object)

    class FakeWorker:
        ids = itertools.count(1)

        def __init__(self, _pid, language="en"):
            self.signals = Signals()
            for name in ("worker_failed", "script_added", "script_failed", "script_ran"):
                setattr(self, name, getattr(self.signals, name))
            self.runs = []

        def start(self):
            pass

        def add_script(self, _spec):
            return next(self.ids)

        def run_now(self, script_id, args=None):
            self.runs.append((script_id, args))

        def requestInterruption(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
            pass

        def wait(self, _ms):
            pass

        def isRunning(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
            return False

    keyboard = FakeKeyboard(focused=4242)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", FakeWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(keyboard_module, "open_reader", lambda: keyboard)

    def row(row_id, label, mode, hotkey=None, enabled=True):
        return SimpleNamespace(id=row_id, label=label, source="return 1;", mode=mode,
                               seconds=5.0, enabled=enabled, params=None, hotkey=hotkey)

    rows = [row(1, "Gold", "manual", "Ctrl+G"), row(2, "Heal", "manual"),
            row(3, "Paused", "manual", "F9", enabled=False), row(4, "Tick", "repeat")]
    repository = SimpleNamespace(list_scripts=lambda _process_id: rows)
    game = cli.AttachedGame(4242, "PillarsOfEternity", 1, None, repository)
    game._start("scripts")
    try:
        worker = game.workers["scripts"]
        assert game.hotkeys is not None and game.hotkeyed == {1: "Ctrl+G"}
        game.hotkeys.poll()
        keyboard.down = {"ctrl", "G"}
        game.hotkeys.poll()
        assert worker.runs == [(1, None)]
        worker.script_ran.emit(1, {"result": "Gold +1000", "error": None})
        worker.script_added.emit(1)
    finally:
        game.stop()
    assert keyboard.closed
    output = capsys.readouterr().err
    assert 'Ctrl+G: running script "Gold".' in output
    assert 'Script "Gold": Gold +1000' in output
    assert 'Script "Gold" runs on Ctrl+G.' in output
```
