from tests.test_hooks import fixture_qt_app, fixture_translations  # pylint: disable=unused-import


def _press(editor, key):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtTest import QTest  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    QTest.keyClick(editor, key)


def test_tab_indents_by_two_spaces_and_shift_tab_outdents(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtGui import QTextCursor  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import CodeEditor

    editor = CodeEditor("a\nb\nc")
    cursor = editor.textCursor()
    cursor.setPosition(0)
    editor.setTextCursor(cursor)
    _press(editor, Qt.Key.Key_Tab)
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "  a\nb\nc"

    # Several lines: each one; a selection ending at a line's start leaves it out
    cursor.setPosition(0)
    cursor.setPosition(editor.document().findBlockByNumber(2).position(),
                       QTextCursor.MoveMode.KeepAnchor)
    editor.setTextCursor(cursor)
    _press(editor, Qt.Key.Key_Tab)
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "    a\n  b\nc"
    _press(editor, Qt.Key.Key_Backtab)
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "  a\nb\nc"
    _press(editor, Qt.Key.Key_Backtab)  # nothing left to remove in b
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "a\nb\nc"
    editor.undo()  # one step per key press
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "  a\nb\nc"

    # A tab pasted from elsewhere is outdented too, and only one indent wide
    editor.setPlainText("\tx")
    _press(editor, Qt.Key.Key_Backtab)
    assert editor.toPlainText() == "x"
    width = editor.fontMetrics().horizontalAdvance(" ")
    assert abs(editor.tabStopDistance() - 2 * width) < 1

def test_javascript_tokens_use_theme_colors(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from grembyte.ui.styles.themes import ThemeManager
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import CodeEditor

    manager = ThemeManager(user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes")
    colors = manager.load_theme("Solarized-Light")["colors"]
    editor = CodeEditor("const player = 'Hero';\nconst health = 42;")
    editor.highlighter.set_colors(colors)
    try:
        block = editor.document().firstBlock()
        formats = block.layout().formats()

        def color_at(position):
            return next(format_range.format.foreground().color().name()
                        for format_range in formats
                        if format_range.start <= position
                        < format_range.start + format_range.length)

        assert color_at(0) == colors["code_keyword"]
        assert color_at(block.text().index("'Hero'")) == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(len(block.text()) - 1) == colors["code_text"]
        editor.highlighter.rehighlight()
        number_block = editor.document().findBlockByNumber(1)
        number_range = next(format_range for format_range in number_block.layout().formats()
                            if format_range.start <= number_block.text().index("42")
                            < format_range.start + format_range.length)
        assert number_range.format.foreground().color().name() == colors["code_number"]
    finally:
        editor.close()

def test_markdown_syntax_and_fenced_code_use_theme_colors(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtGui import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
        QFont,
        QTextCharFormat,
    )
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QPlainTextEdit  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.styles.themes import ThemeManager
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import MarkdownHighlighter

    colors = ThemeManager(user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes").load_theme(
        "Solarized-Light")["colors"]
    editor = QPlainTextEdit("\n".join([
        "## Gold",
        "- call `AddGold(int)` **twice**, not snake_case_name",
        "```js",
        "const gold = 42; /* not",
        "done */ 'x'",
        "```",
        "```",
        "if (a) return 1;",
        "```",
        "after",
    ]))
    MarkdownHighlighter(editor.document(), colors)
    try:
        def format_at(block_number, token, offset=0):
            block = editor.document().findBlockByNumber(block_number)
            position = block.text().index(token) + offset
            for format_range in block.layout().formats():
                if format_range.start <= position < format_range.start + format_range.length:
                    return QTextCharFormat(format_range.format)
            return None

        def color_at(block_number, token, offset=0):
            return format_at(block_number, token, offset).foreground().color().name()

        assert color_at(0, "##") == colors["muted"]
        assert color_at(0, "Gold") == colors["code_keyword"]
        assert format_at(0, "Gold").fontWeight() == QFont.Weight.Bold
        assert color_at(1, "-") == colors["code_keyword"]
        assert color_at(1, "`") == colors["muted"]
        assert color_at(1, "AddGold") == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(1, "**") == colors["muted"]
        assert format_at(1, "twice").fontWeight() == QFont.Weight.Bold
        snake = format_at(1, "snake_case", 5)
        assert snake is None or not snake.fontItalic()
        assert color_at(2, "js") == colors["muted"]
        assert color_at(3, "const") == colors["code_keyword"]
        assert color_at(3, "42") == colors["code_number"]
        assert color_at(4, "done") == colors["muted"]  # the comment goes on
        assert color_at(4, "'x'") == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(7, "if") == colors["code_string"]  # no language: plain code
        assert format_at(9, "after") is None
    finally:
        editor.close()


def _markdown_formats(qt_app, lines):
    """The highlighted editor and ``format_at(line, token)`` for ``lines`` of Markdown."""
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtGui import QTextCharFormat  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QPlainTextEdit  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.styles.themes import ThemeManager
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_editor import MarkdownHighlighter

    colors = ThemeManager(user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes").load_theme(
        "Solarized-Light")["colors"]
    editor = QPlainTextEdit("\n".join(lines))
    editor.markdown_highlighter = MarkdownHighlighter(editor.document(), colors)

    def color_at(block_number, token):
        block = editor.document().findBlockByNumber(block_number)
        position = block.text().index(token)
        for format_range in block.layout().formats():
            if format_range.start <= position < format_range.start + format_range.length:
                return QTextCharFormat(format_range.format).foreground().color().name()
        return None

    return editor, colors, color_at


def test_markdown_fences_open_and_close_as_in_commonmark(qt_app):
    editor, colors, color_at = _markdown_formats(qt_app, [
        "```foo``` is a code span, not a fence",
        "plain",
        "````md",
        "```js",
        "inside",
        "```",
        "still inside",
        "````",
        "after",
        "~~~",
        "``` no end for tildes",
        "~~~~",
        "end",
    ])
    try:
        assert color_at(1, "plain") is None
        assert color_at(4, "inside") == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(6, "still") == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(8, "after") is None
        assert color_at(10, "no end") == colors["code_string"]
        assert color_at(12, "end") is None
    finally:
        editor.close()

```py
"""The code explorer: strings, references, functions and patterns of a module's file
(see grembyte/features/code_explorer.py)."""

# pylint: disable=protected-access

import shutil
import subprocess

import pytest

from grembyte.core import messages
from grembyte.features.code_explorer import (
    CALL,
    DATA,
    POINTER,
    CodeIndex,
    load_image,
    parse_location,
)
from grembyte.features.pseudocode import render as render_pseudocode

from tests.test_hooks import fixture_qt_app  # pylint: disable=unused-import


# A game's code in small: a message used by one function, called by two others,
# and a table of pointers to strings (like a list of command names)
_SOURCE = r"""
#include <stdio.h>

int counter;
const char *const commands[] = { "grembyte_cmd_heal", "grembyte_cmd_kill" };

__attribute__((noinline)) int use_message(int value) {
    puts("Grembyte marker: available only in debug mode.");
    counter += value;
    return counter;
}

__attribute__((noinline)) int first_caller(int value) { return use_message(value) + 1; }
__attribute__((noinline)) int second_caller(int value) { return use_message(value * 3) - 2; }

float scale;

__attribute__((noinline)) void set_scale(float value) { scale = value * 2.0f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    (void)argv;
    puts(commands[argc & 1]);
    set_scale((float)argc * 1.5f);
    return first_caller(argc) + second_caller(argc);
}
"""

requires_gcc = pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("gcc") is None, reason="needs gcc")
requires_mingw = pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc") is None,
                                    reason="needs x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc")


def _compile(tmp_path, compiler, output, *flags):
    source = tmp_path / "game.c"
    source.write_text(_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / output
    subprocess.run([compiler, "-O1", *flags, str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    return CodeIndex(load_image(str(binary)))


def _string(index, text):
    found = [address for address, string, _kind in index.strings if string == text]
    assert len(found) == 1, (text, found)
    return found[0]


def _check_index(index, symbols, rip=True):
    """What both formats must give for _SOURCE."""
    message = _string(index, "Grembyte marker: available only in debug mode.")
    refs = index.references(message)
    assert [ref.kind for ref in refs] == [DATA]
    use = index.function_at(refs[0].address)
    assert use is not None
    use = index.owner(use)
    if symbols:
        assert index.name(use.start) == "use_message"
        assert index.where(refs[0].address).startswith("use_message")
    # Called by both callers (the compiler may also inline nothing else)
    callers = {index.owner(index.function_at(ref.address)).start
               for ref in index.references(use.start) if ref.kind == CALL}
    assert len(callers) == 2
    # The command names are reached through a table of pointers
    heal = _string(index, "grembyte_cmd_heal")
    assert POINTER in {ref.kind for ref in index.references(heal)}

    # The function view names the string the instruction loads, and the
    # imported function it calls (through a PLT stub or an import slot)
    lines = index.disassemble(use)
    assert any(line.comment == '"Grembyte marker: available only in debug mode."'
               for line in lines)
    assert any(line.comment.split("!")[-1] == "puts" for line in lines), \
        [line.comment for line in lines]
    # A pattern for the function is unique, its RIP-relative parts wildcards
    pattern = index.pattern(use.start)
    assert pattern.matches == 1
    assert index.count_matches(pattern.text.split()) == 1
    loading = next(line for line in lines if line.target == message)
    assert "??" in index.pattern(loading.address).text.split()
    script = index.script(loading.address)
    # RIP-relative (position-independent) or an absolute address in the instruction
    assert "n.scan(" in script
    assert ("n.rip(at, " if rip else "readU32()") in script
    assert '"Grembyte marker' in script
    assert "n.fn(at" in index.script(use.start)
    # The pseudocode names the string and the import, the argument by the convention
    pseudocode = render_pseudocode(index, use)
    assert 'puts("Grembyte marker: available only in debug mode.");' in pseudocode
    assert ("(int32_t a1 /* rdi */)" if index.image.format == "elf"
            else "(int32_t a1 /* rcx */)") in pseudocode

    # Signatures guessed from the code, by the platform's calling convention
    linux = index.image.format == "elf"
    signature = index.signature(use.start)
    assert signature.convention == ("sysv" if linux else "win64")
    assert [(p.register, p.type) for p in signature.parameters] == \
        [("rdi" if linux else "rcx", "int")]
    assert (signature.returns, signature.returns_known) == ("int", True)  # callers add 1
    assert 'n.fn(at, "int", ["int"])' in index.script(use.start)
    if symbols:
        scale = parse_location("set_scale", index.image)
        signature = index.signature(scale)
        assert [(p.register, p.type) for p in signature.parameters] == [("xmm0", "float")]
        assert signature.returns == "void"
        assert signature.text("set_scale") == "void set_scale(float xmm0)"
    assert index.signature(use.start + 1) is None  # no function start
    return use


@requires_gcc
def test_an_elf_module_gives_strings_references_functions_and_patterns(tmp_path):
    index = _compile(tmp_path, "gcc", "game", "-fPIE", "-pie")
    image = index.image
    assert (image.format, image.bits, image.base) == ("elf", 64, 0)  # position-independent
    use = _check_index(index, symbols=True)

    assert parse_location("use_message", image) == use.start
    assert parse_location(f"game+0x{use.start:x}", image, module_name="game") == use.start
    assert parse_location(f"0x{use.start:x}", image) == use.start
    # A runtime address of the module loaded at 0x555555554000
    assert parse_location(f"0x{0x555555554000 + use.start:x}", image,
                          module_base=0x555555554000) == use.start
    assert parse_location("no_such_symbol", image) is None

@pytest.mark.parametrize("symbol_path", [None, "local-symbols"])
def test_local_pe_symbols_enrich_names_without_replacing_exports(monkeypatch, symbol_path):
    from grembyte.features import code_explorer

    image = code_explorer.Image("game.exe", "pe", 64, 0x140000000, b"\xc3" * 0x100)
    image.sections.append(code_explorer.Section(
        ".text", image.base + 0x1000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, True, False))
    image.functions.append(code_explorer.Function(image.base + 0x1010, image.base + 0x1011))
    image.names[image.base + 0x1000] = "exported"
    calls = []

    def symbols(path, base, size, folder):
        calls.append((path, base, size, folder))
        return {base + 0x1000: "alias", base + 0x1010: "buy_item"}

    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer, "load_pe_symbols", symbols)
    code_explorer._pe_symbols(image, symbol_path)
    assert calls == [("game.exe", image.base, 0x1100, symbol_path)]
    assert image.names == {image.base + 0x1000: "exported",
                           image.base + 0x1010: "buy_item"}
    index = CodeIndex(image)
    function = index.function_starting(image.base + 0x1010)
    assert index.name(function.start) == "buy_item"
    assert index.where(function.start) == "buy_item"
    assert parse_location("buy_item", image) == function.start
    assert "buy_item(" in render_pseudocode(index, function)


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("qt_app")
def test_symbol_folder_rebuilds_a_cached_module(monkeypatch):
    from grembyte.features.code_explorer import Image, ModuleChoice
    from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import code_explorer

    image = Image("game.exe", "pe", 64, 0x140000000, b"")
    index = CodeIndex(image)
    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer, "cached_index", lambda _path: index)
    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer, "process_modules", lambda _pid: [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer.QFileDialog, "getExistingDirectory",
                        lambda *_args: "local-symbols")
    worker = code_explorer.CodeIndexWorker("game.exe", symbol_path="local-symbols")
    started = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(worker, "start", lambda: started.append(worker.symbol_path))
    calls = []

    def make_worker(path, *, symbol_path):
        calls.append((path, symbol_path))
        return worker

    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer, "CodeIndexWorker", make_worker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(code_explorer, "keep_until_finished", lambda _worker: None)
    dialog = code_explorer.CodeExplorerDialog(load_translations("en"))
    try:
        assert not dialog.symbols_button.isEnabled()
        dialog._load(ModuleChoice("game.exe", "game.exe", None))
        assert dialog.index is index
        assert dialog.symbols_button.isEnabled()
        assert "0 named addresses" in dialog.status_label.text()
        dialog._open_symbols()
        assert calls == [("game.exe", "local-symbols")]
        assert started == ["local-symbols"]
        assert dialog.index is None
        assert not dialog.symbols_button.isEnabled()
    finally:
        dialog.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", [None, "initialize", "load", "enumerate"])
def test_dbghelp_symbols_are_scoped_and_resources_are_released(monkeypatch, failure):
    import ctypes
    from types import SimpleNamespace

    from grembyte.platform import symbols

    class NativeCall:
        def __init__(self, function):
            self.function = function

        def __call__(self, *arguments):
            return self.function(*arguments)

    options = []
    cleaned = []
    closed = []
    initialized = []
    loaded = []
    base = 0x140000000

    def initialize(handle, path, invade):
        initialized.append((handle, path, invade))
        return failure != "initialize"

    def load(*arguments):
        loaded.append(arguments)
        return 0 if failure == "load" else base

    def enumerate_symbols(handle, module, mask, callback, context):
        assert (handle, module, mask, context) == (123, base, None, None)
        for address, tag, name in [(base + 0x10, 5, "heal_\u00e4"),
                                   (base + 0x20, 7, "gold"),
                                   (base + 0x30, 10, "public_name"),
                                   (base + 0x40, 3, "local"),
                                   (base + 0x1000, 5, "outside")]:
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(name)
            offset = symbols._SymbolInfo.Name.offset
            buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(max(
                ctypes.sizeof(symbols._SymbolInfo), offset + ctypes.sizeof(text)))
            info = symbols._SymbolInfo.from_buffer(buffer)
            info.Address, info.Tag, info.NameLen = address, tag, len(name)
            ctypes.memmove(ctypes.addressof(buffer) + offset, text, ctypes.sizeof(text))
            assert callback(ctypes.pointer(info), 0, None)
        return failure != "enumerate"

    kernel = SimpleNamespace(
        CreateEventW=NativeCall(lambda *_arguments: 123),
        CloseHandle=NativeCall(lambda handle: closed.append(handle) or True))
    dbghelp = SimpleNamespace(
        SymGetOptions=NativeCall(lambda: 0x40),
        SymSetOptions=NativeCall(lambda value: options.append(value) or value),
        SymInitializeW=NativeCall(initialize),
        SymCleanup=NativeCall(lambda handle: cleaned.append(handle) or True),
        SymLoadModuleExW=NativeCall(load),
        SymEnumSymbolsW=NativeCall(enumerate_symbols))
    monkeypatch.setattr(ctypes, "WinDLL", lambda name, **_kwargs:
                        kernel if name == "kernel32" else dbghelp, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ctypes, "WINFUNCTYPE", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE, raising=False)

    result = symbols._load_symbols("game.exe", base, 0x100, "local-symbols")
    assert result == ({} if failure else {base + 0x10: "heal_\u00e4",
                                         base + 0x20: "gold",
                                         base + 0x30: "public_name"})
    assert initialized == [(123, "local-symbols", False)]
    if failure != "initialize":
        assert loaded == [(123, None, "game.exe", None, base, 0x100, None, 0)]
    assert cleaned == ([] if failure == "initialize" else [123])
    assert closed == [123]
    assert options[-1] == 0x40
    assert options[0] & symbols._SYMOPT_EXACT_SYMBOLS
    assert options[0] & symbols._SYMOPT_IGNORE_NT_SYMPATH
    assert not options[0] & 0x40


def test_pe_symbols_are_optional_without_windows(monkeypatch):
    from grembyte.platform import symbols

    monkeypatch.setattr(symbols.sys, "platform", "linux")
    assert symbols.load_pe_symbols("game.exe", 0x140000000, 0x1000) == {}


@requires_gcc
def test_the_window_leads_from_a_string_to_its_function_and_back(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    import time

    from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.code_explorer import CodeExplorerDialog, ModuleChoice

    source = tmp_path / "game.c"
    source.write_text(_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "game"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O1", "-fPIE", "-pie", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    translations = load_translations("en")
    dialog = CodeExplorerDialog(translations)  # no game attached
    try:
        assert dialog.status_label.text() == translations["code.no_process"]
        assert not dialog.monitor_button.isEnabled()
        dialog._load(ModuleChoice("game", str(binary), None))
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while dialog.index is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            qt_app.processEvents()
            time.sleep(0.01)
        assert dialog.index is not None, dialog.status_label.text()

        # A named global: its module offset, where a pointer chain would start
        dialog.goto_input.setText("counter")
        dialog._goto()
        counter = parse_location("counter", dialog.index.image)
        assert f"(counter, game+0x{counter - dialog.index.image.base:x})" in \
            dialog.refs_label.text()

        # A C# method as the write watch names JIT code, and an address outside the file
        dialog.goto_input.setText("Scripts:GivePlayerMoney+0x61")
        dialog._goto()
        assert "managed code (C#)" in dialog.status_label.text()
        dialog.goto_input.setText("0x7f3a1c2044b0")
        dialog._goto()
        assert "lies in no file of this module" in dialog.status_label.text()

        dialog.string_filter.setText("marker debug")
        assert dialog.string_model.rowCount() == 1
        dialog._string_activated(dialog.string_model.index(0, 0))
        assert dialog.ref_model.rowCount() == 1
        dialog._reference_activated(dialog.ref_model.index(0, 0))
        assert dialog.function_label.text().startswith("use_message:")
        # The pseudocode is rendered when its tab is shown, at the selected instruction
        loading = dialog._selected_address()
        assert dialog.pseudocode_view.toPlainText() == ""
        dialog.function_tabs.setCurrentWidget(dialog.pseudocode_page)
        assert "int32_t use_message(" in dialog.pseudocode_view.toPlainText()
        assert "puts(" in dialog.pseudocode_view.textCursor().block().text()
        # Finding a text moves to it, and selects its instruction in the assembler
        dialog.find_input.setText("return")
        assert "return" in dialog.pseudocode_view.textCursor().block().text()
        returned = dialog._selected_line()
        assert returned.address > loading
        dialog.find_input.setText("no such text")
        assert dialog.find_status.text() == "Not found"
        dialog.find_input.clear()
        dialog.function_tabs.setCurrentWidget(dialog.line_view)
        dialog._show_function(loading, loading, remember=False)
        selected = dialog._selected_address()
        assert dialog.index.where(selected).startswith("use_message+")

        dialog._copy_pattern()
        assert "??" in QGuiApplication.clipboard().text()
        assert "unique" in dialog.status_label.text()
        # Without a process there is no runtime address to monitor
        assert not dialog.monitor_button.isEnabled()

        dialog._show_callers()
        assert dialog.ref_model.rowCount() == 2
        dialog._reference_activated(dialog.ref_model.index(0, 0))
        assert dialog.function_label.text().split(":")[0] in ("first_caller", "second_caller")
        dialog._back()
        assert dialog.function_label.text().startswith("use_message:")

        dialog.goto_input.setText("main")
        dialog._goto()
        assert dialog.function_label.text().startswith("main:")
    finally:
        dialog.close()
```

```py
"""Deleting entries saved for processes, and its window."""

from sqlalchemy import select

from grembyte.db.models import Address, AssemblySelectionRecord, Hook, PointerScan, Process

from tests.test_game_export import (  # pylint: disable=unused-import
    PROTON_EXP,
    PROTON_GE,
    _process_id,
    fixture_qt_app,
    fixture_repository,
    fixture_sessions,
    fixture_translations,

def _count(sessions, model, *where):
    with sessions() as session:
        return len(list(session.scalars(select(model).where(*where))))


def test_deleting_addresses_takes_their_pointer_scans(sessions, repository):
    souls = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_GE)
    assert repository.delete_entries(souls, ["addresses"]) == {"addresses": 1, "pointer_scans": 1}
    assert _count(sessions, PointerScan) == 0
    assert _count(sessions, Process, Process.id == souls) == 1


def test_only_the_chosen_kinds_go(sessions, repository):
    souls = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_GE)
    assert repository.delete_entries(souls, ["pointer_scans"]) == {"pointer_scans": 1}
    assert _count(sessions, Address, Address.process_id == souls) == 1


def test_removing_a_process_takes_everything_saved_for_it(sessions, repository):
    other = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_EXP)
    with sessions() as session:
        session.add(AssemblySelectionRecord(process_id=other, name="Assembly-CSharp"))
        session.commit()
    deleted = repository.delete_entries(other, [], remove_process=True)
    assert deleted["hooks"] == 1 and deleted["process"] == 1
    assert _count(sessions, Process, Process.id == other) == 0
    assert _count(sessions, Hook) == 0
    assert _count(sessions, AssemblySelectionRecord) == 0
    # The game's other process stays.
    assert _count(sessions, Address) == 1


def test_dialog_ticks_rows_and_deletes(qt_app, translations, sessions, repository, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.database_entries import (
        KIND_COLUMNS,
        PROCESS_COLUMN,
        ROW_COLUMN,
        DeleteEntriesDialog,
    )

    souls = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_GE)
    dialog = DeleteEntriesDialog(translations, repository, current=souls)
    rows = {process.process_id: row for row, process in enumerate(dialog.processes)}
    row = rows[souls]
    table = dialog.table
    assert not dialog.delete_button.isEnabled()
    # The attached process cannot be removed; counts of 0 cannot be ticked.
    assert not table.item(row, PROCESS_COLUMN).flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable
    assert not table.item(row, KIND_COLUMNS["hooks"]).flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable

    # Addresses take their pointer scans along, and all boxes tick the row's box.
    table.item(row, KIND_COLUMNS["addresses"]).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    assert table.item(row, KIND_COLUMNS["pointer_scans"]).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked
    assert table.item(row, ROW_COLUMN).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked
    table.item(row, ROW_COLUMN).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
    assert dialog.selection() == []

    other = rows[_process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_EXP)]
    table.item(other, PROCESS_COLUMN).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    assert table.item(other, KIND_COLUMNS["hooks"]).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked
    table.item(row, KIND_COLUMNS["pointer_scans"]).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    assert dialog.delete_button.isEnabled()

    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "question", lambda *_args: QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
    dialog.delete_button.click()
    assert dialog.deleted[souls] == {"pointer_scans": 1}
    assert dialog.deleted[dialog.processes[other].process_id]["process"] == 1
    assert _count(sessions, PointerScan) == 0 and _count(sessions, Address) == 1


def test_space_steps_the_selected_rows(qt_app, translations, sessions, repository):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtGui import QShortcut  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.database_entries import (
        KIND_COLUMNS,
        PROCESS_COLUMN,
        ROW_COLUMN,
        DeleteEntriesDialog,
    )

    souls = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_GE)
    other_id = _process_id(sessions, "DarkSoulsIII.ex", PROTON_EXP)
    dialog = DeleteEntriesDialog(translations, repository, current=souls)
    rows = {process.process_id: row for row, process in enumerate(dialog.processes)}
    table = dialog.table
    (space,) = table.findChildren(QShortcut)
    assert space.key().toString() == "Space"
    assert space.context() == Qt.ShortcutContext.WidgetShortcut

    def ticked(row):
        return [column for column in (ROW_COLUMN, *KIND_COLUMNS.values(), PROCESS_COLUMN)
                if table.item(row, column).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

    entries = [column for column in KIND_COLUMNS.values()
               if table.item(rows[other_id], column).flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable]
    other = rows[other_id]
    table.selectRow(other)
    space.activated.emit()  # the box in front: all entries
    assert ticked(other) == [ROW_COLUMN, *entries]
    space.activated.emit()  # the process too
    assert ticked(other) == [ROW_COLUMN, *entries, PROCESS_COLUMN]
    assert dialog.selection()[0][2]
    space.activated.emit()  # nothing
    assert ticked(other) == [] and dialog.selection() == []
    assert not dialog.delete_button.isEnabled()

    # The attached process cannot be removed: the second step is left out.
    attached = rows[souls]
    table.selectRow(attached)
    space.activated.emit()
    assert ROW_COLUMN in ticked(attached) and PROCESS_COLUMN not in ticked(attached)
    space.activated.emit()
    assert ticked(attached) == []

    # Several rows go together, by the furthest one.
    table.selectAll()
    table.item(other, PROCESS_COLUMN).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    space.activated.emit()
    assert all(ticked(row) == [] for row in range(table.rowCount()))
    space.activated.emit()
    assert ROW_COLUMN in ticked(other) and ROW_COLUMN in ticked(attached)
```

```py
"""Tests for the process and hook repository."""

import json
import logging
import sys

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from grembyte.db.base import Base
from grembyte.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
from grembyte.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository, hook_transform
from grembyte.hooks.transforms import (
    MultiplyTransform,
    ScriptTransform,
    TemplateTransform,
    TransformDefinition,
    TransformParameter,
    example_templates,
)
from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations


@pytest.fixture(name="repository")
def fixture_repository(tmp_path):
    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'grembyte.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    yield HookRepository(sessionmaker(bind=engine))
    engine.dispose()


def _add(repository, process_id, transform, **overrides):
    fields = {
        "label": "Gold",
        "module": "game",
        "module_offset": 0x1139,
        "instruction_bytes": "0137",
        "instruction_text": "add dword ptr [rdi], esi",
        "value_type": "int32",
        "transform": transform,
    }
    fields.update(overrides)
    return repository.add_hook(process_id, **fields)


def test_processes_are_identified_by_name_and_path(repository):
    first = repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game")

    assert repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game") == first
    assert repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/other/game") != first


def test_hooks_round_trip(repository):
    process_id = repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game")
    other_id = repository.get_or_create_process("other", "/opt/other")
    hook_id = _add(repository, process_id, MultiplyTransform(10))
    _add(repository, other_id, MultiplyTransform(2))

    [saved] = repository.list_hooks(process_id)

    assert saved.id == hook_id
    assert (saved.module, saved.module_offset, saved.instruction_bytes) == (
        "game", 0x1139, "0137"
    )
    assert saved.template_id is None
    assert saved.transform_name == "multiply"
    assert saved.transform_source == MultiplyTransform.source.strip()
    assert [p["name"] for p in saved.transform_parameters] == ["factor", "direction"]
    assert saved.transform_params == {"factor": 10, "direction": "increase"}
    assert hook_transform(saved).describe() == "multiply(factor=10, direction=increase)"
    assert saved.enabled
    assert (saved.caller_depth, saved.callers) == (1, [])
    assert not saved.breakpoint


def test_update_and_delete_hook(repository):
    process_id = repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game")
    hook_id = _add(repository, process_id, MultiplyTransform(10))

    repository.update_hook(hook_id, label="Mana", transform=ScriptTransform("ctx => 1"))
    repository.update_hook(hook_id, enabled=False)
    repository.update_hook(hook_id, callers=[[("game", 0x2000)]])
    repository.update_hook(hook_id, breakpoint=True)
    [saved] = repository.list_hooks(process_id)

    assert saved.label == "Mana"
    assert saved.transform_name == "script"
    assert saved.transform_source == "ctx => 1"
    assert saved.transform_params == {}
    assert not saved.enabled
    assert saved.callers == [[["game", 0x2000]]]
    assert saved.breakpoint

    repository.delete_hook(hook_id)
    assert repository.list_hooks(process_id) == []


def test_example_templates_are_created_once(repository):
    examples = example_templates()

    repository.ensure_templates(examples)
    repository.ensure_templates(examples)

    templates = repository.list_templates()
    assert sorted(t.name for t in templates) == [
        "Clamp", "Fixed value", "Method script", "Multiplier", "Result × factor"]
    multiply = next(t for t in templates if t.name == "Multiplier")
    assert multiply == examples["multiply"]
    assert multiply.parameters[1].choice_labels[0] == "Increases only"
    assert multiply.kind == "value"
    # Method hook examples keep their kind.
    method = next(t for t in templates if t.name == "Result × factor")
    assert method.kind == "method" and method == examples["method_multiply"]


def test_example_templates_respect_existing_names(repository):
    examples = example_templates()
    repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("Multiplier", "ctx => 1"))

    repository.ensure_templates(examples)

    templates = repository.list_templates()
    assert len(templates) == 5
    assert next(t for t in templates if t.name == "Multiplier").source == "ctx => 1"


def test_save_template_rejects_duplicate_names(repository):
    first = repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("A", "ctx => 1"))
    second = repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("B", "ctx => 2"))

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="already exists"):
        repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("A", "ctx => 3"), second)
    repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("A", "ctx => 4"), first)

    assert [t.source for t in repository.list_templates()] == ["ctx => 4", "ctx => 2"]


def test_hooks_keep_their_copy_of_a_template(repository):
    process_id = repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game")
    parameters = (TransformParameter("factor", default=2, label="Faktor"),)
    template_id = repository.save_template(
        TransformDefinition("Faktor", "ctx => ctx.new * ctx.params.factor", parameters)
    )
    [template] = repository.list_templates()
    hook_id = _add(repository, process_id, TemplateTransform(template, factor=3))

    repository.save_template(
        TransformDefinition("Faktor", "ctx => ctx.new * 2", parameters), template_id
    )
    [saved] = repository.list_hooks(process_id)
    copy = hook_transform(saved)

    assert copy.definition.template_id == template_id
    assert copy.source == "ctx => ctx.new * ctx.params.factor"
    assert copy.params == {"factor": 3}
    assert copy.definition != repository.list_templates()[0]

    repository.delete_template(template_id)
    [saved] = repository.list_hooks(process_id)
    assert saved.id == hook_id
    assert saved.template_id == template_id
    assert hook_transform(saved).source == "ctx => ctx.new * ctx.params.factor"
    # The id of the deleted template is not handed out again.
    assert repository.save_template(TransformDefinition("Neu", "ctx => 1")) != template_id


def test_addresses_with_pointer_scan(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.core.pointer import PointerChain
    from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import (
        AddressRepository,
        SavedPointerScan,
        address_pointer,
    )

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'addresses.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    process_id = HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game")
    repository = AddressRepository(sessions)
    chain = PointerChain("game", 0x3070, (0x18, 0x40, 0x4))

    gold = repository.add_address(process_id, label="Gold", value_type="int32",
                                  address=0x5000)
    score = repository.add_address(process_id, label="Score", value_type="int32",
                                   address=0x4010, pointer=PointerChain("game", 0x10))
    repository.update_address(
        gold, label="Gold!", address=0x6000, pointer=chain, frozen=True, frozen_value="5000"
    )
    repository.save_pointer_scan(gold, SavedPointerScan([chain], 5, 0x1000, 0))
    repository.save_pointer_scan(gold, SavedPointerScan([chain, chain], 5, 0x1000, 2))

    saved_gold, saved_score = repository.list_addresses(process_id)
    assert (saved_gold.label, saved_gold.address, saved_gold.frozen, saved_gold.frozen_value) \
        == ("Gold!", 0x6000, True, "5000")
    assert address_pointer(saved_gold) == chain
    assert address_pointer(saved_score) == PointerChain("game", 0x10)
    scan = repository.get_pointer_scan(gold)
    assert (scan.chains, scan.rounds) == ([chain, chain], 2)
    assert repository.get_pointer_scan(score) is None

    repository.update_address(score, pointer=None)
    assert address_pointer(repository.list_addresses(process_id)[1]) is None
    repository.delete_address(gold)
    assert [a.label for a in repository.list_addresses(process_id)] == ["Score"]
    assert repository.get_pointer_scan(gold) is None
    engine.dispose()


def test_pointer_scans_are_kept_packed(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.core.pointer import PointerChain
    from grembyte.db.models import PointerScan
    from grembyte.db.models.pointer_scan import pack_chains, unpack_chains
    from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository, SavedPointerScan

    chains = [PointerChain("GameAssembly.dll", 0x3070 + index * 8, (0x18, index, 0x4))
              for index in range(2000)]
    chains.append(PointerChain("mono:Assembly-CSharp:GameState", 0x10, ()))
    as_json = [chain.to_json() for chain in chains]
    assert unpack_chains(pack_chains(as_json)) == as_json
    # Each module is named once: far smaller than the JSON objects.
    assert len(pack_chains(as_json)) * 5 < len(json.dumps(as_json))

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'scans.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    process_id = HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game")
    repository = AddressRepository(sessions)
    gold = repository.add_address(process_id, label="Gold", value_type="int32", address=0x5000)
    repository.save_pointer_scan(gold, SavedPointerScan(chains, 5, 0x1000, 1))
    with sessions() as session:
        stored = session.query(PointerScan).one()
        assert stored.chains == [] and stored.packed is not None
    assert repository.get_pointer_scan(gold).chains == chains
    engine.dispose()


def test_init_db_packs_the_pointer_scans_of_older_versions(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import sqlite3

    from grembyte.db.engine import init_db

    path = tmp_path / "old.db"
    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    connection.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE processes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE addresses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, process_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            label VARCHAR NOT NULL, value_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, address INTEGER NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE pointer_scans (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            address_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES addresses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            max_depth INTEGER NOT NULL, max_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, chains JSON NOT NULL,
            rounds INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME);
        INSERT INTO processes (name) VALUES ('game');
        INSERT INTO addresses (process_id, label, value_type, address)
            VALUES (1, 'Gold', 'int32', 20480);
    """)
    chains = [{"module": "game", "base_offset": index * 8, "offsets": [0x18, 0x40]}
              for index in range(5000)]
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO pointer_scans (address_id, max_depth, max_offset, chains, rounds,"
        " updated_at) VALUES (1, 5, 4096, ?, 2, '2026-01-02 03:04:05.000000')",
        (json.dumps(chains),))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    size = path.stat().st_size

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{path}")
    init_db(engine)
    init_db(engine)  # nothing left to pack
    engine.dispose()

    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    stored, packed, updated = connection.execute(
        "SELECT chains, packed, updated_at FROM pointer_scans").fetchone()
    connection.close()
    assert stored == "[]" and packed is not None
    assert updated == "2026-01-02 03:04:05.000000"  # when it was last filtered
    assert path.stat().st_size < size / 2  # the space is given back
    from grembyte.db.models.pointer_scan import unpack_chains  # pylint: disable=C0415
    assert unpack_chains(packed) == chains


def test_init_db_adds_new_nullable_columns(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import sqlite3

    from grembyte.db.engine import init_db

    path = tmp_path / "old.db"
    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE processes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL)")
    connection.execute("INSERT INTO processes (name) VALUES ('game')")
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{path}")
    init_db(engine)
    init_db(engine)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    columns = {row[1] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(hooks)")}
    process_columns = {row[1] for row in connection.execute("PRAGMA table_info(processes)")}
    assert "pointer" in columns
    assert "created_at" in process_columns
    assert connection.execute("SELECT name FROM processes").fetchall() == [("game",)]
    connection.close()
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.mark.skipif(not sys.platform.startswith("linux"), reason="XDG_DATA_HOME is Linux only")
def test_default_db_path_follows_environment(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.db.engine import default_db_path

    monkeypatch.delenv("GREMBYTE_DB", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", str(tmp_path))
    assert default_db_path() == tmp_path / "grembyte" / "grembyte.db"

    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_DB", str(tmp_path / "custom.db"))
    assert default_db_path() == tmp_path / "custom.db"


def test_legacy_db_is_copied_once(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.db.engine import adopt_legacy_db

    legacy = tmp_path / "repo" / "grembyte.db"
    legacy.parent.mkdir()
    legacy.write_bytes(b"old")
    path = tmp_path / "data" / "grembyte.db"
    path.parent.mkdir()

    assert adopt_legacy_db(path, legacy)
    assert path.read_bytes() == b"old" and legacy.exists()

    path.write_bytes(b"new")
    assert not adopt_legacy_db(path, legacy)
    assert path.read_bytes() == b"new"
    assert not adopt_legacy_db(tmp_path / "data" / "other.db", tmp_path / "missing.db")


def test_database_inserts_and_updates_are_logged_after_commit(caplog, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.db.models import SettingRecord

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'logged.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="grembyte.db"):
        with sessions() as session:
            session.add(SettingRecord(key="refresh_interval_ms", value=100))
            session.commit()
        with sessions() as session:
            record = session.get(SettingRecord, "refresh_interval_ms")
            record.value = 200
            session.commit()

    messages = [record.getMessage() for record in caplog.records
                if record.name == "grembyte.db"]
    assert messages == [
        "database record created: settings",
        "database record updated: settings (fields: value)",
    ]
    engine.dispose()


def test_rolled_back_database_changes_are_not_logged(caplog, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.db.models import SettingRecord

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'rollback.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="grembyte.db"):
        with sessions() as session:
            session.add(SettingRecord(key="refresh_interval_ms", value=100))
            session.flush()
            session.rollback()

    assert not [record for record in caplog.records
                if record.name == "grembyte.db" and record.levelno == logging.INFO]
    engine.dispose()


def test_orm_and_bulk_deletes_are_logged_after_commit(caplog, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from sqlalchemy import delete

    from grembyte.db.models import SettingRecord

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'deletes.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    with sessions() as session:
        session.add_all([
            SettingRecord(key="orm_delete", value=True),
            SettingRecord(key="bulk_delete", value=True),
        ])
        session.commit()

    with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="grembyte.db"):
        with sessions() as session:
            session.delete(session.get(SettingRecord, "orm_delete"))
            session.commit()
        with sessions() as session:
            session.execute(delete(SettingRecord).where(
                SettingRecord.key == "bulk_delete"))
            session.commit()

    messages = [record.getMessage() for record in caplog.records
                if record.name == "grembyte.db"]
    assert messages == [
        "database record deleted: settings",
        "database records deleted: settings (count: 1)",
    ]
    engine.dispose()


def test_rolled_back_deletes_are_not_logged(caplog, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from sqlalchemy import delete

    from grembyte.db.models import SettingRecord

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'rollback-delete.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    with sessions() as session:
        session.add(SettingRecord(key="to_keep", value=True))
        session.commit()

    with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO, logger="grembyte.db"):
        with sessions() as session:
            session.execute(delete(SettingRecord).where(SettingRecord.key == "to_keep"))
            session.rollback()

    assert not [record for record in caplog.records
                if record.name == "grembyte.db" and record.levelno == logging.INFO]
    engine.dispose()


def test_vacuum_frees_the_space_of_deleted_rows(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from sqlalchemy import text

    from grembyte.db.engine import database_size, vacuum_db

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'grembyte.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        connection.execute(text("CREATE TABLE junk (data BLOB)"))
        connection.execute(text("INSERT INTO junk VALUES (zeroblob(2000000))"))
        connection.execute(text("DROP TABLE junk"))
    size, free = database_size(engine)
    assert free > 1_900_000

    before, after = vacuum_db(engine)
    assert before == size and after < 200_000
    assert database_size(engine)[1] == 0
    engine.dispose()


def test_german_examples_and_their_hooks_become_english(repository):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from grembyte.db.models import Hook, HookTemplate, MethodHook
    from grembyte.hooks.transforms import GERMAN_EXAMPLE_TEXTS

    examples = example_templates()
    multiply = examples["multiply"].parameters_json()
    multiply[0]["label"] = "Faktor"
    multiply[1]["label"] = "Anwenden auf"
    multiply[1]["choices"] = [["increase", "Nur Erhöhungen"], ["decrease", "Nur Verringerungen"],
                              ["both", "Alle Änderungen"]]
    script = examples["method_script"].parameters_json()
    script[0]["label"] = "Skript"
    script[0]["default"] = GERMAN_EXAMPLE_TEXTS["method_script.code_default"][1]
    process_id = repository.get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game/game")
    with repository._sessions() as session:
        german = HookTemplate(name="Multiplikator", source=examples["multiply"].source,
                              parameters=multiply, seed_key="multiply", description="")
        own_script = HookTemplate(name="Mein Skript", source=examples["method_script"].source,
                                  parameters=script, seed_key="method_script",
                                  description="Selbst geschrieben", kind="method")
        mine = HookTemplate(name="Multi_2", source="ctx => 1", parameters=multiply)
        session.add_all([german, own_script, mine])
        session.flush()
        session.add_all([
            Hook(process_id=process_id, label="Gold", module="game", module_offset=1,
                 instruction_bytes="01", value_type="int32", template_id=german.id,
                 transform_name="Multiplikator", transform_source=german.source,
                 transform_parameters=multiply, transform_params={"factor": 2}),
            # Its template was deleted: found by the name and the unchanged code.
            Hook(process_id=process_id, label="Clamped", module="game", module_offset=2,
                 instruction_bytes="01", value_type="int32", template_id=99,
                 transform_name="Begrenzen", transform_source=examples["clamp"].source,
                 transform_parameters=examples["clamp"].parameters_json(),
                 transform_params={}),
            MethodHook(process_id=process_id, label="DoDamage", managed={"token": 1},
                       template_id=own_script.id, transform_name="Methoden-Skript",
                       transform_source=own_script.source, transform_parameters=script,
                       transform_params={"code": "// mein Code"}),
        ])
        session.commit()

    assert repository.translate_examples() == 5
    assert repository.translate_examples() == 0
    templates = {t.name: t for t in repository.list_templates()}
    assert templates["Multiplier"].parameters == examples["multiply"].parameters
    # A name and a description the user wrote stay; the German labels go.
    assert templates["Mein Skript"].description == "Selbst geschrieben"
    assert templates["Mein Skript"].parameters == examples["method_script"].parameters
    assert templates["Multi_2"].parameters[0].label == "Faktor"
    with repository._sessions() as session:
        names = {hook.label: hook for hook in session.query(Hook)}
        assert names["Gold"].transform_name == "Multiplier"
        assert names["Gold"].transform_parameters[1]["choices"][0] == ["increase", "Increases only"]
        assert names["Clamped"].transform_name == "Clamp"
        method = session.query(MethodHook).one()
        assert method.transform_name == "Method script"
        assert method.transform_parameters[0]["label"] == "Script"
        assert method.transform_params == {"code": "// mein Code"}


def test_an_english_name_taken_by_the_user_keeps_the_german_example(repository):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from grembyte.db.models import HookTemplate

    examples = example_templates()
    with repository._sessions() as session:
        session.add_all([
            HookTemplate(name="Multiplikator", source=examples["multiply"].source,
                         parameters=examples["multiply"].parameters_json(),
                         seed_key="multiply", description=""),
            HookTemplate(name="Multiplier", source="ctx => ctx.new * 3", parameters=[]),
        ])
        session.commit()

    repository.translate_examples()
    repository.ensure_templates(examples)
    names = {t.name: t for t in repository.list_templates()}
    assert names["Multiplier"].source == "ctx => ctx.new * 3"
    assert names["Multiplikator"].source == examples["multiply"].source
    # The other examples are created all the same.
    assert {"Fixed value", "Clamp"} <= set(names)


def test_init_db_sets_aside_a_table_of_the_first_versions(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import sqlite3

    from grembyte.db.engine import init_db
    from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository

    path = tmp_path / "first.db"
    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    connection.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE processes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL);
        INSERT INTO processes (name) VALUES ('game');
        CREATE TABLE addresses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                                label VARCHAR, address VARCHAR NOT NULL,
                                value_type VARCHAR, frozen INTEGER, last_value VARCHAR);
        INSERT INTO addresses (game_id, label, address) VALUES (1, 'Gold', '0x5000');
        CREATE TABLE pointer_scans (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                                    address_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE
                                        REFERENCES addresses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                                    max_depth INTEGER NOT NULL, max_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
                                    chains JSON NOT NULL, rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
    """)
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{path}")
    init_db(engine)
    init_db(engine)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(path)
    tables = {row[0]: row[1] for row in connection.execute(
        "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'")}
    # The old rows are kept; the process keeps its id and gets a path.
    assert connection.execute("SELECT label FROM addresses_old").fetchall() == [("Gold",)]
    assert connection.execute("SELECT id, name, path FROM processes").fetchall() == [
        (1, "game", "")]
    assert "addresses_old" not in tables["pointer_scans"]
    connection.close()

    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    repository = AddressRepository(sessions)
    gold = repository.add_address(1, label="Gold", value_type="int32", address=0x5000)
    assert [(a.label, a.address) for a in repository.list_addresses(1)] == [("Gold", 0x5000)]
    # Foreign keys are on: removing the process removes its addresses.
    with engine.begin() as db:
        db.exec_driver_sql("DELETE FROM processes WHERE id = 1")
    assert repository.list_addresses(1) == [] and gold
    engine.dispose()


def test_scripts_are_saved_changed_and_deleted_per_process(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.db.repository.scripts import ScriptRepository
    from grembyte.features.scripts import (
        ScriptParam, ScriptSpec, params_from_json, params_to_json)

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'grembyte.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    try:
        hooks = HookRepository(sessions)
        scripts = ScriptRepository(sessions)
        game = hooks.get_or_create_process("game", "/games/game")
        other = hooks.get_or_create_process("other", "/games/other")
        heal = scripts.add_script(game, label="Heal", source="ctx.log(1);", mode="repeat",
                                  seconds=60)
        scripts.add_script(other, label="Gold", source="return 1;", mode="manual", seconds=0)

        scripts.update_script(heal, seconds=30, enabled=False)
        [saved] = scripts.list_scripts(game)
        assert (saved.label, saved.source, saved.mode, saved.seconds, saved.enabled) == (
            "Heal", "ctx.log(1);", "repeat", 30, False)
        spec = ScriptSpec(saved.source, saved.mode, saved.seconds, saved.enabled, saved.label)
        assert spec.to_agent(3) == {"id": 3, "source": "ctx.log(1);", "mode": "repeat",
                                    "seconds": 30, "enabled": False, "args": {}, "options": {}}
        assert saved.params is None and saved.last_args is None

        # Parameters and the values of the last run are kept as JSON; empty
        # parameters remove them.
        params = (ScriptParam("item", "Item", "choice", "ItFo_Apple", 'return ["ItFo_Apple"];'),
                  ScriptParam("count", "Anzahl", "number", "1,5"))
        scripts.update_script(heal, params=params_to_json(params),
                              last_args=json.dumps({"item": "ItFo_Apple", "count": 3}))
        [saved] = scripts.list_scripts(game)
        spec = ScriptSpec(saved.source, saved.mode, saved.seconds, saved.enabled, saved.label,
                          params_from_json(saved.params))
        assert spec.params == params and json.loads(saved.last_args)["count"] == 3
        assert spec.to_agent(3)["args"] == {"item": "ItFo_Apple", "count": 1.5}
        assert spec.to_agent(3)["options"] == {"item": 'return ["ItFo_Apple"];'}
        scripts.update_script(heal, params="")
        assert scripts.list_scripts(game)[0].params is None

        scripts.delete_script(heal)
        assert scripts.list_scripts(game) == []
        assert [script.label for script in scripts.list_scripts(other)] == ["Gold"]
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


def test_script_spec_rejects_unknown_modes_and_busy_loops():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptSpec

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScriptSpec("return 1;", "hourly", 60)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScriptSpec("return 1;", "repeat", 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScriptSpec("return 1;", "once", -1)
    assert ScriptSpec("return 1;", "once", 0).mode == "once"


def test_script_params_are_checked_and_typed():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptParam, ScriptSpec, choice_matches

    for bad in (dict(name="2nd"), dict(name="a b"), dict(name="x", kind="date"),
                dict(name="x", kind="choice"), dict(name="x", kind="number", default="viel"),
                dict(name="x", kind="bool", default="vielleicht")):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            ScriptParam(**bad)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScriptSpec("return 1;", params=(ScriptParam("x"), ScriptParam("x", kind="number")))
    number = ScriptParam("count", kind="number")
    assert (number.value("20"), number.value(" 2,5 "), number.value("")) == (20, 2.5, 0)
    flag = ScriptParam("all", kind="bool", default="ja")
    assert (flag.value(flag.default), flag.value("")) == (True, False)
    choice = ScriptParam("item", kind="choice", options="return [];")
    assert choice.value("") is None and choice.value("ItFo_Apple") == "ItFo_Apple"
    # Options come back from JavaScript: 3 as 3.0, true as True
    assert choice_matches(3.0, "3") and choice_matches(True, "true")
    assert not choice_matches("ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear")
```

```py
"""Dialogs docked in the main window as tabs (grembyte.ui.widgets.docking)."""

# pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,import-error,no-name-in-module

import pytest

from tests.test_scripts import fixture_qt_app  # pylint: disable=unused-import


@pytest.fixture(name="window")
def _window(qt_app):
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMainWindow

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import DockManager

    window = QMainWindow()
    window.dock_manager = DockManager(window)
    window.show()
    qt_app.processEvents()
    yield window
    window.close()


def _dialog(translations, title, parent):
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import PinButton

    dialog = QDialog(parent)
    dialog.setWindowTitle(title)
    dialog.pin_button = PinButton(translations)
    QVBoxLayout(dialog).addWidget(dialog.pin_button)
    return dialog


@pytest.fixture(name="translations")
def _translations():
    from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations

    return load_translations("en")


def test_dialogs_dock_as_tabs_and_float_again(window, translations, qt_app):
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import RIGHT

    manager = window.dock_manager
    gold = _dialog(translations, "Gold", window)
    mana = _dialog(translations, "Mana", window)
    manager.add(gold, "pointer_scan", RIGHT)
    assert gold.isWindow() and gold.isVisible()  # nothing remembered yet

    gold.pin_button.click()
    host = manager.host(RIGHT)
    assert host.dialogs() == [gold] and not gold.isWindow() and host.isVisible()
    assert gold.pin_button.isChecked() and gold.pin_button.text() == translations["dock.unpin"]
    assert host.windowTitle() == "Gold"

    manager.add(mana, "pointer_scan", RIGHT)  # the next one follows: docked beside it
    assert host.dialogs() == [gold, mana] and host.dialog() is mana
    assert [host.tabs.tabText(i) for i in range(2)] == ["Gold", "Mana"]
    mana.setWindowTitle("Mana 2")  # the tab follows the title
    assert host.tabs.tabText(1) == "Mana 2" and host.windowTitle() == "Mana 2"

    manager.show(gold)
    assert host.dialog() is gold

    gold.pin_button.click()  # floats again; the next one would, too
    assert host.dialogs() == [mana] and gold.isWindow() and gold.isVisible()
    assert gold.parentWidget() is window and not gold.pin_button.isChecked()
    assert not manager.remembered("pointer_scan")

    mana.reject()  # finished: its tab goes, the empty dock hides
    qt_app.processEvents()
    assert host.dialogs() == [] and not host.isVisible()


def test_tab_and_dock_close_buttons_close_the_dialogs(window, translations):
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import BOTTOM

    manager = window.dock_manager
    dialogs = [_dialog(translations, name, window) for name in ("Trace", "Log", "Monitor")]
    finished, cleaned = [], []
    for dialog in dialogs:
        dialog.finished.connect(lambda _result, d=dialog: finished.append(d))
        # The tools stop their workers in closeEvent
        dialog.closeEvent = lambda event, d=dialog: (cleaned.append(d), event.accept())
        manager.add(dialog, "trace", BOTTOM, dock=True)
    host = manager.host(BOTTOM)
    assert host.dialogs() == dialogs and host.dialog() is dialogs[2]

    host.tabs.tabCloseRequested.emit(1)  # a tab behind: its dialog is hidden
    assert finished == cleaned == [dialogs[1]]
    assert host.dialogs() == [dialogs[0], dialogs[2]]
    host.close()
    assert finished == cleaned == [dialogs[1], dialogs[0], dialogs[2]]
    assert host.dialogs() == []


def test_a_docked_dialog_goes_with_the_window_it_came_from(window, translations, qt_app):
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import RIGHT, find_dock_manager

    monitor = QDialog(window)
    inspector = _dialog(translations, "Inspector", monitor)
    manager = find_dock_manager(inspector)
    assert manager is window.dock_manager
    finished = []
    inspector.finished.connect(finished.append)
    manager.add(inspector, "inspector", RIGHT, dock=True)
    assert manager.host(RIGHT).dialogs() == [inspector]

    monitor.reject()
    qt_app.processEvents()
    assert finished and manager.host(RIGHT).dialogs() == []


def test_inspectors_open_next_to_a_docked_one(window, translations, qt_app):
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import RIGHT
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.inspection import Inspections
    from tests.test_scripts import _FakeScriptWorker

    inspections = Inspections(translations, _FakeScriptWorker(1), window)
    inspections.inspect({"address": "0x1000"})
    first = inspections.inspectors[-1]
    assert first.isWindow()  # nothing remembered: a window of its own
    host = window.dock_manager.host(RIGHT)

    first.pin_button.click()
    assert host.dialogs() == [first]
    inspections.inspect({"address": "0x2000"}, origin=first)  # a field's object
    second = inspections.inspectors[-1]
    assert host.dialogs() == [first, second] and host.dialog() is second
    assert second.depth == 2

    second.pin_button.click()  # floated; the next one opens floating too
    inspections.inspect({"address": "0x3000"}, origin=second)
    third = inspections.inspectors[-1]
    assert third.isWindow() and host.dialogs() == [first]
    for inspector in (first, second, third):
        inspector.reject()
    qt_app.processEvents()
    assert host.dialogs() == []

def test_tools_close_with_the_game_but_log_and_pointer_scans_stay(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=protected-access
    from grembyte.ui import main_window
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import BOTTOM, RIGHT

    window = main_window.MainWindow("en")
    try:
        manager = window.dock_manager
        window._open_log()
        log = window._log_dialog

        class PointerScan:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            pid = "game"

            def set_process(self, pid):
                self.pid = pid

        pointer = _dialog(translations, "Pointer scan", window)
        pointer.set_process = PointerScan.set_process.__get__(pointer)
        window._pointer_dialogs[1] = pointer
        tools = {}
        for name, area in (("_objects_dialog", RIGHT), ("_gas_dialog", RIGHT),
                           ("_memory_viewer", RIGHT), ("_native_monitor", BOTTOM)):
            tools[name] = _dialog(translations, name, window)
            setattr(window, name, tools[name])
            manager.add(tools[name], name, area, dock=True)
        manager.add(pointer, "pointer_scan", RIGHT, dock=True)
        manager.add(log, "log", BOTTOM, dock=True)
        closed = []
        for name, dialog in tools.items():
            dialog.finished.connect(lambda _result, n=name: closed.append(n))

        window._detach_process()
        qt_app.processEvents()
        assert sorted(closed) == sorted(tools)
        assert all(getattr(window, name) is None for name in tools)
        assert manager.host(RIGHT).dialogs() == [pointer] and pointer.pid is None
        assert manager.host(BOTTOM).dialogs() == [log]
    finally:
        window.close()


def test_the_log_button_closes_the_docked_log_in_front(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=protected-access,unused-argument
    from grembyte.ui import main_window
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.docking import BOTTOM

    window = main_window.MainWindow("en")
    try:
        window.show()
        manager = window.dock_manager
        window.btn_log.click()
        log = window._log_dialog
        assert log is not None
        manager.host(BOTTOM).pin(log)

        # Another tab in front: the button brings the log forward
        other = _dialog(translations, "Native monitor", window)
        manager.add(other, "native_monitor", BOTTOM, dock=True)
        assert manager.host(BOTTOM).dialog() is other
        window.btn_log.click()
        assert window._log_dialog is log and manager.host(BOTTOM).dialog() is log

        # In front: the button closes it
        window.btn_log.click()
        qt_app.processEvents()
        assert window._log_dialog is None
        assert manager.host(BOTTOM).dialogs() == [other]
        other.reject()
    finally:
        window.close()
```

```py
"""Tests for the favorites: keys, persistence, the star column and the favorites window."""

import os

                     False, 0x06001234, "Game.PlayerInventory:AddCurrency (int)")

def test_native_functions_are_known_by_module_and_offset():
    moved = NativeFunction(0x7ffd00001000, "game", 0x1000)  # the next start of the game
    assert favorite_key(moved) == favorite_key(ROLL)
    assert favorite_key(JIT) == "native:0x7f0000"
    assert favorite_from_function(ROLL).lasting
    assert not favorite_from_function(JIT).lasting


def test_favorites_rebuild_what_they_were_made_of():
    method = favorite_from_method(GOLD, CATALOG)
    assert (method.kind, method.label, method.location) == (
        METHOD, "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency", "Assembly-CSharp")
    assert method.target() == GOLD
    function = favorite_from_function(ROLL, NATIVE_TRACE)
    assert (function.kind, function.label, function.location) == (NATIVE, "roll_dice",
                                                                   "game+0x1000")
    assert function.target() == ROLL
    assert function.matches(["roll", "game+0x1"]) and not function.matches(["gold"])


def test_repository_keeps_favorites_and_their_notes(repository, process_id, sessions):
    other_id = HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("other", "/opt/other")
    gold_id = repository.add_favorite(process_id, favorite_from_method(GOLD, CATALOG))
    repository.add_favorite(process_id, favorite_from_function(ROLL, NATIVE_TRACE))
    repository.add_favorite(other_id, favorite_from_function(JIT))
    repository.set_note(gold_id, "adds gold after a sale")
    # Marked again from elsewhere: still one favorite, the note stays
    assert repository.add_favorite(process_id, favorite_from_method(GOLD, "trace")) == gold_id

    gold, roll = repository.list_favorites(process_id)
    assert gold.note == "adds gold after a sale" and gold.source == "trace"
    assert gold.method() == GOLD and roll.function() == ROLL
    assert [favorite.key for favorite in repository.list_favorites(other_id)] == [
        favorite_key(JIT)]
    repository.delete_favorite(process_id, gold.key)
    assert [favorite.label for favorite in repository.list_favorites(process_id)] == [
        "roll_dice"]


def test_favorite_store_backfills_argument_names(repository, process_id):
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.favorites import FavoriteStore

    legacy = favorite_from_method(GOLD)
    legacy.data.pop("argument_names")
    repository.add_favorite(process_id, legacy)
    store = FavoriteStore(repository)
    store.set_process(process_id)
    named = CatalogMethod(
        GOLD.assembly, GOLD.class_name, GOLD.name, GOLD.parameters, GOLD.return_type,
        GOLD.static, GOLD.token, GOLD.signature, GOLD.engine, ("amount",),
    )

    store.enrich_methods([named])

    assert store.favorites()[0].method().display_signature == (
        "Game.PlayerInventory:AddCurrency (int amount)"
    )


def test_star_column_marks_and_unmarks(qt_app, repository, process_id, translations):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.features.trace import NEW, TraceRow
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.favorites import NO_STAR, STAR, FavoriteStore
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.native_trace import NativeRowModel
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.trace import trace_table

    store = FavoriteStore(repository)
    store.set_process(process_id)
    model = NativeRowModel(translations)
    view = trace_table(model, 2, sortable=True, favorites=store, source=NATIVE_TRACE)
    model.set_items([ROLL, JIT], [TraceRow(0, 3, 1.0, None, NEW, 0),
                                  TraceRow(1, 7, 2.3, None, NEW, 1)])
    repaints = []
    model.dataChanged.connect(lambda *_args: repaints.append(True))

    assert model.data(model.index(0, 0)) == NO_STAR
    view.clicked.emit(model.index(0, 0))
    assert model.data(model.index(0, 0)) == STAR and repaints
    assert [favorite.label for favorite in store.favorites()] == ["roll_dice"]
    view.clicked.emit(model.index(1, 2))  # not the star column
    assert model.data(model.index(1, 0)) == NO_STAR
    model.sort(0, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)
    assert model.data(model.index(0, 2)) == "roll_dice"
    view.clicked.emit(model.index(0, 0))
    assert model.data(model.index(0, 0)) == NO_STAR and store.favorites() == []

    hidden = trace_table(NativeRowModel(translations), 2)
    assert hidden.isColumnHidden(0)

def test_favorites_window_handles_several_at_once(qt_app, repository, process_id, translations,
                                                  monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.favorites import FavoritesDialog, FavoriteStore

    store = FavoriteStore(repository)
    store.set_process(process_id)
    store.toggle(GOLD, CATALOG)
    store.toggle(ROLL, NATIVE_TRACE)
    dialog = FavoritesDialog(translations, store)
    dialog.set_attached(True)
    methods, functions = [], []
    dialog.method_monitor_requested.connect(methods.extend)
    dialog.native_monitor_requested.connect(functions.extend)

    dialog.table.selectAll()
    assert len(dialog.selected_favorites()) == 2
    assert dialog.selection_label.text() == "2 Favoriten ausgewählt"
    dialog.monitor_button.click()
    assert methods == [GOLD] and functions == [ROLL]

    dialog.copy_button.click()
    assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text().splitlines() == [GOLD.signature, "game+0x1000"]

    # A refresh, e.g. after a note was edited, keeps both selected.
    dialog.table.item(0, 4).setText("Gold")
    assert len(dialog.selected_favorites()) == 2

    # Removing several asks first.
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "question",
                        lambda *_args: QMessageBox.StandardButton.No)
    dialog.remove_button.click()
    assert len(store.favorites()) == 2
    monkeypatch.setattr(QMessageBox, "question",
                        lambda *_args: QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
    dialog.remove_button.click()
    assert store.favorites() == []

    # One selected: its signature, no question.
    store.toggle(GOLD, CATALOG)
    dialog.table.selectionModel().select(
        dialog.table.model().index(0, 0),
        QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.ClearAndSelect | QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Rows)
    assert dialog.selection_label.text() == GOLD.signature

                           "Game.PlayerInventory:GetCurrency ()")
    store.toggle(static, CATALOG)
    dialog = FavoritesDialog(translations, store)

    assert [dialog.table.item(row, 1).text() for row in range(2)] == ["", "✓"]


def test_catalog_sorts_by_column_and_keeps_the_selection(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel, Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTableView  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.catalog import CatalogModel

    class Engine:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        @staticmethod
        def is_framework_assembly(_assembly):
            return False

    sell = CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Shop", "Sell", "(int)", "bool",
                         True, 0x06000001, "Game.Shop:Sell (int)")
    load = CatalogMethod("Loader", "Boot", "Load", "()", "void",
                         False, 0x06000002, "Boot:Load ()")
    model = CatalogModel(translations, Engine())
    view = QTableView()
    view.setModel(model)
    model.add([GOLD, sell])
    view.selectionModel().setCurrentIndex(
        model.index(1, 1), QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.ClearAndSelect
        | QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Rows)
    classes = lambda: [model.method_at(row).class_name  # noqa: E731
                       for row in range(model.rowCount())]

    model.sort(1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
    assert classes() == ["Game.PlayerInventory", "Game.Shop"]
    model.sort(4, Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)  # static ones first
    assert model.method_at(view.currentIndex().row()) is sell
    model.add([load])  # read later, sorted in
    assert classes() == ["Game.Shop", "Game.PlayerInventory", "Boot"]
    model.sort(1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
    assert classes() == ["Boot", "Game.PlayerInventory", "Game.Shop"]
    assert model.method_at(view.currentIndex().row()) is sell
    model.set_filter("game", False)
    assert classes() == ["Game.PlayerInventory", "Game.Shop"]
    model.sort(-1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)  # the order read in
    model.set_filter("", False)
    assert classes() == ["Game.PlayerInventory", "Game.Shop", "Boot"]
```
