```py
"""The scripts tab: its dialog and texts (running scripts: see test_unreal)."""

import itertools
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptSpec
from grembyte.ui.localization import language_code, load_translations


@pytest.fixture(name="qt_app", scope="module")
def fixture_qt_app():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    return QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])


def test_both_languages_name_the_same_script_texts():
    folder = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "grembyte" / "ui" / "localization"
    keys = {language: {key for key in json.loads((folder / f"{language}.json").read_text("utf-8"))
                       if key.startswith("scripts.")}
            for language in ("en", "de")}
    assert keys["en"] == keys["de"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language, expected", [("de-DE", "de"), ("en_US", "en"),
                                                  ("fr", "en")])
def test_language_code_resolves_supported_script_languages(language, expected):
    assert language_code(language) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language", ["en", "de"])
def test_the_dialog_builds_a_script_and_rejects_busy_loops(qt_app, language):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptDialog, timing_text

    translations = load_translations(language)
    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations)
    dialog.label_edit.setText("Heal")
    dialog.code_edit.setPlainText("ctx.find('AlabamaCheatManager').call('GiveHealth', 50);")
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("repeat"))
    dialog.seconds_spin.setValue(0)
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec is None and dialog.error_label.text()

    dialog.seconds_spin.setValue(30)
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec == ScriptSpec("ctx.find('AlabamaCheatManager').call('GiveHealth', 50);",
                                     "repeat", 30, True, "Heal")
    assert "30" in timing_text(translations, dialog.spec)

    # Editing keeps whether the script is paused; manual scripts have no delay.
    paused = ScriptSpec("return 1;", "once", 5, False, "Later")
    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations, spec=paused)
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("manual"))
    assert not dialog.seconds_spin.isEnabled()
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec == ScriptSpec("return 1;", "manual", 0.0, False, "Later")


def test_only_manual_scripts_keep_a_hotkey(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptDialog, timing_text

    assert ScriptSpec("return 1;", "repeat", 5, hotkey="F9").hotkey == ""
    assert ScriptSpec("return 1;", hotkey="shift+ctrl+g").hotkey == "Ctrl+Shift+G"
    translations = load_translations("en")
    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations)
    dialog.code_edit.setPlainText("return 1;")
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("manual"))
    assert dialog.hotkey_edit.isEnabled()
    dialog.hotkey_edit.setKeySequence(QKeySequence("Ctrl+Shift+G"))
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec.hotkey == "Ctrl+Shift+G"
    assert "Ctrl+Shift+G" in timing_text(translations, dialog.spec)

    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations, spec=dialog.spec)
    assert dialog.hotkey() == "Ctrl+Shift+G"
    dialog.hotkey_edit.setKeySequence(QKeySequence("Ctrl+Tab"))
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec is None and "Tab" in dialog.error_label.text()
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("repeat"))
    dialog.seconds_spin.setValue(30)
    assert not dialog.hotkey_edit.isEnabled()
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec.hotkey == ""


def test_the_panel_runs_manual_scripts_by_their_hotkeys(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import scripts
    from tests.test_hotkeys import FakeKeyboard

    keyboard = FakeKeyboard(focused=4242)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "open_reader", lambda: keyboard)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(load_translations("en"))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        assert panel._hotkeys is None  # no script has a hotkey
        gold = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 1;", label="Gold", hotkey="Ctrl+G"))
        paused = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 2;", label="Paused", enabled=False,
                                             hotkey="F9"))
        worker = panel._worker
        worker.script_added.emit(gold)
        worker.script_added.emit(paused)
        panel._hotkeys.poll()
        keyboard.down = {"ctrl", "G"}
        panel._hotkeys.poll()
        keyboard.down = {"F9"}
        panel._hotkeys.poll()
        assert [request for request in worker.requests if request[0] == "run"] == [
            ("run", gold, None)]
        assert "Ctrl+G" in panel.log_view.toPlainText()

        # Without a script with a hotkey it stops listening
        panel.remove_script(gold)
        panel.remove_script(paused)
        assert not panel._hotkeys._timer.isActive()
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()
    assert keyboard.closed


def test_the_address_search_folds_away_and_stays_so(qt_app, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from grembyte.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
    from grembyte.db.base import Base
    from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from grembyte.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from grembyte.db.repository.scripts import ScriptRepository
    from grembyte.ui import main_window

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'grembyte.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ScriptRepository", lambda: ScriptRepository(sessions))
    settings_file = str(tmp_path / "settings.ini")
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "QSettings",
                        lambda *_args: QSettings(settings_file, QSettings.Format.IniFormat))

    def open_window():
        window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
        window._refresh_timer.stop()
        return window

    def close(window):
        window.close()
        shiboken6.delete(window)

    try:
        window = open_window()
        file_menu = window.menuBar().actions()[0].menu()
        file_actions = file_menu.actions()
        assert file_actions[-2].isSeparator()
        assert file_actions[-1] == window.act_check_gadget
        assert window.act_check_gadget.isEnabled() == (main_window.sys.platform != "win32")
        assert not window.act_check_gadget.icon().isNull()
        assert not window._scan_area.isHidden() and window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        window.btn_scan_area.click()
        assert window._scan_area.isHidden() and not window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        assert window.btn_scan_area.text() == "Adresssuche einblenden"
        assert not window.btn_scan_area.icon().isNull()

        # The tab of tracked addresses counts them, like those of hooks and scripts.
        tab = window.bottom_tabs.indexOf(window._address_box)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen"
        address_buttons = (window.btn_write_value, window.btn_freeze, window.btn_remove_address)
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.insertRow(0)
        window.addr_table.insertRow(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen (2)"
        # The address actions need a selected address.
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.selectRow(0)
        assert all(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.removeRow(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen (1)"
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.setRowCount(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen"
        close(window)

        # Started again: still folded away; the menu entry shows it again.
        window = open_window()
        assert window._scan_area.isHidden() and not window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        window.act_scan_area.trigger()
        assert not window._scan_area.isHidden()
        assert window.btn_scan_area.text() == "Adresssuche ausblenden"
        close(window)
        assert QSettings(settings_file, QSettings.Format.IniFormat).value(
            "scan_area_visible", type=bool) is True
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


def test_native_tools_ask_first_in_mono_games(qt_app, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from grembyte.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
    from grembyte.db.base import Base
    from grembyte.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from grembyte.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from grembyte.db.repository.scripts import ScriptRepository
    from grembyte.engines.registry import engine_by_id
    from grembyte.ui import main_window

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'grembyte.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ScriptRepository", lambda: ScriptRepository(sessions))
    answers, asked = [QMessageBox.StandardButton.No, QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes], []

    def warning(*args):
        asked.append(args[1])
        return answers.pop(0)

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window.QMessageBox, "warning", warning)
    window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
    window._refresh_timer.stop()
    try:
        window._current_pid = 4242
        window._engine = engine_by_id("unreal")
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Trace") and not asked

        window._engine = engine_by_id("mono")
        window._update_catalog_button()
        assert window.act_native_trace.isEnabled()
        assert "Mono-Spiel" in window.act_native_trace.toolTip()
        assert not window._confirm_native_tools("Trace")  # "No"
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Trace")      # "Yes"
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Monitor")    # not asked again
        assert asked == ["Trace", "Trace"]
    finally:
        window.close()
        shiboken6.delete(window)
        engine.dispose()


class _FakeScriptWorker:
    """Stands in for ScriptWorker: records the requests; the test answers."""

    # As ScriptWorker's: unique across workers
    _ids = itertools.count(1)

    def __init__(self, pid, _parent=None, _language="en"):
        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        self.pid = pid
        from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

        class Signals(QObject):  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            script_added = Signal(int)
            script_updated = Signal(int)
            script_removed = Signal(int)
            script_failed = Signal(int, str)
            script_ran = Signal(int, object)
            worker_failed = Signal(str)
            inspected = Signal(int, object)
            inspect_failed = Signal(int, str)
            evaluated = Signal(int, object)
            evaluate_failed = Signal(int, str)
            methods_listed = Signal(int, object)
            methods_failed = Signal(int, str)
            text_fetched = Signal(int, object)
            text_failed = Signal(int, str)
            gas_listed = Signal(int, object)
            gas_failed = Signal(int, str)
            gas_set = Signal(int, object)
            gas_set_failed = Signal(int, str)
            options_listed = Signal(int, object)
            options_failed = Signal(int, str)
            classes_browsed = Signal(int, object)
            browse_failed = Signal(int, str)
            instances_browsed = Signal(int, object)
            instances_failed = Signal(int, str)
            finished = Signal()

        self.signals = Signals()
        self.script_added = self.signals.script_added
        self.script_updated = self.signals.script_updated
        self.script_removed = self.signals.script_removed
        self.script_failed = self.signals.script_failed
        self.script_ran = self.signals.script_ran
        self.worker_failed = self.signals.worker_failed
        self.inspected = self.signals.inspected
        self.inspect_failed = self.signals.inspect_failed
        self.evaluated = self.signals.evaluated
        self.evaluate_failed = self.signals.evaluate_failed
        self.methods_listed = self.signals.methods_listed
        self.methods_failed = self.signals.methods_failed
        self.text_fetched = self.signals.text_fetched
        self.text_failed = self.signals.text_failed
        self.gas_listed = self.signals.gas_listed
        self.gas_failed = self.signals.gas_failed
        self.gas_set = self.signals.gas_set
        self.gas_set_failed = self.signals.gas_set_failed
        self.options_listed = self.signals.options_listed
        self.options_failed = self.signals.options_failed
        self.classes_browsed = self.signals.classes_browsed
        self.browse_failed = self.signals.browse_failed
        self.instances_browsed = self.signals.instances_browsed
        self.instances_failed = self.signals.instances_failed
        self.finished = self.signals.finished
        self.requests = []

    def start(self):
        pass

    def isRunning(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return True

    def requestInterruption(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def wait(self, _timeout):
        return True

    def setParent(self, _parent):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def deleteLater(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def add_script(self, spec):
        self.requests.append(("add", spec))
        return next(self._ids)

    def update_script(self, script_id, spec):
        self.requests.append(("update", script_id, spec))

    def remove_script(self, script_id):
        self.requests.append(("remove", script_id))

    def run_now(self, script_id, args=None):
        self.requests.append(("run", script_id, args))

    def script_options(self, script_id, name):
        self.requests.append(("options", script_id, name))
        return len(self.requests)

    def inspect(self, target):
        self.requests.append(("inspect", target))
        return len(self.requests)

    def gas_attributes(self):
        self.requests.append(("gas_attributes",))
        return len(self.requests)

    def gas_set_base(self, name, value):
        self.requests.append(("gas_set_base", name, value))
        return len(self.requests)

    def browse_classes(self, filter_text="", internal=False):
        self.requests.append(("browse_classes", filter_text, internal))
        return len(self.requests)

    def browse_instances(self, klass, filter_text="", internal=False):
        self.requests.append(("browse_instances", klass, filter_text, internal))
        return len(self.requests)


def test_objects_scripts_return_open_in_the_inspector_from_the_log(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.widgets import scripts

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(load_translations("de"))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        script_id = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec('return ctx.call("GameState:get_PlayerCharacter");',
                                                label="Spieler"))
        worker = panel._worker
        worker.script_added.emit(script_id)
        target = {"address": "0x7f82508577e0"}
        player = {"runs": 1, "time": 0, "result": 'Player "Player_New_Game(Clone)_1"@0x7f82508577e0',
                  "target": target, "logs": [{
                      "text": 'Player "Player_New_Game(Clone)_1"@0x7f82508577e0',
                      "targets": [target]}], "error": None}

        # Neither a timed run nor one by hand opens a window: the log links it.
        worker.script_ran.emit(script_id, player)
        panel.table.selectRow(0)
        panel.btn_run.click()
        worker.script_ran.emit(script_id, {**player, "runs": 2})
        assert not panel.inspections.inspectors
        assert panel.log_view.toPlainText().count("Inspizieren") == 4

        panel.log_view.anchorClicked.emit(QUrl("inspect:0"))
        assert len(panel.inspections.inspectors) == 1
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        panel.log_view.anchorClicked.emit(QUrl("inspect:1"))
        assert len(panel.inspections.inspectors) == 2
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        assert panel.table.item(0, 4).text().startswith("Player")
    finally:
        for inspector in list(panel.inspections.inspectors if panel.inspections else []):
            inspector.close()
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language, suffix", [("en", "(copy)"), ("de", "(Kopie)")])
def test_context_menu_creates_a_localized_script_copy(qt_app, monkeypatch, language, suffix):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import scripts

    class FakeAction:
        def __init__(self, label, callback):
            self.label = label
            self.callback = callback
            self.enabled = True

        def setEnabled(self, enabled):
            self.enabled = enabled

    class FakeMenu:
        instances = []

        def __init__(self, _parent):
            self.actions = []
            self.instances.append(self)

        def addAction(self, _icon, label, callback):
            action = FakeAction(label, callback)
            self.actions.append(action)
            return action

        def exec(self, _position):
            pass

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "QMenu", FakeMenu)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "add_delete_action", lambda *_args: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "add_copy_actions", lambda *_args: None)
    translations = load_translations(language)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(translations, language=language)
    spec = ScriptSpec("return ctx.lang;", "repeat", 3, True, "Language", (
        ScriptParam("choice", "Choice", "choice", "en", 'return ["en", "de"];'),
    ))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        original_id = panel.add_script(spec)
        worker = panel._worker
        position = panel.table.visualItemRect(panel.table.item(0, 0)).center()
        panel._show_context_menu(QPoint(position))

        menu = FakeMenu.instances[-1]
        assert [action.label for action in menu.actions] == [
            translations["scripts.edit"], translations["scripts.run"],
            translations["scripts.pause"], translations["scripts.copy"],
        ]
        menu.actions[-1].callback()

        copied_id = panel._selected_id()
        copied = panel._scripts[copied_id]
        assert copied_id != original_id
        assert copied["spec"] == ScriptSpec(
            spec.source, spec.mode, spec.seconds, spec.enabled, f"Language {suffix}", spec.params)
        assert copied["runs"] == 0 and copied["last"] == "" and copied["options"] == {}
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("add", copied["spec"])
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


def test_scripts_show_disconnected_when_their_session_ends(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import scripts

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(load_translations("de"))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        running = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 1;", label="Läuft"))
        paused = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 2;", label="Pausiert", enabled=False))
        worker = panel._worker
        worker.script_added.emit(running)
        worker.script_added.emit(paused)
        assert panel.table.item(0, 2).text() == "Aktiv"

        # The session is ended in the sessions window: the worker just finishes.
        worker.finished.emit()
        assert panel._worker is None
        assert [panel.table.item(row, 2).text() for row in range(2)] == ["Getrennt"] * 2
        panel.table.selectRow(1)
        assert not panel.btn_run.isEnabled()
        assert panel.btn_toggle.text() == "Fortsetzen"

        # Resuming starts it anew in a new session, running.
        panel.btn_toggle.click()
        restarted = panel._worker
        assert restarted is not worker
        assert restarted.requests[-1][0] == "add" and restarted.requests[-1][1].enabled
        assert panel.table.item(0, 2).text() == "Getrennt"  # the other one stays
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


def test_the_dialog_defines_parameters_and_their_options(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptDialog

    dialog = ScriptDialog(load_translations("de"))
    dialog.code_edit.setPlainText("return ctx.args.count;")
    editor = dialog.param_editor
    editor.btn_add.click()
    editor.table.item(0, 0).setText("item")
    editor.table.item(0, 1).setText("Item")
    editor.table.cellWidget(0, 2).setCurrentIndex(3)  # a choice: its code shows
    assert editor.options_edit.isEnabled() and "return" in editor.options_edit.toPlainText()
    editor.options_edit.setPlainText('return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];')
    editor.btn_add.click()
    editor.table.item(1, 0).setText("count")
    editor.table.cellWidget(1, 2).setCurrentIndex(1)
    editor.table.item(1, 3).setText("x")
    assert not editor.options_edit.isEnabled()  # a number has no options

    # A default that is no number keeps it open, on the parameters' tab.
    dialog.tabs.setCurrentIndex(0)
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec is None and "count" in dialog.error_label.text()
    assert dialog.tabs.currentIndex() == 1
    editor.table.item(1, 3).setText("20")
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec.params == (
        ScriptParam("item", "Item", "choice", "", 'return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];'),
        ScriptParam("count", "", "number", "20"))

    # Editing shows them again; removing the choice takes its code along.
    dialog = ScriptDialog(load_translations("de"), spec=dialog.spec)
    editor = dialog.param_editor
    assert editor.table.rowCount() == 2
    editor.table.selectRow(0)
    assert editor.options_edit.toPlainText() == 'return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];'
    editor.btn_remove.click()
    dialog._accept()
    assert [param.name for param in dialog.spec.params] == ["count"]


def test_running_by_hand_asks_for_the_parameters(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import scripts
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.script_params import ScriptRunDialog

    translations = load_translations("de")
    spec = ScriptSpec("return 1;", label="Items", params=(
        ScriptParam("item", "Item", "choice", "ItFo_Apple", "return [];"),
        ScriptParam("count", "Anzahl", "number", "1"),
        ScriptParam("all", "Alle", "bool")))
    worker = _FakeScriptWorker(4242)
    cache = {}

    # The choice's options come from the game; the last run's values are preselected.
    dialog = ScriptRunDialog(translations, spec, worker=worker, script_id=7,
                             options_cache=cache, last={"item": "ItFo_Pear", "count": 5})
    assert worker.requests == [("options", 7, "item")]
    combo = dialog._inputs["item"]
    assert not combo.isEnabled()
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args is None and dialog.error_label.text()  # nothing to pick yet
    worker.options_listed.emit(99, [{"label": "x", "value": "y"}])  # another request's
    assert not combo.isEnabled()
    options = [{"label": "Apfel", "value": "ItFo_Apple"}, {"label": "Birne", "value": "ItFo_Pear"},
               {"label": "ItFo_Plum", "value": "ItFo_Plum"}]
    worker.options_listed.emit(1, options)
    assert [combo.itemText(i) for i in range(3)] == [
        "Apfel  (ItFo_Apple)", "Birne  (ItFo_Pear)", "ItFo_Plum"]
    assert combo.currentText() == "Birne  (ItFo_Pear)"
    assert dialog._inputs["count"].text() == "5"
    dialog._inputs["all"].setChecked(True)
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args == {"item": "ItFo_Pear", "count": 5, "all": True}

    # A text that is no option is refused; the options are asked for only once.
    dialog = ScriptRunDialog(translations, spec, worker=worker, script_id=7, options_cache=cache)
    assert len(worker.requests) == 1
    assert dialog._inputs["item"].currentText() == "Apfel  (ItFo_Apple)"  # the default
    dialog._inputs["item"].setEditText("Bir")
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args is None and "Item" in dialog.error_label.text()
    dialog.close()

    # The panel runs it with the values typed in and keeps them for the next run.
    shown = []

    class _Accepting:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        def __init__(self, _translations, spec, **kwargs):
            shown.append((spec, kwargs))
            self.args = {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2, "all": False}

        def exec(self):
            return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptRunDialog", _Accepting)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(translations)
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        script_id = panel.add_script(spec)
        panel._worker.script_added.emit(script_id)
        panel.table.selectRow(0)
        panel.btn_run.click()
        assert panel._worker.requests[-1] == ("run", script_id, shown[0][0].default_args()
                                              | {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2})
        panel.btn_run.click()
        assert shown[1][1]["last"] == {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2, "all": False}
        assert shown[1][1]["options_cache"] is shown[0][1]["options_cache"]
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()
```

`tests/test_sessions.py`:

```py
"""The session registry, its window and the shutdown dialog, with fake workers."""

import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

from PySide6.QtCore import QThread  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.core import sessions
from grembyte.core.sessions import SESSIONS, frida_agents
from grembyte.ui.widgets.sessions import SessionsDialog, ShutdownDialog, duration_text

from tests.test_hooks import _wait_for, fixture_qt_app, fixture_translations, linux_only  # pylint: disable=unused-import


class _FakeFridaSession:
    def __init__(self):
        self.detached = threading.Event()

    def detach(self):
        self.detached.set()


class _Worker(QThread):
    """Runs until asked to stop, or (``hangs``) until its session is cut."""

    def __init__(self, pid, hangs=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.pid = pid
        self.hangs = hangs
        self.frida = _FakeFridaSession()

    @sessions.tracked(sessions.HOOKS)
    def run(self):
        SESSIONS.set_frida_session(self, self.frida)
        while not self.frida.detached.is_set():
            if self.isInterruptionRequested() and not self.hangs:
                return
            time.sleep(0.01)


def _start(qt_app, worker):
    worker.start()
    _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: any(s.worker is worker and s.frida_session
                                  for s in SESSIONS.sessions()))
    return next(s for s in SESSIONS.sessions() if s.worker is worker)


def test_registry_tracks_running_workers_only(qt_app):
    worker = _Worker(4242)
    assert not SESSIONS.sessions(4242)
    session = _start(qt_app, worker)
    assert (session.kind, session.pid, session.stopping) == (sessions.HOOKS, 4242, None)
    assert SESSIONS.sessions(1) == []
    SESSIONS.stop(session)
    assert worker.wait(2000)
    assert not SESSIONS.sessions(4242)


def test_window_lists_sessions_and_cuts_a_hanging_one(qt_app, translations):
    worker = _Worker(4243, hangs=True)
    session = _start(qt_app, worker)
    # A process without Frida agents (the tests' own may have one: the
    # syntax check's, see grembyte.hooks.syntax)
    clean = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(30)"])
    dialog = SessionsDialog(translations, lambda: clean.pid)
    try:
        assert dialog.table.rowCount() == 1
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 0).text() == "Hooks (Frida)"
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 3).text() == "aktiv"
        assert "0 Frida-Agenten" in dialog.agents_label.text()

        dialog.table.selectRow(0)
        dialog.stop_button.click()
        assert not worker.wait(200)
        session.stopping -= 10
        dialog.refresh()
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 3).text().startswith("reagiert nicht (10 s)")
        dialog.table.selectRow(0)
        assert dialog.disconnect_button.isEnabled()
        dialog.disconnect_button.click()
        assert worker.wait(2000)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: dialog.table.rowCount() == 0)
    finally:
        dialog.close()
        clean.kill()
        clean.wait()
        worker.frida.detach()
        worker.wait(2000)


def test_shutdown_waits_then_cuts_what_hangs(qt_app, translations):
    polite, stubborn = _Worker(4244), _Worker(4245, hangs=True)
    _start(qt_app, polite)
    _start(qt_app, stubborn)
    began = time.monotonic()
    # The polite one ends when asked; the stubborn one only when cut.
    result = ShutdownDialog(translations, timeout_s=0.5, grace_s=2).exec()
    assert result == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted
    assert stubborn.frida.detached.is_set() and not polite.frida.detached.is_set()
    assert time.monotonic() - began < 2.5
    assert polite.wait(1000) and stubborn.wait(1000)


def test_shutdown_gives_up_on_a_worker_that_ignores_everything(qt_app, translations):
    class _Deaf(_Worker):
        @sessions.tracked(sessions.TRACE)
        def run(self):
            SESSIONS.set_frida_session(self, self.frida)
            while not self.release.is_set():
                time.sleep(0.01)

    deaf = _Deaf(4246)
    deaf.release = threading.Event()
    _start(qt_app, deaf)
    try:
        result = ShutdownDialog(translations, timeout_s=0.2, grace_s=0.3).exec()
        assert result == QDialog.DialogCode.Rejected
        assert SESSIONS.sessions(4246)
    finally:
        deaf.release.set()
        deaf.wait(2000)
        qt_app.processEvents()


@linux_only
def test_counts_frida_agents_in_maps(tmp_path):
    maps = tmp_path / "77" / "maps"
    maps.parent.mkdir()
    maps.write_text(
        "7f00-7f10 r--p 00000000 00:01 5 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "7f10-7f20 r-xp 00010000 00:01 5 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "8f00-8f10 r--p 00000000 00:01 6 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "9f00-9f10 r--p 00000000 08:01 7 /usr/lib/libc.so.6\n")
    assert frida_agents(77, proc_root=str(tmp_path)) == 2
    assert frida_agents(78, proc_root=str(tmp_path)) == 0


def test_duration_text():
    assert [duration_text(s) for s in (4.9, 75, 3725)] == ["4 s", "1:15 min", "1:02 h"]


def test_workers_log_under_the_name_of_their_session(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    import logging

    from grembyte.core import logs

    class Named(QThread):
        pid = 4711

        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.names = []

        @sessions.tracked(sessions.NATIVE_TRACE)
        def run(self):
            self.names.append(threading.current_thread().name)
            logs.log.info("inside")

    records = []
    handler = logging.Handler()
    handler.emit = records.append
    logs.log.addHandler(handler)
    previous = logs.log.level
    logs.log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    worker = Named()
    try:
        worker.start()
        assert worker.wait(5000)
    finally:
        logs.log.removeHandler(handler)
        logs.log.setLevel(previous)
    name = worker.names[0]
    assert name.startswith("native_trace-") and name.split("-")[1].isdigit()
    assert [record.threadName for record in records
            if record.getMessage() in ("inside", "session native_trace started (pid 4711)",
                                       "session native_trace ended (pid 4711)")] == [name] * 3
```

```py
def test_the_window_saves_applies_and_resets(repository, qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument

    )

    assert not dialog.editors["activity_log"].isChecked()

def test_the_window_leaves_its_widgets_to_qt(qt_app, translations, repository):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument,import-outside-toplevel

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.settings_dialog import SettingsDialog

        dialog = SettingsDialog(translations, repository, parent=parent)

        assert not shiboken6.ownedByPython(dialog.pages)

def test_trace_agents_get_the_sequence_capacity():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from grembyte.features import native_trace, trace

    assert "const EVENT_CAPACITY = 250000;" in trace.build_agent_source(250_000)
    native = native_trace.build_agent_source(500_000)
    assert "const EVENT_CAPACITY = 500000;" in native
    # The table of first calls grows with it: twice the sequence, a power of two.
    assert f"const FIRST_CAPACITY = {1 << 20};" in native
    assert native_trace.first_capacity(100_000) == 1 << 19
    settings.apply({"trace_sequence": 20_000})
    assert "const EVENT_CAPACITY = 20000;" in trace.TraceWorker(1).agent_source()
    assert "const EVENT_CAPACITY = 20000;" in native_trace.NativeTraceWorker(1).agent_source()


def test_the_activity_log_follows_its_setting(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from grembyte import main
    from grembyte.core import activity

    monkeypatch.setenv("GREMBYTE_LOG_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    settings.subscribe(main._follow_activity_setting)
    try:
        settings.apply({"activity_log": True})
        assert activity.enabled()
        settings.apply({"activity_log": True})  # unchanged: nothing happens
        assert activity.enabled()
        settings.apply({"activity_log": False})
        assert not activity.enabled()
        events = [entry["event"] for entry in activity.read_entries(tmp_path / "activity.jsonl")]
        assert events[-1] == "activity_log_off"
        settings.apply({"activity_log": True})
        assert activity.enabled()
    finally:
        activity.teardown()
```

`tests/test_syntax.py`:

```py
"""Syntax check of hook scripts in Frida's engine (see grembyte.hooks.syntax)."""

import pytest

from grembyte.hooks.syntax import (
    BODY,
    FUNCTION,
    SyntaxChecker,
    SyntaxIssue,
    check_body,
    check_function,
    checker,
    looks_like_function,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not checker().available,
                                reason="needs Frida's system session")


def test_errors_name_the_line_of_the_checked_code():
    source = "function (ctx) {\n  const a = 1;\n  return ctx.result * ;\n}"

    assert check_function(source) == SyntaxIssue("unexpected token in expression: ';'", 3)
    assert check_body("const x = 1;\nif (x > ) return 2;").line == 2
    # A missing end is reported on the last line, not on what the check appends.
    assert check_function("function (ctx) {\n  return 1;\n").line == 3


def test_modern_javascript_passes():
    # Qt's engine rejects all of these; Frida's (in the game) runs them.
    for source in ("x => ({...x})", "x => x?.a ?? 1", "async x => await x", "x => 1n",
                   "function (ctx) { class A { b = 1 } return new A().b; }"):
        assert check_function(source) is None, source
    assert check_body("const { a, ...rest } = ctx.args; return rest;") is None


def test_the_code_is_compiled_not_run():
    assert check_body("throw new Error('ran');") is None
    assert check_body("while (true) {}") is None


def test_a_checker_without_frida_checks_nothing(monkeypatch):
    def refuse(_pid):
        raise OSError("no frida")

    monkeypatch.setattr("grembyte.hooks.syntax.frida.attach", refuse)
    without = SyntaxChecker()

    assert without.check(BODY, "if (") is None
    assert not without.available
    assert without.check(FUNCTION, "(") is None


def test_function_hint():
    assert looks_like_function("function (ctx) { return 1; }")
    assert looks_like_function("// doubles\nctx => ctx.new * 2")
    assert looks_like_function("/* a */ (ctx) => 1")
    assert looks_like_function("async function f(ctx) {}")
    assert not looks_like_function("ctx.result * 2")

```

```py
"""Copying rows and cells of tables (see grembyte.ui.widgets.table)."""

from PySide6.QtCore import QStringListModel, Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QComboBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QMenu,
    QTableView,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QWidget,
)

from grembyte.ui.widgets import table as table_module
from grembyte.ui.widgets.table import add_copy_actions, cell_text, copy_menu, row_text

from tests.test_hooks import fixture_qt_app, fixture_translations  # pylint: disable=unused-import


def _table():
    table = QTableWidget(1, 6)
    table.setItem(0, 0, QTableWidgetItem("0x1234"))
    table.setItem(0, 1, QTableWidgetItem("int32"))
    # A check box centred in a container, like the method monitor's options
    box = QWidget()
    check = QCheckBox()
    check.setChecked(True)
    QHBoxLayout(box).addWidget(check)
    table.setCellWidget(0, 2, box)
    combo = QComboBox()
    combo.addItems(["Zahl", "Code"])
    combo.setCurrentIndex(1)
    table.setCellWidget(0, 3, combo)
    table.setCellWidget(0, 4, QLabel('<a href="#">Objekt-Details</a>'))
    table.setItem(0, 5, QTableWidgetItem("secret"))
    table.setColumnHidden(5, True)
    return table


def test_cells_with_widgets_count_by_what_they_show(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    table = _table()
    assert [cell_text(table, 0, column) for column in range(6)] == [
        "0x1234", "int32", "✓", "Code", "", "secret"]
    # Hidden columns are left out of the row.
    assert row_text(table, 0) == "0x1234\tint32\t✓\tCode\t"


def test_views_with_a_model(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    view = QTableView()
    model = QStringListModel(["Game.Loot:Take", "Game.Inventory:AddGold"])
    view.setModel(model)
    assert cell_text(view, 1, 0) == "Game.Inventory:AddGold"
    assert row_text(view, 0) == "Game.Loot:Take"


def test_menu_actions_copy_the_row_and_the_cell_under_the_pointer(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    table = _table()
    table.resize(800, 200)
    table.show()
    position = table.visualRect(table.model().index(0, 1)).center()
    menu = QMenu()
    menu.addAction("Watch")
    add_copy_actions(menu, table, position, translations)
    actions = [action for action in menu.actions() if not action.isSeparator()]
    assert [action.text() for action in actions] == ["Watch", "Zeile kopieren", "Zelle kopieren"]
    actions[1].trigger()
    assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text() == "0x1234\tint32\t✓\tCode\t"
    actions[2].trigger()
    assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text() == "int32"

    # Outside the rows there is nothing to copy.
    empty = QMenu()
    add_copy_actions(empty, table, table.viewport().rect().bottomRight(), translations)
    assert empty.isEmpty()
    table.close()


def test_tables_without_a_menu_get_one(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    table = _table()
    copy_menu(table, translations)
    assert table.contextMenuPolicy() == Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu


def test_tables_with_a_remove_function_offer_to_delete_the_clicked_row(
        qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    table = QTableWidget(3, 1)
    for row in range(3):
        table.setItem(row, 0, QTableWidgetItem(f"row {row}"))
    table.setSelectionBehavior(QTableWidget.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    table.resize(400, 300)
    table.show()
    deleted = []
    copy_menu(table, translations, lambda: deleted.append(
        sorted(index.row() for index in table.selectionModel().selectedRows())))
    shown = []

    class Menu(QMenu):
        """Picks its first action instead of waiting for the user."""

        def exec(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
            shown.append([action.text() for action in self.actions()
                          if not action.isSeparator()])
            chosen = self.actions()[0]
            chosen.trigger()
            return chosen

    # PySide6 ignores methods patched onto QMenu itself; a subclass is used.
    monkeypatch.setattr(table_module, "QMenu", Menu)

    # The clicked row is selected first; the delete action acts on it.
    table.customContextMenuRequested.emit(table.visualRect(table.model().index(1, 0)).center())
    assert shown[-1] == ["Zeile löschen", "Zeile kopieren", "Zelle kopieren"]
    assert deleted == [[1]]

    # A selection of several rows the click is in stays, and is named.
    table.selectAll()
    table.customContextMenuRequested.emit(table.visualRect(table.model().index(2, 0)).center())
    assert shown[-1][0] == "3 Zeilen löschen"
    assert deleted[-1] == [0, 1, 2]
    table.close()
```

```py
def test_choices_round_trip():

    )

def test_debug_window_lists_filters_and_pauses(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from grembyte.ui.widgets import hook_debug
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.hook_debug import HookDebugWindow

    window = HookDebugWindow(translations)
    window.set_hooks({1: "#1 Gold", 2: "#2 Mana"})
    window.add_events([
        {"hookId": 1, "time": 0, "old": 100, "new": 110, "result": 130.0, "logs": ["x"]},
        {"hookId": 2, "time": 0, "skipped": "caller", "address": "0x10"},
        {"hookId": 1, "time": 0, "old": 1, "new": 2, "error": "Error: boom\nstack"},
    ], {1: 5})
    window.add_console("info", "hello")

    assert window.table.rowCount() == 4
    assert window.table.item(0, 7).text() == "130"
    assert "Ausgabe: x" in window.table.item(0, 8).text()
    assert "Aufrufer nicht gelernt" in window.table.item(1, 8).text()
    assert window.table.item(2, 8).text() == "Fehler: Error: boom"
    assert window.table.item(3, 1).text() == "Konsole"
    assert "5 vom Agenten verworfen" in window.count_label.text()

    window.table.selectRow(2)
    assert "stack" in window.details.toPlainText()

    window.filter_combo.setCurrentIndex(window.filter_combo.findData(1))
    assert window.table.rowCount() == 2

    window.btn_pause.setChecked(True)
    window.add_events([{"hookId": 1, "time": 0}])
    assert len(window.entries()) == 4
    assert "1 während der Pause" in window.count_label.text()

    window.btn_pause.setChecked(False)
    window.filter_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
    window.add_events([{"hookId": 1, "time": 0}] * hook_debug.MAX_ENTRIES)
    assert len(window.entries()) == hook_debug.MAX_ENTRIES
    assert window.table.rowCount() == hook_debug.MAX_ENTRIES


def test_method_templates_keep_their_kind_and_code(dialog, repository):
    # pylint: disable=protected-access
    script = next(i for i in range(dialog.template_list.count())
                  if dialog.template_list.item(i).text() == "Method script")
    dialog.template_list.setCurrentRow(script)
    assert dialog.hook_kind_combo.currentData() == "method"
    assert "ctx.result" in dialog.script_hint.text()
    # The code parameter keeps its kind and its multi-line default.
    assert dialog.param_table.cellWidget(0, 2).currentData() == "code"
    assert dialog.save()
    saved = next(t for t in repository.list_templates() if t.name == "Method script")
    assert saved.kind == "method"
    assert saved.parameters[0].kind == "code" and "attacker" in saved.parameters[0].default

    # A new template becomes a method template by choosing the kind.
    dialog._new_template()
    dialog.name_input.setText("Halbieren")
    dialog.hook_kind_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.hook_kind_combo.findData("method"))
    dialog.source_input.setPlainText("function (ctx) { return ctx.result / 2; }")
    assert dialog.save()
    assert next(t for t in repository.list_templates() if t.name == "Halbieren").kind == "method"

def test_syntax_errors_block_saving(dialog, repository):
    # pylint: disable=protected-access
    dialog._new_template()
    dialog.name_input.setText("Kaputt")
    dialog.source_input.setPlainText("function (ctx) {\n  return ctx.new * ;\n}")
    if not dialog.syntax_hint.problem():
        pytest.skip("needs Frida's system session")
    assert dialog.syntax_hint.text().startswith("Syntaxfehler in Zeile 2")

    assert not dialog.save()
    assert dialog.error_label.text().startswith("Syntaxfehler in Zeile 2")
    assert all(t.name != "Kaputt" for t in repository.list_templates())

    # The default of a code parameter is checked as a function body.
    dialog.source_input.setPlainText("function (ctx) { return ctx.new; }")
    assert dialog.syntax_hint.problem() is None
    assert dialog.syntax_hint.text() == "✓ Syntax in Ordnung"
    dialog._add_parameter_row(None)
    _set_cell(dialog, 0, 0, "code")
    dialog.param_table.cellWidget(0, 2).setCurrentIndex(2)  # code
    _set_cell(dialog, 0, 3, "if (")
    assert not dialog.save()
    assert dialog.error_label.text().startswith("code: Syntaxfehler")

    _set_cell(dialog, 0, 3, "return 1;")
    assert dialog.save()
```

`tests/test_text_viewer.py`:

```py
"""The text viewer for long strings, e.g. a save game's JSON."""

import json

from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from grembyte.ui.widgets.text_viewer import TextViewerDialog, parse_json, summary

from tests.test_hooks import fixture_qt_app, fixture_translations  # pylint: disable=unused-import

_SAVE = json.dumps({"m_StatisticsBuffers": [{"Key": "PlayTimeStatistic", "Value": []},
                                            {"Key": "Level", "Value": [3, 4]}],
                    "m_PlayerIndex": 1})


def test_json_is_recognized_only_for_objects_and_arrays():
    assert parse_json(_SAVE)["m_PlayerIndex"] == 1
    assert parse_json('  [1, 2]') == [1, 2]
    assert parse_json('"text"') is None and parse_json("42") is None
    assert parse_json("{not json") is None
    assert [summary(value) for value in ({"a": 1}, [1, 2, 3], "x", None, 2.5)] == [
        "{1}", "[3]", '"x"', "null", "2.5"]
    assert summary("x" * 300).endswith("…")


def test_json_shows_as_a_tree_filled_on_expanding(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    viewer = TextViewerDialog(translations, "statistic", _SAVE)
    try:
        assert viewer.tabs.tabText(0) == "Baum" and viewer.tabs.currentIndex() == 0
        assert "JSON" in viewer.info_label.text()
        top = viewer.tree.topLevelItem(0)
        assert (top.text(0), top.text(1)) == ("m_StatisticsBuffers", "[2]")
        assert top.childCount() == 0  # not filled before it is expanded
        top.setExpanded(True)
        assert [top.child(i).text(0) for i in range(top.childCount())] == ["[0]", "[1]"]
        # Formatted in the text tab
        assert viewer.plain.toPlainText().startswith('{\n  "m_StatisticsBuffers": [')

        viewer.tree.setCurrentItem(top.child(1))
        viewer.copy_button.click()
        assert json.loads(QGuiApplication.clipboard().text()) == {"Key": "Level",
                                                                  "Value": [3, 4]}
        viewer.tabs.setCurrentWidget(viewer.plain)
        viewer.copy_button.click()
        assert QGuiApplication.clipboard().text() == _SAVE
    finally:
        viewer.close()


def test_plain_text_and_a_cut_text(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument
    viewer = TextViewerDialog(translations, "name")
    try:
        assert not viewer.copy_button.isEnabled()  # still loading
        viewer.set_text("hello world", length=20)
        assert viewer.tabs.count() == 1 and viewer.plain.toPlainText() == "hello world"
        assert viewer.info_label.text() == "Die ersten 11 von 20 Zeichen"
        assert viewer.copy_button.isEnabled()
        viewer.show_missing()
        assert "nicht mehr verfügbar" in viewer.info_label.text()
    finally:
        viewer.close()


def test_monitor_details_link_every_string(qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument,import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from grembyte.features.monitor import MethodMonitorWorker
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.method_monitor import MethodMonitorDialog

    # No game: the worker is not started, the call below is made up.
    monkeypatch.setattr(MethodMonitorWorker, "start", lambda self: None)
    fetched = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(MethodMonitorWorker, "full_text",
                        lambda self, text_id: fetched.append(text_id) or 1)
    dialog = MethodMonitorDialog(translations, 999999)
    try:
        dialog.log.append([{"monitorId": 1, "time": 0, "args": [
            {"name": "name", "text": '"statistic"', "string": True},
            {"name": "count", "text": "3"},
            {"name": "none", "text": "null"}],
            "result": {"text": '"{\\"m_Statistics…', "string": True, "fullText": 9,
                       "length": 4000}}])
        dialog.log_view.selectRow(0)
        links = [dialog.details.cellWidget(row, 2) for row in range(4)]
        assert [link is not None for link in links] == [True, False, False, True]
        assert "9 Zeichen" in links[0].toolTip() and "4000 Zeichen" in links[3].toolTip()

        # A short string is all there; a long one comes from the agent.
        links[0].linkActivated.emit("#")
        viewer = dialog.findChildren(TextViewerDialog)[-1]
        assert viewer.text == "statistic"
        links[3].linkActivated.emit("#")
        assert fetched == [9]
        dialog.inspections._on_text_fetched(1, _SAVE)
        assert dialog.findChildren(TextViewerDialog)[-1].data["m_PlayerIndex"] == 1
    finally:
        for viewer in dialog.findChildren(TextViewerDialog):
            viewer.close()
        dialog.close()
```

```py
"""Tests for JSON UI theme loading and persistence."""

from grembyte.ui.styles.styles import build_stylesheet
from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations
from grembyte.ui.styles.themes import COLOR_KEYS, ThemeManager
from PySide6.QtCore import QStandardPaths  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
import pytest

from grembyte.core.messages import LocalizedValueError


class MemorySettings:
    def __init__(self):
        self.values = {}

    def value(self, key, default=None):
        return self.values.get(key, default)

    def setValue(self, key, value):
        self.values[key] = value


def test_default_theme_is_github_dark():
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes")

    assert manager.load_theme()["name"] == "Github-Dark"
    assert "Default" not in manager.available_themes()
    assert next(iter(manager.available_themes())) == "Github-Dark"
    assert manager.stylesheet() == build_stylesheet(manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"])
    assert "#e6edf3" in manager.stylesheet()


def test_unknown_saved_theme_falls_back_to_github_dark():
    settings = MemorySettings()
    settings.setValue("ui_theme", "Default")
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=settings, user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes")

    assert manager.load_theme()["name"] == "Github-Dark"


def test_saved_theme_is_discovered_and_can_be_selected(tmp_path):
    settings = MemorySettings()
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=settings, user_theme_dir=tmp_path)
    colors = manager.load_theme()["colors"]
    colors["background"] = "#102030"

    saved_path = manager.save_theme("Night_Test", colors)
    manager.set_current("Night_Test")

    assert saved_path.name == "grembyte_themes_Night_Test.json"
    assert manager.load_theme()["colors"]["background"] == "#102030"
    assert "$" not in manager.stylesheet()
    assert "#102030" in manager.stylesheet()



@pytest.mark.parametrize(("name", "broken", "key"), [
    ("Night Test", False, "error.theme.invalid_name"),
    ("Night_Test", True, "error.theme.invalid_colors"),
])
def test_theme_save_errors_are_translated(tmp_path, name, broken, key):
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir=tmp_path)
    colors = dict(manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"])
    if broken:
        colors["background"] = "not a colour"
    with pytest.raises(LocalizedValueError) as raised:
        manager.save_theme(name, colors)
    assert raised.value.key == key
    with pytest.raises(LocalizedValueError) as raised:
        manager.set_current("Missing")
    assert raised.value.key == "error.theme.unknown"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        QStandardPaths, "writableLocation",
        lambda location: str(tmp_path if location ==
                             QStandardPaths.StandardLocation.GenericConfigLocation
                             else tmp_path / "legacy"))
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings())

    assert manager.user_theme_dir == tmp_path / "grembyte" / "themes"

    assert "#0d1117" not in build_stylesheet(colors)

        translations = load_translations(language)

        assert all(f"theme.color.{key}" in translations for key in COLOR_KEYS)


def test_malformed_theme_is_ignored(tmp_path):

    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir=tmp_path)

    assert "Broken" not in manager.available_themes()


def test_older_user_theme_inherits_syntax_colors(tmp_path):
    import json

    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir=tmp_path)
    colors = manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"]
    for key in ("code_text", "code_keyword", "code_string", "code_number"):
        colors.pop(key)
    colors["background"] = "#102030"
    (tmp_path / "grembyte_themes_Old_Custom.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"name": "Old_Custom", "colors": colors}), encoding="utf-8")

    loaded = manager.load_theme("Old_Custom")["colors"]
    defaults = manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"]

    assert loaded["background"] == "#102030"
    assert all(loaded[key] == defaults[key]
               for key in ("code_text", "code_keyword", "code_string", "code_number"))


def test_user_theme_saved_before_content_colors_still_loads(tmp_path):
    import json

    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir=tmp_path)
    colors = manager.load_theme("Github-Light")["colors"]
    for key in ("purple", "orange"):
        colors.pop(key)
    # Same name as the bundled theme: the missing colours come from that one.
    (tmp_path / "grembyte_themes_Github-Light.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"name": "Github-Light", "colors": colors}), encoding="utf-8")

    loaded = manager.load_theme("Github-Light")["colors"]

    assert loaded["purple"] == "#8250df"
    assert loaded["orange"] == "#bc4c00"

def test_existing_menu_icons_follow_theme(monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtGui import QIcon  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMenu  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import apply_icon_theme, material_icon

    monkeypatch.setenv("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    application = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes")
    default_colors = manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"]
    apply_icon_theme(default_colors)
    menu = QMenu()
    action = menu.addAction(material_icon("track_changes"), "Trace")

    try:
        apply_icon_theme(manager.load_theme("Solarized-Light")["colors"])
        image = action.icon().pixmap(16, 16, QIcon.Mode.Normal).toImage()
        colors = {
            image.pixelColor(x, y).name()
            for x in range(image.width())
            for y in range(image.height())
            if image.pixelColor(x, y).alpha()
        }
        assert "#30525c" in colors
    finally:
        apply_icon_theme(default_colors)
        menu.deleteLater()
        application.processEvents()

def test_toolbar_logo_follows_the_theme(monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QLabel  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from grembyte.ui.widgets.icons import apply_icon_theme, set_brand_icon

    monkeypatch.setenv("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    application = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    manager = ThemeManager(settings=MemorySettings(), user_theme_dir="/tmp/no-grembyte-themes")
    default_colors = manager.load_theme("Github-Dark")["colors"]
    apply_icon_theme(default_colors)
    label = QLabel()
    set_brand_icon(label, 64)

    def opaque_colors():
        image = label.pixmap().toImage()
        return {
            image.pixelColor(x, y).name()
            for x in range(image.width())
            for y in range(image.height())
            if image.pixelColor(x, y).alpha() == 255
        }

    try:
        assert default_colors["brand"] in opaque_colors()
        light = manager.load_theme("Github-Light")["colors"]
        apply_icon_theme(light)
        assert light["brand"] != default_colors["brand"]
        assert opaque_colors() == {light["brand"]}
    finally:
        apply_icon_theme(default_colors)
        label.deleteLater()
        application.processEvents()
```

`tests/test_trace_filters.py`:

```py
"""Trace filters: choosing the methods worth tracing (no target process needed)."""

import os

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from grembyte.db.base import Base
from grembyte.db.repository.trace_filters import TraceFilterRepository
from grembyte.features.catalog import CatalogMethod
from grembyte.features.trace_filters import (
    BUILTIN_FILTERS,
    TraceFilter,
    has_number,
    is_generated,
    looks_like_change,
    name_parts,
    select_methods,
    word_matches,
)
from grembyte.ui.localization import load_translations


def _method(class_name, name, parameters="()", return_type="void", assembly="Assembly-CSharp",
            token=1):
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    return CatalogMethod(assembly, class_name, name, parameters, return_type, False, token,
                         f"{class_name}:{name} {parameters}")


_METHODS = [
    _method("Game.Inventory", "AddGold", "(int&,int)", token=1),
    _method("Game.Inventory", "get_Items", "()", "System.Collections.Generic.List`1", token=2),
    _method("Game.Player", "SetStateHealth", "(int)", token=3),
    _method("Game.StateMachine", "Tick", token=4),
    _method("Game.Garden", "Marigold", token=5),
    _method("Game.Player/<>c__DisplayClass1_0", "<Heal>b__0", token=6),
    _method("UI.HPBar", "set_Value", "(single)", token=7),
    _method("Game.Hero", "GetStat", "(int)", "int", token=8),
    _method("Game.Combat", "RollDamage", "(int,single)", "int", token=9),
    _method("AC.GlobalVariables", "SetIntegerValue", "(int,int)", token=10),
]


def _names(methods):
    return [f"{m.class_name}:{m.name}" for m in methods]


def _builtin(key):
    return next(f for f in BUILTIN_FILTERS if f.builtin == key)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, parts", [
    ("HPBar", ["hp", "bar"]),
    ("SetStateHealth", ["set", "state", "health"]),
    ("gold_amount", ["gold", "amount"]),
    ("addGold2", ["add", "gold", "2"]),
    ("Game.Inventory", ["game", "inventory"]),
])
def test_name_parts(text, parts):
    assert name_parts(text) == parts


@pytest.mark.parametrize("word, part, matches", [
    ("item", "item", True), ("item", "items", True), ("item", "itemize", False),
    ("stat", "state", False), ("stat", "stats", True),
    ("inventory", "inventoryslot", True), ("gold", "marigold", False),

def test_short_words_match_exactly_long_words_as_prefix(word, part, matches):

def test_signature_rules():
    add_gold, items, set_health = _METHODS[0], _METHODS[1], _METHODS[2]
    assert has_number(add_gold) and not has_number(items)
    assert looks_like_change(add_gold) and looks_like_change(_METHODS[6])  # set_Value
    assert not looks_like_change(items) and looks_like_change(set_health)
    assert is_generated(_METHODS[5]) and not is_generated(add_gold)


def test_builtin_filters_pick_game_values_not_lookalikes():
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("money")])) == ["Game.Inventory:AddGold"]
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("inventory")])) == [
        "Game.Inventory:AddGold", "Game.Inventory:get_Items"]
    stats = _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("stats")]))
    assert "Game.Hero:GetStat" in stats and "UI.HPBar:set_Value" in stats
    assert "Game.StateMachine:Tick" not in stats
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("combat")])) == ["Game.Combat:RollDamage"]
    assert "AC.GlobalVariables:SetIntegerValue" in _names(
        select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("progress")]))


def test_filters_combine_with_or_and_words_narrow():
    both = select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("money"), _builtin("combat")])
    assert _names(both) == ["Game.Inventory:AddGold", "Game.Combat:RollDamage"]
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [_builtin("money"), _builtin("combat")],
                                 ["roll"])) == ["Game.Combat:RollDamage"]
    # without filters only the words count
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [], ["inventory"])) == [
        "Game.Inventory:AddGold", "Game.Inventory:get_Items"]


def test_generated_code_is_left_out_unless_asked_for():

    assert select_methods(_METHODS, [healing]) == []
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [healing], generated=True)) == [
        "Game.Player/<>c__DisplayClass1_0:<Heal>b__0"]


def test_user_filter_from_text_with_exclusions_and_rules():

                                         numbers=True)
    assert trace_filter.words == ("player", "hero", "stat")
    assert trace_filter.exclude == ("state",)
    assert _names(select_methods(_METHODS, [trace_filter])) == ["Game.Hero:GetStat"]

    assert rebuilt == trace_filter
    assert not TraceFilter("leer").matches(_METHODS[0])

    assert copy.builtin == "" and copy.filter_id is None and copy.words == _builtin("money").words


@pytest.fixture(name="repository")

    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    return TraceFilterRepository(sessionmaker(bind=engine))


def test_repository_keeps_user_filters(repository):
    gold_id = repository.save_filter(TraceFilter.from_text("Gold", "gold coin"))
    repository.save_filter(TraceFilter.from_text("Alpha", "alpha", numbers=True))
    assert [f.name for f in repository.list_filters()] == ["Alpha", "Gold"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        repository.save_filter(TraceFilter.from_text("Gold", "other"))
    repository.save_filter(TraceFilter.from_text("Gold", "gold coin money", filter_id=gold_id))
    gold = next(f for f in repository.list_filters() if f.name == "Gold")
    assert gold.words == ("gold", "coin", "money") and gold.filter_id == gold_id
    repository.delete_filter(gold_id)
    assert [f.name for f in repository.list_filters()] == ["Alpha"]

def test_panel_counts_and_selects(qt_app, repository):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from grembyte.ui.widgets.trace_filters import TraceFilterPanel

    translations = load_translations("de")
    repository.save_filter(TraceFilter.from_text("Gold", "gold"))
    panel = TraceFilterPanel(translations, repository)
    assert panel.selection() is None  # no method list yet
    panel.set_candidates(_METHODS)
    texts = [panel.list.item(row).text() for row in range(panel.list.count())]
    assert "Geld (1)" in texts and "Gold (1)" in texts and "Kampf (1)" in texts
    # nothing ticked: every method but the generated one
    assert len(panel.selection()) == len(_METHODS) - 1
    combat = next(row for row in range(panel.list.count())
                  if panel.list.item(row).text().startswith("Kampf"))
    panel.list.item(combat).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    assert _names(panel.selection()) == ["Game.Combat:RollDamage"]
    # built-in filters cannot be deleted
    panel.list.setCurrentRow(combat)
    assert panel.edit_button.isEnabled() and not panel.delete_button.isEnabled()


def test_editor_saves_a_new_filter_without_repository(qt_app):
```

`tests/test_trace_selection.py`:

```py
"""Which catalog methods a Mono trace hooks (see select_methods)."""

from grembyte.features.catalog import CatalogMethod
from grembyte.features.trace import (
    IMPL_INTERNAL_CALL,
    METHOD_ABSTRACT,
    METHOD_PINVOKE,
    select_methods,
    untraceable,
)

_STATIC = 0x10
# The catalog's ``classes`` answer with the flags, as the agent sends it
_CLASSES = [
    ["Game.Loot", [
        ["Take", "(int&,int)", "System.Void", True, 0x06000002, "Game.Loot:Take (int&,int)",
         _STATIC, 0],
        ["Roll", "()", "System.Int32", False, 0x06000003, "Game.Loot:Roll ()",
         METHOD_ABSTRACT, 0],
    ]],
    ["Game.Native", [
        ["Beep", "()", "System.Void", True, 0x06000004, "Game.Native:Beep ()",
         _STATIC | METHOD_PINVOKE, 0],
        ["Now", "()", "System.Single", True, 0x06000005, "Game.Native:Now ()",
         _STATIC, IMPL_INTERNAL_CALL],
    ]],
    ["R3.ReactiveProperty<T>", [
        ["set_Value", "(T)", "System.Void", False, 0x0600000e,
         "R3.ReactiveProperty`1:set_Value (T)", 0, 0],
    ]],
]


def test_only_methods_with_code_of_their_own_are_traced():
    methods, skipped = select_methods({"Assembly-CSharp": _CLASSES}, [])

    assert methods == [CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Loot", "Take", "(int&,int)",
                                     "System.Void", True, 0x06000002,
                                     "Game.Loot:Take (int&,int)")]
    assert skipped == {"abstract": 1, "native": 2, "generic": 1}


def test_words_choose_by_class_method_and_assembly():
    def chosen(*words):
        methods, skipped = select_methods({"Assembly-CSharp": _CLASSES}, words)
        return [method.name for method in methods], sum(skipped.values())

    assert chosen("LOOT", "take") == (["Take"], 0)
    # Methods that cannot be traced count only when they match too.
    assert chosen("loot") == (["Take"], 1)
    assert chosen("native") == ([], 2)
    assert chosen("csharp") == (["Take"], 4)
    assert chosen("nothing") == ([], 0)


def test_generic_methods_of_a_generic_definition_are_untraceable():
    assert untraceable("Ns.List<T>", "Add", "Ns.List`1:Add (T)", 0, 0) == "generic"
    # Method<T>: Mono names it without its type parameters in the signature.
    assert untraceable("Ns.Util", "Find", "Ns.Util:Find<T> (T)", 0, 0) == "generic"
    assert untraceable("Ns.Util", "Find", "Ns.Util:Find (int)", 0, 0) is None
```
